title: Configuration Analyst II
description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.


The Job

The Configuration Analyst II supports implementation, maintenance, and governance of SCAN Health Plan’s Benefit Configuration, including Prior Authorization (PA) and Pre-Determination (PD) code sets. This role ensures approved code sets are accurately and timely configured across claims, utilization management, and related operational systems.


The Configuration Analyst II partners with Medical Policy, Utilization Management, Configuration, Information Technology, delegated entities, providers, and vendors to support configuration, reporting, data analysis, system maintenance, and process improvement activities.


You Will

  • Maintains PA and PD code sets across claims, utilization management, and related operational systems.
  • Supports benefit configuration and prior authorization activities, including configuration, testing, validation, deployment, and post implementation review.
  • Serves as a technical liaison for PA and PD configuration activities with internal teams, delegated entities, providers, and vendors.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves benefits and authorization-related configuration issues, technical inquiries, and system problems impacting operational workflows.
  • Supports Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) readiness by completing assigned benefit configuration activities, validating configuration accuracy, and meeting established implementation timelines.
  • Analyzes data to identify trends, risks, process improvement opportunities, and operational or financial impacts.
  • Supports continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing workflows, reporting capabilities, data quality, system functionality, and operational efficiency.
  • Creates and maintains procedures, workflow documentation, training materials, and other resources supporting PA and PD list operations.
  • Maintains knowledge of healthcare coding standards, authorization processes, CMS regulations, healthcare technology, and related best practices.
  • We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
  • Actively support the achievement of SCAN’s Vision and Goals.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 2 or more years of experience in healthcare systems, operations, analytics, medical coding, utilization management, or related technical functions.
  • 2 or more years of experience with reporting, data analysis, SQL, or healthcare-related data.
  • Experience working with healthcare coding systems, code set maintenance, or authorization-related processes.
    Knowledge of healthcare coding systems, including CPT®, HCPCS, and related code sets.
  • Understanding of healthcare claims processing, utilization management, authorization workflows, and healthcare operations.
  • Knowledge of CMS regulations and Medicare Advantage and Medicaid program requirements preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including data interpretation, issue identification, root cause analysis, and solution development.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, performance measurement methodologies, SQL, reporting tools, and business intelligence platforms preferred.
  • QNXT experience is required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related business productivity applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Commitment to accuracy, quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and standard office-based work activities, including computer and office equipment use for extended periods.

Experience Preferred:


  • Experience managing Prior Authorization or Pre-Determination Lists.
  • Experience working with Medicare Advantage and/or Medicaid managed care programs.
  • Experience supporting healthcare claims, utilization management, or medical policy operations.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
  • Familiarity with healthcare vendor platforms such as MHK, ikaSystems, CareAxis, or similar applications.
  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled analytical tools and automation technologies.
  • Coursework or training in healthcare analytics, healthcare informatics, business intelligence, or database management.
  • Certification or coursework in SQL and Power BI.
  • Certification in healthcare analytics, data visualization, business intelligence, or related technical discipline.

What's in it for you?


  • Base salary range: $71,700 to $103,732 per year
  • Work Mode: Mostly Remote
  • An annual employee bonus program
  • Robust Wellness Program
  • Generous paid-time-off (PTO)
  • Eleven paid holidays per year, plus 1 floating holiday, plus 1 birthday holiday
  • Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match and contribution
  • Robust employee recognition program
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

We're always looking for talented people to join our team! Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now!

description:

ABOUT JNB BEARINGS PVT LTD

JNB Bearings Pvt Ltd is a technology-driven, fast-growing industrial distribution company headquartered in Chennai. We supply industrial bearings, pillow blocks, V-belts, and oil seals to manufacturing clients across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Maharashtra.

We operate on documented SOPs, digital approval workflows, and ERP-grade accounting systems — with a performance culture that mirrors the operating standards of much larger corporates. Our finance function is fully digitised, from GST e-invoicing and e-way bill generation to real-time bank reconciliation and cloud-based payroll.

We are building a modern, system-driven finance function powered by automation, compliance, and operational discipline. If you want your accounting skills genuinely put to use — in an organisation where systems matter and finance is treated as a strategic function — this is where you belong.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a meticulous, technology-proficient, and deadline-driven Accounts Executive to join our Finance team. This hands-on role demands strong familiarity with GST compliance, multi-platform accounting software, and high-volume transaction processing. You will be a direct contributor to the company's financial accuracy, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance.

This is not a passive back-office position. It is built for a professional who takes initiative, values precision, and thrives in a disciplined, systems-driven environment.

TECHNOLOGY STACK YOU WILL WORK WITH

Proficiency across multiple platforms below is mandatory; experience with all is highly preferred.

Zoho BooksZoho PayrollZoho ExpenseTally Prime
GST PortalE-Invoicing SystemE-Way Bill PortalMS Excel / Google Sheets

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Day-to-Day Accounting Operations

  • Manage purchase and sales entry processing with accuracy and within timelines
  • Maintain and update books of accounts on Zoho Books and Tally Prime daily
  • Post journal entries, debit/credit notes, and adjustment entries as required
  • Ensure every accounting entry complies with applicable accounting standards and GST regulations

B. GST, E-Invoicing & Statutory Compliance

  • Handle GST billing, invoice verification, and GSTR-2A/2B reconciliation against purchase records
  • Support GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B return preparation and coordinate directly with the CA/tax consultant
  • Generate e-invoices and e-way bills accurately; manage amendments and cancellations
  • Post TDS entries, run deductee-wise reconciliation, and support quarterly TDS return filing

C. Accounts Receivable & Payable

  • Own the complete AR/AP cycle — invoice tracking, aging analysis, and payment follow-ups
  • Coordinate vendor payments and ensure timely settlement within agreed credit terms
  • Monitor outstanding receivables and proactively flag overdue accounts to the Finance Manager
  • Maintain vendor ledgers, reconcile supplier statements, and resolve discrepancies

D. Bank Reconciliation & Cash Flow

  • Perform daily/weekly bank reconciliation across multiple accounts to a high standard of accuracy
  • Coordinate with banks on NEFT/RTGS/IMPS transactions and resolve query items promptly
  • Track and report cash and bank positions on a daily basis

E. Payroll & Expense Management

  • Coordinate monthly payroll through Zoho Payroll — attendance inputs, salary statements, disbursement
  • Review employee expense claims on Zoho Expense; verify against policy and route for approval
  • Maintain payroll records and support PF/ESI coordination where applicable

F. MIS Reporting & Financial Data

  • Prepare weekly and monthly MIS reports covering AR/AP aging, GST status, bank balances, and expenses
  • Support preparation of monthly P&L and balance sheet data for management review
  • Keep organised digital records of all vouchers, invoices, and supporting documents for audit access

G. Audit & Compliance Coordination

  • Keep documentation audit-ready at all times — not only at year-end
  • Support monthly and year-end closing — journal reviews, ledger finalisation, provision entries
  • Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, and the CA firm during audit periods
  • Respond to audit queries promptly and supply required records on time
  • Help streamline accounting workflows and automation within Zoho Books to reduce manual effort

PERFORMANCE KPIS

Accountability is built into every role at JNB Bearings. Performance is reviewed monthly against these metrics:

KPI MetricTarget / BenchmarkReview Frequency
GST Filing Accuracy (GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B)100% error-free submissionsMonthly
Bank Reconciliation TurnaroundCompleted by the 3rd of every monthMonthly
Ledger Accuracy RateZero unresolved discrepancies beyond 7 daysWeekly
Vendor Payment Tracking100% payments released on scheduleWeekly
MIS Report SubmissionDelivered by the 5th of the following monthMonthly
Payroll Coordination AccuracyZero salary errors or missed disbursementsMonthly
Expense Verification TurnaroundAll claims processed within 48 hoursWeekly
E-Invoice / E-Way Bill Accuracy100% compliance; zero portal errorsDaily
Audit Readiness ScoreAll records retrievable within 24 hoursQuarterly
Documentation AccuracyZero missing or misfiled transaction recordsMonthly

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Educational Qualification

  • B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) from a recognised university
  • CA Inter / CMA Inter candidates with relevant work experience will be given strong preference

Work Experience

  • 2–5 years of core accounting experience in a trading, manufacturing, or distribution environment
  • Hands-on experience with GST filing, TDS, bank reconciliation, and AP/AR
  • Prior experience across multiple accounting platforms is a definite advantage

Technical Skills (Mandatory)

  • Working knowledge of Zoho Books or equivalent cloud accounting software
  • Proficiency in Tally Prime, including voucher types and ledger management
  • GST portal operations — GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B reconciliation, e-invoicing, e-way bill
  • Competence in MS Excel or Google Sheets

Behavioural Competencies

title: Commercial Operations & Commercial Excellence Director
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

This position is an exciting opportunity to work with the Diabetes business. Medtronic announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and to reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic. The Diabetes division, now known as MiniMed, completed its IPO in March 2026. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investment to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care. While you will start your employment with Medtronic, upon completion of required local legal and employment processes, we expect your employment to transfer to MiniMed, subject to business needs and any applicable information and consultation requirements in your jurisdiction.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Excellence & Operations Director to lead MiniMed commercial transformation and operational excellence initiatives across our Emerging EMEA region, comprising Russia, Central Asia, Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East, Turkey, and Africa. This strategic leadership position is responsible for driving sales enablement, commercial analytics, operational governance, and indirect channel management to accelerate revenue growth and enhance commercial execution.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Enablement

  • Design and deliver competency training programs and develop incentive strategies aligned with commercial excellence objectives and business goals
  • Create and implement StartUp training curriculum for new salespeople, ensuring rapid ramp-up and early productivity
  • Develop comprehensive competency frameworks that define required skills, behaviors, and performance standards across all sales roles and experience levels
  • Lead commercial upskilling strategy, encompassing curriculum design, content development, and delivery mechanisms tailored to regional markets
  • Design and implement Sales Incentive Plan (SIP) strategies that drive desired behaviors, motivate performance, and align with regional and global commercial priorities
  • Evaluate, select, and deploy enablement tools and platforms that enhance sales productivity, knowledge sharing, and performance management
  • Ensure flawless execution of strategy through robust governance, measurement frameworks, and continuous improvement processes

Analytics and Operations

  • Generate actionable commercial insights through data analysis, market research, and competitive intelligence to inform strategy and decision-making
  • Develop and implement predictive analytics capabilities to forecast sales performance, identify trends, and optimize resource allocation
  • Establish and enforce governance frameworks, policies, and standards for commercial excellence that ensure consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency across the region
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop dashboards that provide visibility into sales enablement effectiveness and commercial execution

Indirect Channel Management

  • Oversee indirect channel partner enablement programs, ensuring partners have access to training, tools, and resources necessary for successful commercial execution
  • Develop partner competency frameworks and incentive programs that align partner interests with company objectives
  • Implement channel management processes, policies, and performance standards that drive accountability and excellence
  • Build and maintain partner relationships, providing strategic guidance and operational support
  • Monitor channel performance through analytics and provide coaching to optimize partner productivity

Commercial Operations

  • Tendering and Contracting execution and portal administration, enforce pricing strategy and operations in alignment with global.
  • Event operations management - vendor and logistics coordination, ensuring healthcare compliance and reporting, securing approvals to post-event follow up.
  • Ensuring governance, policies and standards for commercial excellence and operations are met in line with Global requirements

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with regional Sales leadership to align enablement initiatives with commercial strategies and revenue targets
  • Collaborate with Human Resources on talent development, performance management, and organizational design
  • Work with Finance to develop business cases, manage budgets, and demonstrate ROI on enablement and operational initiatives
  • Liaise with global Commercial Excellence teams to ensure consistency with global standards while addressing regional needs
  • Lead cross-functional projects and drive change management initiatives to support commercial transformation

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in sales enablement, commercial excellent and operations, or related functions within complex, global organizations
  • Minimum of 7 years of people management experience
  • Demonstrated success designing and implementing sales training programs, competency frameworks, and enablement strategies
  • Strong background in sales incentive design, analytics, and performance management
  • Proven ability to develop and interpret complex business analytics, dashboards, and performance metrics
  • Experience managing indirect channels or partner enablement programs
  • Excellent project management and change management capabilities
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence across organizational levels
  • Fluency in English; additional EMEA regional languages highly valuable
  • Willingness to travel within the Emerging EMEA region as needed

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute comprehensive commercial excellence strategies aligned with business objectives
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Proficiency in analytics, metrics, and using insights to drive business decisions
  • Change Management: Capability to lead organizational change and drive adoption of new processes and systems
  • Leadership: Strong ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive accountability
  • Project Management: Excellence in planning, executing, and delivering complex, multi-workstream initiatives
  • Communication: Clear, persuasive communication skills across diverse audiences and cultures
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of sales processes, revenue models, and commercial dynamics
  • Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in dynamic, complex environments with evolving requirements

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About us

We are a technology consulting firm providing high-impact data and automation solutions in healthcare, fintech, and insurance. Our clients range from startups to well-established enterprises. You will join a team of over 40 members distributed across Canada, working in a remote-first environment. Our clients choose us because we practice extreme ownership and deliver solutions that truly work. We move quickly, think deeply, and take pride in our partnerships.

What we're looking for

We are seeking an exceptional problem solver who lives at the intersection of technical excellence and scalable solutions. You will use your deep technical knowledge and product sense to deliver high-quality, robust software solutions.

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will take ownership of key project areas, leading technical implementation and promoting engineering best practices. You will collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to successfully deliver and scale solutions.

The ideal candidate will possess a comprehensive understanding of both back-end and front-end systems, exceptional problem-solving abilities, and a strong passion for developing outstanding, scalable products. This role requires the ability to deliver rapidly while upholding high standards and demonstrating strong ownership of all deliverables.

Responsibilities

Technical Excellence & Ownership
  • Create, own, and maintain high-quality, readable code that is appropriately flexible, reusable, and adaptable to changing requirements
  • Own the full lifecycle of software products from design to production, including bugfixes, load testing, penetration testing, and accessibility remediation
  • Tackle the hardest technical challenges in a project and provide early unlocks to the blind spots.
  • Debug complex issues across full technology stacks and code bases effectively while maintaining both speed and quality
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt and potential future challenges
  • Take full ownership of smaller project areas while maintaining high standards of code quality
  • Switch between optimizing for speed versus quality based on team requirements
Scalable Solutions & Impact
  • Translate product requirements and tickets into clear, efficient code solutions.
  • Create and share project and domain-specific knowledge that benefits other engineers.
  • Go deep into technical problems, advocate for solutions, get buy-in from stakeholders, and rally the engineers behind the solution.
  • Design and implement highly scalable, performant, and resilient full-stack systems.
Quality and Craftsmanship
  • Champions craftsmanship and maintains high standards.
  • Looks for ways to simplify code and infrastructure, prioritizing maintenance and migration costs.
  • Prioritize developer efficiency and prevent the reinvention of the wheel.
  • Create code that avoids common pitfalls and "code smells".
  • Actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback while remaining open to learning opportunities.
Project Execution & Communication
  • Work effectively on moderately defined project areas, incorporating review and guidance from senior technical leaders.
  • Develop deep self-sufficiency in at least one large area of the project while maintaining broad understanding across the system.
  • Communicate technical designs effectively through proofs of concept and documentation.
  • Clearly communicate assumptions and actively seek clarification when needed.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality work on schedule and follow through on commitments.
  • Think multiple steps ahead to anticipate and prevent potential problems.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements for a successful candidate:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of full-time work experience, or equivalent, as a:
    • Full-stack or back-end software developer
    • Data engineer
    • Engineering manager
    • Start-up founder
  • Advanced proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
  • Proficient in at least one of the following programming languages: Typescript/Javascript, Python, Go, C#, or Rust.
  • Strong understanding of databases and data modelling.
  • Experience building and maintaining REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience building front-end web apps using modern technologies & frameworks (e.g., React, Node).
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization (e.g., Docker).
  • Familiarity with enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines.
Your candidacy is enhanced by:
  • In-depth business knowledge of a particular area/sector (e.g. financial payments, insurance, healthcare, government, etc)
  • Knowledge of front-end performance optimization techniques and responsive design principles.
  • Knowledge of front-end design systems and component libraries.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and infrastructure as code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform).
This role probably isn’t for you if:
  • You want cleanly defined tasks assigned for you by a manager.
  • You always want to “hop on a call” rather than read or write clear documentation.
  • You struggle to clearly communicate ideas with internal and external stakeholders.
  • You are a front-end or mobile developer with limited back-end experience.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible hours: We are a fully remote company. Work on your schedule–pick up the kids, go to the dentist–you decide when you work.
  • Compensation: We offer a competitive salary and health benefits package, including a Wellness spending account.
  • Continuous learning: Access a dedicated learning budget to deepen your expertise. Complete certification programs in GCP, AWS, and other technologies.
  • Time off: It’s no secret we all have lives outside of work. Jet off to your favourite spot or just relax with flexible paid vacation days and sick days.
  • Annual team retreat: Once a year, we meet in person to collaborate, reconnect, and reset.

title: Senior Investment Coordinator
description:
Senior Investment Coordinator

Department: Total Portfolio Management - Investment Division

Type: Contract - 12 Month

Location: Toronto (Hybrid)

Posting Date: September 25, 2026


At OPTrust, paying pensions today, preserving pensions for tomorrow is our mission and business.


When you choose OPTrust, you join a team of smart, talented people who fuel our success and have a passion for pensions. Everyone at OPTrust – in Toronto, London and Sydney – makes a meaningful impact. Our culture is driven by team members with different backgrounds and perspectives creating an inclusive and fulfilling place to work for everyone. We work in a fast-paced environment, but we find time to have fun and give back to the community.


What OPTrust offers you


  • Unique culture rooted in our core values – collaboration and teamwork, integrity, respect, flexibility, excellence and continuous improvement.
  • A purpose-driven environment where we all work towards the common goal of paying pensions today and preserving pensions for tomorrow.
  • A flexible, hybrid work model.
  • Benefits package after six months of consecutive employment.
  • Optional membership in our world-class defined benefit pension plan.
  • A dedicated inclusion, diversity and equity strategy with meaningful opportunities to participate, including our employee-led resource groups.

About the role


Reporting to the Senior Executive Managing Director and Global Head of Liquid Assets, Total Portfolio Management (TPM), this role will oversee various operational and business administration aspects for TPM. The Senior Investment Coordinator, TPM will perform diverse functions to support the advancement of TPM's priorities across OPTrust. Their actions will also contribute to the ongoing strengthening of the team’s culture.


This role is well-suited for a highly organized individual who can handle a large volume of requests and possesses and brings perceptive and an understanding of how to support a large Investment team with multiple leaders. Additionally, this role requires someone who understands the confidentiality and urgency required to undertake operational issues and ensure internal controls are met.


What you’ll do


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, providing responsive and professional support across a broad range of business activities.
  • Manage the calendar and incoming inquiries of the Senior Executive Managing Director and Global Head of Liquid Assets, Total Portfolio Management.
  • Manage complex calendars and administrative priorities for senior leadership, proactively coordinating schedules, meeting logistics, and competing business demands.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders, service providers, and business partners to support team objectives and strategic initiatives.
  • Manage vendor relationships, including account administration, contract negotiations, service agreements, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Lead procurement activities for research, services, and operational requirements, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and budget parameters.
  • Prepare business cases, conduct vendor due diligence, and support data gathering and market research to inform procurement decisions.
  • Oversee multiple cost centres and departmental budgets, including forecasting, invoice processing, expense tracking, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
  • Administer centralized research budgets and external manager fee expenditures, ensuring accurate allocation and adherence to established financial controls.
  • Perform account reconciliations and prepare periodic financial reports to support governance, transparency, and budget management.
  • Coordinate investment committee, leadership, and team meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, material development, minute-taking, and follow-up activities.
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis, research, and special projects to support business priorities and decision-making.
  • Ensure all activities are executed in accordance with procurement, governance, financial, and organizational policies.
  • Provide broader administrative and operational support to the team and undertake additional responsibilities as required.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Ensure clear understanding and adherence of all OPTrust’s policies, procedures, guidelines as well as living our values and fostering an inclusive culture.

What you bring


  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience working directly with investment professionals, preferably with exposure to knowledge management processes.
  • A university education related to business, finance, or other relevant disciplines with knowledge of the investment or pension industry is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience and knowledge in the investment related procurement process.
  • Proven track record in negotiation of contract terms and pricing.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat Pro, with strong PowerPoint and Excel experience preferred.
  • Detail-oriented, with experience supporting teams and balancing multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Effective listening, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize and deliver high-quality, professional work products.
  • Self-motivated and able to work with minimum supervision, as well as a team player.
  • Analytical/Problem solving skills to learn quickly and to identify and resolve problems.
  • Demonstrated service orientation and relationship management skills with a demonstrated ability to forge strong relationships with internal stakeholders and a variety of external partners at all levels.
  • Demonstrated project management, planning, organization and time management skills.
  • Canadian Securities Course (CSC) preferred.
  • Exemplify OPTrust’s values: collaboration and teamwork, integrity, respect, flexibility, excellence, and continuous improvement.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


The range of expected compensation for this position is $87,018 to $104,116 per year.


Please submit your application via Workday by October 9, 2026.

Serving a membership as diverse as ours and investing in a global market means cultivating an environment that embraces inclusion, diversity, and equity in everything we do. OPTrust is an organization engaged in building on our unique and diverse strengths. We know a diversity of backgrounds, cultures, gender identities and perspectives are critical to achieving our shared goals.

If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please send a message to careers@optrust.com, or discuss your needs with the Talent Acquisition Consultant during the telephone screening. We will do our best to work with you and provide appropriate accommodation.

title: Quality Tech - Martin
description:
Position Summary: Monitors production processes of the facility to ensure all products meet company quality and food safety requirements during plant operations to ensure compliance with all company, regulatory and USDA standards.

Role qualifications:

Employee will need to be able to:

  • Lift and stack up to 40 – 80 pounds
  • Work at a fast pace for up to 3 hours at a time
  • Work in a warm, dusty environment for extended periods.
  • Work in a cold, moist environment for extended periods.
  • Push and/or pull heavy objects
  • Tolerate the sight of continuous moving objects
  • Walk up and down multiple flights of stairs multiple times daily.
  • Work in all weather conditions
  • Be around chemicals for extended periods
  • Adheres to all safety requirements including PPE (Personal Protective Equipment), preventing, and reporting unsafe acts and conditions, Lockout-Tagout procedures and Process Safety Management related matters.
  • Maintains clean and safe working environment.
  • Ensures product meets internal and customer specifications and takes appropriate actions when a non-compliance is noted.
  • Accurately conducts product reviews for compliance to include grading, packaging, temperature control and weights.
  • Performs and accurately records quality checks on product and regulatory checks as specified within company programs and USDA regulations.
  • Monitors associates' work practices and addresses any deficiencies noticed immediately while continually evaluating potential for foreign material contamination while in assigned work areas.
  • Inspects equipment for cleanliness and proper working condition prior to start up and records findings.
  • Monitor production employees to ensure GMP compliance and reports violations
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by Supervisor

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Be dependable and honest.
  • Time management: the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Strong team player
  • Commitment to company values
  • Be able to work overtime when needed.
  • Attention to detail a must
  • Wear employer-specified protective gear, including gloves, face/eye shields, aprons, boots, etc. (some of which to be supplied by employer).
  • Exposure to chemical solution (with protective gear)
  • Perform varying tasks while standing, lifting, crouching, etc. during long periods of time.
  • Perform all tasks safely and in a manner that will not create or pose a direct threat to the health and/or safety of the sanitation worker or any other person.

Physical Demands and work environment: The physical and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions

of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical demands and work environment: Exposure primarily consists of wet and moist floors which include metal grating surfaces. May be exposed to temperatures of 28 degrees to 100 degrees Fahrenheit. May handle product 25 degrees to 50 degrees Fahrenheit. May be exposed to noise ranges of 50 db to 110 db. May be exposed to dust, feathers and all chemicals used in poultry, food, processing facility. Must wear and use protective and safety equipment required for the job as directed by the Company. Occasional exposure to carbon dioxide vapors 10ppm and chlorine less than 20 ppm. Able to stand for several hours. Work may include lifting (up to 80 lbs.), reaching, bending, pushing, extending.

title: Senior Sales/Business Manager | Software Engineering
description:
Java | iOS | Android | Cloud | DevOps | Specialists | Teams | Deliveries | Products

Vill du inte bara sälja IT-konsulter – utan vara med och bygga affären, erbjudandena och bolaget bakom dem? Deploja söker en Commercial Director som vill ta ett ledande kommersiellt ansvar för vår fortsatta tillväxt.

Ditt primära fokus blir att utveckla våra affärer inom Java, iOS och Android, samtidigt som du får friheten att utveckla kunder inom hela vårt erbjudande – från .NET, Cloud och DevOps till test, data och arkitektur.

Vi säljer inte bara CV:n. Affären kan vara en senior specialist, ett komplett utvecklingsteam eller ett större åtagande.

Samtidigt utvecklar vi egna digitala produkter och tjänster, bland annat tillsammans med våra seniora konsulter. Vår långsiktiga ambition är att bygga ett bolag där konsultaffären, teamleveranser och flera egna produkter växer sida vid side.

Din uppgift är att hitta affären, utveckla kunden och vara med och bygga nästa Deploja.

Ditt uppdrag

Du får ett brett kommersiellt ansvar och stort mandat att skapa nya kunder, utveckla befintliga relationer och växa affären. En kundrelation kan börja med en Javautvecklare, iOS-utvecklare eller DevOps-specialist. Din uppgift är att förstå kundens större behov och utveckla relationen vidare:

Du arbetar hands-on genom hela affären – från prospektering och första kundkontakt till behovsanalys, lösning, offert, förhandling och avslut.

Tillsammans med vår befintliga affärsorganisation får du också stort inflytande över vilka kunder vi satsar på, hur vi säljer, vilka erbjudanden vi bygger och vilka kompetenser vi rekryterar.

Rollen får även en naturlig koppling till vår produktutveckling. Du behöver inte vara produktchef, men vi ser gärna att du kan bidra kommersiellt genom att validera marknader, hitta pilotkunder och hjälpa oss ta nya produkter från idé till betalande kund.

Du kommer bland annat att

  • skapa nya kunder genom aktiv nykundsbearbetning och utveckla befintliga kundrelationer

  • sälja seniora specialister inom framför allt Java, iOS och Android

  • utveckla affärer inom .NET, Cloud, DevOps, test, data, arkitektur och andra IT-områden

  • sälja och paketera kompletta team, projekt och åtaganden

  • bygga relationer med CIO, CTO, IT-chefer, utvecklingschefer, Engineering Managers och inköp

  • driva hela säljprocessen från första kontakt till avtal

  • ta fram kommersiella upplägg, offerter och priser

  • arbeta tillsammans med våra seniora konsulter kring lösnings- och leveransförslag

  • bidra i ramavtal, upphandlingar och större affärsdialoger

  • bidra till go-to-market och kommersialisering av våra egna produkter

  • identifiera nya kunder, partners och affärsmöjligheter.

Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du idag arbetar inom IT-konsulting, Software Engineering.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Minst 5 års erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning inom IT

  • erfarenhet av IT-konsultaffären och försäljning av systemutvecklingskompetens

  • dokumenterad förmåga att skapa nya kunder och utveckla dem

  • relevant nätverk bland IT-beslutsfattare, gärna i Stockholmsområdet

  • erfarenhet av att självständigt driva hela säljprocessen

  • god förståelse för pris, marginal, avtal och lönsamhet

  • tillräcklig teknisk förståelse för att föra en trovärdig dialog med IT- och utvecklingschefer

  • ett entreprenöriellt arbetssätt och förmåga att få saker att hända.

Extra intressant är du om du har

  • sålt inom Java, iOS/Android, .NET, Cloud eller DevOps

  • sålt både enskilda specialister och kompletta team

  • sålt projekt, åtaganden eller andra större leveranser

  • utvecklat en kund från en konsult till flera konsulter eller ett helt team

  • etablerat nätverk bland CIO/CTO, IT- och utvecklingschefer

  • erfarenhet av både privat och offentlig sektor

  • arbetat med ramavtal och upphandlingar

  • haft kommersiellt ansvar för ett affärsområde eller konsultverksamhet

  • erfarenhet av SaaS, produktförsäljning eller go-to-market.

Varför Deploja?

Deploja är ett entreprenörsdrivet IT-bolag med seniora specialister och kunder inom både privat och offentlig sektor.

Ser du en affärsmöjlighet ska vägen kunna vara:

Kundmöte → behov → rätt kompetens → team → offert → affär.

Inte fem interna styrgrupper.

Ersättning

Fast lön + prestationsbaserad provision med hög uppsida.

Det här kan vara rätt roll för dig om...

Du kanske sitter på ett större konsultbolag och har kunderna, nätverket och erfarenheten, men tycker att beslutsvägarna blivit för långa. Du kanske säljer utvecklingskonsulter idag men vill gå vidare till team, större leveranser och mer kommersiellt ansvar.

Eller så lockas du av att kombinera en etablerad konsultaffär med något mer entreprenöriellt, där nya tjänster och egna produkter kan bli nästa stora affärsområde.

Vi är mer intresserade av vad du kan bygga tillsammans med oss framåt än vad det står på ditt nuvarande visitkort.

title: Security Analyst I (Monday-Thursday, 12AM -11AM CST)
description:
Are you looking for limitless career opportunities with a company that values growth, innovation, and teamwork? At Ntiva, we’re more than a Managed Services Provider, we’re a community dedicated to helping each other, our clients, and their businesses thrive both personally and professionally. Ntiva is a culture of people who are passionate about the work…and each other.

Our clients view us as an essential part of their teams, relying on us for strategic guidance, fast solutions to complex challenges, and proactive support. With strategic locations across the U.S. and leadership from our founder, Steven Freidkin, we’re on the front lines of a fast-paced industry, facing cybersecurity threats and rapid technology changes together.

If you thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment and enjoy going above and beyond, we’d love to meet you. Come explore one of our many opportunities and grow with us!

How you’ll make an Impact

As a Security Analyst I, you'll be our first line of defense against cyber threats. You'll swiftly respond to security alerts, investigate potential malicious activity, secure compromised accounts, and review change activity to prevent or minimize security events. By managing routine security tool adjustments and escalating complex issues, you'll ensure our defenses remain effective and responsive, safeguarding our client's assets and data.


Location and Work Expectations

  • This is a remote position; however, team members should be willing and able to travel if the need arises, though such travel is expected to be infrequent. Candidates with proximity to one of our Centers of Excellence are preferred (Lombard, IL; McLean, VA; Shreveport, LA; Overland Park, KS).
  • Schedule: 4 days on, 3 days off! Monday-Thursday, 12am–11am CST (following a required training period on day shift, M–F 8am–5pm CST — duration varies by individual progress)
  • This role also includes participation in a rotating on-call schedule.

What you will be doing

  • Monitor & Investigate: Actively monitor security dashboards, queues, and alerts from various sources (automated tools, escalated tickets) to detect potential threats.
  • Incident Triage & Response: Conduct initial investigations into security alerts, perform rapid response actions like securing user accounts, and collect necessary log data for analysis.
  • Escalate Effectively: Analyze findings to determine the scope and severity of incidents, resolving straightforward issues and escalating complex cases to Level 2 Analysts with clear, concise information.
  • Security Tool Management: Review and implement authorized, routine changes to security tools, such as processing client exemption requests in the EDR or temporarily adjusting settings for testing.
  • Collaborate with the Security Team: Work closely with fellow analysts and security engineers, sharing information, participating in team discussions, and contributing to a collaborative security environment.
  • Engage with Users/Clients: Communicate professionally and clearly with end-users or clients to gather details about potential security issues, explain security procedures, and provide guidance during incident resolution.
  • Liaise Across Departments: Interact effectively with other teams (e.g., Reactive Support, Client Strategy, NOC) to coordinate security responses and share necessary information.
  • Document Actions: Maintain accurate and detailed records of investigations, actions taken, communications, and resolutions within ConnectWise.
  • Provide Support: Offer timely and helpful support related to security inquiries, upholding a professional and customer-service-oriented approach in all interactions.



You’ll be successful in this role if you have

  • 1-2 years of experience in Cybersecurity
  • 3-5 years in an IT role including log analysis, account/access management, or endpoint troubleshooting
  • This is a full-time role requiring your full alertness and reliable attendance during scheduled hours. Additional outside employment, regardless of hours, is not permitted
  • CySA+, GCIH, or SC-200 (or actively pursuing)
  • Hands-on exposure to at least one EDR/SIEM platform (e.g., SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel)
  • Direct hands-on experience using ConnectWise Manage for ticket documentation, with a demonstrated track record of clear, timestamped, audit-ready incident notes
  • Must have practical familiarity with at least one of: SIEM log correlation, Windows Event Viewer (Security log IDs like 4624/4625/4648), or a ticketing-based alert queue
  • Sharp attention to detail with a proactive approach to accuracy and thoroughness
  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer service, with a track record of exceeding client expectations
  • Strong enthusiasm for learning new things and ability to adapt to evolving technology trends and industry advancements
  • This role involves extended periods of sitting or standing and regular use of computers and office equipment


Required language skills

  • Ability to communicate professionally, in English, both written and orally
  • Ability to write business correspondence and process procedures
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, and the general public

Bonus points for

  • Security + Certification

Benefits and Perks

  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employee and family
  • 401k + company-matched contributions 4% match on 5% contribution - no vesting period! (Employee and Company contribute after 90 days)
  • Group Term Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment coverage (company provided)

You will responsible for vacuum and atmospheric furnace operations to complete all heat treatment cycles correctly and safely to meet production schedules.

Job Description

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

  • Understanding of High Risk Operation (HRO) and able to exercise emergency procedures during power failure and HF leak
  • Required to perform 12-hours rotating shift

  • Able to read and understand the manufacturing operation sheets and standard operation procedures in English

title: Senior Product Manager - Retail Staff Tools
description:
Join us in shaping the next generation of digital tools used by more than 100,000 store colleagues across H&M Group’s store portfolio. As Senior Product Manager, you will raise the bar for how H&M builds colleague-facing products at global scale – defining the vision, roadmap and measurable outcomes that help store teams work more efficiently, make better decisions and create great customer experiences every day.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
Retail Staff Tools owns the digital capabilities store colleagues use every day — supporting areas such as customer care, store performance, visual merchandising, workforce management, store management and collaboration. Our mission is to reduce friction in everyday store operations, helping colleagues spend less time navigating systems and more time serving customers, creating inspiring stores and running efficient daily operations.

This is a senior product role with high visibility and real-world impact. To succeed, you will bring people together across a large, global organisation — building trust, creating alignment and helping teams move with clarity towards shared outcomes. You will partner closely with an Engineering Manager and cross-functional teams to turn colleague needs, business opportunities and the power of AI, automation and data into simple, scalable product experiences that elevate how store teams work every day.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for colleague-facing products used across H&M Group’s global store portfolio.
  • Translate complex business challenges, store colleague needs, data and research into clear product opportunities, value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Data & Analytics and business teams to shape products that are intuitive, scalable and valuable in everyday store operations.
  • Reimagine how AI, automation and data can elevate the colleague experience — from smarter guidance and decision support to more proactive ways of working.
  • Simplify and modernize the store tool landscape, reducing friction and helping colleagues spend less time navigating systems and more time serving customers.
  • Create clarity and momentum across a global stakeholder landscape, aligning teams around the most important opportunities, decisions and outcomes.

WHO YOU ARE
We believe you are a strategic and outcome-oriented product leader who turns ambiguity into direction and creates alignment in complex organisations. You combine business acumen with curiosity for users, technology and value creation, and are motivated by shaping products that improve everyday work at global scale.

We are looking for people who have

  • A bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent experience gained through work.
  • +5 years of experience in product management, strategy, transformation, business development or a similar role with measurable impact.
  • Experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, KPIs and business cases for complex products, services or transformation initiatives.
  • Strong ability to structure complex problems, develop clear recommendations and influence decision making.
  • Experience turning user insight, data and business priorities into product opportunities, value hypotheses and prioritized outcomes.
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering and design teams to move from strategy to delivery, balancing user value, business impact, technical feasibility and cost.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment and momentum in a global, cross-functional environment.

And people who are

  • Outcome-oriented and commercially minded – focus on value, impact and measurable results.
  • Strategic, structured and analytical — able to turn complexity into clear direction.
  • Curious and externally aware – bringing fresh thinking from product, technology, or retail environments.
  • Collaborative and influential – a strong communicator with the ability to build trust and align people across functions, markets and levels of seniority.
  • Pragmatic, positive and resilient — comfortable moving forward even when the path is not yet fully defined.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience from global retail, store operations or large-scale colleague environments.
  • Background in management consulting, strategy, or transformation.
  • Experience with app consolidation, AI-enabled tools, or automation.
  • Strong vendor management skills.

Location: This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden. We are unable to provide relocation assistance or visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already have the right to work in Sweden.

    WHO WE ARE​
    H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

    We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

    WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
    At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

    • 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
    • H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.
    • In addition to our global benefits, our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. (Example: Competitive compensation for your dedication and long-term commitment. A day off on your birthday to relax and celebrate your special day. Special gift to celebrate the birth of your child, etc.)

    JOIN US
    Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

    Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

title: Video Editor (Work from Home)
description:
Key Media is a fast-growing global B2B media company, and we’re looking for a sharp, creative and detail-oriented Video Editor. In this hands-on role, you’ll be responsible for editing B2B video content - including executive interviews, panel discussions, and podcasts - that align with our editorial and commercial objectives.

Life at Key Media: Where every story matters

About Key Media

At Key Media, your next role comes withglobal exposure. With teams acrossAustralia, Canada, New Zealand, the Philippines, the US, the UK, and Europe, we give you the chance to grow your career while collaborating with colleagues from around the world. From cross-border teamwork to supporting major live events, you'll be part of something international, fast-moving, and meaningful.

We’re a thriving B2B media company creating award-winning content and events across industries like legal, HR, insurance, finance, education, property, and more. With over 350 talented team members, we connect professionals through digital platforms, in-person events, and print, always delivering high-impact work that informs, celebrates, and brings business communities together.

People stay at Key Media for one big reason: the culture. We call it orange energy. We're collaborative, full of energy, and kind. We offer the flexibility to work hybrid or fully remote, plus regular socials, DEI initiatives, and a sense of belonging. We give people the freedom to take ownership, share ideas, and grow their careers quickly. If you want to do great work, be yourself, and explore global opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

title: Technical Product Owner, RDT Lead – 3PD
description:
The Position

Technical Product Owner, RDT Lead – 3PD (Personalized, Predictive Patient Data)

The Opportunity

The Technical Product Owner, RDT Lead – 3PD drives the technical product strategy and delivery for Roche’s Patient Strategy data ecosystem. Combining strategic product ownership and delivery leadership, this role unifies internal and external data streams into a scalable, compliant engine that powers personalized healthcare experiences.


About the Ecosystem

3PD connects patients, providers, and operations through unified data, predictive analytics, and AI/ML capabilities. Spanning ingestion, integration, governance, and advanced decisioning, it empowers timely interventions to optimize patient treatment journeys.


The Technical Product Owner/RDT Lead evolves 3PD as an integrated enterprise platform—balancing immediate Patient Strategy needs with long-term scalability, interoperability, reliability, and reuse.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Vision & Strategy: Define and execute the 3PD strategy, roadmap, and backlog, translating business needs into scalable data capabilities and AI/ML enablement.
  • Data Lifecycle Ownership: Provide technical leadership across acquisition, ingestion, processing, storage, and consumption to support end-user and downstream system needs.
  • Vendor Data Acquisition: Lead technical onboarding of external data sources, including mapping, validation, reconciliation, quality, and operational readiness.
  • System Integration & Enablement: Drive upstream and downstream integrations, making patient data available for operational systems, analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and decisioning platforms.
  • Delivery Management: Lead end-to-end technical delivery across workstreams, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and cross-team handoffs.
  • Data Quality & Reliability: Establish standards for data accuracy, timeliness, and completeness; implement monitoring, observability, and issue-remediation with engineering teams.
  • Architecture & Strategy: Partner with architects to guide integration patterns, scalability, interoperability, and long-term sustainability while managing technical debt.
  • Governance & Compliance: Embed data governance, lineage, privacy, consent, security, and regulatory requirements into product design and delivery.
  • Dependency Management: Maintain an end-to-end view of dependencies across consuming products to prevent delivery bottlenecks.
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Leadership: Build partnerships across Patient Strategy, business, DDA, architecture, engineering, and external vendors to drive alignment and resolve conflicts.
  • Product Health & Improvement: Define metrics for product health, data quality, adoption, and operational stability to guide continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, or a related field; an advanced degree or certifications (PMP/PgMP/Product) preferred.
  • 10+ years leading complex technical integrations, enterprise data products, and cross-functional product delivery within large-scale IT environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise owning data ecosystems—including vendor ingestion, data quality, governance, lineage, and enablement for analytics, AI/ML, and decisioning platforms.
  • Strong technical fluency in cloud platforms, APIs, batch/event integrations, data pipelines, data modeling, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  • Proven track record translating business needs into product roadmaps, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and driving cross-team execution.
  • Solid background in data privacy, consent, security, and regulatory compliance for sensitive patient data environments.

Technical / Business Skills

  • Strong knowledge of the end-to-end data lifecycle, including acquisition, ingestion, integration, transformation, quality, and consumption.
  • Experience translating business and end-user needs into technical requirements, product roadmaps, and scalable data capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, privacy, consent, security, and regulatory requirements for sensitive patient data.
  • Strong product and delivery management skills, including roadmap and backlog management, prioritization, dependency and risk management, and end-to-end delivery.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate technical options and drive decisions across complex, cross-functional environments.

Additional Qualifications

  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to drive consensus across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and navigate complex cross-functional and vendor relationships.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring capabilities across product and delivery teams.
  • Experience with Agile/product operating models and complex, multi-team technical delivery.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, patient services, or other regulated data environments preferred.
  • Experience enabling data for analytics, AI/ML, predictive capabilities, decisioning, or personalization is highly desirable.

title: Investment Analyst
description:
The Office of University Investments is seeking a highly qualified, entry level Investment Analyst. This is a three-year term position in OUI’s New York City office with a start date of summer 2027 (earlier is possible). The office currently operates on a hybrid schedule with 4 days a week in person, 1 day remote.


Note: Application window is set to expire at 11:59PM ET on Friday, Oct. 2, 2026.


Please note: A PDF resume must be attached to the candidate's application materials.


No Visa sponsorship is provided for this position. US nationals and applicants with current visa status (including OPT) who do not require Visa sponsorship and are able to fulfill the three-year term will be considered for this opportunity.


No relocation assistance is provided for this position.


Who we are:

The Office of University Investments (OUI) manages the University's $13+ billion endowment which supports this mission by seeking to generate superior risk-adjusted returns through traditional and alternative investments in US and international equities, fixed income, hedge funds, private equity, venture capital, and real assets. The global, multiple-asset class approach taken exploits a central insight of modern financial theory: namely, that portfolio risk can be minimized for any targeted rate of return through the inclusion of a broad selection of asset classes – since risky asset classes often behave differently as regional and global economic, financial, and political events unfold.


The Chief Investment Officer is responsible for the day-to-day oversight of the Investment Office and is supported by a dedicated team of investment professionals. The Investment Office is responsible for implementing policies established by the University Board of Trustees and its Investment Committee. To learn more about OUI's policies, objectives, and organizational structure, please visit our website.


Analyst Program Purpose and Goals:

Through a wide variety of asset class, operations, and portfolio and risk analytics assignments, Investment Analysts are expected to acquire a deep knowledge of issues surrounding the development and execution of a robust global, multi-asset class, long-term oriented institutional investment strategy. Analysts work with senior team members in the investment analysis and due diligence process and take on numerous analytic, quantitative, and qualitative projects on an independent basis to facilitate the overall investment process. In contrast to more narrowly defined entry-level finance positions, Investment Analysts are assigned a broad and deep range of asset class exposure and projects covering all aspects of institutional portfolio construction and management over the course of the three-year period.


As part of the program, OUI encourages and supports Investment Analysts as they pursue the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation as well as one other professional credential (CAIA, FRM, CIPM, etc.).


Responsibilities:

  • Acquire a deep knowledge of issues surrounding the development and execution of a robust global, multi-asset class, long-term oriented institutional investment strategy;
  • Collaborate with senior team members on work related to investment analysis and investment underwriting, including investment sourcing, due diligence, and structuring of new investments;
  • Take on numerous analytic, quantitative, and qualitative projects on an independent basis to facilitate the overall investment process;
  • Evaluate and engage with existing investments and manager relationships by analyzing reports, attending meetings with managers, identifying potential issues, and proactively providing relevant updates and/or necessary solutions to emerging issues;
  • Use rigorous quantitative/statistical techniques and apply and/or develop innovative modelling skills to analyze current and prospective investments and conduct portfolio-level analyses;
  • Acquire a deep understanding of portfolio rebalancing and optimization, asset class construction, and investment valuation and relative valuation techniques;
  • Execute a wide variety of performance, risk measurement, and attribution analyses;

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent: All majors are encouraged to apply (Master’s degree candidates welcome). Disciplines on our team have recently included: Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering (Biological, Biomedical, Chemical, Mechanical, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering Management), French, Actuarial Science, Biology, English Literature, Statistics, Physics, Physiology, Psychology.
  • Relevant experience: Up to 1 year of related or relevant work experience.
  • Excellent qualitative and interpersonal skills: Applicants must be capable of interacting effectively with external investment managers, the campus community, and the University's Investment Committee.
  • Strong quantitative capabilities: Significant coursework in one or more of the following fields (even if not a major) is highly valued: statistics, mathematics, computer science, operations research, science, and/or information systems (evidenced via a transcript or other documentation).

Desired Skills:

  • Demonstrated interest in learning about investment theory and practice, economics, and financial markets.
  • Willingness to undertake the CFA Program upon joining (see for background on the CFA® credential).
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a thorough and detail-oriented fashion.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Enthusiasm for supporting the mission of higher education and representing the University in a professional manner.
  • Evidence of ability to work in teams, positive attitude, and ability to gain and maintain credibility with the campus community and investment managers.
  • Willingness to travel, at times extensively, on average 15% of the time.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software and mathematics/quantitative technique.
  • Demonstrated programming skills in one or more of the following languages: R, VBA, Python, SQL, SAS, Tableau, C#.

Rewards and Benefits:

  • Cornell receives national recognition as an award-winning workplace for our health, wellbeing, sustainability, and diversity initiatives.
  • Our benefits programs include comprehensive health care options, generous retirement contributions, access to wellness programs, and employee discounts with local and national retail brands. We invite you to follow this link to get more information about our benefits: .
  • Follow this link to learn more about the Total Rewards of Working at Cornell: .
  • Cornell's impressive educational benefits include tuition-free Extramural Study and Employee Degree Program, tuition aid for external education, and Cornell Children's Tuition Assistance Program.

The Office of University Investments is located in Midtown Manhattan, centrally located near Times Square and Bryant Park.

title: Group Copy Supervisor
description:
As a Group Copy Supervisor, you’ll lead the copy function across key client accounts, shaping brand voice, creative direction, and the quality of work from concept through execution. Working in close partnership with your art counterpart, you’ll help solve strategic and creative challenges, strengthen client confidence, and ensure teams are delivering work that is original, relevant, and grounded in a deep understanding of the brand, category, and market.

You’ll also play a significant people-leadership role. You’ll manage, mentor, and develop a team of creatives while balancing a fast-moving workload across multiple assignments. Success in this role means bringing together strong creative judgment, healthcare knowledge, operational discipline, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and cross-functional partners.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead copy and creative direction across assigned accounts, bringing together client objectives, audience needs, market dynamics, competitive activity, and clinical developments to shape strategically grounded work.
  • Partner with art leadership and cross-functional teams to develop original, integrated creative ideas and solve strategic or executional challenges from concept through delivery.
  • Review and guide creative output to ensure work meets high standards for writing, brand consistency, strategic alignment, scientific accuracy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Build trusted client relationships through regular collaboration, creative presentations, market research, and strategic discussions, clearly articulating the thinking behind the work.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop direct reports through clear expectations, ongoing feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Set priorities and manage team workloads, project schedules, budgets, and resources to keep multiple assignments moving efficiently and effectively.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment and build strong relationships across Creative, Client Services, Strategy, Medical, Science & Regulatory, Production, and other disciplines.
  • Stay current on healthcare, creative, cultural, and technology trends, including responsible applications of AI, and share relevant learning that strengthens the work and the team.

Required

  • 7+ years of professional experience in copywriting, advertising, marketing communications, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking and integrated campaign work.
  • Demonstrated experience leading copy and creative direction across complex brands or client accounts, from strategic concept through final execution.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare or pharmaceutical marketing, including product and treatment-category dynamics, clinical developments, healthcare audiences, and regulated review environments.
  • Ability to translate complex strategic, scientific, and clinical information into clear, compelling creative communications.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and client relationship skills, with experience confidently presenting and defending creative and strategic recommendations.
  • People-management experience, including mentoring, coaching, performance management, and developing creative talent.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while collaborating effectively across Creative, Client Services, Strategy, Medical, Science & Regulatory, and production teams.

Desired

  • Experience leading and developing copy teams and contributing to the hiring and retention of strong creative talent.
  • Experience presenting campaign concepts, brand platforms, and strategic creative direction to senior client stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with healthcare creative production and review workflows, including annotation tools, reference management systems, routing, and regulatory review platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Marketing, Communications, Writing, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
