title: Enterprise Market Intelligence & Strategic Partnerships, Director
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
Role Summary

The Director, Enterprise Market Intelligence & Strategic Partnerships is GCET's enterprise lead for healthcare ecosystem trends, market and customer insights, external partnerships, and Business of Healthcare learning content. This role tracks shifts in care delivery, payment models, technology, policy, and customer dynamics across U.S. and international markets, and turns those developments into market content, curricula, and insights that support customer-facing readiness and capability development.

The Director draws on healthcare expertise, external networks, and analytics tools to identify emerging trends and build training content and enterprise perspectives that strengthen customer-facing readiness. This role works with GCET and business stakeholders to align insights and training solutions to organizational and business unit objectives.


Key Responsibilities


Healthcare Ecosystem & Market Intelligence

  • Serves as the enterprise subject matter expert on healthcare ecosystem trends — care delivery, payment models, technology, policy, and customer dynamics — across U.S. and international markets.
  • Monitors the global healthcare environment to identify emerging trends and their implications for customer engagement, readiness, and capability development.
  • Translates external developments into market insights and recommendations that support readiness and capability efforts.
  • Identifies capability or readiness gaps before they become broader organizational issues.
  • Applies analytics and intelligence tools to speed up trend identification, insight generation, and content curation, consistent with enterprise AI governance standards.

Strategic Partnerships & Thought Leadership

  • Builds and maintains relationships with academic institutions, professional associations, healthcare innovators, and industry experts.
  • Curates external research and best practices that strengthen customer-facing readiness and capability initiatives, and connects market dynamics to organizational strategy with GCET and customer-facing leaders.
  • Engages external stakeholders to capture emerging trends and customer perspectives relevant to capability development.
  • Evaluates partnership opportunities against business priorities and future capability needs.
  • Represents Pfizer at conferences, advisory forums, and industry events.

Business of Healthcare Curriculum & Market Content Development

  • Develops and maintains role-based Business of Healthcare curricula covering healthcare ecosystems, care delivery, payment models, policy, technology, and customer dynamics.
  • Creates market-focused learning content and insight-driven materials based on healthcare trends, customer insights, and external thought leadership.
  • Builds enterprise-level market intelligence frameworks and learning resources usable across therapeutic areas and business units.
  • Translates complex healthcare and customer intelligence into learning content that supports readiness, capability development, and activation planning.

Future Trends & Capability Readiness

  • Monitors healthcare ecosystem evolution to identify future risks and opportunities relevant to customer-facing roles.
  • Develops enterprise perspectives on future trends and their implications for customer engagement and capability development.
  • Supports long-range planning on emerging customer needs, healthcare innovation, technology adoption, and policy evolution.
  • Informs launch strategies through market insights and associated training needs.

Basic Qualifications


Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, market strategy, healthcare consulting, customer engagement, capability development, commercial learning, or related fields.
  • Experience translating market and healthcare intelligence into business, readiness, capability, or learning outcomes.
  • Track record of building strategic partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience developing market-focused educational resources, Business of Healthcare content, or learning programs.
  • Experience working across global, matrixed organizations.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of healthcare ecosystems, customer engagement, care delivery models, healthcare policy, reimbursement, and industry dynamics.
  • Ability to connect market insights to customer-facing readiness and capability needs.
  • Experience developing educational content or curricula informed by external market dynamics.
  • Experience with AI, analytics, or knowledge-management platforms.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to represent Pfizer credibly with external academic, industry, healthcare, and policy leaders.
  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of information into actionable recommendations and content.
  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience supporting global learning, capability development, or commercial training organizations.
  • Experience across global markets and diverse healthcare systems.
  • Background in healthcare strategy consulting, market access, customer experience, or commercial learning.
  • Experience building partnerships with academic institutions, health systems, or professional associations.
  • Experience in knowledge management, content enablement, or thought-leadership development.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled solutions to intelligence, learning, or capability-development work.
  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of external information into actionable recommendations and content.
  • Ability to identify patterns, trends, risks, and opportunities from diverse sources.
  • Ability to build trust-based relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to operate in complex, matrixed environments.

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Regular domestic and international travel for conferences, academic partnerships, and industry engagements.

  • WORK LOCATION ASSIGNMENT: Hybrid, 2-3 days onsite/week US Commercial Pfizer site (per Pfizer’s Log In For Your Day Policy)
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $189,200.00 to $315,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. title: SQL DBA II
description:
Versant is seeking a SQL Database Administrator II to help ensure the reliability, performance, security, and ongoing improvement of our database environment across cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

In this Level 2 role, you’ll administer and troubleshoot SQL Server environments while also supporting relational database platforms such as MySQL and PostgreSQL. You’ll partner closely with Software Development, Data Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, and other technology teams to strengthen database operations through proactive monitoring, performance optimization, automation, observability, and resilient backup and disaster-recovery practices.

Success in this role means maintaining highly available database platforms, identifying and mitigating operational risks, resolving complex production issues, and continuously improving the tools and practices that support reliable database engineering.

Why This Role Matters: Our database platforms support critical applications and workflows across Versant. Your work will directly contribute to the stability, scalability, security, and recoverability of the systems our teams rely on to operate effectively.

This is a remote role based in Florida. While the position is primarily remote, employees should expect opportunities for in-person collaboration, team meetings, or company events approximately 10% of the time.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the health and reliability of SQL Server environments across Production, Staging, and Development, including SQL Server hosted on AWS RDS, maintaining availability in accordance with established SLAs, SLOs, RTOs, and RPOs.
  • Support and administer additional relational database platforms, including MySQL and PostgreSQL, as needed across cloud and on-premises environments, applying consistent standards for reliability, security, performance, backup, and recovery.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance and capacity using execution plans, Query Store, wait statistics, Extended Events, indexing analysis, observability platforms, and other diagnostic tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Strengthen database security and resilience by administering access and permissions using least-privilege practices and designing, implementing, testing, and validating backup, restore, high-availability, and disaster-recovery strategies.
  • Partner with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle to improve T-SQL, query and schema design, indexing, CI/CD workflows, automated deployments, data migrations, integrations, and post-deployment validation.
  • Automate repeatable database operations and improve production support using infrastructure-as-code, PowerShell, and other scripting technologies while enhancing monitoring, alerting, dashboards, incident response, root-cause analysis, and technical documentation.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on SQL Server transactional database administration experience, including production database environments.
  • Strong SQL Server administration expertise across configuration, security, permissions, maintenance, backups, restores, troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Strong experience with AWS database and infrastructure services, particularly RDS, Secrets Manager, S3, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Advanced SQL Server performance analysis and optimization capabilities, including execution plans, Query Store, index design, wait statistics, blocking analysis, query tuning, Extended Events, and related diagnostic technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server concurrency and transaction behavior, including isolation levels, locking, blocking, and deadlocks.
  • Experience designing and supporting high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including Always On Availability Groups, backup and restore strategies, and RTO/RPO planning.
  • Strong proficiency in T-SQL and PowerShell, with experience using automation to improve database administration and operational workflows.
  • Working knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL administration, including configuration, monitoring, security, backup and restore, and troubleshooting in production environments.
  • Experience with source control and database CI/CD practices using Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex production database issues, perform root-cause analysis, manage assigned work, communicate risks and blockers, and escalate appropriately.
  • An associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

How We Do It

  • Trust: Exercise sound judgment when managing production data, access, credentials, and critical database infrastructure.
  • Teamwork: Partner effectively with Software Development, Data Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, and other teams to solve problems and improve shared systems.
  • Transparency: Communicate database health, risks, incidents, blockers, and technical recommendations clearly and proactively.
  • Agility: Adapt to changing operational priorities, respond effectively to production incidents, and continuously improve database environments as business and technology needs evolve.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Look for opportunities to automate manual work, improve database engineering practices, and build scalable solutions rather than relying on one-time fixes.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Python or Bash.
  • Experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL in AWS-managed services such as Amazon RDS or Aurora.
  • Experience operating and optimizing heterogeneous database environments that include SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building infrastructure-as-code or other repeatable database provisioning and configuration workflows.
  • Experience supporting data integration, migration, or replication across systems and environments.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll have the opportunity to work on database platforms that support Versant’s portfolio of media and entertainment businesses while collaborating with experienced technology teams across multiple disciplines.

This role offers meaningful ownership of database reliability and engineering practices, with opportunities to improve automation, observability, performance, security, and operational resilience across SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL environments.

As a remote Florida-based employee, you’ll primarily work remotely while participating in in-person collaboration opportunities, team gatherings, or company events approximately 10% of the time.

title: Transformation and Change Management Practitioner
description:
Transformation and Change Management Practitioner

What we believe

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.

Our role

We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.

Our approach

The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.

What we value

Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.

If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.

About the role

Lead large-scale transformation and change-management engagements for private equity investors and portfolio companies, as well as technology and technology-enabled businesses.

Help clients turn strategic ambition into an executable transformation programme, aligning operating model, technology, processes, people and governance around measurable business outcomes.

Bring the judgement and communication skills of a trusted consultant: frame complex problems, lead senior stakeholder discussions, establish a compelling case for change and maintain momentum through delivery.

Apply enough technology depth to connect transformation priorities to the underlying product, engineering, data, platforms, delivery capability and technology operating model.

Design practical approaches to change adoption, including stakeholder alignment, communications, organisation design, capability building, programme governance and benefits realisation.

Work collaboratively with investment teams, boards, executive leadership and Crosslake colleagues across commercial, operational, financial and technical workstreams.

Role responsibilities

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes from initial diagnosis and mobilisation through to sustained delivery and measurable outcomes.
  • Create clear transformation roadmaps, including the case for change, target operating model, initiative sequencing, accountabilities, investment requirements, risks and benefits.
  • Establish effective programme governance and delivery rhythms, enabling senior leaders to make timely decisions, resolve dependencies and maintain accountability.
  • Build commitment across client organisations through credible stakeholder engagement, practical communications and approaches that support adoption rather than simply designing change.
  • Translate technical and operational issues into commercial implications for growth, customer outcomes, margin, resilience, investment risk and value creation.
  • Support post-deal value creation by helping portfolio-company leadership teams deliver transformation priorities at pace while maintaining business continuity.
  • Develop trusted client relationships, contribute to proposition development and mentor colleagues in transformation, programme leadership and change-management practice.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of experience leading transformation, change management, operating-model improvement, technology-enabled transformation or complex programme delivery.
  • A strong track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional change programmes with senior sponsors and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience shaping and delivering transformation roadmaps, programme governance, organisation and process change, capability building and benefits realisation.
  • The ability to communicate a compelling, evidence-based story that helps leaders understand why change is needed, what must happen and how progress will be measured.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to connect transformation activity to business value, including growth, cost, customer experience, risk and operational performance.
  • Sufficient technology fluency to work credibly with product, engineering, data and technology leaders, and to integrate technology change into a wider transformation agenda.
  • Experience with private equity, transaction advisory, corporate development or high-growth technology businesses is strongly preferred.
  • An experience spike in a business domain - for example insurance, capital markets, healthcare, logistics or supply chain.
  • Excellent structured thinking, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills, together with a collaborative and action-oriented leadership style.

title: Senior Software Engineer- iOS
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Senior Software Engineer (iOS) in the Design System team, you will build and evolve the foundations that enable iOS teams across H&M to deliver consistent, accessible and high-quality digital experiences. You will work at the intersection of Design, Engineering and Product, creating reusable components, APIs, patterns and tooling that can be adopted across multiple products.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development and evolution of reusable iOS components using Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit where appropriate.
  • Design scalable component APIs supporting variants, states, themes, composition and accessibility.
  • Translate Figma/design specifications into production-ready components in close collaboration with designers.
  • Contribute to design tokens and foundations such as colour, typography, spacing, sizing and themes.
  • Establish architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices for the iOS Design System.
  • Build accessibility, performance, quality and maintainability into components by default.
  • Work with product teams to support adoption, identify gaps and turn recurring needs into reusable solutions.
  • Create clear documentation, examples and guidance that make components easy to discover and use.
  • Maintain automated unit, UI and snapshot/visual regression tests where appropriate.
  • Own component evolution, including versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation and migration strategies.
  • Lead technical discussions, conduct code reviews and mentor engineers across the iOS community.
  • Explore improvements to design-to-code workflows and developer experience.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

We in the Design System team, empower teams to build great digital experiences. Our Design System provides reusable, accessible and scalable foundations that help product teams deliver consistent customer experiences faster. We connect Design, Engineering and Product through components, patterns, tokens and developer tooling.

Team Principles

  • Build reusable foundations that enable teams to move faster.
  • Collaborate across Design, Product and Engineering.
  • Solve real customer and developer problems rather than introducing technology for its own sake.
  • Design for consistency, accessibility, quality and scalability.
  • Treat the Design System as a product, continuously improving it through feedback and adoption.
  • Share knowledge and enable teams to contribute and succeed.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with...

  • Swift & iOS: 6-10 years of strong Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit experience; modern iOS SDK knowledge; Swift Concurrency; modular architecture and Swift Package Manager.
  • Design System Engineering: Experience building or contributing to an iOS Design System, component library or reusable platform; strong component/API design and understanding of variants, states, themes and composition.
  • Design & Design-to-Code: Experience collaborating with designers and translating Figma specifications into robust iOS components; understanding of design tokens and design-system foundations.
  • Accessibility: Strong understanding of iOS accessibility, including VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, accessibility labels/traits and inclusive component behaviour.
  • Testing & Quality: Strong unit/UI testing experience; snapshot or visual regression testing is valuable; understanding of CI/CD and automated quality checks.
  • Performance: Understanding of rendering, memory management and concurrency; ability to use Instruments and debugging tools to diagnose complex issues.
  • Architecture & Leadership: Ability to make architectural decisions, communicate trade-offs, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers and influence across teams.
  • Developer Experience: Focus on discoverability, documentation, examples and ease of adoption for engineers consuming shared libraries.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with enterprise-scale Design Systems or shared component libraries.
  • Experience with Figma Variables, Code Connect, design-token pipelines or design-to-code tooling.
  • Experience with visual regression testing and developer documentation platforms.
  • Experience aligning iOS components with Web/Android Design Systems.
  • Experience with developer tooling, automation, code generation or AI-assisted development workflows.

title: Seasonal Customer Experience Representative

title: Maintenance - Lopez
description:
General Purpose: Provide general and preventive maintenance in food manufacturing industry equipment, and have basic knowledge of tools and equipment, and how to use them. Must always use and maintain personal protective equipment, and work in compliance with all company policies, Animal Welfare Guidelines, and local, state, and federal policies, laws, and regulations.

  • Maintain work area, tools, parts, and equipment in a clean and organized manner for the purposes of safety, efficiency, and appearance.
  • Perform installation and maintenance work as part of a team of skilled workers including electrical, mechanical systems, which require the safe and proficient use of shop tools (both hand and power).
  • Demonstrates sense of urgency and ability to handle multiple assignments efficiently.
  • Ability to distinguish priorities and develop a plan to minimize downtime in key areas.
  • Communicate with all levels of the organization including shift-to-shift transfer of knowledge/information, peers, production personnel, and management.
  • Any other corrective, preventative, or predictive maintenance functions or duties as assigned. General and preventive maintenance experience in the food manufacturing industry.
  • 2+ years previous experience in maintenance.
  • Able to speak, read, write, and comprehend English fluently.
  • Able to work any day including Saturday or Sunday if needed.
  • Basic knowledge of machinery including 1st processing poultry machinery and/or de-boning equipment.
  • Associate degree or Technical Certificate (or equivalent experience).
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements, especially those governing the food industry.
  • High level of interpersonal skills.
  • Intermediate computer skills with a focus on PM Systems
  • Occasionally lift up to 100 lbs.

title: Mobile Coordinator - Vermont & Surrounding Areas
description:
Are you a dedicated OSHC leader who thrives in a fast-paced, supportive environment and enjoys making a real impact across multiple services? We are looking for a passionate and adaptable Mobile Coordinator to support our Outside School Hours Care services across the Vermont region.

This is a permanent part-time opportunity, working 38 hours per week across split shifts, Monday to Friday:

  • Before School Care: 6:00am – 9:00am
  • After School Care: 2:30pm – 6:00pm
  • Block shifts during school holidays between 6:00am – 6:00pm

Why You'll Love Working With Us

  • Work-Life Balance: Our split shift model gives you your middle of the day back, so you can study, manage family life, or enjoy personal time.
  • Competitive Pay: $79,499 - $85,000 plus superannuation + car allowance, rewarding the important role you play every day.
  • Regional Manager Support: Leading a service doesn't mean doing it alone. Your Regional Manager will provide coaching, guidance and practical support every step of the way.
  • Coordinator Loyalty Program: Enjoy $1,250 in retention bonuses during your first year as a thank you.
  • Family-Friendly Support: Access paid parental leave (10 weeks) and up to 50% off childcare fees, supporting you and your family now and in the future.
  • Career Growth & Development: Build your skills through paid training and clear pathways to progress within JAG.
  • Health, Wellbeing & Lifestyle Benefits: Access discounted gym & wellbeing memberships, health insurance and retail savings, helping your money go further.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn $1,000 cash for every successful referral and help us grow our exceptional team.

About the Role

Junior Adventures Group is seeking an experienced Mobile Coordinator to support the delivery of high-quality Outside School Hours Care services across Vermont & Surrounding Areas.

The Mobile Coordinator works directly within our before-school, after-school and vacation-care services. The position provides hands-on care and supervision to school-aged children while supporting Service Coordinators, Assistant Coordinators and Educators across multiple locations.

The successful applicant will regularly attend OSHC services, provide leadership coverage during planned and unplanned absences, and ensure children continue to receive safe, engaging and developmentally appropriate care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and conduct educational and recreational activities for children attending before-school, after-school and vacation care, as well as food and menus in accordance with nutritional, dietary, hygiene and food-safety requirements.

  • Guide children’s behaviour and social development using positive, inclusive and child-centred practices.

  • Support children’s individual wellbeing, medical and dietary requirements, including medication documentation and risk-minimisation plans.

  • Monitor and evaluate educational programs to ensure activities are engaging, inclusive, culturally appropriate and responsive to children’s needs.

  • Provide direct service leadership and ratio cover when replacing Service Coordinators or Service Managers. Coach, mentor and support Coordinators, Assistant Coordinators and Educators.

  • Conduct service visits, compliance checks, risk assessments, emergency drills and safety reviews. Support services to comply with the National Quality Framework, National Quality Standards and applicable legislation.

  • Support incident, complaint, workplace health and safety and child-safeguarding processes.

  • Assist with employee onboarding, rostering, attendance records and service-improvement initiatives.

  • Build positive relationships with children, families, schools, educators and local communities.

Who are we looking for?

You are a confident and adaptable leader who enjoys supporting teams and creating meaningful experiences for children.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • An AQF Level 5 or Level 6 qualification in Early Childhood Education and Care, or another approved qualification for outside school hours care, as required under the applicable state regulations.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with children in an education and care environment, preferably within OSHC.

  • Experience leading and supporting teams within regulated education and care services.

  • Sound knowledge of the National Quality Framework, National Quality Standards and My Time, Our Place.

  • Experience planning and implementing educational and recreational programs for school-aged children.

  • Demonstrated ability to support child safety, active supervision, regulatory compliance and service improvement.

  • The ability to establish effective relationships across multiple services, schools and communities.

  • A current driver’s licence and the ability to travel between services within the region.

Mandatory Requirements

The successful applicant must hold or be able to obtain:

  • A current Working with Children Check;

  • A satisfactory National Police Check;

  • Current First Aid, CPR, asthma and anaphylaxis qualifications;

  • A National Foundations of Child Safety Certificate; and

  • Full working rights or eligibility to work in Australia.

A Food Handling or Food Safety qualification is desirable.

At Junior Adventures Group, child safety and child safeguarding principles are our top priorities. Our recruitment process includes thorough background checks and screenings to ensure the wellbeing of all children in our care.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

title: Sr. Analytics Analyst
description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems, and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration.

As our Sr. Analytics Analyst, you will play a critical role in transforming data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making across the Revenue Cycle Organization. You’ll lead efforts in reporting, analysis, automation, and quality assurance—delivering high-impact solutions that support operational excellence and executive visibility.

Here's what you will experience working as Sr. Analytics Analyst:

  • Report Creation
    • Design and deliver recurring Power BI and ad-hoc Excel reports to stakeholders.
    • Acquire and manage data from internal and external sources.
    • Ensure timely delivery of insights for business-critical decisions.
  • Analysis
    • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
    • Translate findings into clear, concise summaries for leadership and operations.
    • Support strategic initiatives with data-driven recommendations.
  • Automation & Process Improvement
    • Utilize development tools such as SQL Server, Snowflake, Databricks, and Git.
    • Experience with programming languages such as SQL, Python, and/ or YAML.
    • Identify and implement process enhancements to improve quality, efficiency, and accuracy.
  • AI Agent Design for Reporting
  • Design and develop AI-powered agents to automate insight generation and reporting workflows.
  • Integrate AI models to enhance analytics capabilities and enable intelligent decision support.
  • Evaluate and implement AI tools to improve efficiency and accuracy in data-driven processes.
  • Data Modeling
  • Design and optimize large-scale data models to support complex analytics and reporting requirements.
  • Implement dimensional modeling and star schema architectures for efficient data analysis.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to ensure scalable and maintainable data structures.
  • Quality Assurance
    • Establish and enforce validation standards for data integrity and report accuracy.
    • Conduct thorough QA checks on deliverables and reporting outputs.
    • Document and maintain quality protocols to ensure consistency.

Required Skills:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience working in an analytics role with complex datasets.
  • Background in healthcare, finance, or operations analytics.
  • Expert in SQL on any platform, including Snowflake/T-SQL/Microsoft SQL (must pass proficiency test).
  • Advanced experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Familiarity with Epic data structures and healthcare data systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiar with cloud-based data warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks).
  • Proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development workflows.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and large-scale data environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot CLI) and demonstrated ability to leverage AI models for analytics and automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other programming languages such as Python or DAX to automate the delivery of reports across an enterprise is also preferred.
  • Experience with Python or PySpark for data analysis and automation.
  • Knowledge of data governance and compliance standards.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing AI agents for business process automation and analytics workflows.

For this US-based position, the base pay range is $52,025.00 - $97,528.69 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.This job is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan at a target of 5.00%

title: 2027 Spring Intern - Cell Culture and Bioprocess Operations (CCBO)
description:
The Position

2027 Spring Intern - Cell Culture and Bioprocess Operations (CCBO)


Department Summary


We in Cell Culture and Bioprocess Operations develop the cell lines used to make our products, improve the process of cell line development, manufacture GMP cell banks to support clinical and commercial drug substance production, and develop the fermentation and cell culture processes to support pre-clinical and clinical development through Phase III. We provide essential material to gRED, reduce the risk/cost/time of process development through technology development, and deliver the process through small and large scale pilot runs.


This internship position is located in South San Francisco, on-site


The Opportunity


As a Technical Development Intern, Laboratory focus, you may be assigned a project in one of the following areas within CCBO:


  • Cell Line Development
  • Host Cell Development
  • Cell Culture Bioprocess Operation
  • Cell Culture and Fermentation Development
  • Genetics and Cell Engineering
  • Pharmaceutical Development
  • Molecular Biology
  • Bioprocess

Your key responsibilities include:


  • Conduct lab focused research under a supervisor’s guidance
  • Thoroughly document activities electronically
  • Thoroughly organize, analyze and interpret data
  • Prepare for regular meetings to report and present work progress
  • Present work to different team members and the department

Program Highlights


  • Intensive 6 Months (with a possible 6-month extension) full time (40 hours per week) paid internship.
  • Program start dates are in January 2027 (Spring).
  • A stipend, based on location, will be provided to help alleviate costs associated with the internship.
  • Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects.
  • Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.
  • Final presentations of project work to senior leaders.
  • Lead or participate in intern committees to design and coordinate program events and initiatives.
  • Professional & personal development curriculum throughout the program, including networking opportunities, workshops, and panel discussions.
  • Participate in volunteer projects, social events, and team-building activities.

Who You Are (Required)


Required Education: You meet one of the following criteria:


  • Must be pursuing or have attained an Associate's Degree.
  • Must be pursuing a Bachelor's Degree (enrolled student).
  • Must have attained a Bachelor's Degree (not currently enrolled in a graduate program).
  • Must be pursuing a Master's Degree (enrolled student).
  • Must have attained a Master's Degree.
  • Must be pursuing a PhD (enrolled student).
  • Must have attained a PhD.

Required Majors: Chemical Engineering, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Bioengineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Biophysics, or related disciplines.


Required Skills:


  • Detail-oriented, enthusiastic, and self-directed individual who is excited about tackling complex and creative scientific challenges in an industrial setting.
  • Ability to show a high degree of adaptive capacity.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications


  • Relevant work experience in research labs or the biotechnology industry is desirable but not required.
  • Lab work experience is preferred but not required.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
  • Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.


The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $26.00-$47.00 per hour. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position also qualifies for paid holiday time off benefits.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Azure DevOps
description:
Description

At UBDS Group, we simplify complexity and deliver innovative, secure solutions at pace. As we continue to grow our cloud and engineering capabilities, we're looking for an experienced Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to design, build and improve secure, scalable cloud platforms and delivery pipelines for our clients.

Description

At UBDS Group, we simplify complexity and deliver innovative, secure solutions at pace. As we continue to grow our cloud and engineering capabilities, we're looking for an experienced Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to design, build and improve secure, scalable cloud platforms and delivery pipelines for our clients. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation and modern DevOps practices. You'll work across complex client environments, collaborating with Cloud Engineers, Architects, Security specialists and delivery teams to automate infrastructure, improve engineering practices and enable teams to deploy services quickly, consistently and securely. We're looking for someone with strong Azure and DevOps experience who can take ownership of technical challenges, make pragmatic engineering decisions and help establish high-quality engineering practices across delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain secure and scalable Azure cloud environments.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using technologies such as Terraform and Bicep.
  • Design, implement and optimise CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Automate the provisioning, configuration and deployment of cloud infrastructure and services.
  • Build reusable infrastructure modules, deployment patterns and engineering components.
  • Implement automated testing, quality controls and security checks within deployment pipelines.
  • Apply DevSecOps principles, embedding security throughout the development and deployment lifecycle.
  • Work with Architects and engineering teams to translate solution designs into deployable cloud platforms and services.
  • Support the implementation of Azure networking, identity, security, compute, storage and platform services.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and observability across cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex platform, deployment and infrastructure issues.
  • Improve reliability, scalability and operational performance through automation and engineering best practice.
  • Support containerised workloads and modern application platforms where appropriate.
  • Work within appropriate governance, security and compliance requirements, particularly within regulated and secure environments.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, design decisions and knowledge sharing.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers within delivery teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, engineering standards and reusable capability across UBDS Group.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Significant hands-on experience delivering solutions within Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines, repositories and associated tooling.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform and/or Bicep.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated cloud deployment pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of Azure services, including networking, identity, compute, storage and security.
  • Experience with Git and modern source-control practices.
  • Strong understanding of DevOps and DevSecOps principles and practices.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using technologies such as PowerShell, Bash or Python.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging and operational tooling within Azure environments.
  • Understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access management, RBAC, secrets management and secure configuration.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure and deployment issues.
  • Strong understanding of resilient, scalable and highly available cloud architecture.
  • Experience working within Agile engineering and multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable Experience

  • Microsoft Azure certifications.
  • HashiCorp Terraform certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones and enterprise-scale Azure environments.
  • Experience with GitOps approaches and tooling.
  • Experience with policy-as-code and automated governance.
  • Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights or equivalent observability tooling.
  • Experience implementing automated security scanning within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience with configuration management and automation tooling.
  • Experience working within public sector, financial services or other regulated environments.
  • Experience operating within environments subject to UK Government security requirements.
  • Active UK Security Clearance (SC) or current eligibility to obtain and maintain SC clearance.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines strong Azure knowledge with an automation-first mindset. You'll be comfortable working hands-on with Azure, Terraform, pipelines and code while also understanding the wider architecture, security and operational requirements of the solutions you're building. You'll look for opportunities to automate rather than repeat manual processes, build reusable solutions rather than solve the same problem multiple times, and embed security and quality into engineering practices from the outset. You won't need to be a specialist in every Azure service. You'll have strong depth across Azure and DevOps, sound engineering judgement and the ability to work with architects and specialists when deeper expertise is required. Most importantly, you'll take ownership of technical problems and help teams deliver secure, reliable cloud solutions at pace.

title: Associate Full Stack Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join a cyber security company in Bahrain that receives a very large volume of security telemetry from many customers, The platform runs automated analysis, gives our operations teams the tools to reach and act on decisions. The platform serves many customers from a single deployment, so every pipeline stage has to hold up under strict tenant isolation, bursty traffic, third-party rate limits, and partial failure. The engineering problems are, first and foremost, distributed systems problems. The team is small and senior in outlook. Engineers ship to production, own what they ship, and work directly with the operations teams who use the product every day. We hire for engineering quality above everything else. You will build production components of the platform from your first month, paired with a senior engineer who owns the subsystem you work in, and you will grow toward owning one yourself. This is not a junior role in the usual sense. We are looking for someone early in their career who has already shown they operate above their level, and who wants hard systems problems rather than glue code.

Desired Candidate Profile

Role Requirements: Two or more years writing production software in TypeScript on Node.js or in Python, with a working command of the other. Hands-on experience with a system that had real scale. You contributed to, and can explain in detail, a service that handled sustained high throughput, large data volumes, or many concurrent tenants. You need not have designed it, but you must know why it was built the way it was and where its limits were. A proven record of excellence, evidenced by at least one of: graduating at the top of your cohort from a strong program; a competitive programming or security capture-the-flag ranking; meaningful contributions to a widely used open-source project; an early promotion or an outsized ownership grant at a previous employer; a shipped feature with a measured business or reliability outcome you can describe. Solid fundamentals: data structures, concurrency and asynchronous programming, HTTP and REST, relational and document databases, message queues. Discipline: you write tests without being asked, you read the code you depend on, and your pull requests explain the why. Clear written communication in English. Much of our design work happens in documents and pull request threads. Exposure to cyber-security: log analysis, endpoint-detection tooling, the MITRE ATTACK framework, or a security-focused degree or certification Used a workflow orchestration engine or a streaming platform in production. Deployed to Kubernetes and debugged a pod that would not start. Integrated with a third-party API that had strict rate limits and lived to tell the tale. No security background required. You'll learn how defenders think and how attacks unfold.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

Senior individual contributor with 6 or more years of experience, at least 2 in a senior or lead capacity

LEVEL: Senior Software Engineer (individual contributor, with architectural authority and mentoring responsibility)

EXPERIENCE: 6+ years of professional software engineering, 2+ senior or lead on a production system

LANGUAGES: TypeScript (Node.js) and Python

STACK: TypeScript on Node.js and Python for services; React for the user interface; durable workflow orchestration; document, graph, and in-memory data stores; containers on Kubernetes in a major public cloud; distributed tracing and metrics throughout.

OWNERSHIP: One or more of: telemetry ingestion and normalization; workflow orchestration; the third-party integration framework; automated analysis; the response and enforcement engine

LOCATION: Manama, Bahrain

About the Role

We build a cyber-security platform that receives very large volumes of security telemetry from many customers, normalizes it into a common schema, runs automated analysis over it, and gives our operations teams the tools to reach and act on decisions. The platform serves many customers from a single deployment, so every pipeline stage has to hold up under strict tenant isolation, bursty traffic, third-party rate limits, and partial failure. The engineering problems are, first and foremost, distributed systems problems.

The team is small and senior in outlook. Engineers ship to production, own what they ship, and work directly with the operations teams who use the product every day. We hire for engineering quality above everything else.

You will own one or more of the subsystems that make the platform work under load. Ownership means the design, the delivery, the production operation, and the reliability numbers. We need someone who has already done this elsewhere: you designed a system that many people depended on, watched it break at scale, and rebuilt the parts that broke. You can hold a room of engineers to a high bar without slowing them down, and you will be expected to mentor associate engineers toward ownership of their own.

What we Require

  • Six or more years of professional software engineering, including at least two in a senior or lead capacity on a production system.
  • You designed and operated a system at scale. Be ready to give the numbers: throughput, data volume, tenants or users, latency percentiles, availability. Be ready to tell us what broke, what it cost, and what you changed. We weight the second half of that story more than the first.
  • Distributed systems depth: queues and streams, workflow engines, retries and idempotency, consistency trade-offs, partial failure, backpressure, observability. You hold opinions on these earned through incidents, not only through reading.
  • Strong TypeScript on Node.js and strong Python, with the judgment to know which to use where, and comfort reading and fixing code in either.
  • Cloud and Kubernetes fluency. You have run services on Kubernetes in production and understand what the cluster does when you are not looking.
  • Production ownership. You have defined service-level objectives, led incident response, run blameless post-incident reviews, and driven the follow-through.
  • A proven record of excellence, evidenced by several of: promotions ahead of the typical cadence; ownership of a system critical to your employer's business; public work such as talks, papers, patents, or open-source projects with real users; a reputation among former colleagues we can verify by reference; a measurable outcome you drove, such as an order-of-magnitude cost, latency, or reliability improvement.

title: Trust & Safety Specialist — Content Moderation
description:
We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew.

Trust & Safety Specialist — Content Moderation


Location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA (hybrid — San Francisco and/or San Jose offices)

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hrs/week), W-2

Department: Trust & Safety


About the Role

ModSquad is seeking a Trust & Safety Specialist — Brand Representative supporting a leading creative technology company's content moderation and abuse operations at their office in San Francisco or San Jose. As a ModSquad employee, you will work directly within the client's Trust & Safety operations team, serving as a front-line operator for content review, abuse report handling, escalation management, and quality and training support.

This is not a generalist support role. The core of this work is high-volume, policy-driven content moderation embedded inside one of the world's leading creative technology companies, covering a wide range of violation types including harmful and illegal content, account abuse, and policy enforcement across creative tools and platforms. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and care deeply about keeping online spaces safe, read on.

This position must be performed in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Candidates must be authorized and able to work from that location. The first two weeks are an onboarding period requiring four days per week in office, with flexibility to split between the San Francisco and San Jose locations. After onboarding, the schedule is three days per week in office — Tuesdays are fixed; other days are flexible. Desk space is available at both the San Francisco and San Jose offices.


What You'll Do

  • Review, analyze, and act on sensitive, violative, and illegal content in accordance with the client's content safety policies and guidelines, ensuring accurate and timely enforcement decisions.
  • Review, analyze, and action abuse reports and handle proactive content moderation workflows across the client's platforms and tools.
  • Escalate urgent or high-priority requests to the Trust & Safety Policy and Ops team and leadership, with clear documentation and appropriate urgency.
  • Conduct quality control reviews of moderation decisions, including calibration sessions and accuracy audits, to ensure consistency with policy and identify areas for coaching.
  • Develop and deliver training programs and onboarding materials for new and existing team members.
  • Develop efficient processes, documentation, and metrics to support operational consistency and performance visibility.
  • Identify trends in content, queue data, and operational patterns and surface insights to inform process improvements and tooling enhancements.
  • Communicate effectively with a diverse audience including cross-functional partners, vendor teams, and leadership.

Required

  • Strong analytical judgment for nuanced, gray-area content decisions where policy application is not immediately obvious.
  • Detail oriented, highly organized, and able to maintain documentation standards under volume and time pressure.

Preferred

title: Associate Director / Director of Development
description:
Who We Are

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation.

The Role

CDI is looking for an Associate Director or Director of Development to run our fundraising operations. You’ll report directly to our Co-Founder and Executive Director, who will continue to serve as CDI’s primary fundraiser. Your role will be to enable her fundraising in two key ways: (1) by running an exceptionally organized fundraising operation behind the scenes, and (2) by being responsible for grant writing and reporting responsibilities. This role combines meaningful ownership—you’ll operate with significant autonomy—with the chance to work with an experienced fundraiser and deepen your own expertise.

We’re looking for a development generalist with two super strengths: (1) operational excellence and (2) exceptional writing and communication skills. You bring rigor and organization to everything you touch, and you can make complex ideas clear and compelling without flattening their nuance. You notice details, anticipate what’s coming, and are always looking for a smarter way to run the work.

We’re open to candidates with different levels of fundraising experience. At the Director level, you’d take on more relationship management and strategy from the start; at the Associate Director level, you’d have room to grow into those responsibilities over time. What matters most to us is that you take real pride in the quality of your work and believe deeply in CDI’s mission.

What You’ll Do

Grant Writing & Management

  • Lead development and submission of compelling grant proposals, reports, and donor materials.

  • Translate CDI’s work and impact into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with funders while staying true to CDI’s voice and strategy.

  • Collaborate closely with Finance, Marketing & Communications, and program teams across CDI to gather the content needed for grant proposals and reports.

  • Maintain an exceptionally high bar for both the quality of all grant materials and the efficiency of the processes behind them.

  • Maintain a comprehensive grants calendar; proactively manage all deadlines for grants and other funder commitments.

Development Operations

  • Own the systems and infrastructure behind CDI’s fundraising work, from HubSpot and funder records to internal workflows and documentation.

  • Maintain and refine core assets, including reusable grant content, case studies, pitch decks, templates, and annual reports.

  • Partner closely with Finance to process new contributions, track grant requirements, and maintain funder and grant documentation.

  • Keep CDI’s fundraising pipeline current and actionable; partner with Finance to translate that pipeline into revenue projections.

  • Build and continuously improve the workflows, tools, and systems that keep CDI’s fundraising function running smoothly.

Fundraising Strategy & Relationships

  • Proactively manage the preparation and follow-through around the Executive Director’s funder relationships, enabling her to focus on relationship building.

  • Support the Executive Director in shaping fundraising strategy and priorities.

  • Conduct prospect and landscape research to identify new funding opportunities and inform fundraising strategy.

  • Depending on experience, directly manage and steward a portfolio of funder relationships.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in development or fundraising, including experience writing successful grants in the six- and seven-figure range.

  • Passionate about development operations, with experience building systems and processes that keep fundraising work running exceptionally smoothly, particularly in smaller or growing organizations.

  • An excellent writer and communicator who can make complex ideas clear and compelling for different audiences.

  • Exceptionally organized and self-directed; you keep work moving, stay ahead of deadlines, and require minimal oversight.

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a very high bar for quality and accuracy.

  • Strong judgment; you notice nuance, anticipate issues before they happen, and can assess what requires attention or escalation.

  • Passionate about constructive dialogue and aligned with CDI’s values.

For the Director role, we’ll also look for:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in development or fundraising, including 2+ years in management or leadership roles.

  • Experience owning funder relationships through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

  • Experience building and executing fundraising strategies to achieve philanthropic revenue goals of $1 million or more.

What We Offer

  • A Mission-Driven Culture — our work culture genuinely reflects our mission, characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness

  • Unlimited PTO — recharge on your own schedule with unlimited paid time off, in addition to 13 company holidays

  • Health, Vision & Dental — health, vision, and dental plans through, with CDI contributing toward your premiums each month

  • 401(k) Match — invest in your future with a 100% match on your contributions, up to 3% of your pay

  • Professional Development — an annual budget to invest in your growth: build new skills, deepen existing ones, and stay inspired in your work

  • Remote Work Support — up to $500 reimbursed for home office equipment and up to $50/month reimbursed for home internet or cell phone expenses

The Details

  • Compensation: Associate Director: $101,000–$113,000; Director: $132,000–$147,000

  • Reports to: Executive Director

  • Direct reports: None

  • Schedule: Full-time, flexible within U.S. time zones

  • Target start date: ASAP

  • Location: Remote, must be based in the U.S.


A note on AI: We know AI has become a useful writing assistant, and we’re comfortable with candidates using it that way. But when AI does too much of the writing, applications start to sound remarkably similar, making it hard for us to understand what you uniquely bring to the table. Please keep this in mind as you prepare your application.

Highlights

CDI is hiring a resourceful, detail-oriented Director of Development Operations to own our fundraising systems, relationships, and grant process, and support our Executive Director.

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.

A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

Job Summary





To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Logistics Analyst located in Mechanical Plant Batu Kawan, Penang.


Enhance product workflow by researching and developing logistics plans that affect production, distribution, and inventory. Create and review logistics procedures to maximize client satisfaction and minimize cost.


What a typical day looks like:


Responsible for ensuring productivity, efficiency, and management of various logistics operations. These operations may include, but are not limited to, tracking product shipments, contract negotiations, preparation of budget and cost analysis statements, creation of more efficient logistical planning, and coordination of shipments.


  • Recommend improvements to existing or planned logistics processes.
  • Research for logistics data, using methods such as data mining, data modeling, or cost or benefit research.
  • Apply investigation methods or tools to comprehend, predict, or control logistics operations or processes.
  • Interpret data on logistics elements, such as availability, maintainability, reliability, supply chain management, strategic sourcing or distribution, supplier management, or transportation.
  • Prepare reports on logistics performance measures.
  • Write or revise standard operating procedures for logistics processes.
  • Confer with logistics management teams to define ways to optimize service levels, maintain supply-chain efficiency, or minimize cost.
  • Maintain databases of logistics data and information in accordance with corporate policies.
  • Provide ongoing researching in areas such as transportation costs, parts procurement, back orders, or delivery processes.
  • Develop or maintain models for logistics uses, such as cost estimating or demand forecasting.
  • Monitor industry standards, trends, or practices to identify developments in logistics planning or execution.
  • Track product flow from origin to final delivery. Monitor flor of vehicles or inventory using logistics systems.
  • Define packaging requirements.
  • Compute reporting metrics, such as on-time delivery rates and order fulfillment rates.
  • Manage systems to ensure that pricing structures adequately reflect logistics costing.
  • Contact carriers for rates or schedules.
  • Communicate with or monitor service providers, such as ocean carriers, air freight forwarders, global consolidators, customs brokers, or trucking companies.
  • Compare locations or environmental policies of carriers or suppliers to make transportation resolutions with lower environmental impact.
  • Develop or maintain freight rate databases for use by supply chain departments to define the most economical modes of transportation.
  • Reorganize shipping schedules to consolidate loads, maximize vehicle usage, or limit the movement of empty vehicles or containers.
  • Develop or maintain payment systems to ensure accuracy of vendor payments.
  • Route or reroute drivers in real time with remote route navigation software, satellite linkup systems, or global positioning systems (GPS) to improve operational efficiencies.
  • Enter carbon-output or environmental-impact data into spreadsheets or environmental management or auditing software programs.


The experience we’re looking to add to our team:


  • Requires a Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent experience.
  • Requires a minimum of 2 year of experience in logistics.
  • A background in mechanical manufacturing industry would be an added advantage.

What you’ll receive for the great work you provide:

  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Benefits
  • Allowances and Bonuses

title: Senior Data Engineer (Helsinki, other)
description:
Apply between 23 September 2026 and 7 October 2026 23:59 (Europe/Helsinki)

Join Elisa’s Data & AI Team as a Senior Data Engineer!

At Elisa, our Data & AI function is dedicated to developing large-scale data and AI applications to meet various business needs. You would be joining our Data Modeling and Delivery team, which is responsible for delivering data pipelines, data warehouse, tools & best practices around Data and AI area for organization. We value data and are committed to enhancing our customers' experiences in their everyday lives.

The Role

We are looking for a passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Modeling and Delivery team on our cloudification journey. In this role, you will design and implement data models, data pipelines, and other development items that support multiple business areas. This role requires strong data integration skills, solid coding experience, and the ability to turn business needs into reliable data solutions. For that matter, the role will require not only knowledge of the technical side, but also to develop a good understanding of the business processes powering Elisa’s operations.

In this job, you can use your skills in a creative and versatile way right at the heart of our company, as we maintain and further develop our platform.

We at Elisa believe in the importance of face-to-face interaction in maintaining and developing our culture as well as strengthening the sense of belonging and sense of community. We have a hybrid work model in place, where the expectation is that Elisians will work on average three days a week at the office.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build and own data models and pipelines in BigQuery and Cloud Composer (Airflow) from requirements to production.
  • Make technical design decisions and help set team standards for modeling, testing, code quality and documentation.
  • Work directly with business stakeholders, translating their needs into reliable data solutions and building deep knowledge of one or more business domains.
  • Continuously improve and optimize data operations, review code and work in collaboration with other engineers.
  • Help shape how we use AI in data engineering: explore AI-assisted development, share what works with the team, and help turn it into shared practices.

What to Expect:

  • A collaborative environment where you'll never be alone.
  • A team that supports each other and learns together.
  • Exposure to a modern tech-stack and business domain.
  • Flexibility to work from any Elisa office in Finland, with occasional travel to our HQ in Pasila, Helsinki.

What We Expect from You

  • Strong experience with modern data engineering or data warehouse modeling, and development, with the ability to build reliable, production-ready data solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python/SQL; knowledge of other programming languages is a plus.
  • Practical development experience in some major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience is a big advantage, as this is our main platform.
  • Ability to build infrastructure and components using best practices (e.g., IaC with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, git).
  • Knowledge of GCP Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow).
  • Familiarity with data processing frameworks like GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Datastream.
  • Interest in AI-assisted development, with a practical mindset for using AI tools to work smarter and identifying where they can genuinely add value in our development practices.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or LLM-based tooling (e.g. Github Copilot, Gemini) in a data engineering context is considered a plus.
  • Write maintainable and well-tested code.
  • Good communication skills and fluency in English.
  • Previous experience in team mentorship or supervisory roles is also considered an asset.

Here are some of the things why we like working at Elisa but don’t take our word for it, come and see for yourself!

  • In this role you have an opportunity to work with true big data
  • Friendly and highly skilled colleagues
  • We are a large Finnish company with over 2 million customers and you have a unique opportunity to impact our customers' everyday lives.
  • We offer and develop a variety of digital services, making our work diverse and impactful.
  • Elisa is rated as one of the world’s most sustainable companies, our mission is a sustainable future through digitalisation.
  • As a large IT house, we provide modern tools and work with the latest technology.
  • We are known for our flexible working conditions, endless learning opportunities, and friendly, laid-back culture.

title: Transmission Line Engineer, Energy

Who is Welty Energy?

Welty Energy, an affiliate of Welty, is a professional services company specializing in program and project management, transmission line engineering, substation engineering and construction oversight on transmission, substation and distribution projects ranging in voltages from 4kV to 765kV.

Headquartered in Akron, OH, and working nationally, Welty Energy currently manages approximately $500 million in construction projects for electric utilities in the Midwest and Northeast regions of the U.S.

As a Transmission Line Engineer II, you will design high voltage transmission lines (34kV – 500kV).

While this position can be remote the hired team member is to be based in the state of OH, VA, WV, MD, PA (currently). Relocation and sponsorship is unfortunately not provided at this time.

Day to day, you may:

  • Prepare construction plan documents as required per project.

title: Feed Mill Panel Operator (Utility)
description:
The Feed Mill Panel Operator visually monitors and programs computer terminals, as well as operates all associated equipment in order to efficiently formulate, pelletize and direct all feeds to their proper bins. Must be able to dump micro-components into correct bins, apply the correct quantities of fat to finished feeds, and be able to operate computerized and manual grinding equipment.

Principal and Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Monitors all batching, grinding, and pelleting terminals and associated equipment to ensure an efficient, effective, timely mix of raw feed ingredients to produce the best quality of feed possible.

Ensures that all feeds produced are made per their perspective formulas.

Performs maintenance and cleaning of some equipment is required.

Effectively communicates and cooperates with Quality Control, Mill management, and Maintenance personnel. Requires some feed sampling.

Coordinates feed production with dispatchers as related to feed orders and available bin space.

title: Principal Enterprise Identity Engineer - RDT Identity & Access Management
description:
The Position

Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity:

As the Principal Enterprise Identity Engineer, you are the ultimate technical authority and visionary for our global Enterprise Identity Management (EIM) and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) landscape. Moving beyond individual contribution, you will define the multi-year identity strategy, driving zero-trust initiatives across a highly complex, global ecosystem.

Operating at the highest levels of our technical ladder, you will bridge the gap between executive business strategy and deep technical execution. You will architect resilient, massively scalable identity frameworks, mentor senior engineering talent, and lead cross-functional transformations that protect our most critical global assets while enabling frictionless business operations.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the multi-year roadmap and end-to-end technical strategy for enterprise identity, aligning IGA architectures with global security policies and zero-trust frameworks.

  • Establish and enforce enterprise-wide architecture patterns, engineering standards, and reusable frameworks across identity, cloud, and infrastructure domains.

  • Architect and oversee the deployment of next-generation, SailPoint-based EIM solutions that operate flawlessly at a massive, distributed scale.

  • Translate complex security paradigms and regulatory requirements into actionable, board-level technical strategies.

  • Pioneer the adoption of emerging identity technologies, including decentralized identity, advanced ML-driven access analytics, and complex microservice/API integrations.

  • Act as the technical cornerstone for the identity organization, mentoring senior engineers and leading Tier 4 escalation and root-cause analysis for catastrophic or highly complex systemic issues.

Who you are:

Qualifications and Core Expertise

  • Minimum of 8-10 years of hands-on engineering experience in Cybersecurity and Identity Management, with at least 5 years operating at an enterprise architecture or principal level.

  • 5+ years of experience steering identity strategies in highly regulated, multinational enterprise environments (Healthcare, Finance, or similar industries highly preferred).

  • Deep-tier technical expertise in SailPoint (IdentityNow/IdentityIQ), encompassing enterprise-scale design, custom development, performance tuning, and global deployment.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Java and Python for developing highly complex connectors, custom rules, and automated workflows.

  • Proven track record of architecting integration solutions across complex multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and profound familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps methodologies, and microservices.

  • Exceptional executive presence with the ability to communicate deeply technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and lead distributed global engineering teams autonomously.

  • The ability to troubleshoot complex identity issues across multiple technology layers—from ISC configuration and APIs through connectors, applications, directories, and downstream provisioning systems.

  • Mentor engineers and solution architects, conduct architecture and design reviews, and help build a strong global Enterprise Identity community.

Education & Certifications

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or Advanced degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Certifications: CISSP, CISM, or CIAM is strongly preferred for this leadership level.

  • Technical Certifications: Advanced certifications in AWS/Azure/GCP Architecture or SailPoint highly desirable.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Must work onsite in South San Francisco
