title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description

Who are we?

Humanforce’s vision is to make work easier and life better for frontline and flexible workforces.

Humanforce provides the market leading, best-in-one human capital management (HCM) suite for frontline and flexible workforces - without compromise. Our employee centred, intelligent and compliant HCM suite is highly integrated and composable, and consists of Workforce Management (WFM), HR, Talent, Payroll, and Wellbeing.

Humanforce has built strong foundations since its founding in 2002. We help over 2300 customers and almost 1 million employees under management in 30+ countries, across a wide range of industries, including aged, child and health care; education; hospitality; retail; local government and more. Today, we have offices across Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom, North America and the Philippines.

Customers choose Humanforce because we enable them to deliver an exceptional employee experience, build a compelling employee value proposition, and connect the flow of the world’s talent with the growth, productivity and efficiency objectives of frontline and flexible workforces.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our growing product and engineering team. This is an opportunity to work across the full software development lifecycle, contributing to modern, scalable products used by organisations around the world. You will play an important role in designing, building and improving customer-focused solutions across both backend and frontend technologies.

You will work with a collaborative team of engineers, product managers, designers and other specialists. You will bring strong technical capability, sound engineering judgement and a genuine interest in solving complex problems in a practical, customer-focused way.

What you will do
  • Design, build, test and maintain high-quality full stack software solutions.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using .NET and related technologies.
  • Build responsive, intuitive user experiences using the frontend technologies and practices used by the team.
  • Contribute to technical design, architecture and engineering standards.
  • Work closely with Product, Design and other engineering teams to deliver valuable customer outcomes, while constructively challenging assumptions and negotiating practical scope where needed.
  • Translate business and customer needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Take ownership of work from discovery and estimation through to delivery and ongoing improvement, proactively looking beyond assigned tickets to identify and investigate opportunities to improve the product.
  • Adopt a testing-first mindset by writing, running and updating appropriate automated tests alongside code changes, validating behaviour before changes are released, and keeping test coverage and regression protection current as the system evolves.
  • Identify and address performance, scalability, reliability and security considerations.
  • Participate in code reviews and support a culture of clean, maintainable code.
  • Mentor and support the development of other engineers, helping to build an engaged, accountable and collaborative team.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues when required.
  • Be inquisitive about how the product and team work, challenge “this is how it’s always‑been” when appropriate, and have the courage to propose and help deliver meaningful changes to practices, tooling and ways of working.
  • Explore and responsibly apply AI tools to improve development efficiency, quality and problem-solving.
What we are looking for
  • Significant experience in full stack software engineering within a commercial product or SaaS environment.
  • Strong experience developing applications using .NET and C#.
  • Strong experience building user interfaces using the frontend technologies relevant to the team’s product, together with a solid understanding of modern frontend practices.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with relational databases.
  • Understanding of cloud platforms, automated testing, CI/CD and modern software delivery practices.
  • A testing-first mindset and practical experience writing, maintaining and improving automated tests appropriate to the change, such as unit, integration, API or end-to-end tests.
  • A strong sense of ownership for the quality, testability and maintainability of your changes.
  • Experience working with agile product and engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, engineering patterns and development lifecycle practices.
  • A track record of delivering reliable, maintainable and scalable software.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the ability to negotiate requirements and manage expectations constructively with Product.
  • Experience mentoring or leading other engineers, with the ability to support team engagement, accountability and development.
  • A genuinely inquisitive, ambitious and proactive mindset: someone who wants to understand the product, customers and underlying problems, actively looks for improvements, and has the courage to challenge established ways of working and make changes.
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development and AI-enabled product experiences.
Our values
  • We are bold
  • We are all in
  • We are customer obsessed
  • We do what we say
  • We are good humans
Our approach to flexibility

We are passionate about people making their own decisions about where and when they work. Our hybrid model of minimum two days a week of in office moments supports flexibility tailored to individual and team needs, empowering people to achieve their career and personal goals.

Benefits
  • A truly flexible workplace through our Flex@HF approach
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing global tech company
  • A focus on learning and development through Humanforce HR
  • A generous talent referral program – know great people, be rewarded
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers, 4 weeks’ for secondary

  • A cool reward and recognition program – shout to your colleagues and earn points to spend
  • Access to our own financial wellbeing platform Thrive – including earned wage access, tools to budget and save, perks and cashback across 100s of Australian retailers
  • Fun, collaborative culture with passionate people
  • A workplace where you can genuinely improve the world of work!

We are a diverse and dispersed organisation and are actively looking to grow our team with individuals from all diverse backgrounds. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, ages, genders, neurodiversity, religions, sexual orientations, and experiences to apply.

title: Technician (Toppen Shopping Centre)
location: Johor Bahru, Johor Darul Ta'zim, my
description:
The Facilities Management function ensures that buildings, technical systems, infrastructure, and operational environments are maintained safely, efficiently, sustainably, and in alignment with Ikano Retail operational standards and business objectives. The function supports operational continuity, maintenance planning, compliance, technical reliability, and customer experience through effective operational execution and technical support.

The Technician supports the effective delivery of daily maintenance and building operations within the Shopping Centre. The role contributes to maintaining safe, functional, and reliable facilities through preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment servicing, inspections, troubleshooting, and operational support activities to ensure operational continuity and a positive environment for customers, tenants, co-workers, and stakeholders.

Your assignment

Daily Operations & Maintenance

  • Perform servicing, repair, and maintenance of all mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems and building infrastructure.
  • Conduct routine inspections and operational checks on ACMV systems, lighting systems, electrical panels, plumbing systems, LPG systems, water systems, building structures, façades, and aesthetic components.
  • Take utility meter readings including electricity, Gas and water consumption and record operational data for reporting purposes.
  • Support smooth operation and maintenance of building facilities, technical systems, and operational assets.
  • Assist in maintaining operational areas, technical rooms, and facilities infrastructure in safe and functional condition.

Preventive Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Execute preventive maintenance activities according to approved schedules and CMMS requirements including Urbanise systems.
  • Maintain operating logs, maintenance checklists, equipment records, and technical documentation accurately.
  • Troubleshoot technical systems including Fire Protection Systems, ELV Systems, PA Systems, CCTV, Intrusion Alarm Systems, UPS Systems, and Public Display Panels.
  • Escalate abnormalities, technical faults, operational risks, and unresolved maintenance issues to the Technician Team Lead or Facilities Management team.
  • Support emergency response activities and after-hours operational breakdown support where required.
  • Support corrective maintenance works, technical troubleshooting, and operational recovery activities to minimise operational disruptions.

Safety & Compliance

  • Support Safety & Security operations by maintaining building safety equipment in accordance with SecCheck standards and operational requirements.
  • Ensure all operational and maintenance activities are carried out safely and with minimal disruption to customers, tenants, co-workers, and operations.
  • Follow Permit to Work (PTW) procedures, operational guidelines, and safety requirements during maintenance and contractor activities.
  • Support internal audits, operational inspections, authority visits, and compliance reviews where required.
  • Ensure operational tasks comply with statutory requirements, operational standards, SOPs, and governance expectations.

Contractor Support & Coordination

  • Assist in monitoring contractors and service providers during scheduled maintenance and ad-hoc operational works.
  • Check quality, completion status, and workmanship of vendor activities and report deficiencies or operational concerns where required.
  • Coordinate with other departments during operational activities, repairs, events, and tenant support works.
  • Support contractor operational coordination and ensure work activities comply with operational and safety requirements.

General Support

  • Assist in updating equipment inventories, PM checklists, maintenance documentation, and technical drawing records.
  • Support operational improvements, maintenance activities, and operational assignments as directed by the Technician Team Lead or Facilities Management team.
  • Perform ad-hoc operational duties, technical support tasks, and maintenance assignments required by the business.

  • Certificate in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Technology, or equivalent technical trade qualification.
  • Relevant trade certification such as Wireman or certification in Low Voltage Systems such as A0, A1, and A4 is preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in building maintenance, Facilities Management, or technical operations environments.
  • Good understanding of M&E systems, architectural drawings, plumbing systems, and technical infrastructure.
  • Familiar with CMMS systems, operational reporting, and maintenance documentation practices.
  • Basic reporting capability and ability to document completed works and operational updates clearly.
  • Experience in retail property management or facilities operations environments is preferred.
  • Good understanding of operational safety requirements, PTW procedures, and maintenance practices.
  • Proficient in Bahasa Malaysia and English both written and spoken.

We hire based on our values. Watch the video and answer the following question in your application:

Tell me about a typical week at work. How do you structure your week? What tips do you have to manage workload?

title: Maintenance - Cantley
description:
General Purpose: Provide general and preventive maintenance in food manufacturing industry equipment, and have basic knowledge of tools and equipment, and how to use them. Must always use and maintain personal protective equipment, and work in compliance with all company policies, Animal Welfare Guidelines, and local, state, and federal policies, laws, and regulations.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Troubleshoot, repair, replace, remove, and/or modify manufacturing structures and equipment to correct manufacturing issues of a mechanical, electrical, and/or structural nature.
  • Maintain accurate daily records of all work performed in the computerized maintenance management system.
  • Perform preventative maintenance (e.g., lubrication, inspection, etc.) for poultry production structures and equipment.
  • Maintain work area, tools, parts, and equipment in a clean and organized manner for the purposes of safety, efficiency, and appearance.
  • Perform installation and maintenance work as part of a team of skilled workers including electrical, mechanical systems, which require the safe and proficient use of shop tools (both hand and power).
  • Demonstrates sense of urgency and ability to handle multiple assignments efficiently.
  • Ability to distinguish priorities and develop a plan to minimize downtime in key areas.
  • Communicate with all levels of the organization including shift-to-shift transfer of knowledge/information, peers, production personnel, and management.
  • Any other corrective, preventative, or predictive maintenance functions or duties as assigned. General and preventive maintenance experience in the food manufacturing industry.
  • 2+ years previous experience in maintenance.
  • Able to speak, read, write, and comprehend English fluently.
  • Able to work any day including Saturday or Sunday if needed.
  • Basic knowledge of machinery including 1st processing poultry machinery and/or de-boning equipment.
  • Associate degree or Technical Certificate (or equivalent experience).
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements, especially those governing the food industry.
  • High level of interpersonal skills.
  • Intermediate computer skills with a focus on PM Systems
  • Occasionally lift up to 100 lbs.
  • Frequently and constantly walks throughout the facility.
  • Frequently stoops, kneels, and crawls.
  • Climb ladders occasionally.
  • Constantly subject to extremely wet and cold environments as well as wet and hot environments

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Time management: the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Strong team player
  • Commitment to company values
  • Follow all safety rules and procedures.
  • Operate or be trained to operate a forklift.
  • Be able to work overtime when needed.
  • Have no fear of heights.
  • Must have computer skills.
  • Familiar with Lockout Tagout, OSHA protocols

Physical Demands and work environment: The physical and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical demands: Regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and talk or hear. Occasionally required to sit. Frequently must squat, stoop, or kneel, reach above the head, and reach forward. Daily uses hand strength to grasp tools, supplies and equipment.

Work environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to weather conditions prevalent to the time. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. They often work in dusty, humid, and heated environments; as well as cold, moist environments.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist – Predictive Modeling & Generative AI

Location: Lisbon

Work Model: Hybrid (1-2 days per week)


About the Role

We are building a team to develop predictive algorithmic models for a major utilities company. This is a high-impact, applied data science role where you'll work at the intersection of machine learning, generative AI, and quantitative modeling to help anticipate market movements and price dynamics.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and validate predictive models for price forecasting, demand/supply dynamics, and market signal generation
  • Use generative AI tools (LLM-assisted coding, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agentic workflows) to speed up research, feature engineering, and model iteration
  • Work with large, messy, time-series-heavy datasets specific to our client's market
  • Translate trading team needs into modeling problems, and translate model outputs back into insights that can be acted on
  • Continuously test, monitor, and refine models in a live, fast-moving market environment
  • Collaborate with client engineers to embed models into production workflows
  • Document methodology and findings clearly for both technical and non-technical stakeholders


What We're Looking For

Experience & Technical Skills

  • 3–5 years of experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar applied role
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and standard ML/data stacks (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
  • Practical experience using generative AI / LLM tools in a real workflow (e.g., Copilot-style coding assistants, LangChain/LlamaIndex, RAG, prompt engineering, agentic pipelines) — this is a hands-on requirement, not just familiarity
  • Solid grounding in predictive modeling and time-series forecasting techniques
  • Comfortable working with SQL and large, real-world (i.e. imperfect) datasets
  • Experience deploying or maintaining models in a production or near-production setting is a plus


Domain Knowledge

  • Any exposure to commodities, trading, financial markets, or energy systems is a strong plus, not a requirement
  • A genuine will to learn a complex, fast-moving business model is essential


Soft Skills & Working Style

  • High degree of autonomy — comfortable owning problems end-to-end with limited hand-holding
  • Strong intellectual curiosity and drive to grow technically and domain-wise
  • Clear communicator, able to work closely with traders and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable in a hybrid, project-driven environment with evolving priorities

title: Lead Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React) - Independent Contractor
description:
Lead Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React)

Bogota, Colombia – Remote. -- Please note thatwhile this role is remote, we require team members to be based in this region for periodic in-person meet-ups.

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our team, taking technical ownership of a high-impact, customer-facing product, which some of the world's biggest companies, central banks and non-governmental organisations use to build revenue and volume through data and analytics. This is an opportunity to influence technical direction, elevate engineering standards and deliver features that make a meaningful difference to our clients.

What success looks like in this role:

  • Influencing and coaching the team engineers

  • Aligning your team on goals, outcomes and timelines

  • Collaborating with Product and Technology teams to translate our strategic roadmap into actionable tasks; providing visibility on delivery progress outside your team

  • Designing, developing, testing, maintaining and enhancing the Golang microservices and frontend applications you're responsible for

  • Delivering beautiful, performant interfaces, driven by our design system, for our customers

  • Improving the performance and observability of our services and applications

  • Improving the quality of life of your team and the business, through automation, process improvement or new technologies

About the team:

  • You will join a technical team of approximately 30 technologists with a key purpose of continuously and reliably collecting large amounts of financial data describing cross-border payments, then processing the data, verifying its quality and serving it to our users so that they can make informed business decisions

  • A typical team contains around three engineers and a Product Manager

  • You will be interacting with various stakeholders across the business in addition to your immediate team

You should apply if you can confidently:

  • Write Golang services and web app backends, and deploy them in Docker containers

  • Write performant SQL

  • Build beautiful, componentised application frontends in React/TypeScript

  • Understand clean code principles and the language idioms of TypeScript and Go, experience reviewing code using these principles and establishing team quality standards

  • Learn and engage with a new business domain and product

  • Communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical people

  • Talk about how you learn and improve your skills

These skills will help, but aren’t essential:

  • Applications with concurrent logic (i.e. goroutines)

  • Building CI/CD pipelines, especially with GitLab CI

  • Configuring and using observability tools (e.g. Prometheus and Grafana)

  • Experience utilising AI to increase productivity and efficiency of work and productionised AI tools

  • MaterialUI

  • Using Airflow, Python, Terrafrom

Tech Stack:

  • Golang, TypeScript, React, MaterialUI, MariaDB, Clickhouse, Gitlab, AWS, SQL

AI Usage Disclaimer:

At FXC Intelligence, we are enthusiastic about the use of AI tools and value candidates with experience or interest in AI technologies. However, we kindly ask that candidates refrain from using AI tools during interviews or for technical tasks unless explicitly instructed by us. This is because we want to understand your thought process and approach to tasks. If AI assistance is used in tasks or interviews where it was not permitted and is detected, the submission may be discounted.

About us:

FXC Intelligence is a leading provider of cross-border payments data and intelligence, providing some of the world's biggest companies, central banks and non-governmental organisations with the strategic insights, expertise and awareness to effectively compete in their chosen markets. By joining us, you will be diving into a world of data-driven exploration and innovation, revolutionising financial insights through cutting-edge technologies, machine learning and predictive analytics.

Your contributions will shape the future of cross-border finance, helping clients to uncover better paths to growth and profitability, as well as being a trusted reference and source for many of the leading international publications.

We are proud to produce industry-changing data and intelligence, aided by our company values of being customer-focused, taking ownership, knowledge, communication and leadership.

We’re an innovative company that strives to look after its team, and we take pride in providing a positive company culture. Feel free to check out ourBlog,Instagram, andGlassdoorpages to learn more about our culture and hear directly from our team about what it's really like to work with us!

At FXC Intelligence, we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity status or disability status.

title: Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS søker fagansvarlig lønn og bemanning
description:
Er du rå på Excel, nysgjerrig på hva tallene forteller – og liker å gjøre innsikt om til handling?

Vi i Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS søker en analytisk og initiativrik fagperson som vil videreutvikle hvordan vi jobber med lønn, bemanningsplanlegging og styringsinformasjon for våre butikker i SPAR, Joker og Nærbutikken.

Dette er en selvstendig rolle og et tydelig fagansvar. Du skal bruke data, systemer og fagkompetanse til å identifisere forbedringsmuligheter, sikre kvalitet og bidra til gode beslutninger og arbeidsprosesser.

Du vil jobbe tett med vårt driftsapparat, og være en viktig faglig støttespiller i arbeidet med lønn, bemanning og kompetanse. Du må trives med å ta initiativ og drive arbeidet fremover, samtidig som du samarbeider godt på tvers av HR, drift, lønnsavdelingen og andre fagmiljøer.

Stillingen er en del av HR-avdelingen i Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS og rapporterer til HR-direktør. Arbeidssted er Skøyen.

Dette vil du jobbe med

  • Utvikle og analysere styringsinformasjon for lønn og bemanning, identifisere avvik og forbedringsmuligheter og omsette innsikten til beslutningsstøtte og konkrete tiltak
  • Sikre kvalitet og etterlevelse av arbeidsmiljøloven, tariffavtaler og interne rutiner innen lønn, arbeidstid og bemanningsplanlegging
  • Jobbe tett med driftsapparatet ift. opplæring og veiledning slik at de blir trygge i spørsmål knyttet til lønn, bemanning, arbeidstid og relevant lov- og avtaleverk
  • Ha faglig ansvar for forvaltning og videreutvikling av Quinyx
  • Identifisere kompetansebehov og utvikle og gjennomføre opplæring og kompetansetiltak innen fagområdet og systembruk
  • Drive forbedrings- og effektiviseringstiltak innen eget fagområde og ansvar, fra analyse og idé til gjennomføring og oppfølging

Rollen handler i mindre grad om å løse enkeltsaker og mer om å forstå hvorfor avvik oppstår, bruke data til å finne årsakene og bidra til varige forbedringer.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av kombinasjonen av analyse, systemer og forbedringsarbeid, og som trives med å jobbe tett på driften.
Du er analytisk og strukturert, men også nysgjerrig og proaktiv. Du ser hva som bør gjøres, tar initiativ og trives med å drive fagområdet fremover på egen hånd.

Samtidig er du en god samarbeidspartner. Du evner å involvere og kommunisere godt med ledere, driftsapparatet, lønnsavdelingen og andre fagmiljøer. Du trives med å finne gode løsninger sammen med andre.

Du har god forretningsforståelse og evner å se sammenhengen mellom bemanning, lønnskostnader og våre mål. Samtidig er du pedagogisk og kommuniserer godt. Du evner å gjøre komplekse problemstillinger og data forståelige og relevante for ulike målgrupper, og motiveres av å utvikle kompetansen hos andre. Du evner å kombinere faglig tyngde med en praktisk forståelse for ledernes og butikkenes hverdag.

Vi ser etter deg som har

  • Relevant høyere utdanning, fortrinnsvis innen økonomi, HR eller tilsvarende
  • Minst 3–5 års relevant arbeidserfaring innen lønn, bemanningsplanlegging/Workforce Management, analyse eller tilsvarende fagområde
  • Avansert kompetanse i Excel, med erfaring i å sammenstille, analysere og strukturere større datamengder
  • Svært god systemforståelse og evne til å se sammenhenger mellom systemer, data og arbeidsprosesser
  • God forståelse for relevant lov- og avtaleverk og sammenhengen mellom arbeidsavtaler, arbeidstid, bemanning og lønn
  • Gode pedagogiske ferdigheter og erfaring med opplæring og kompetanseutvikling
  • Evne til å ta eierskap, drive initiativer fremover og skape resultater både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre
  • Erfaring med Power BI, Quinyx og/eller detaljhandel er en fordel.

Hvorfor denne rollen?

Du får en selvstendig fagrolle med stort handlingsrom, der du får mulighet til å forme og videreutvikle hvordan vi jobber med lønn, bemanning og analyse for butikkene våre i SPAR, Joker og Nærbutikken.

Du blir en viktig faglig sparringspartner for driftsapparatet og får bruke analyse og systemforståelse til å skape bedre beslutningsgrunnlag, utvikle kompetansen hos våre ledere og forbedre måten vi jobber på.

Du får mulighet til å sette retning innen eget fagområde og drive frem forbedringer som bidrar til bedre kvalitet, mer effektive arbeidsprosesser og god bemanningsplanlegging i butikkene våre.

Hos oss får du mer enn en spennende jobb

Vi holder til i moderne lokaler på Skøyen, med god kantine og et hyggelig og aktivt arbeidsmiljø. Som medarbeider hos oss får du blant annet støtte til trening, tilbud om årlig helsekontroll og mulighet til å søke økonomisk støtte gjennom NorgesGruppens miljøfond for ansatte.

Vi har også ulike sosiale aktiviteter gjennom året som bidrar til et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

Er dette noe for deg – da håper vi å høre fra deg.
Vi kan foreta bakgrunnsjekk via Semac.

Dette er Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS

Kjøpmannshuset er NorgesGruppens profilhus for kjøpmannseide butikker. Vi er et ledende selskap for utvikling og drift av riksdekkende kjeder for lokale supermarkeder og nærbutikker. Vi drifter og forvalter kjedene SPAR/EUROSPAR, Joker og Nærbutikken.

title: AI Specialist

The role requires curiosity, strong research skills, and the ability tolearn and experiment. Coding knowledge is useful as a technical background forprototyping and solution assessment, but it is not the main focus of theposition.

title: OSHC Educator (Unqualified) | St Jerome's OSHClub

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

title: Analyst, Supply Chain
description:
MISSION

The Analyst, Supply Chain ensures product availability, timely communication and supply chain flow performance in order to meet the needs of the business. This role also supports the larger supply chain group through inventory storage and processing capacity.

KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS

  • Product flow visibility and optimization

title: Sr Product Sppt Tech Advisor
description:
Job Overview

This role acts as a technical escalation point across Product Support, Platform Engineering, DaaS, and Operations, bridging product functionality and operational excellence.
• You will be responsible for advanced issue triage, root cause analysis, production support, and customer‑facing technical guidance, while driving continuous improvement in support processes, platform resilience, and customer experience. The role requires strong technical depth, cross‑team collaboration, and ownership mindset.
• Hybrid work model: 1–3 days per week from the Bengaluru office.

Key Responsibilities / Essential Functions
Product & Platform Support

• Own end‑to‑end incident triage, including problem identification, impact analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and permanent remediation.
• Support QA, UAT, and production go‑lives, including pre‑release readiness, cutover support, and post‑release validation.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

Operations & Support Governance

title: Senior Software Development Engineer ( Labs)
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer III (Full Stack) to join our Labs team. Labs is the platform that powers how HighLevel ships new features to production — controlling staged rollouts, feature flags, and experimentation across the platform, and closing the loop with in-product customer feedback. Today, every new capability shipped across HighLevel's platform passes through Labs' feature-flag and rollout infrastructure, spanning 100K+ agencies and the 2M+ businesses they serve. The systems we build directly shape how safely and quickly the rest of the engineering org can ship — enabling gradual rollouts, targeted enablement at the company and location level, and fast, safe rollback when something goes wrong. The team builds and scales core capabilities across feature flag management, staged feature rollout, and customer feedback collection. These systems let product and engineering teams control exactly who gets a feature and when, monitor adoption and health in real time, and gather structured feedback directly from agencies and locations to inform what ships next. As an SDE-3, you'll play a key role in building and evolving these systems across the frontend and backend, while contributing to technical architecture and engineering decisions. You'll work on challenges involving high-throughput flag evaluation, scalable APIs and services, distributed systems, and data architecture — with a strong focus on reliability, low latency, and correctness, since every other team's shipping velocity depends on this platform working correctly. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers across the org to take features from requirements and technical planning through implementation and production, while contributing to technical decisions and continuously improving the systems you own.

Responsibilities

  • Own and contribute to the architecture, design, and development of key product areas across Feature Flags, Staged Rollouts, and Customer Feedback within the Labs platform.
  • Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations, working across internal microservices and third-party platforms such as Statsig, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and performance.
  • Build performant and scalable frontend experiences for feature flag management, rollout configuration, and feedback collection workflows using modern frontend frameworks and component-driven architecture with strong state management practices.
  • Drive technical decisions, identify risks and trade-offs, and independently own complex features from technical design through production.
  • Leverage AI-first development practices and AI-assisted development tools to improve development, testing, debugging, and refactoring while maintaining strong quality and security standards.
  • Design data models and build efficient queries and caching strategies across data stores such as MongoDB and Redis, optimized for low-latency flag evaluation at scale.
  • Participate across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and technical design to implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Write clean, efficient, secure, and testable code with appropriate unit and integration test coverage.

title: Myyjä, Hyllykallio Kivisaarentie 2
description:
Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava R‑kioskin myyjämme.

R‑kioskilla asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Myyjänä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

  • Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
  • Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
  • Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
  • Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
  • Osallistut arjen sujuvuuteen: asiakkaat, työkaverit ja sinä viihdytte kioskilla yhtä lailla.

Miksi juuri sinä sopisit meille?

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen ja rohkea tarttumaan tehtäviin.
  • Pystyt ratkomaan ongelmatilanteita nopeasti ja palveluasenteella.
  • Sykähdyt vauhdikkaasta työstä ja nautit siitä, että jokainen päivä on erilainen.
  • Haluat tehdä työtä vastuullisesti – meillä se näkyy sekä valikoimassa että arjen teoissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana opit työn perusteet ja käytännöt.
  • Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun ammattilaiseksi.
  • Halutessasi väylän kohti esihenkilö- tai yrittäjäpolkua: voit hakea Trainee‑valmennusohjelmaamme ja edetä aina oman R‑kioskin yrittäjäksi asti.

Haemme Hyllykallio Kivisaarentie 2 R-kioskille myyjää. Työsuhde on osa-aikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Toivomme että pystyt työskentelemään keskimäärin 25 h/vko ja pystyt aloittamaan työt mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan!

Arvostamme

• Aikaisempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä

• Kiinnostusta kahvila- ja delimaailmaan

• Kokemusta pelimyynnistä ja postitoiminnoista

Edellytämme

• Ystävällistä ja iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

• Reipasta myyntihenkisyyttä

• Itsenäistä ja vastuullista otetta työhön

• Hygieniapassia

• Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

• Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

• Tarkastamme luottotiedot osana rekrytointiprosessia

title: Engineering Co-Op, Electro-Acoustics
description:
In this Electro-Acoustics Engineering Co-Op, you’ll work side-by-side with experienced design, development, and research engineers to help create the next generation of professional loudspeakers and audio systems. Over two consecutive semesters, you’ll get hands-on experience with the entire product-development process—from the first prototype and lab measurement to analysis, troubleshooting, refinement, and ultimately bringing a market-leading product to life.

This isn’t a co-op where you spend your days watching from the sidelines. You’ll be in the lab, building, measuring, analyzing data, and solving problems.

Your work may revolve around a primary engineering project, but you can expect plenty of variety along the way. Every day can bring a new technical challenge, experiment, or opportunity to learn something different.

What You’ll Do

Get Hands-On in the Lab

You’ll work directly with loudspeakers, test equipment, prototypes, and the systems used to evaluate professional audio products.

  • Constructing and modifying prototype loudspeaker systems.
  • Performing acoustical, electrical, mechanical, thermal, and materials testing.
  • Designing and building new test systems, including hardware, software, data acquisition, and measurement setups.
  • Maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing existing test equipment and systems.
  • Soldering, wiring, assembling components, and making mechanical repairs.
  • Assembling loudspeaker cabinets and moving loudspeaker systems between test rooms and facilities.
  • Performing acoustic measurements using microphones, anechoic chambers, impedance measurement systems, and other specialized equipment.
  • Setting up experiments and figuring out creative ways to measure things that don't have an obvious measurement method.

Analyze, Simulate & Solve Problems

Great audio engineering isn't just about hearing the difference—it’s about understanding why there is a difference.

  • Analyze acoustic, electrical, mechanical, and electro-magnetic test data.
  • Use simulation tools to predict and understand loudspeaker performance.
  • Troubleshoot unexpected test results and determine their root causes.
  • Create and modify mechanical designs using CAD.
  • Produce mechanical drawings and documentation.
  • Support product development, engineering validation, and industrialization activities.
  • Research electro-acoustic technologies and investigate new approaches to loudspeaker design.
  • Research international standards and industry validation methods.
  • Use programming and data-analysis tools to automate measurements, process data, and make engineering decisions.

What You’ll Learn

By the end of the co-op, you’ll have experience with far more than textbooks and classroom theory. You’ll gain exposure to the complete professional loudspeaker development process and learn how engineering concepts become real products.

  • Loudspeaker design: Thiele/Small parameters and their application to loudspeaker systems.
  • Signal processing: Analog and digital filters, Fourier analysis, frequency- and time-domain analysis, digital signal processors, and frequency-response manipulation.
  • Programming & automation: MATLAB, Simulink, LabVIEW, Python, and related engineering tools.
  • Electro-acoustic engineering: Understanding the interaction between electrical, mechanical, and acoustic systems.
  • Simulation: Acoustic, mechanical, and electro-magnetic modeling.
  • Crossover design: Passive 2-way and 3-way loudspeaker crossover networks.
  • Thermal sciences: Heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and thermal behavior of audio components.
  • Mechanical design: CAD, assemblies, drawings, prototyping, and basic woodworking.
  • Test & measurement: Microphones, impedance measurement, data acquisition, anechoic measurements, and laboratory test methods.
  • Professional audio systems: PA systems, mixers, effects, DJ equipment, live bands, and sound reinforcement.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for students who are curious, hands-on, analytical, and genuinely excited about audio.

Strong candidates will have experience or coursework in several of the areas above. You don't need to know everything on day one—we expect you to learn. What matters most is that you’re excited to understand how things work, why they work, and how to make them better.

Particularly valuable qualifications include:

  • Engineering students at a Sophomore, Junior, or Senior level
  • Familiarity with Thiele/Small parameters and loudspeaker design.
  • Programming experience with MATLAB, Simulink, LabVIEW, Python, or similar tools.
  • Experience with live sound reinforcement, PA systems, DJ equipment, mixers, effects, or live music.
  • Strong critical listening skills and an interest in music production, recording, mixing, mastering, or loudspeaker evaluation.
  • Knowledge of signal processing and frequency/time-domain analysis.
  • Experience designing passive crossover networks.
  • Familiarity with thermal sciences, heat transfer, or fluid dynamics.
  • CAD experience and an interest in mechanical design.
  • Hands-on experience with woodworking, hand tools, soldering, wiring, or building things.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to turn a confusing test result into a solvable engineering problem.

Most Important: Bring Your Passion for Audio

We're especially interested in students who don't just love music or audio—they're curious about it.

Come spend two semesters with us, and leave with the experience of having helped create something!

title: Projectleider Wegenbouw
description:
Functietitel

Projectleider Wegenbouw

Functieomschrijving

Zo werk jij aan de toekomst van Nederland

Als projectleider stuur je uitdagende wegenbouw- en infraprojecten aan. Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, interesses en ambities kijken we samen welke projecten het beste bij jou passen. Van projecten zoals de Zeeheldenbuurt in Schijndel, BIC Noord in Eindhoven tot aan de Promenade in Heerlen en het Kazernekwartier in Venlo. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze projecten veilig, volgens planning en binnen budget worden gerealiseerd.

Dit ga je doen:

  • De uitvoering van wegenbouwprojecten aansturen en verantwoordelijk zijn voor planning, financiën en projectresultaat.
  • Intensief samenwerken met opdrachtgevers en bouwen aan langdurige relaties.
  • Jouw praktijkkennis inzetten bij tenders en het verwerven van nieuwe projecten.
  • Projectteams coachen en de samenwerking tussen interne en externe partners coördineren.
  • Kwaliteit, veiligheid, duurzaamheid en risicobeheersing continu bewaken.

Je werkt samen met Bas, Bedrijfsleider
"Bij Heijmans krijg je veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om projecten succesvol te maken. Tegelijkertijd werk je samen met collega's die altijd voor elkaar klaarstaan. We delen kennis, helpen elkaar verder en realiseren samen mooie projecten voor onze leefomgeving. Het kan samen!"

Heij Projectleider! Welkom in ons team

Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines binnen de infra. Bij grotere projecten vorm je onderdeel van een integraal projectteam, terwijl je bij kleinere projecten nauw samenwerkt met een compact bouwteam. Welke uitdaging er ook op je pad komt, je kunt rekenen op betrokken collega's, korte lijnen en een prettige samenwerking. Als makers van een gezonde leefomgeving bouwen we samen aan duurzame infrastructuur in Limburg. Samen werken we slimmer en bereiken we meer.

Dit krijg je

  • Een vast contract.
  • Een brutomaandsalaris tussen € 5.200,- en € 7.200,- passend bij je opleiding, je ervaring en de teamsamenstelling.
  • Veel vrije tijd om op te laden: 25 vakantiedagen en 18 roostervrije dagen.
  • Een prettige werksfeer: als collega's staan we altijd voor elkaar klaar en vieren we regelmatig onze successen.
  • Een warm welkom, compleet met een Heijmans-welkomstpakket. Tijdens twee introductiedagen maak je uitgebreid kennis met ons bedrijf, daarna volg je een inwerktraject met een persoonlijke buddy.
  • Veel mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen via onze eigen Heijmans Academie en praktijkgerichte trainingen. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld doorgroeien naar tendermanager, projectmanager of bedrijfsleider.
  • Een goede balans tussen werk en privé.
  • Een leaseauto, laptop en smartphone.
  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Bouw & Infra.

Dit ben jij

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat van jouw projecten en behoudt overzicht, ook wanneer verschillende belangen samenkomen. Door helder te communiceren en duidelijke keuzes te maken, zorg je ervoor dat mensen weten wat er van hen wordt verwacht. Je bouwt sterke relaties op met opdrachtgevers en collega's en werkt samen toe naar een succesvol projectresultaat.

Verder heb je:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur richting Civiele Techniek, Bouwkunde of vergelijkbaar.
  • Ervaring als projectcoördinator, projectleider of een vergelijkbare functie binnen de infrasector.
  • Kennis van verschillende contractvormen binnen infrastructurele projecten.
  • Ervaring met het aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams.

Vragen over je volgende stap?
Wil je meer weten over de functie, je toekomstige collega's of over solliciteren bij Heijmans? De recruiter helpt je graag verder. Neem gerust contact op.

This is not standard application development: performance, predictable response times and robustness are what decide whether code reaches production.

Building trading components where latency is measured

  • Developing and optimising the platform's core Java components, with low latency as a constant objective.
  • Implementing and continuously improving trading, pricing and hedging algorithms, working closely with quants and traders.
  • In-depth work on concurrency, multithreading and fine-grained memory management to limit garbage collector pressure.
  • JVM analysis and optimisation: profiling, tuning, JIT behaviour, allocation analysis.
  • Integration with the front office ecosystem: real-time market data feeds, FIX connectivity, time-series databases.

Technical environment

  • Java 17+
  • JVM (JIT, GC, memory)
  • Multithreading
  • Lock-free structures
  • LMAX Disruptor
  • FIX protocol
  • KDB+
  • JFR / JMC
  • async-profiler

This role suits developers who want to master not only the how but also the why of system performance.

Who we are looking for

  • At least six years of Java development in technically demanding environments — capital markets, trading, real-time or critical platforms — including three in a front office environment.
  • Demonstrated skills in algorithms, performance and concurrent systems.
  • Ability to justify architecture and implementation choices from a performance standpoint.
  • Appetite for the low-level side of Java: memory, garbage collection, CPU, latency.
  • Fluent professional English, as the context is international.

Why this role is worth your time

  • You work on real performance problems, where every line of code has a measurable effect.
  • Business exposure is direct: the users of what you write sit in the same room.
  • The systems are long-lived and built over several years.
  • You get the full technical context before any interview with the client.

title: Associate Director - Source-to-Contract Global Process Owner
description:
Job Purpose

The Source-to-Contract Global Process Owner (GPO) is accountable for the global strategy, governance, design, standardization, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end Source-to-Contract process across GSK Procurement. The role establishes the vision and roadmap for process excellence, digital enablement, and policy compliance, ensuring the process enables efficient, compliant, and value-driven procurement outcomes.

Operating within the Global Procurement Centre of Excellence, the role partners closely with Procurement, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders to define and evolve global process standards, capabilities, and system solutions. The Source-to-Contract process impacts large populations of internal and external parties, requiring strong leadership across a complex stakeholder landscape.

The role drives process harmonization, governance, performance management, and transformation initiatives, ensuring Source-to-Contract capabilities remain scalable, efficient, compliant, data-driven, and aligned to GSK's strategic objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the global Source-to-Contract process and supporting technology ecosystem, defining the end-to-end process strategy, operating model, governance framework, standards, and future-state vision on behalf of Global Procurement.
  • Lead the design, standardization, and optimization of Source-to-Contract processes across Direct and Indirect Procurement, driving simplification, harmonization, scalability, and adoption of leading practices globally.
  • Lead process transformation initiatives while maintaining business-as-usual process effectiveness, including oversight of testing, release readiness, and deployment of enhancements across process and technology platforms.
  • Develop and execute a continuous improvement and innovation roadmap, leveraging stakeholder insights, external benchmarking, emerging technologies, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities to ensure the process remains fit for purpose and delivers business value.
  • Own process and technology performance, defining data requirements, governance, key performance indicators, and reporting structures to monitor effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and drive measurable outcomes.
  • Accountable for maximizing the return on investment of the Source-to-Contract process and supporting technologies, including benefits realization, value tracking, prioritization of enhancement investments, and management of funding requests.
  • Own and maintain the policies, standards, controls, and documentation governing the process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, regulatory alignment, and effective governance across the enterprise.
  • Develop and deliver effective change management, communications, training, and adoption strategies to ensure consistent understanding, execution, and compliance with Source-to-Contract standards and ways of working.
  • Ensure audit readiness and business continuity by leading process controls, supporting internal and external audit activities, coordinating issue resolution, risk mitigation, and business continuity planning.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders to govern process priorities, manage demand, influence strategic decisions, and lead a high-performing team responsible for delivering the Source-to-Contract roadmap and ongoing process excellence.

Why You?

  • Masters of Bachelors degree with overall experience of 18+ years
  • Deep expertise in procurement processes, operating models, governance, systems, data, and change management to design, standardize, and continuously improve the global Source-to-Contract process.
  • Requires strategic analysis and judgement to resolve complex process, policy, data, and technology challenges where stakeholder needs, system constraints, compliance requirements, and business objectives must be balanced.
  • Business knowledge and end-to-end procurement process understanding
  • Strong stakeholder partnership and cross-functional collaboration to be the face the process
  • Technical understanding and curiosity to translate business requirements to feasible technical requirements


Skills

Agile Thinking, Analytical Thinking, Contract Management, Detail-Oriented, Digital Literacy, Interactive Storytelling, Negotiation, Problem Solving, Sourcing Management, Stakeholder Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Technical Team lead
description:
Primary Location :

Roennede, Denmark

At Solina, our community of close to 5,000 people share a passion for food and live our entrepreneurial culture.

We design customised savoury solutions for our clients operating in the food industry, food service, butchery and nutrition markets. With sustainability at the heart of our business model, we aim to produce food that is good in every sense of the word: delicious, nourishing, affordable, sustainable and convenient.

Solina is a fast-growing business, with around 50 production sites and R&D laboratories present in more than 19 countries mainly in Europe and North America.

By constantly rethinking culinary solutions, we make food matter for people and the planet.

If you're ready for a new adventure in a dynamic, expanding, passionate, international company, join us !

Teamleder Teknik


Er du teknisk stærk, god til at skabe struktur og koordinere? Og motiveres du af at få tingene til at fungere i praksis? Vil du være med til at sikre høj driftssikkerhed i en virksomhed i vækst?

Så er du måske vores nye Teamleder i Engineering & Technique hos OSCAR i Rønnede. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for planlægning og koordinering af vedligeholdelsesopgaver og samtidig er du tæt på driften og tager aktiv del i det daglige tekniske arbejde.

Er du klar til dine næste udfordringer?
Vi søger en Teamleder til vores Engineering & Technique-team på fabrikken i Rønnede. Du bliver en del af et engageret teknisk team og får en central rolle i at sikre høj driftssikkerhed og et stærkt samarbejde mellem teknik og produktion. Rollen refererer til Engineering Manager.


Som Teamleder er du ansvarlig for planlægning og koordinering af vedligeholdelsesaktiviteter samt prioritering af opgaver i tæt samarbejde med teknikteamet og produktionen. Samtidig deltager du aktivt i det daglige vedligehold og bidrager til løbende forbedringer af vores produktionsapparat.

Der er ikke formelt personaleansvar forbundet med stillingen.

Du får en bred kontaktflade i organisationen og bliver en vigtig samarbejdspartner for både produktionen og eksterne leverandører.


Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Bidrage aktivt til det daglige vedligehold samt TPM- og sikkerhedsarbejdet
  • Planlægge og prioritere vedligeholdelsesopgaver på tværs af teknik og produktion
  • Sikre stabil drift gennem planlagt vedligehold, fejlfinding og løbende forbedringer
  • Koordinere ressourcer, eksterne samarbejdspartnere og større vedligeholdelsesaktiviteter
  • Være bindeled mellem teknik og produktion og sikre et godt informationsflow

Din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer: Du har en teknisk uddannelse som elektriker, mekaniker, automatiktekniker eller lignendeDu har erfaring med vedligehold af maskiner og gerne fra fødevareindustrienDu er god til at planlægge, koordinere og skabe overblikDu kommunikerer tydeligt og samarbejder godt på tværs af funktionerDu tager ansvar, følger opgaver til dørs og har fokus på den bedste løsning for helhedenDu behersker dansk i skrift og tale, og engelsk er en fordel.


Hvordan er det at arbejde hos os?
Hos Oscar bliver du en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor tempoet er højt, og samarbejdet er afgørende for vores succes. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar og giver plads til, at du kan tage initiativ og præge din egen hverdag.Vi søger en kollega, der trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften. Du er løsningsorienteret, handlekraftig og god til at skabe relationer. Samtidig værdsætter du samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.


Vi tilbyder:
En spændende og selvstændig rolle i en virksomhed i vækst, hvor du får stor indflydelse på den daglige drift og mulighed for at gøre en synlig forskel. Du bliver en central del af vores Engineering & Technique-team og får en nøglefunktion i arbejdet med at sikre stabil produktion gennem vedligehold, koordinering og løbende forbedringer.Du får en bred kontaktflade på tværs af organisationen og bliver en vigtig samarbejdspartner for produktionen, øvrige afdelinger og interne/eksterne leverandører. Samtidig bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor sparring, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er en naturlig del af hverdagen.Derudover tilbyder vi kantineordning, sundhedsforsikring, pension og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling i en international koncern med ambitiøse vækstmål.Arbejdstiderne vil ligge mandag til fredag, fordelt i tidsrummet mellem kl. 06:00 – 16:00.


Om os:
Vores nordiske hovedkontor ligger på OSCAR-fabrikken i Rønnede, og vores datterselskab Puljonki Oy har produktion i Juuka, Finland. Vi er 140 medarbejdere, hvoraf 80 er i Rønnede, hvor denne stilling er placeret.
OSCAR Nordic leverer til foodservice-industrien, herunder kantiner, catering, restauranter, hoteller og caféer.Vi er en del af Solina-koncernen med over 5.000 medarbejdere, som deler en passion for mad og en entreprenant kultur. Bæredygtighed er en central del af vores forretning, og vi arbejder for at skabe mad, der er god på alle måder: velsmagende, nærende, overkommelig, bæredygtig og nem.Solina er en hurtigt voksende virksomhed med mere end 40 produktionssites og R&D-laboratorier og er til stede i over 19 lande – primært i Europa og Nordamerika. Hos Solina “skaber vi mad, der gør en forskel for mennesker og planeten”.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!


Vi gennemgår indkommende ansøgninger løbende og indkalder løbende til samtaler, så send din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt via link.


Opstart er snarest muligt, og arbejdsstedet er i Rønnede.

title: Transport Research Intern
description:
Transport Research Intern - Cities and Transport Program


This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.



Program Overview

WRI Indonesia’s e-mobility portfolio focuses on reducing cities’ greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions through sustainable transportation and vehicle electrification, while working in parallel with energy and climate programs to green the electricity grid and maximize emission reductions. Our mission is to help cities and provinces implement low-carbon development, particularly in the transportation and energy sectors, to achieve economic, social, and environmental goals.

Zero-Emission Heavy-Duty Vehicle (HDV) Acceleration

Heavy-duty vehicles (HDVs) contribute 31.7% of GHG emissions from national land transport and are also a major contributor to air pollution. From an energy security perspective, national diesel consumption continues to increase, reaching 38.57 million kiloliters (KL) in 2024. Indonesia’s high reliance on diesel also exposes the transport sector to volatility in global oil prices, creating broader implications for national energy security. To address these environmental and energy challenges, the Government of Indonesia (GoI), through the National Energy Master Plan, has set ambitious targets for zero-emission vehicle (ZEV) adoption, including the electrification of heavy-duty vehicles such as public transport buses and trucks.

To address these fundamental barriers, WRI Indonesia is proposing a supply- and demand-side approach to accelerate ZEV adoption in the HDV sector in Indonesia. The goal of this project is to develop a policy framework and proof of concept for the National Green Logistics Corridor Initiative to accelerate freight decarbonization, which can simultaneously address supply- and demand-side barriers to HDV electrification. Through this strategic program, which will be co-implemented with key national ministries and private-sector stakeholders, WRI Indonesia seeks to engage a Transport Research Intern to support research and analysis on sustainable transport and electric mobility strategies.

General Internship Roles

The Transport Research Intern will work closely with the Urban Mobility team to support research and implementation related to electric mobility strategies. The role will involve conducting desk research, carrying out interviews with key stakeholders, analyzing mobility data, and assisting in the preparation of reports, presentations, and other research materials.

Furthermore, the Intern will also support the development and implementation of the Indonesia Freight Decarbonization Accelerator (IFDA) by contributing to strategy-related activities, supporting stakeholder engagement activities, and assisting in the preparation of materials for project activities and engagement.

Based in Jakarta with office-flex working arrangement, the intern will report directly Electric Mobility Program Lead. In support of WRI's DEI commitment, the Intern will be responsible for actively participating in these collaborative efforts by integrating equity into their work, the workplace, and the organizational culture.

What You Will Learn

1. Gain exposure to various topics related to electric mobility and transportation decarbonization.

2. Develop research skills and apply research findings to strategic planning and research for electric mobility projects, including:

  • Involvement in policy and regulatory analysis related to electric mobility and zero-emission vehicles.
  • Involvement in research and data analysis on transportation decarbonization, electric vehicles, and other low-carbon mobility solutions.
  • Involvement in event planning and execution, data collection and processing, and project development, as necessary.

3. Develop stakeholder engagement skills and apply them to support the development of electric mobility initiatives.

  • Engage with key stakeholders in the field of sustainable transportation, with a focus on government agencies, to support the development and implementation of green mobility initiatives.
  • Assist with meetings and other external communication tasks.

Internship Development Approach

Throughout the internship period, the intern will receive guidance, supervision, and regular feedback from assigned supervisors to support both learning objectives and professional development. The internship is intended to provide meaningful exposure to the topic while allowing the intern to contribute to ongoing program activities in a supportive learning environment.

The intern may also have opportunities to:

  • participate in internal discussions, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
  • observe stakeholder engagement and program coordination processes;
  • receive mentoring and constructive feedback on assignments and outputs;
  • strengthen understanding of professional practices within nonprofit and research-based organizations

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s Degree in transportation, urban planning, civil engineering, economics, or any other related field. Final-year student are welcome to apply.
  • Demonstrate interest in transportation, green mobility, environment, and low carbon technology issues.
  • Basic experience in conducting research and data analysis using various tools.
  • Highly motivated, strong can-do attitude, proactive work style and excellent organizational skills and work ethic.
  • Ability and willingness to work from Jakarta, Indonesia.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to other provinces/cities in Indonesia if assigned
  • Proficiency in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and verbal
  • Legally able to enroll on an internship program in Indonesia

Duration

3 (three) months

Internship Terms

This is a paid internship program. Intern will actively participate on the program activities and entitled for a compensation on monthly basis.



How to Apply:

  • Please submit a resume with a cover letter by 9 October 2026. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates.
  • Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position.
  • Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed.
  • This is a locally engaged position, Indonesian nationals are encouraged to apply.

What we offer:

  • Internship standard wages
  • Travel insurance for both domestic and international for any travel duty as assigned by WRI Indonesia
  • Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields.
  • A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work
  • The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI
  • Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours


About Us:

World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.


Our mission and values:

WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations.

Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership, and Care.


Our culture:

WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Our Human Resources Team carefully reviews all applications.

title: Construction Security Programme Manager (Narvik)
description:
Please note: This role requires you to be work permanently on-site in Narvik, Norway.

About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

At Nscale, our Global Physical & Data Center Security team plays a critical role in protecting our people, sites, and critical infrastructure from construction through operations. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

Nscale is seeking a Construction Security Senior Program Manager to lead Nscale's Kvandal campus located in Narvik, Norway. This is a site-based leadership role, not a remote or corporate position. The successful candidate will serve as Nscale's primary security representative at the project site, working closely with the General Contractor (GC), construction management, Nscale's Data Center Infrastructure and Design teams, security integrators, security vendors, and local stakeholders.

The role has two primary responsibilities: representing Nscale's security interests throughout construction — working with the GC to ensure appropriate site security, access control, contractor management, incident response, and security procedures are implemented and maintained — and partnering with Nscale's Security Design & Technology team, DCI, the Engineer of Record, and the security integrator to ensure physical security systems are properly designed, coordinated, installed, tested, commissioned, and delivered in accordance with Nscale and customer requirements.

The position will also help establish the security foundation for the transition from construction to operational data center security.

What You'll Be Doing

Construction Security:

  • Serve as Nscale's primary security representative on the Kvandal construction site
  • Partner with the GC, construction management, and security contractors on day-to-day site security
  • Monitor implementation of Nscale security requirements and identify gaps or emerging risks
  • Oversee construction access control, badging, visitor management, contractor access, and credentialing processes
  • Ensure appropriate controls are in place for personnel, vehicles, materials, and equipment entering and leaving the site
  • Review and provide input on site security plans, staffing, perimeter controls, gates, lighting, surveillance, access control, and temporary security measures
  • Coordinate security requirements with construction phasing and changing site conditions
  • Support security incident reporting, escalation, investigation, and corrective actions
  • Maintain a strong security presence and ensure concerns are identified and addressed before they become operational issues
  • Coordinate with Nscale Security leadership on significant incidents, threats, deficiencies, and emerging risks

Security Technology & Design Coordination:

  • Act as the site-level security liaison to Nscale's Security Design & Technology organization
  • Coordinate with DCI, the Engineer of Record, GC, electrical/design teams, and the security integrator on physical security systems
  • Track delivery of cameras, access control, biometrics, intrusion detection, intercoms, security networks, and other security technology
  • Ensure security technology installation aligns with approved designs, Nscale standards, and customer requirements
  • Participate in design reviews, construction coordination meetings, system testing, commissioning, and acceptance activities
  • Identify design or installation issues early and drive resolution with the appropriate stakeholders
  • Support security system commissioning and operational readiness activities
  • Maintain visibility into security technology schedule, dependencies, risks, and outstanding deficiencies

Stakeholder & Local Security Coordination:

  • Develop effective working relationships with local law enforcement, emergency services, and relevant government and community stakeholders as directed by Nscale Security leadership
  • Coordinate with Corporate Security, Safety, Legal, Risk, and other Nscale functions where responsibilities overlap
  • Support the security implications of construction activity, public visibility, community concerns, protests, unauthorized surveillance, trespassing, or other activity affecting the site
  • Ensure appropriate escalation paths exist for security and safety incidents involving the campus
  • Coordinate with Nscale leadership on significant local security developments

Program Governance & Reporting:

  • Maintain a construction security risk register and track mitigation actions
  • Provide regular security status updates, including risks, incidents, deficiencies, staffing, technology deployment, and upcoming construction activities
  • Participate in project meetings where security requirements or risks are relevant
  • Track security-related project milestones and dependencies
  • Conduct or coordinate periodic security assessments of the construction site
  • Ensure security documentation, procedures, and records are maintained throughout the project

Transition to Operations:

  • Transition construction security responsibilities into the operational security program
  • Establish operational procedures, post orders, access control processes, and security escalation protocols
  • Validate security technology readiness and operational acceptance
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and training of the operational security team
  • Participate in security commissioning, readiness reviews, and customer/site turnover activities
  • Identify and close remaining security gaps before operational handover

About You

About You (Skills / Qualifications)

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in physical security, data center security, construction security, critical infrastructure security, or a related field
  • Experience managing security programs at large-scale construction or critical infrastructure projects
  • Experience working directly with general contractors, construction managers, security integrators, and engineering/design organizations
  • Strong understanding of physical security systems, including CCTV, access control, biometrics, intrusion detection, perimeter security, and security communications
  • Experience developing or implementing security procedures, standards, and risk mitigation measures
  • Strong project and program management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving construction environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Ability to identify security risks independently and drive issues to resolution
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive security information

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with hyperscale data centers, AI/GPU data centers, power generation facilities, substations, or other critical infrastructure
  • Experience supporting data center construction from design through commissioning and operational turnover
  • Experience with Genetec or comparable physical security platforms
  • Experience managing security technology deployments and commissioning
  • Experience working with law enforcement, emergency management, fire services, and local government
  • ASIS certifications such as CPP, PSP, or equivalent professional credentials
  • Experience developing construction security programs for high-security or mission-critical facilities

Why this role matters: success means Kvandal has a secure construction environment, strong security governance, and no surprises at operational turnover. This role requires someone comfortable being hands-on at the site, challenging the project team when necessary, and translating Nscale's security requirements into practical construction and operational outcomes.

What We Can Offer You

You’ll have the opportunity to help shape the operating standards behind a next-generation AI cloud platform, working on complex infrastructure challenges with real ownership and impact. This is a chance to play a meaningful role in scaling high-performance, sustainable data centre operations in a fast-moving environment.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.
