title: Director, Translational Medicine Expert (Neurodegeneration)
description:
Band

Level 6


Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: Director
Location: Cambridge, MA, USA

The Director, Translational Medicine Expert (Neurodegeneration) will lead the end to end translational strategy for neurodegenerative programs, bridging preclinical research to early clinical development (Phase 1–2).
This role is accountable for biomarker strategy, clinical endpoint selection, and early phase trial design, enabling efficient, data driven decision-making through key development milestones (e.g., Transition Decision Points) and ensuring competitive differentiation of neuromuscular assets.
In addition, he/she oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of clinical trials research, data collection activities and clinical operations. Establishes and approves scientific methods for design and implementation of clinical protocols, data collection systems and final reports. Support new and ongoing clinical research and clinical trials and ensure efficient and timely processing of confidentiality agreements and clinical agreements


Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

1. Translational Strategy & Program Leadership

    • Define and execute integrated translational strategies across neurodegeneration programs
    • Lead translational components from preclinical → Phase 1/2 clinical studies
    • Drive program progression through key decision gates (e.g., IND, TDP, IDPA)
    • Ensure strong mechanistic linkage between target biology, biomarkers, and clinical endpoints

2. Biomarker & Endpoint Leadership

    • Collaborate with Biomarker Development colleagues toward development and validation of:
      • Molecular biomarkers (tissue, blood, CSF where applicable)
      • Functional endpoints (strength, mobility, disease-specific measures)
      • Patient-reported outcomes (PROs)
      • Establishing quantitative biomarkers to support:
        • Target engagement
        • Disease modification
        • Dose selection and PoC decisions
    • Integrate biomarker strategy into clinical protocols and operational plans
    • Drive early biomarker de‑risking, a key priority in neuromuscular programs

3. Early Clinical Development (Phase 1/2)

    • Co‑lead design and execution of early clinical studies
    • Define:
      • Dose escalation strategy
      • Exposure–response framework
      • Translational endpoints (biopsy, imaging, functional)
    • Ensure TM leadership within Clinical Trial Teams (CTTs) for:
      • Trial design
      • Execution oversight
      • Data interpretation and decision-making

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Serve as core Translational Medicine representative within global project teams
    • Partner closely with:
      • Clinical Development
      • Biomarker Development
      • Clinical Pharmacology (PKS)
      • Preclinical Safety (PCS)
      • Regulatory
    • Drive alignment between research, TM, and development organizations

5. External Scientific Leadership

    • Build and lead collaborations with:
      • Academic KOLs
      • Patient advocacy groups (critical in rare neuromuscular disease)
      • Technology partners (imaging, omics platforms)
    • Contribute to scientific strategy and external positioning of programs

6. Patient-Centered Development

    • Integrate the patient voice into translational and clinical strategies
    • Advance:
      • Meaningful functional endpoints
      • Patient-relevant outcome measures
      • Innovative trial approaches (e.g., decentralized models where feasible)

7. Portfolio Contribution & Strategic Input

    • Contribute to:
      • Asset prioritization and portfolio strategy
      • Competitive differentiation strategy (e.g., vs RNA or gene therapy competitors)
    • Provide scientific input to:
      • Business development / due diligence
      • Indication expansion strategies

Essential Requirements:

· MD, neurologists, clinical training in neurodegenerative diseases

· Experience in translational medicine, early clinical development, or experimental therapeutics.

· Ability to shape development strategies, execute early clinical studies, and influence regulatory/packages supporting differentiation.

Desirable Requirements:

· Experience working in pharmaceutical/biotech company strongly preferred.

· PhD, PharmD, or equivalent in:

o Neurology / Neuroscience

o Neurodegenerative diseases

title: Bioanalytikere til Klinisk Mikrobiologisk Afdeling, Hvidovre Hospital
description:
Vil du være en del af en højtspecialiseret afdeling, hvor faglighed, teknologi og godt kollegaskab går hånd i hånd?

Vi er en stor afdeliing med dygtige og engagerede bioanalytikere, som søger nye kollegaer, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores hverdag. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra starten. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerring, engageret og har lyst til at lære.

Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde i en højtspecialiseret mikrobiologisk afdeling, hvor faglighed, udvikling, teknologi og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi arbejder hele tiden på at udvikle vores diagnostik, metoder og arbejdsgange - og de kommende år kommer til at byde på mange spændende foandringer.

Om afdelingen

Klinisk Mikrobiologisk Afdeling beskæftiger sig med undersøgelse af patientprøver med henblik på diagnosticering af infektionssygdomme. Vi anvender bakteriologiske, serologiske og molekylærbiologiske metoder til diagnostikken. Afdelingen servicerer både hospitaler, privathospitaler, praktiserende læger og speciallæger, og har mere end 1 mio prøver årligt.

Afdelingen har et stærkt fokus på udvikling og forskning. Vi arbejder både med udvikling af ny viden og med optimering af de metoder og arbejdsgange, vi allerede anvender. Samtidig har vi stort fokus på kvalitetssikring, kompetenceudvikling og på at levere den bedste service og rådgivning.

Vi deltager desuden i uddannelsen af blandt andet bioanalytikere og læger.

Om laboratoriet

Laboratoriet består af 2 sektioner, den bakteriologiske og den molekylærbiologiske/serologiske. Samlet set er vi 72 bioanalytikere og assistenter, som varetager den daglige drift. Hertil er der 1 specialist og 5 molekylærbiologer, som understøtter dagligdagen.

Her arbejder vi med en bred vifte af metoder og teknologier og med både nyere og mere etableret laboratorieudstyr. Du skal derfor have lyst til at arbejde med teknik og være nysgerring på, hvordan nye teknologier, AI og automatisering kan understøtte den mikrobiologiske diagnostik og drift.

Det kræver nysgerrighed, omstillingsparathed og lyst til at tænke arbejdsgange på nye måder - og til gengæld får du mulighed for at være en aktiv del af en afdeling, hvor teknologi, faglighed og udvikling går hånd i hånd.

Vi tror på, at et godt arbejdsmiljø og en høj trivsel skabes sammen. Derfor betyder humor, medinddragelse, respekt og tillid meget for os - både i de enkelte teams og på tværs af hele afdelingen.

Vi forventer

Du er uddannel bioanalytiker, men du behøver ikke have erfaring fra klinisk mikrobiologi. Vi sørger for en grundig introduktion og oplæring, der tager udgangspunkt i dine kompetencer og erfaringer.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du er nysgerrig, engageret og har lyst til at lære. Du arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver samtidig med, at du bidrager til fællesskabet og det gode samarbejde. Du er mødestabil og fleksibel og du trives med en hverdag, hvor der sker noget, og hvor arbejdsgange, teknologi og metoder hele tiden udvikler sig.

Du har flair for IT og teknisk udstyr og arbejder struktureret og systematisk med blik for kvalitet og detaljer. Du møder dine kollegaer med humor og respekt, og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Det er ikke afgørende, at du kan det hele på forhånd. Det afgørende er, at du har lyst til at lære det.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du en hverdag, hvor du både kan bruge den faglighed, du kommer med, og udvikle dig - både fagligt og personligt.

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med høj faglighed, avanceret laboratorieteknoloig og fokus på udvikling og automatisering. Du får en grundig introduktion og oplæring, og din kompetenceudvikling tilrettelægges med udgangspunkt i dig og dine erfaringer.

Hverdagen byder på tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med blandt andet bioanalytikere, specialister, læger og molekylærbiologer. Du får en varieret hverdag med mulighed for at lære nyt og være med til at udvikle både metoder, arbejdsgange og vores måde at arbejde på.

Og så får du selvfølgelig gode kollegaer, humor og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor trivsel, respekt og fællesskab betyder noget. Vi har også sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviter - både i og uden for afdelingen.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingerne er med vagtforpligtelse. Du vil indgå i afdelingens vagtberedskab, som indtil videre dækker weekender, helligdage samt aftenarbejde frem til kl. 22.00 på hverdage.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale og aftaler mellem Dbio og Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn med lønindplacering som bioanalytiker. Du kan finde din startløn via dette link: Se regionens oversigt over startlønninger her.

Ansøgningsprocedure
Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og har også stillinger til besættelse i det nye år.

I din ansøgning må gerne fortælle, om de har en særligt interesse for den bakteriologiske sektion eller den molekylærbiologiske/serologiske sektion - eller om du er åben for nye udfordringer og har lyst til at lære hele afdelingen at kende.

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte overbioanalytiker Louise Jørgensen (bakteriologi) på tlf.: 21 84 66 93 eller overbioanalytiker Mahvish Ikram (molekylærbiologi) på tlf.: 23 42 03 56.

Ansøgningsfrist

Send din motiverede ansøgning med CV og evt. autorisationsbevis via nedenstående link senest søndag den 15. november 2026.

title: Live Hanger - Potter-Rodrigues
description:
Position Summary: The Live Hanger worker quickly and effectively hangs live birds by the legs within a moving shackle line, ensuring the line is full.


General Purpose: The Live Hanger is responsible for hanging chicken while adhering to the company animal welfare policy, along with other state and local laws.


Role Responsibilities and Qualifications:


Employee will need to be able to:
• Hot and moist environment with temperatures ranging from 50 to 90 degrees.
• Stand/walk 100% of workday
• Exposure to noise levels greater than 85 decibels.
• Bend, stoop, and lift various weights as needed.
• Climb stairs, frequently stoop, kneel, crawl and bend.
• Exposure to strong, raw, and foul odors.
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists.
• Repetitively lift 5–10 pound birds throughout the workday.
• Ability to withstand working with live birds.
• Hang chickens on shackles while abiding by animal welfare policies adhered to and required by all employees.
• Rapid, repetitive grasping and hanging of live birds by the feet into overhead shackles.

Education and/or Experience:
• No prior experience or training
• Must be 18 years of age.
• Legally authorized to work in the United States.

Essential Skills and Experience:
• Be dependable and honest
• Time management: the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
• Strong team player
• Commitment to company values
• Be able to work overtime when needed to including Saturday
• Wear employer-specified protective gear, including gloves, face/eye shields, aprons/smock, boots, etc. (some of which to be supplied by employer).
• Exposure to chemical cleaning solution (with protective gear)
• Perform varying tasks while standing, lifting, crouching, etc. during long periods of time.
• Perform all tasks safely and in a manner that will not create or pose a direct threat to the health and/or safety of the worker or any other person.


Physical Demands and work environment: The physical and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions
of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Physical demands: Be able to efficiently work in a plant environment. Lift up to 10 lbs. repetitively. Moderate to Heavy amount of physical effort required. Constant standing, simple and power grasping of the hands, fine manipulation/feeling with the hands, reaching at and below shoulder level, repetitive motion of the shoulders, arms, and hands, light to moderate lifting/carrying, use of vision. Inside the production plant and around plant grounds expose employee to loud equipment/machines; walking around drains, footbaths, hoses; wet environment, occasional dust.


Work environment: While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; fumes or airborne particles and extreme cold and hot. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions and extreme heat. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: Associate Director - Energy Advisory
description:
Australia’s energy transition is reshaping the way organisations think about strategy, investment, regulation, operating models, technology and delivery. KordaMentha’s Energy Advisory team helps clients move from intent to execution, providing practical, commercially grounded advice across a fast-moving and complex market.

We are looking for an Associate Director to join our Energy Advisory team and take a leading role in shaping client opportunities, delivering complex engagements and contributing to the continued growth of the practice.

This is a senior opportunity for an advisory professional who brings energy sector depth, strong commercial judgement, trusted client relationships and the confidence to lead work that matters.

As an Associate Director, you will work alongside genuine energy experts on practical, outcome-focused engagements across Australia’s changing energy system. You will help clients make clear decisions in complex environments, balancing commercial outcomes, reliability, affordability, policy, regulation, technology and delivery considerations.

You will:

  • Lead and grow trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, becoming a credible point of contact beyond a single engagement.

  • Identify and shape new opportunities for clients and the practice, contributing to business development, proposals, marketing activities and industry events.

  • Build depth in one or more energy domains and bring a point of view on energy transition, market reform and emerging practice.

You are a commercially minded advisory professional with strong technical capability, sound judgement and the ability to lead complex engagements. You are confident working with senior stakeholders, shaping opportunities and delivering practical recommendations in complex environments.

You will bring:

  • 7-10 years of relevant energy and utilities experience in the private sector or government, for example in consulting, advisory, professional services, government infrastructure teams or in-house energy teams, ideally with energy or wider infrastructure exposure.

  • Credible depth in one or more energy and utility sectors, such as generation, networks, retail, gas or water.

  • Strong judgement across complex commercial, regulatory, operational or technology problems.

  • Experience across diverse range of energy advisory engagements, spanning strategy, transformation, regulation, capital investment and project/program delivery challenges.

  • Comfort using AI tools to improve quality and efficiency, with the judgement to apply them appropriately and validate outputs.

  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Experience with electricity networks, consulting, in-house energy roles or regulators would be highly regarded, as would familiarity with economic regulatory frameworks, revenue determinations and revenue reset processes.

An emerging thought-leadership capability and a point of view on topics shaping the energy transition, including data centres, market reform, CER and renewables economics, would also be valued.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
At Digital Turbine, we make mobile advertising experiences more meaningful and rewarding for users, app publishers, and advertisers — intelligently connecting people in more ways, across more devices. We provide app publishers and advertisers with powerful ads and experiences that captivate consumers, fuel performance, and help telecoms and OEMs supercharge awareness, acquisition, and monetization. In a rapidly evolving industry, we are constantly innovating and creating better paths of discovery to connect consumers, publishers, and advertisers across the mobile ecosystem.

Please note that Digital Turbine is a hybrid work environment-only candidates local to the posting location will be considered.

The Role


Digital Turbine runs on small, autonomous pods that own an outcome and a roadmap end to end. We hire engineers, not language specialists: we care that you can reason about systems, pick the right tool for the problem, and ship reliable software across the stack.


As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product surfaces that bring our marketplace together — campaign management and creation, unified dashboards and reporting, audience and asset tooling, and the APIs that connect demand to supply. You'll work across front-end, back-end, and data, contributing to the unified product architecture at the heart of our FY27 roadmap. The underlying platform requires heavy back-end engineering, low-latency optimization, and algorithmic problem-solving to manage massive throughput and real-time marketplace dynamics.


About the Senior Full Stack Engineer Role

  • Design and build full-stack features: from responsive web front-ends to back-end services and APIs — that power campaign management, reporting, and marketplace optimization
  • Choose the right language and tools for each problem (we run a polyglot stack), and keep the front end lightweight by pushing complex computational logic, data modeling, and heavy algorithmic weight into robust, scalable back-end services
  • Build and consume well-designed APIs that integrate DT products into a unified architecture rather than isolated silos
  • Own your services in production: testing, observability, performance, and on-call, treating quality as a whole-team responsibility
  • Collaborate directly with product leads and stakeholders, contributing to scoping, estimation, and technical decisions within your pod
  • Mentor teammates and raise engineering standards through code review, automation, and pragmatic architecture

About You as the Senior Full Stack

  • 5+ years building and shipping production platforms, with a heavy skew toward backend architecture, system design, and code optimization
  • Strong algorithmic fundamentals, data structures, and a proven track record of solving complex data-processing or resource optimization problems
  • Demonstrated ability to be effective in more than one language/ecosystem (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Python, Go, Scala, or C++) — you optimize for the problem, not a single tool
  • Solid command of modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React) and back-end service design, plus relational and/or distributed data stores (MySQL, PostgreSQL, and similar)
  • Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, testing, and system design
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, agile, ownership-driven environment with limited hand-holding


Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), containers, and CI/CD
  • Exposure to AdTech, dashboards/BI surfaces, or high-throughput data-driven products
  • Experience integrating ML or data services into product workflows

About Digital Turbine:

Digital Turbine (NASDAQ: APPS) powers superior mobile consumer experiences and results for the world’s leading telcos, advertisers and publishers. Our end-to-end platform uniquely simplifies the ability to supercharge awareness, acquisition and monetization — connecting our partners to more consumers, in more ways, across more devices.

The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with global offices in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, London, Berlin, Singapore, Tel Aviv, and other cities around the world, serving top agency, app developer, and advertising markets.

We are honored to have achieved numerous awards as an employer of choice, around the world, including: BuiltIn's Best Places to Work Awards in 2022, 2023 and 2024, DUNS 100 Best Places to Work in Tech for 2023 and 2024, and BDICode's 100 Best Companies to Work in 2024.

Digital Turbine is an equal opportunity employer committed to exemplifying diversity and inclusion around the world. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We embed diversity in our mindset, products, and teams to empower an inclusive, equitable, and culturally fluent environment. Building and continuously fostering this culture within our teams makes us better collaborators, partners, and innovators.

title: Director, Head of Chemistry
description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.


Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.


Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!



Director, Head of Organic and Medicinal Chemistry - Antibody Drug Conjugates

Your Role


As Director, head of Organic and Medicinal Chemistry for Antibody Drug Conjugates at Genmab in Utrecht, you will play a pivotal role in the Discovery Department. You will use your knowledge and expertise to support and bolster Genmab’s discovery pipeline. You will guide a new team dedicated to synthetic organic chemistry, medicinal chemistry and analytics, shaping strategic direction.


Within this role, you will provide oversight of all synthetic organic and medicinal chemistry activities related to ADCs. This role will involve building up the wet lab capabilities, fostering innovation and managing a high-performance team. Your role will be instrumental in ensuring the successful progression of ADC projects from discovery through clinical development.


Collaboration will be central to your role, as you engage with the various discovery departments and contribute actively to the discovery management team.

Your Responsibilities


  • Provide strategic direction for the synthetic organic and medicinal chemistry team, focusing on ADC discovery and development.
  • Lead the functional team of synthetic organic chemists responsible for designing, synthesizing, conjugating, and analyzing payloads, linkers, and the conjugated ADCs.
  • Development and implementation of innovative synthetic methodologies and strategies to enhance efficiency, scalability, and overall project success.
  • Oversee bioconjugation strategy across site-specific and stochastic conjugation approaches including DAR control and bioconjugate characterization (HIC, RP-HPLC, mass spectrometry).
  • Direct exploration of novel payload classes balancing potency, stability, and manufacturability.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including biology, pharmacology, protein engineering and manufacturing, to integrate chemistry efforts and achieve project milestones.
  • Lead tech transfer and scale-up of synthetic routes from discovery to GMP manufacturing, partnering with CMC and process chemistry teams to ensure a smooth transition of ADC programs toward IND-enabling and clinical supply.
  • Shape Genmab’s strategy for scouting and external collaborations on ADC and linker-payload synthetic chemistry, together with business development teams.
  • Support due diligence, CRO oversight, and evaluation of in-licensing/out-licensing opportunities related to ADC and linker-payload technologies.
  • Contribute to the preparation of patent applications, scientific publications, and regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the company externally through conference presentations, scientific publications, and engagement with key opinion leaders in the ADC field.
  • Cultivate a collaborative environment, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Encourage scientific knowledge exchange and best practice within the team and across functions.
  • Establish and oversee EHS/industrial hygiene protocols for handling highly potent cytotoxic compounds within the wet lab, ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
  • Own the budget and capital planning for wet lab build-out, including equipment procurement and space planning.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop team members; own performance management and career development for direct reports, and champion diversity and inclusion within the team.

Qualifications and Skills


  • Ph.D. in organic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in early-stage biopharmaceutical or biotechnology industry or partly in academia. Prior experience (5+ years) in a leadership role overseeing cross-functional teams is crucial to manage the complexities and the scale of operations in this role.
  • Proven record of accomplishment of leading successful ADC chemistry projects from discovery to clinical development.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industry standards and scientific advancements in early-stage discovery chemistry and analytics, involving ADC-, conjugation- and linker-payload chemistry.
  • Expertise in synthetic organic and medicinal chemistry techniques.
  • Hands-on expertise with bioconjugation chemistries DAR analytics, and bioconjugate characterization methods.
  • Experience with CMC/tech transfer of synthetic routes to GMP scale, and familiarity with IND-enabling study requirements and regulatory expectations specific to ADCs.
  • Experience overseeing safety programs for handling highly potent compounds (EHS/industrial hygiene) in a wet lab environment.
  • Strategic planning skills.
  • Experience with structure-activity relationship (SAR) studies.
  • Familiarity with computational chemistry and molecular modeling tools is desirable.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate complex research findings to diverse audiences.
  • Flexibility to adapt to new organizational directions and work on multiple projects simultaneously, in accordance with evolving departmental needs.


The proposed gross annual/monthly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

EUR97.920,00---146.880,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Pension
  • Health insurance and wellness benefits
  • Paid time off
  • Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.



About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.


Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

title: PAXLOVID HCP Lead

Since PAXLOVID’s emergency use authorization on 12/22/21, PAXLOVID has helped treat over 25M patients at high-risk from progression to severe COVID-19, which can lead to hospitalization and/or death. PAXLOVID is well-positioned to remain the gold standard in COVID-19 treatment, however the COVID-19 treatment landscape is a rapidly evolving space with significant complexity. Opportunity to increase treatment rates for eligible patients and bolster PAXLOVID’s leadership position in the marketplace continues. New burden of disease studies and real-world evidence is anticipated throughout 2026 and beyond to help continue to support the treatment value proposition.


The Senior Director, HCP Team Lead, US Antiviral will report directly to the VP of US Antiviral and will be responsible for leading the development and execution of marketing strategies for U.S. HCPs in a complex and evolving market


The role will require the ability to work collaboratively with the U.S. Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) organization, the CMO, and other agency and cross-functional teams. They will need to translate insights into action and identify business accelerators and innovative strategies to overcome market challenges and drive business. The ideal candidate will have high learning agility and demonstrated prior success in leading key marketing and strategic initiatives and demonstrate the ability to learn and adapt strategies and tactical execution quickly given how dynamic the marketplace is.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead a team of experienced marketers and drive treatment of appropriate patients through strong leadership in the following areas:

· Develop the overall HCP strategy and tactics to support appropriate utilization of PAXLOVID

· Support the development and implementation of annual tactical plans that drive the short- and long-term HCP strategy, based on key customer insights

· Member of the U.S. PAXLOVID leadership team; actively contributes to overall strategy for the brand, development of the team and accountability for the culture and environment

· Continuously own the measurement and impact of HCP marketing initiatives, generating key learnings, and driving continuous improvement in order to achieve brand objectives

· Ensures marketing materials are compelling and appropriate across all appropriate channels.

· Coordinate with IIS on the design and implementation of HCP market research to gain customer insights and monitor HCP performance trackers

· Partner with CEP, Commercial Effectiveness, and CMO teams to incorporate our Brand Strategic Customer Insights into broader field-based Targeting and Segmentation plans

· Partner with GCET to ensure new hire training adapts consistent with brand strategy and critical success factors

· Lead the U.S. POA meetings and other Sales Force meetings including planning, execution and follow-up engagement

· Manage U.S. PAXLOVID A&P budget and performance of the Agency of Record and other key partner agencies

· Collaborate and align with marketing team counterparts and cross-functional team members to ensure the plans work in synergy to deliver business objectives

· Conduct all responsibilities in accordance with Company policies, with a strong adherence to our Values including compliance

· Exhibit a high performance, values driven approach to develop strategies, identify opportunities, and manage key issues to achieve commercial objectives

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor's degree with 10+ years of relevant experience; master’s degree preferred.

· Experience successfully converting market and stakeholder insights into actionable strategies and tactics.

· Experience successfully engaging and partnering with external customers.

· ​Excellent communication and presentation skills, including to internal and external senior leaders.

· Strong strategic skills including creativity and effectiveness in identifying and managing major strategic challenges; can manage through ambiguity.

· Ability and eagerness to challenge status quo, act decisively and operate successfully in an empowered organization.

· A commitment to excellence – both in the results achieved and in how they are achieved.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Master’s degree preferred.

· US Marketing experience

· Pharmaceutical marketing experience

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Other Job Details

At Meijer, we’re more than a retailer. We’re a family company that serves people and communities. When you join our team, you’re supported with opportunities to grow, lead, and make a real impact at work and beyond.

title: Regional Business Director - Hematology -  West
description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role


The Regional Business Director will help recruit, hire, develop, and lead his/her sales team in hematology for Genmab’s US Oncology sales organization. This person will be responsible for leading a team of Oncology Account Managers within his/her specified region/division to meet and exceed all sales goals while maintaining compliance with field sales activity. The Director will develop the business plan for their geography and implement regional/national sales strategies and programs while continually developing the skills of individuals within his/her sales team.


The West region encompasses California, Oregon, Washington, Nevada, Utah Idaho, and Hawaii


Responsibilities


  • Focus the team on delivering high-impact opportunities by implementing customer-specific approaches based upon their needs and preferences
  • Develop team members on impactful digital and in-selling techniques, establishing a culture of value-based selling through all mediums
  • Establishes a culture that empowers employees to focus their efforts on actions that drive brand value, prioritizing activities that make a difference for patients.
  • Establish relationships with key customers and opinion leaders to incorporate new perspectives and ideas
  • Collaborate with alliance partners to optimize customer experience, resources, and results
  • Evaluate current business environment and practice models in each of his/her regions/divisions to develop and maintain key partnering relationships internally through a matrix team and externally with key accounts and key opinion leaders in their assigned geography
  • Lead his/her sales teams’ activities such as recruiting, hiring, training, development, performance evaluation, and compliance
  • Execute an effective recruiting and hiring plan that focuses on candidate attributes that will drive business performance in the modern sales environment
  • Partner and pull through training and development to create a modern learning program which provides employees with the confidence to effectively operate in a hybrid model that includes in-person and virtual.
  • Understand and navigate the product/process throughout key accounts and large institutions
  • Set clear expectations for utilization of approved promotional programs
  • Communicate competitive market intelligence to brand teams and management
  • Accountable for analyzing the Region/division business and building short- and long-term business plans that meet/exceed sales goals and drive sales growth
  • Actively participate in meetings
  • Communicate regularly with his/her Team, Director, Peers, Internal/External Partners and Clients to optimize resources and exceed customer expectations
  • Develop and ensure strong culture and team dynamics
  • Adhere to financials and budgets outlined by home office and brand
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and procedures and applicable regulatory and legal standards and requirements

Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree; Advanced degree a plus
  • Minimum 8 years sales experience in the pharma/biotech industry with minimum 3 years leadership experience in leading in the Oncology therapeutic area.
  • Preference for hematology experience
  • Proven ability to recruit, hire, develop, and retain top sales talent
  • Demonstration of superior coaching skills that drive improvements in sales behaviors and team development
  • Proven success in launching Oncology product(s) with strong results
  • A record of strategic thinking and disciplined execution
  • Awareness and ability to navigate and adhere to Commercialization and Corporate governance processes
  • Ability to collaborate and strong team player
  • Excellent presentation, organization and communication skills
  • Must be proficient in the following applications: MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook, MS Teams, Veeva Engage, etc.
  • Possess highest level of professional behavior and ethics; consistently demonstrate sound judgment and strategic decision-making abilities
  • Travel will be required by car and plane

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$211,680.00---$317,520.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.


When you join Genmab, you’re joining a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional wellness. Within the first year, regular full-time U.S. employees are eligible for:

  • 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions
  • Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance
  • Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave
  • Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support
  • Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses


Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.


Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.


Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

title: Senior Partner Agent Architect (UK)
location: London Office; Remotely in the UK
description:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As a Sr Partner Agent Architect at Parloa, you will operate at the intersection of enterprise solution architecture, conversational AI, and partner enablement, helping strategic partners and enterprise customers design, implement, and scale AI-driven customer experiences. This is a highly consultative, customer-facing role where you will guide partners and clients through solution discovery, end-to-end solution architecture, enterprise integration design, conversational architecture, and implementation strategy for enterprise AI Agents. You will design how Parloa’s platform integrates into complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions. While you bring strong technical depth and can build when needed, your primary focus will be helping partners shape the right technical solutions, architect scalable integrations, prioritize effectively, and successfully operationalize Parloa’s platform within complex enterprise environments. You will also help shape the conversational experience layer by translating customer requirements into AI Agent behavior through prompt engineering, LLM concepts, and conversational design. Prior conversational design experience is valuable but can be further developed on the job. You will work closely with strategic partners, enterprise customers, Partner Success Managers, Technical Program Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solution Engineers, and the broader Agent Architect organization to drive successful AI deployments and long-term customer value.

This is your opportunity to shape how enterprise organizations and global partners adopt agentic AI at scale while acting as a trusted advisor across both business and technical stakeholders.

Areas of ownership:

  • Scope and design end-to-end AI Agent deployments across complex enterprise environments.
  • Define how Parloa integrates with systems such as CRMs, ERPs, ticketing platforms, contact center technologies, and other enterprise applications.
  • Apply systems thinking to solve complex multi-system data flows, dependencies, and integration challenges.
  • Guide partners and customers on API design, authentication, data transformation, field mapping, error handling, and integration patterns.
  • Build, configure, test, or troubleshoot integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, JSON/XML payloads, and tools such as Postman.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios beyond standard platform capabilities.
  • Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture reviews, and solution design sessions with partner and customer stakeholders.
  • Translate customer workflows and business requirements into structured conversational components and reliable AI Agent behavior.
  • Apply knowledge of LLMs, prompting strategies, embeddings, and context management to improve agent performance.
  • Support prompt design, conversational flows, guardrails, escalation logic, and voice configuration such as SSML, lexicons, and regex.
  • Apply structured testing to validate architecture, integration reliability, agent quality, and real-world behavior.
  • Review partner-created solution designs and help partners build the capability to deliver Parloa solutions independently.
  • Identify and resolve delivery blockers with Product, Solution Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Customer Success, and partner teams.
  • Document reusable architecture patterns, implementation guidance, technical standards, and best practices.

What Success Looks Like

  • Partners and customers trust you as a strategic and technical advisor.
  • Partner-led deployments launch with scalable architectures, reliable integrations, and strong AI Agent performance.
  • Partners become increasingly self-sufficient while maintaining high delivery quality and alignment with Parloa standards.
  • Technical risks, integration gaps, and implementation blockers are identified and resolved early.
  • Reusable technical guidance and architecture patterns improve delivery quality across the partner ecosystem.

Who you are:

  • 4+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing technical roles across solution architecture, systems architecture, enterprise integration, technical consulting, or complex SaaS implementation.
  • Experience working with strategic partners, systems integrators, consulting firms, or partner-led delivery models.
  • Strong systems thinking and experience solving complex problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms such as CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms, or workflow tools.
  • Proficiency in REST APIs, JSON/XML, API testing tools such as Postman, and authentication patterns including OAuth, API keys, and JWT.
  • Experience reading API documentation, defining field mappings, and troubleshooting integration behavior.
  • Ability to evaluate technical feasibility, architecture quality, scalability, security, and delivery risk.
  • Comfort working hands-on with integrations, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, conversational architecture, and enterprise AI workflows.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into reliable prompts, conversational flows, and agent behaviors.
  • Strong stakeholder and project management skills, with experience leading workshops, discovery sessions, or architecture discussions.
  • Excellent communication and consultative problem-solving skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, strong initiative, and comfort operating in an evolving environment.
  • Excellent written and spoken English is required

Nice to have:

  • Experience enabling systems integrators or technical delivery partners.
  • Exposure to contact center, telephony, or enterprise CX technologies.
  • Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SAP Integration Suite.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, tool calling, retrieval, or agent orchestration.
  • Experience with SSML, lexicons, regex, or voice configuration.
  • Exposure to TypeScript, Node.js, Git, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or Kubernetes.
  • Experience supporting enterprise go-lives and production troubleshooting.

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical & Expert Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

title: Kock med bageriintresse eller bagare med matlagningsintresse
description:
Kock med bageriintresse eller bagare med matlagningsintresse

Viggbyholms Stationskafé i Täby söker en ny kollega till köket.

Är du kock och tycker om att baka?

Eller är du bagare och tycker om att laga mat?

Då vill vi gärna träffa dig.

Vi söker en hungrig, ambitiös och praktiskt lagd person som vill utvecklas i vårt kök.

Du behöver inte vara expert på både matlagning och bakning. Det viktiga är att du har en bra grund inom det ena och ett genuint intresse för det andra.

Vad gör vi?

På Viggbyholms Stationskafé lagar vi maten själva och bakar vårt bröd från grunden.

I köket arbetar vi bland annat med:

  • Bröd och enklare bakning
  • Sallader
  • Soppor
  • Pajer
  • Förberedelser inför dagens försäljning

Arbetet är varierat och du får möjlighet att använda både dina kunskaper inom matlagning och ditt intresse för bakning.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker framför allt någon som passar in på en av dessa två profiler:

Kock med bageriintresse

Du är utbildad kock eller har erfarenhet av kockyrket.

Du tycker om att baka och vill utvecklas mer inom bröd och bakning.

eller

Bagare med matlagningsintresse

Du är utbildad bagare eller har erfarenhet från bageri.

Du tycker om att laga mat och vill utvecklas mer inom matlagning.

Det viktigaste är personen

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början.

Vi tror att en duktig och ambitiös person som vill lära sig kan komma långt hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Är arbetsvillig och tar ansvar
  • Är nyfiken och vill lära dig
  • Tycker om att arbeta praktiskt
  • Har ordning omkring dig
  • Kan arbeta självständigt
  • Ser vad som behöver göras
  • Tycker om mat och hantverk
  • Trivs i ett mindre team
  • Har god svenska i det dagliga arbetet
  • Har helst B-körkort
  • Kan arbeta minst varannan helg

Du behöver inte ha många års erfarenhet. Rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas är viktigare för oss.

Vad får du hos oss?

  • Ett varierat arbete med både matlagning och bakning
  • Möjlighet att utvecklas inom det område du kan mindre om
  • Ett självständigt arbete
  • Möjlighet att påverka vårt mat- och bageriutbud
  • Ett mindre team
  • Arbetsplats i Viggbyholm, Täby

Kanske är det här ditt nästa steg?


Vi söker någon som har en bra grund, är nyfiken och vill bli bättre.

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och några korta rader om dig själv.

title: Engineer
description:
The role is responsible for keeping guest rooms, public areas, and building systems in safe, functional, and attractive conditions. The work is typically broad, requiring skills in plumbing, electrical, carpentry, painting, and general building maintenance. 5 shifts per week, days can vary, either 8-4:30 or 3-11:30 with some flexibility needed from time to time on day and time. Position can include overnight shift.


Engineers play a critical role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of all mechanical, electrical, and structural systems within a hotel facility. You will help create a safe and comfortable environment for guests and staff, contributing to an exceptional guest experience.


Engineer Duties and Responsibilities

· Maintenance and Repairs: Perform routine inspections, maintenance, and repairs on HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical systems to ensure they are in working condition.

· Emergency Response: Respond promptly to emergency situations, such as power outages, plumbing leaks, and equipment failures, and take necessary actions to mitigate the impact on guests and staff.

· Equipment Monitoring: Monitor and maintain hotel equipment, including boilers, chillers, elevators, and fire safety systems, to ensure their reliability and safety.

· Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment inspections, and work orders to track maintenance history and plan for future maintenance needs.

· Safety Compliance: Ensure compliance with all safety standards and regulations, conduct regular safety inspections and address any identified hazards promptly.

· Training and Support: Provide training and guidance to hotel staff on safety procedures and equipment operation to promote a safe working environment.

About Us

Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corporation, a family owned business for over 75 years, takes pride in powering progress in health, security and quality of life. We are key partners with the world’s leading medical devices, semiconductor, scientific analytics and industrial systems manufacturers. When they want to push the limits of what’s possible with high voltage applications, they turn to us to make it happen.

For more junior roles, you can expect to get some aid from a lead or supervisor.

What You Will Do
• Wire, solder, fabricate and assemble High Voltage Power Supply units
• Assemble racks, chassis, and top assemblies
• Use schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, engineering sketches, BOMs, ECNs, and verbal instructions to build printed circuit boards and subassemblies
• Rework (as necessary)
• Fabricate vector board circuits and enclosures from engineering sketches
• Work with sheet metal and polycarbonate material utilizing available machine shop hand and power tools (ex: table/band saws, brake, punches, etc.)
• May be required to follow other instructions and to perform other duties as requested by the supervisor and/or manager
• Aid other assemblers as required
• Fill out any associated paperwork such as configuration control travelers

What You Need
• Prefer 3 years' minimum experience in the assembly of electro-mechanical devices.
• Prior industry experience in the Power Electronics field is highly desirable
• Excellent soldering skills. IPC 610 Solder Certification or J-Standard a strong plus
• Must be able to identify component symbols and read technical Engineering documents
• Proficiency with basic hand tools, torque tools, and hand crimp tools

Working conditions are normal for a manufacturing environment. Work involves frequent lifting of materials and product up to 30 pounds. In addition, the following Personal Protective Equipment is required:
• eye safety glasses
• hearing protectors
• work boots
• hardhats
• facemasks

Shifts:
7:00am -3:30pm, typically. Willingness to work overtime (after hours and weekends) as needed

title: Refrigeration - Gilliard
description:

Role qualifications:

Employee will need to be able to:

  • Ensuring the continuous operation and maintenance of the facility HVAC systems.
  • Ensuring the continuous operation and maintenance of the utilities support equipment, used to provide utilities to the HVAC and water preparation equipment, including boilers, chillers, and associated equipment and systems.

  • Utilize and maintain work order system.
  • Ensure facility HVAC systems and water processing and generation systems stay in a validated state.

  • Previous experience as a Refrigeration Technician.

  • Knowledge of local building codes.
  • Advanced mechanical and diagnostic skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work outdoors in extreme weather conditions.
  • Physically fit and able to lift heavy equipment.

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Be dependable and honest.
  • Time management: the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Strong team player
  • Commitment to company values
  • Follow all safety rules and procedures.

  • Poultry experience

title: Patient Service Representative - Pepperell Immediate Care - Full Time - Foundation Medical Partners
description:
Come work at the best place to give and receive care!

​Job Description:

Who We Are:

Southern New Hampshire Health has been a cornerstone of the region since 1893, delivering high-quality, compassionate care close to home. Anchored by Southern New Hampshire Medical Center, a 188-bed, DNV-accredited hospital in downtown Nashua with a Level III Trauma Center, Level II Special Care Nursery, and Magnet® designation for nursing excellence, we offer a full spectrum of services from primary care to advanced diagnostics and specialized treatments. Our medical staff includes over 500 providers from Foundation Medical Partners and local practices. Foundation Medical Partners, our multi-specialty group, spans more than 70 practices across southern New Hampshire and northern Massachusetts, providing coordinated, patient-centered care to thousands each year.


About the Job:

The Patient Service Representative serves as the first point of contact for patients and visitors, providing clerical and administrative support for front desk operations. This role is responsible for patient registration, appointment scheduling, referral management, phone support, documentation processing, and delivering exceptional customer service in a fast-paced healthcare environment.


What You’ll Do:

  • Greet, direct, register, check in, and check out patients in a professional and welcoming manner.
  • Answer incoming telephone calls, provide information, and schedule patient appointments.
  • Enter, track, and manage referrals, including obtaining necessary authorizations.
  • Collect, verify, and update patient demographic and insurance information.
  • Process registration forms, consent documentation, and medical records accurately.
  • Collect and reconcile patient copayments and maintain accurate daily balancing records.
  • Scan, index, and maintain patient documentation.
  • Assist with insurance requirements and communicate information appropriately to patients.
  • Coordinate interpreter services when needed.
  • Maintain compliance with organizational policies, confidentiality standards, and HIPAA requirements.
  • Stay current with system updates and workflow changes, including EPIC enhancements.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and identify potential safety concerns.
  • Communicate effectively with patients, families, providers, and colleagues.
  • Provide administrative support and coverage for other staff as needed.
  • Attend required training, meetings, and educational programs.

Who You Are / Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous customer service experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of reception functions, clinic procedures, and administrative workflows.
  • Understanding of medical terminology preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and basic computer skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain professional relationships with patients, providers, and coworkers.
  • Customer-focused with a caring and compassionate approach to service.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and support multiple office functions as needed.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when managing patient information and documentation.

Why You’ll Love Us:

  • Southern NH Medical Center is a 5-time Magnet designated hospital
  • Health, dental, prescription, and vision coverage for full-time & part-time employees
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life insurance
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Competitive pay
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Nursing Student Loan Paydown Program
  • 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Education & Paid training courses for continued career progression

& more!

Monday 9AM - 5PM

title: Senior Product Owner – Checkout
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy.

Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION

Product Ownership & Backlog Management

  • Own the product backlog for a defined product or capability area (e.g. Checkout within Basket & Checkout).

  • Translate portfolio strategy and investment priorities into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint goals.

  • Define and maintain a prioritised roadmap aligned to portfolio objectives.

  • Ensure backlog items are outcome-led and tied to measurable success criteria.

  • Continuously refine and reprioritise work based on performance, insight, and evolving business needs.

Discovery, Validation & Consumer Centricity

  • Work closely with UX/UI, Research, and CRO to ensure solutions are grounded in user insight and behavioural data.

  • Participate in and support research, testing, and experimentation initiatives.

  • Ensure product decisions are informed by data, experimentation, and validated learning, not opinion.

  • Identify friction, failure points, and improvement opportunities within the owned product area.

  • Champion consumer-centric thinking within the squad and across stakeholders.

Delivery & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data teams to ensure high-quality, timely delivery.

  • Balance discovery and delivery to ensure the team is solving the right problems while shipping value regularly.

  • Manage dependencies across teams and portfolios in a complex, global environment.

  • Escalate risks, trade-offs, and delivery constraints clearly and early to the Teamhead.

  • Ensure alignment with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Security, and other relevant functions where required.

Performance & KPIs

  • Contribute directly to the portfolio KPIs defined by the Teamhead (e.g. conversion, payment success, engagement, reliability).

  • Define feature- and initiative-level success metrics in collaboration with Data & Analytics.

  • Monitor performance trends and use insight to inform backlog refinement.

  • Support experimentation and continuous optimisation within the product area.

  • Clearly communicate impact, learnings, and performance updates to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with the Teamhead / Portfolio Owner to align on priorities and trade-offs.

  • Collaborate with global and regional stakeholders to ensure relevance and scalability.

  • Represent the product area in relevant forums and planning sessions.

  • Ensure transparency of progress, risks, and outcomes.

YOUR TALENT

Experience

  • 6–8+ years of experience in digital product roles such as Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar positions.

  • Significant experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager working on transactional digital products.

  • Strong experience working on eCommerce checkout, payments, or conversion-critical journeys.

  • Proven experience delivering complex features in collaboration with engineering and design teams.

  • Experience working with payment providers, checkout systems, or commerce platforms is highly beneficial.

  • Strong understanding of conversion optimisation and customer journey performance.

  • Experience working within agile product teams managing backlog and delivery cycles.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Deep understanding of checkout flows, payments, and digital commerce best practices.

  • Ability to prioritise work that improves conversion, reliability, and user experience.

  • Strong backlog ownership and product delivery management.

  • Ability to collaborate closely with designers to ensure seamless transactional user experiences.

  • Understanding of technical considerations such as payment integrations, fraud, and platform performance.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify optimisation opportunities.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across engineering, design, and commercial stakeholders.

This job opportunity will be available in full-time or part-time.

title: Digital Growth Analyst
description:
We Put the World on Vacation

Travel + Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide.

As the Digital Growth Analyst and technical associate on the Digital Growth Team, you are tasked with designing scalable data models and optimizing consumer segmentation strategy to drive scalable growth and impactful consumer engagement in support of our digital marketing efforts. By combining technical expertise with analytical insights, you will shape and refine digital marketing strategies, ensuring campaigns are both data-driven and tailored to diverse consumer needs. This role requires a strong foundation in data infrastructure, innovative problem-solving, and a passion for leveraging technology to fuel growth and engagement.

How You'll Shine:

  • Identify and activate key audience segments
  • Innovate and improve our data first strategy
  • Measure, report and optimize our digital tactics

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields, advertising, analytics, marketing
  • Exceptional ability to analyze data, identify trends, and derive actionable insights.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with proficiency in presenting complex data in a clear and persuasive manner to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, sharing insights and influencing strategies across marketing, sales, and product development.
  • Deep understanding of customer segmentation and targeting strategies, particularly in digital contexts, to enhance campaign personalization and effectiveness.
  • Knowledge of media buying strategies and tactics, including the optimization of media spend across various channels.
  • Expertise in web analytics with proficiency in platforms such as Google Analytics and Hubspot.
  • Knowledge of Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) such as Hubspot, Simon Data, SalesForce & AEP.
  • Skilled in utilizing data visualization tools like Tableau, Looker or PowerBI to create compelling visual representations of data.
  • Knowledge of SQL for managing databases and performing complex queries.
  • Understanding of Demand Side Platforms (DSPs) and their use in managing and optimizing digital advertising.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, data engineering, or a similar role with a focus on driving business growth and marketing optimization.

Experience equivalent to the education requirement may be accepted in lieu of the education requirement.

How You'll Be Rewarded:

We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel + Leisure Co. benefits include:

Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Life and accident coverage
  • Disability
  • Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
  • Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
  • 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure - speak to your recruiter for additional information)
  • Legal and identify theft plan
  • Voluntary income protection benefits
  • Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
  • Employee Assistance Program


Where Memories Start with You

Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel + Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

title: Student Placement - Packaging Engineering
description:
Job Description

Are you ready to put your studies into practice and make a meaningful contribution from day one? Our student placement offers a unique opportunity to join a dynamic team where you’ll play an active role in delivering key site projects, driving innovation, and ensuring compliance in a fast paced, regulated environment. You’ll be supported by experienced professionals and empowered to grow your skills in problem solving, communication, and project execution.


The position available is within the Packaging Integrated Process Team (IPT) Engineering Team at Organon.


Organon is recruiting for an Engineering student to join us by the beginning of August 2026 for 12 months for a student placement to join our world class manufacturing site in Cramlington, Northumberland.


Key Responsibilities:


• Provide day-to-day business support and assist with engineering and packaging projects.

• Develop technical knowledge of manufacturing equipment and processes.

• Contribute to improvement initiatives, problem-solving, and investigations into safety incidents or customer complaints.

• Compliance with our Company’s Global Policies, Procedures and Guidelines, regulatory requirements and execute Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) in the performance of day-to-day activities and all applicable job functions.

• Participate in Continuous Improvement projects focused on Safety, Quality, Supply, or Cost.

• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and SOPs, and accurately record and apply training received.


Education & Skills:


• Currently studying an Engineering related degree.

• You will be looking to complete a 12-month placement in your third or penultimate year of study, returning to your course at the end of the placement.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• A collaborative team player with excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines.


Application Process Timeline Overview:

Stage 1 – Submission of CV and Cover Letter (by 19th October 2026) Candidates will be required to submit their CV and cover letter.


Stage 2 – Initial Informal Discussion (between 9th November 18th November 2026) Candidates will be selected and invited to take part in an initial informal discussion about the role, as well as an opportunity for you to find out about the company.


Stage 3 – Assessment Centre + Final Interview (Early December 2026) Candidates successful at stage 2 will be invited to attend an Assessment Centre, located on site at Cramlington. Candidates will spend a day at the facility, getting a feel for Organon as well as taking part in several activities including a site tour and a final interview.

Secondary Job Description

Who We Are:

Organon delivers ingenious health solutions that enable people to live their best lives. We are a $6.5 billion global healthcare company focused on making a world of difference for women, their families and the communities they care for. description:

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Gathers carts from the parking lot. Consistently provides friendly, courteous customer service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work.
