title: Boiler Labor
location: Rose Hill, North Carolina, United States
description:
The Boiler is a source of energy for the processing plant heating water and creating pressurized steam. Operators work 12- hour shifts and monitor the efficiency and safety of the boiler component parts, with the help of computers. The boiler has to be in compliance with our air permit. Repair jobs and maintenance checks may require operators to work under very hot, noisy, and dangerous conditions. Operators have to routinely check systems, performs preventative maintenance, such as lubricating parts and troubleshoots malfunctioning boilers.

Need to be in good physical condition as there are stairs to climb and know about different tools. Be able to wear PPE while working for your own protection.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Tehtävänkuvaus

Senior Backend Developerina ratkaiset asiakkaiden liiketoimintahaasteita suunnittelusta ja arkkitehtuurista aina käytännön toteutukseen ja integrointiin asti. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä projektitiimin ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa rakentaen kestäviä, turvallisia ja skaalautuvia taustajärjestelmiä.

  • Huipputyöyhteisön: Matalan hierarkian ja ketterän työyhteisön, jossa omalle työlle saa vastuuta ja vapautta.
  • Vahvan moniammatillisen yhteisön: Ympärillesi kokeneet kollegat muun muassa ohjelmistokehityksen, datan ja pilviteknologioiden alueilta.
  • Joustavat työskentelytavat: Sujuvan hybridimallin, toimistot keskeisillä paikkakunnilla (Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, Hämeenlinna, Joensuu) sekä erinomaiset etätyömahdollisuudet.
  • Pitkäjänteisen urapolun: Tehtävän, jossa ei haeta tekijää vain yhteen tiettyyn projektiin, vaan panostetaan ammatilliseen kehittymiseen muuttuvassa teknologiantäyteisessä maailmassa.

Työtehtävät

Senior Backend Developerina työskentelet asiakkaidemme liiketoimintahaasteiden parissa vahvasti taustajärjestelmäkehitykseen ja arkkitehtuurillisiin ratkaisuihin painottuen. Olet hands‑on kehittäjä, joka haluaa koodata nyt ja jatkossa, mutta sinulta löytyy myös näkemystä laajoista sovelluskokonaisuuksista.

  • Kehittämään laajasti erilaisia backend‑ratkaisuja sekä sparraamaan laajojen sovellusten arkkitehtuurillisista linjauksista ja niiden perustelusta niin sisäisesti kuin ulkoisesti.
  • Suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan syvällisellä otteella REST‑ ja GraphQL‑rajapintoja.
  • Integroimaan erilaisia taustajärjestelmiä (mm. ERP, PIM, CRM) liiketoimintakriittisiin kokonaisuuksiin.
  • Kehittämään laadukkaita Java‑ ja Spring Boot ‑pohjaisia backend‑ratkaisuja.
  • Hyödyntämään tekoälyä osana teknistä kehitystyötäsi sekä oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta AI‑työkaluista ja ‑menetelmistä.
  • Huolehtimaan sujuvasta CI/CD‑putkien ja testiautomaation toteutuksesta sekä hyödyntämään pilvialustoja (Azure & AWS).
  • Sparraamaan tiimiä, arvioimaan teknisiä vaihtoehtoja ja tuomaan näkemystä laadukkaan koodin ja kestävien taustajärjestelmien takaamiseksi.

Etsimme

  • Laaja kokemus erilaisten backend‑ratkaisujen kehittämisestä ja halu toimia hands‑on kehittäjänä nyt ja jatkossa
  • Ymmärrys ja näkemys laajojen sovellusten arkkitehtuurillisista ratkaisuista sekä kyky perustella valitut ratkaisut niin sisäisesti kuin ulkoisesti
  • Syvä osaaminen REST‑ ja GraphQL‑rajapinnoista sekä kokemus erilaisten taustajärjestelmien, kuten ERP, PIM ja CRM, integroimisesta liiketoimintakriittisiin järjestelmiin
  • Vahva kokemus Java‑ ja Spring Boot ‑pohjaisten backend‑ratkaisujen kehittämisestä
  • CI/CD‑putket ja testiautomaatiot ovat sinulle arkipäivää
  • Kyky hyödyntää tekoälyä teknisessä kehitystyössä ja palava halu oppia lisää sillä saralla
  • Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito
  • Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tietotektiikan tai vastaavalta alalta

Arvostamme

  • TypeScript/JavaScript (esim. Node.js) ja Python backend‑osaaminen
  • Kokemus moderneista TypeScript‑/JavaScript‑pohjaisista frontend‑teknologioista ja ‑sovelluskehyksistä, kuten Reactista
  • Kokemus pilvipalveluista, kuten Azure ja AWS

Rekrytointiprosessimme

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit, jotka toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At Oakland, we help businesses unlock the power of their data. Whether it's data strategy, governance, engineering, analytics, or AI, we work with our clients to turn data into real, impactful results. Our team is made up of friendly, hands-on experts who love solving problems and making a difference. We don’t just advise, we roll up our sleeves and get stuck in, working alongside our clients every step of the way.

Founded in 1986 out of our Leeds HQ, we work with a diverse range of clients across all sorts of industries including Utilities, Telecommunications, Media, Financial Services, Public Sector, and many more! Our projects range from multi-year data transformations to specific, shorter-term assignments, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to diversify your skillset.

We meet high standards for social and environmental impact, transparency, and accountability. We believe businesses should be a force for good, so we make sure our decisions don’t just benefit the bottom line but also our people, communities, and the planet.

And it’s not just us saying we’re a great place to work... we were recently named a Top 5 Best Consultancy to work for in the UK through Best Companies! We’re all about creating an environment where people can grow, do meaningful work, and enjoy the journey.

In April 2025, Oakland was acquired by Softcat, a leading provider of IT infrastructure services to corporate and public sectors. By combining Oakland's deep expertise in data and AI consulting with Softcat's extensive portfolio and market presence, we can deliver unparalleled value and innovation to our clients. This partnership marks a significant milestone in our journey, and we’re looking forward to achieving great things together.

The Role

As a tech-agnostic consultancy, Engineers at Oakland develop broad and adaptable skillsets. As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll be an experienced engineer who remains hands-on while also providing technical leadership across projects, teams, and clients.

You'll have the ability to quickly understand new technologies, evaluate their suitability, and guide teams towards pragmatic, scalable solutions. No two projects are the same, so we encourage our Engineers to become technology polyglots and select the right tools for each client's needs.

Alongside delivering high-quality engineering outcomes, you'll play a key role in shaping technical direction, mentoring colleagues, contributing to solution architecture, and supporting client stakeholders through complex technical challenges.

Our work spans data platform implementations, business intelligence, software engineering, AI solutions, and cloud transformation projects, giving you the opportunity to work across a wide range of technologies while being part of a talented community of 25+ Engineers.

We expect you to have:

  • Significant experience designing, building, and supporting scalable engineering solutions.
  • Experience working within cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • A strong understanding of engineering best practices, including testing, code quality, version control, and design patterns.
  • Experience leading technical workstreams, owning technical decisions, and providing guidance to other engineers.
  • The ability to work directly with clients to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in mentoring, coaching, and supporting the development of junior and mid-level engineers.

It would be nice to have any of the below:

  • Experience designing and implementing modern data platforms using technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar.
  • Experience with solution and/or data architecture
  • Front-end software engineering experience, including building web applications with React (or similar frameworks).
  • Strong DevOps and platform engineering experience, including Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, observability, and tools such as Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
  • AI engineering and architecture experience, including GenAI, LLMs, RAG, agentic systems, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience supporting pre-sales activities, technical discovery workshops, estimations, and proposal creation.

Certifications (Desirable):

  • Azure certifications such as DP-700, DP-600, AZ-305, or AI-focused certifications such as AI-900 and AI-103.
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or SnowPro Specialty or Advanced certifications
  • Equivalent certifications in cloud, data, AI, architecture, or software engineering technologies.

Blended Working:

We operate a blended working model, with colleagues spending at least two days per week in the office, aligned to project team requirements. Occasional travel to client sites may also be required.

This balance helps us stay connected, learn from each other, and build strong relationships - both within our team and with the businesses we support.

Benefits that put you first

At Oakland, we believe in taking care of our people - both inside and outside of work. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Health & Wellbeing – Enjoy Private Healthcare from day one for you and your household, including dental cover, physiotherapy, mental health support, and access to a range of wellbeing services to keep you feeling your best.
  • Discretionary Bonus – Your hard work won’t go unnoticed. When we do well, you’ll do well.
  • Generous Pension – We invest in your future with a 10% employer contribution, plus flexible options so you can adjust to your investment preferences.
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme – Drive greener with tax-efficient options to get behind the wheel of an electric car.
  • Giving Back – Support causes you care about with our Payroll Giving Scheme and Matched Charitable Giving program.
  • Bike to Work Scheme – Save money, stay active, and enjoy tax savings on a new bike.
  • Family-Friendly Policies – We support all paths to parenthood with:
  • Enhanced Maternity Pay – 16 weeks full pay, 10 weeks half pay.
  • Enhanced Paternity Pay – 2 weeks full pay, 2 weeks half pay.
  • Adoption, Surrogacy & Shared Parental Leave.
  • Fertility Treatment Support – Because your family matters.
  • Time to Recharge – 25 days annual leave + bank holidays (and your allowance grows the longer you’re with us!).
  • Learning & Development – We invest in you with:
  • Personalised development plans tailored to your goals.
  • Full support for certifications.
  • Access to The Oakland Academy for a suite of learning materials.
  • An annual Personal Learning Budget to upskill in ways that matter to you.
  • Refer & Earn – Know someone great? If they join us, you’ll get a referral bonus as a thank you.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging at Oakland

At Oakland, we believe that diverse perspectives drive better outcomes for our people, our clients, and our business. Our commitment to DEIB isn’t just about policies; it’s about creating a workplace where everyone feels heard, valued, and empowered to thrive.

We are building a truly inclusive Oakland where you can be yourself, no matter your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

Fair & Inclusive Hiring

Every interviewer completes recruitment and unconscious bias training, and our hiring process is skills-based and structured to ensure fairness and consistency for all candidates.

Support Throughout the Interview Process

If you require any reasonable accommodations to make your interview experience more accessible, our Talent team is here to help. Just let us know.

Job Description Summary

Are you passionate about protecting organizations through strategic risk management and innovative insurance solutions? As Associate Director, US Insurance, you will play a critical role in shaping and executing Novartis' U.S. commercial insurance strategy while serving as a trusted advisor to business leaders across the organization. In this highly visible position, you will lead insurance placements, oversee complex claims, manage broker relationships, and provide expert guidance on risk transfer, contractual protections, and insurance governance.

Job Description

· Lead the negotiation, placement, and renewal of U.S. commercial insurance programs in alignment with the global insurance and risk-transfer strategy.

· Provide expert guidance on contractual risk-transfer provisions, insurance requirements, construction projects, clinical trials, supply-chain agreements, and evidence-of-insurance processes.

· Strong knowledge of insurance policy placement, underwriting, contractual risk transfer, and insurance program governance.

· Experience managing insurance brokers, external service providers, and cross-functional stakeholder relationships.

· Strong financial acumen with experience supporting budgets, forecasting, reporting, and compliance activities.

· Excellent analytical, negotiation, communication, and project management skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across a matrix organization.




Desirable Requirements


· Professional insurance designations such as CPCU, ARM, CRM, or equivalent certifications.

· Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, global insurance programs, or multinational organizations.

title: Network Security Automation Engineer
description:
Who are we:

Neotalent Conclusion is one of the leading Iberian specialists providing services in Information Technology and Engineering services. As part of the Netherlands-based organization Conclusion, which has an ecosystem of over 25 companies and 3,600 employees, we are focused on increasing the technological capacity of our clients and the digital transformation of their application ecosystems.

We are talent specialists, attracting the best people and combining them with the needs of the most ambitious projects, at the right time. Our success comes from our investments in innovation, our focus on results, and, above all, the guarantee that our people will have happy and rewarding careers.

With over 25 years of solid experience, Neotalent Conclusion has established its presence in key locations, including Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid. The company currently has more than 950 professionals in the different areas in which it operates.


Neotalent, the responsive people.

Find out more about us at www.neotalentconclusion.com.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Network Security Automation Engineer to join our teams in a highly challenging international project focused on accelerating network automation, infrastructure orchestration, and operational excellence. You will play a key role in designing and implementing automation frameworks, streamlining network operations, and enhancing the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of complex multi-vendor network environments.


What you will do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain network automation solutions using Python, Ansible, Jinja2, and Git-based workflows;
  • Automate network device provisioning, configuration management, and change management processes across multi-vendor environments;
  • Develop and integrate CI/CD pipelines to support infrastructure automation and network configuration deployment;
  • Implement network monitoring, validation, telemetry, and automated remediation solutions to improve operational efficiency and service reliability;
  • Automate data centre networking environments, including routing, switching, VXLAN-EVPN fabrics, and traffic optimisation capabilities;
  • Integrate automation frameworks with network management, observability, security, and inventory platforms such as NetBox and monitoring solutions;
  • Collaborate with network, infrastructure, and security teams to establish automation standards, best practices, and governance models.


What you are like:

  • Proficient in Python development for network automation, including libraries such as Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, and PyEZ;
  • Experienced with Ansible automation, Jinja2 templating, GitLab, and CI/CD implementations;
  • Strong knowledge of network management protocols, including NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gNOI, and vendor APIs;
  • Solid understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking concepts, routing protocols, network design principles, and VXLAN technologies;
  • Experienced working with network vendors such as Juniper, Arista, Cisco, Fortinet/FortiGate, and Check Point;
  • Familiar with monitoring, observability, and telemetry technologies, including SNMP, NetFlow, sFlow, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, and log analysis platforms;
  • Comfortable working with Linux environments, particularly Red Hat Linux, including system administration and scripting activities;
  • Knowledge of infrastructure inventory and operational tools such as NetBox, JIRA, NetBrain, LogicMonitor, or similar platforms;
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a proactive and automation-first mindset;
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in dynamic, multicultural, and technology-driven environments.


Why join us:

  • Work on challenging projects for big clients;
  • Learn more about emerging technologies;
  • Possibility of working remotely;
  • Design your career plan;
  • Access to continuous training and certifications;
  • Evolve through our internal mobility program;
  • … and much more!

title: Operational Manager, Cloud Services DevOps
description:
Why Verifone


For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.


Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located.



What's Exciting About the Role


Verifone is offering a unique opportunity to step into a newly created role and help shape the future of our global cloud operations. As our DevOps Programme Manager, you'll oversee our enterprise-wide cloud services and infrastructure transformation initiatives. You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. and you will work across cross-functional engineering teams, manage delivery governance, and optimize our continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) and cloud hosting environments (AWS/Azure).



Key Responsibilities


Programme & Delivery Management



  • End-to-End Ownership: Take full accountability for the delivery of complex cloud, infrastructure, and automation programmes from inception to completion.

  • Governance & Reporting: Implement robust project governance, track budgets, manage RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs, and report progress to senior stakeholders.

  • Resource Allocation: Coordinate onshore and offshore engineering teams, defining roles, workflows, and deliverables schedules.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Facilitate communication between software development, IT operations, security, and external clients.


Technical & DevOps Oversight



  • Cloud Strategy: Oversee the management and scaling of multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or Private Cloud).

  • Automation & CI/CD: Ensure adherence to best practices in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automated deployment pipelines using tools like Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.

  • Operational Security: Embed security standards (DevSecOps), compliance requirements, and ITIL frameworks into the core delivery lifecycle.

  • Performance Optimization: Monitor platform reliability, uptime targets (SLAs), and logging/monitoring frameworks.



Required Skills and Qualifications



  • Proven track record of managing enterprise-scale cloud transformation or DevOps programmes.

  • Strong background working in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models within fast-paced environments.

  • Budget management experience and familiarity with tracking toolsets (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, MS Project).

  • Technical Competencies

  • Deep conceptual or hands-on understanding of cloud architecture (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, containerization/Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).

  • Awareness of infrastructure automation and configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible).



Soft Skills and Leadership



  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to articulate technical solutions to non-technical audiences.

  • Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities to guide engineering teams through operational change.



Our Commitment


Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Ecolab is seeking a Chemical Plant Operator I to join our team in Garland, TX. As a Chemical Plant Operator I, you’ll help deliver the products that support clean water, safe food, and healthy environments around the world. You’ll be responsible for operating and controlling chemical processing systems and equipment to produce high-quality products safely and efficiently. This is a hands-on opportunity to grow your skills in a dynamic environment while contributing to a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Review daily mix schedules and confirm availability of required raw materials to ensure smooth production flow
  • Accurately add raw materials to mixing systems using manual methods, pumps, or automated equipment, following standard mix instructions
  • Operate mixing equipment with variable agitation to achieve consistent batch quality
  • Monitor product quality throughout the mixing and filling process, identifying and reporting any out-of-spec materials or batches
  • Partner with Quality team members to resolve batch discrepancies and ensure compliance with standards
  • Perform thorough cleaning of all mix tanks and associated equipment to maintain a safe and sanitary work environment
  • Operate forklifts, palletizers, scales, pumps, and other material handling equipment to move raw materials and finished goods
  • Conduct routine preventative maintenance on production equipment and facility systems
  • Maintain accurate production records and equipment logs
  • Contribute to a culture of safety by following all Ecolab safety protocols and participating in safety initiatives
  • Collaborate with team members to identify and implement process improvements aligned with Ecolab’s continuous improvement goals
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support plant operations and team success

  • Plant Location: Garland, TX
  • Work Week & Shift: C shift, Sunday - Thursday 9:30PM to 5:30AM
  • Compensation: $27.26 per hour

  • Be part of a team that directly supports Ecolab’s mission to protect public health and the environment
  • Gain hands-on experience with chemical processing systems and industry-leading safety practices
  • Grow in a supportive environment that values safety, collaboration, and shared success

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • 1 year of industrial mixing or batching experience
  • 1 year of stand-up reach truck experience
  • 1 year of experience working with systems, pumps, read meters, basic Quality Control data and tracking mixing and quality information (mix logs, batch adjustments, etc.)
  • Ability to simultaneously mix several tanks and accurately complete related documents
  • Ability to read and match numbers on shipping records, labels, raw materials and finished goods
  • No Immigration Sponsorship available for this opportunity

Physical Requirements of Position:

  • Lifting, pushing, pulling, and carrying up to 50 pounds chest high

Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with a disability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working safely and efficiently in a chemical or manufacturing environment
  • Ability to understand systems, pumps, read meters, basic Quality Control data and to track mixing and quality information (mix logs, batch adjustments, etc.)
  • Ability to perform basic Quality Control tests (perform pH testing, take samples)
  • Excellent attention to detail; must be able to simultaneously mix several tanks and accurately complete related documents
  • Experience operating a Forklift
  • Basic knowledge of chemistry and chemical handling
  • Mechanical aptitude and familiarity with hand and power tools
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills
  • Experience working effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

What’s in it For You:

  • Starting on Day 1: Access to our comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, matching 401K, company-paid pension, stock purchase plan, paid parental leave, select discounted childcare resources, and more!
  • The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, and healthy environments
  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best

At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work

Job Description:

SUMMARY / PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The Clinical Project Manager (CPM) is a Project Leader with the end to end accountability for the successful execution of global Evidence Generation activities including but not limited to interventional and non-interventional Company Sponsored Studies (CSS), Research with Secondary Use Data (SUD) and other assigned medical affairs projects falling within the remit of GM Clinical Operations.


The CPM has responsibility for planning, initiation, conduct and reporting for all assigned evidence generation projects ensuring completion to budget and within timelines according to the relevant GXP regulations, external guidelines, SOPs and quality standards. Where activities are outsourced this means oversight of the Service Provider (SP) and co-ordination of internal cross functional team (CFT), if in house then this is undertaking the activities personally and coordinating the deliverables of the internal CFT.


Associate Clinical Project Manager

Provides support to the CPM/SCPM and responsible for activities/task packages delegated to you for projects assigned and/or take accountable for own projects (smaller and/or less complex projects).


Senior Clinical Project Manager

Provide oversight of ACPM/CPM activities for assigned projects, provide mentorship and support to more junior CPMs, where assigned act as lead for full asset/portfolio of projects and provision of strategic Clinical Research Leadership input.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES / JOB EXPECTATIONS


Clinical Research Leadership

Senior Clinical Project Manager

  • To work with internal stakeholders and Cross Functional Team to ensure excellence in execution of all evidence generation activities.
  • To provide internal consultancy and thought leadership with regards to the conduct of clinical research.
  • To design study synopses and develop research protocols aligned with integrated evidence generation plans (IEGP) that will support the study through Ipsen approval pathways.
  • To consult with key opinion leaders and external stakeholders to develop studies relevant to patients and the clinical community.

Preparation of the Study

  • Set-up and lead the study Cross Functional Team (CFT) overseeing study design and kick-off activities.
  • Initiate high level feasibility and continuously monitor how changes to the study design affect feasibility during the preparation and development of the study protocol.
  • Own preparation of the project budget including financial and clinical supply forecasting.
  • Develop the study timelines planning for critical events and milestones as agreed by the Cross Functional Team.
  • Drive excellence in execution and adherence to the project plan through application of project management best practices.
  • Liaise with Global Patients Affairs to embed patient centricity into study conduct and the design of Ipsen evidence generation activities.
  • Maintain awareness of digital opportunities through collaborative work with the DIGS and data strategy teams.
  • Establish close working relationships with Lead Medical Experts, Global Regulatory Affairs and Global Pharmacovigilance to support the submission and approval of PASS/PAES protocols to regulatory bodies such as EMA’s PRAC, the FDA, regional and local regulatory authorities.

Initiation of the Study

  • Lead the SP selection process (RFP creation, bid defense, contracting) and in collaboration with the CFT, Global Procurement and Corporate Legal Affairs.
  • Co-ordinate completion of the study Integrated Oversight Plan (IOP) prior to initiation of the study defining and agreeing KPIs/QTLs/Performance indicators with SPs and the Cross Functional Team.
  • Oversee SP performance and creation of documents required for the execution of the study.
  • Identify and select investigator sites in collaboration with the Medical Asset Lead, SP and Ipsen Affiliates.
  • Coordinate the set-up of the eTMF (Trial Master File) in collaboration with the CTA assigned to the study.
  • Ensure that the study CFT and investigator sites are appropriately trained. (e.g.: Oversight of or creation and approval of investigator training materials, completion and co-ordination of investigator’s meetings)
  • Complete posting of the study on external registries (clinicaltrials.gov etc) in compliance with Ipsen transparency requirements and regulatory commitments.
  • Ensure (or Oversight of) that all necessary regulatory, ethical, IRB and governance approvals are in place prior to commencement of recruitment at an investigator site.

Study Conduct

  • Coordinate the CFT (internal and SPs) overseeing the progress of the study and SP’s performance to ensure timely on budget delivery.
  • Monitor execution and delivery of KPIs/QTLs/Performance indicators as agreed in the IOP.
  • If applicable for projects assigned, review site visit reports per the IOP, ensuring timely and appropriate follow up of issues raised by monitors, cross functional team members, affiliates and/or CROs as appropriate.
  • If applicable liaise with Regional Clinical Operations team to execute any co-monitoring activities defined for SP oversight and/or set up regular meeting with MSLs (Medical Science Liaison) at LMA (Local Medical Affairs) who may be able to support Clinical Operations at various steps (site qualification, site recruitment).
  • Proactively escalate deviations and non-compliances affecting the rights, wellbeing and safety of patients, adherence to the protocol or the ethical conduct of the study.
  • Via leadership of the study team, provide end to end oversight of the data, to ensure delivery to defined protocol, timelines and quality, timely execution of data deliverables and subsequent delivery of excellence in execution.
  • Recommend, review and oversee amendments to study protocol ensuring implementation at investigator sites following receipt of the necessary approvals.
  • Provide and present regular reports on study progress including site performance, data quality and resource needs.
  • Undertake activities to inform and motivate investigators and the study team through appropriate engagement activities e.g. distribution of regular newsletters, ad hoc investigator meetings and motivational calls.
  • Ensure that the CTMS is updated and that data in SMD is submission ready.
  • Accountable for eTMF inspection readiness.

Study Completion

  • Coordinate the preparation, the review and the submission of the CSR with Medical Writing.
  • Ensure the finalization and archiving of the eTMF.
  • Ensure that the study results are posted to the required registries.
  • All necessary regulatory reporting requirements of the study results and end of study summaries are completed.

KNOWLEDGE, ABILITIES & EXPERIENCE


Senior CPM

  • Significant and relevant experience of pharmaceutical drug development (Ph2, Ph3) including project management of national and international programs OR significant and relevant experience in RWE/HEOR, NIS studies, including project management of national and international programs.

Clinical Project Manager

  • Relevant experience of pharmaceutical drug development (Ph2, Ph3) including project management of national and international programs OR significant and relevant experience in RWE/HEOR, NIS studies, including project management of national and international programs.

Associate Clinical Project Manager

  • Background in pharmaceutical drug development (Ph2, Ph3) including project management of national and international programs OR significant and relevant experience in RWE/HEOR, NIS studies, including project management of national and international programs.

Additional Knowledge, Abilities & Experience

  • Experience and know-how in Oncology or in Rare Diseases or in Neurosciences.
  • Proven track record of delivery of projects to time, budget and quality.
  • Extensive track-record of interactions with country Medical Affairs Staff is a significant plus.
  • Intimate knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) for CPMs managing interventional CSS and non-GCP data regeneration regulations for CPMs managing NIS and research with SUD.
  • Senior CPM: Recent, significant and successful experience in mentoring people.
  • Experience of working with multidisciplinary groups and ability to work within a team environment.
  • Experience of managing and developing relationships with Service Providers.
  • Excellent organisational and management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s life science degree or Master’s degree or equivalent.
  • Excellent oral and written English.
  • Computer literacy.
  • Ability to travel as required with the needs of the role, up to approximately 25% of the time.

In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

About the Department

Group Technology and Operations (GTO) provides software and system development, information technology support services and banking operations.

We have centralized and standardized the technology components into Singapore, creating a global footprint which can be utilized for supporting our regional subsidiaries and the branches around the world. We operate and support 19 countries with this architecture to provide a secure and flexible banking infrastructure.

Our Operations divisions provide transactional customer services for our businesses while also focusing on cost efficiency through process improvements, automation and straight through processing.

This is a specialist role within UOB’s Group Business Continuity Management function. title: Software Engineer
description:
About Eon

Eon is building a new category around cloud backup data. We help enterprises turn their backup infrastructure into searchable, accessible, and AI-ready data — across the cloud environments they already use.

We’re a high-growth company backed by Sequoia, Lightspeed, Greenoaks, BOND, and Elad Gil. Our team includes the founders of CloudEndure, and we’re building the company at a stage where small teams can still have an outsized impact.

We’re looking for a Growth Engineer to help us find new, technical ways to create demand and distribution.

The role

This is not a traditional marketing engineering role.

You’ll sit inside the growth team and use software, AI, data, APIs, automation, and product mechanics to build new ways for Eon to reach the right customers and create pipeline.

You’ll build the systems behind our growth engine: automation, AI agents, data pipelines, web experiences, internal tools, experiments, and new distribution channels. You’ll also look for opportunities that don’t look like traditional campaigns — things we can build once and have compound over time.

This is the first Growth Engineer at Eon. You’ll have significant ownership over what gets built, what gets tested, and where we invest our technical effort. The systems and playbooks you create will become the foundation for a larger growth team.

What you’ll do

Build Eon’s growth engine

  • Identify and build AI and automation use cases that make our demand generation and pipeline generation faster and more scalable.

  • Build workflows and agents using tools such as Claude, Clay, LLM APIs, and custom code.

  • Connect data across Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, our website, product data, and third-party sources to identify signals and trigger actions.

  • Build systems that help the growth team research accounts, identify intent, personalize outreach, launch experiments, and measure results.

  • Build and automate parts of our paid acquisition infrastructure, including audience creation, campaign setup, and optimization across LinkedIn and Google.

  • Own the technical side of eon.io — from page architecture and personalization to experimentation and CRO infrastructure.

  • Build tools that make it dramatically cheaper and faster to test new GTM ideas.

  • Work closely with Marketing and Revenue Operations. They own our core systems; you build new capabilities on top of them.

Find new ways to create demand

  • Find technical opportunities for Eon to reach cloud, infrastructure, data, and security teams in ways our competitors aren’t.

  • Build free tools, calculators, benchmarks, datasets, and technical resources that our target customers actually want to use and share.

  • Turn Eon’s technical expertise and product capabilities into things people can experience rather than just read about.

  • Build distribution through developer communities, technical ecosystems, integrations, marketplaces, and other channels.

  • Experiment with referral, sharing, and product-led mechanics that can create compounding distribution.

  • Identify emerging AI platforms, APIs, developer ecosystems, and other channels before they become crowded.

  • Prototype quickly, measure what works, kill what doesn’t, and double down on the signals.

What you bring

  • 3+ years building and shipping production software.

  • Strong coding skills and the ability to take an idea from zero to production independently.

  • Experience with Python and/or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, and SQL.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent.

  • Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or AI-powered workflows.

  • A strong understanding of how systems connect — APIs, data, automation, web, and third-party platforms.

  • A builder mindset: you like figuring things out yourself, moving quickly, and learning by shipping.

  • Curiosity about growth, distribution, marketing, and how companies acquire customers.

  • Evidence that you’ve built something outside of your core job that people actually used, whether it’s a product, tool, open-source project, automation, or technical experiment.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, ad platform APIs, or marketing automation.

  • Experience with growth, marketing, GTM, or developer relations.

  • Experience building tools or products for technical audiences.

  • A presence or reputation in a technical community.

  • Experience in cloud infrastructure, data, backup, security, or adjacent markets.

Why Eon

This is a chance to join at the beginning of something that doesn’t exist yet.

You won’t be inheriting a mature growth engineering function or maintaining someone else’s playbook. You’ll build the playbook.

If you’re the kind of engineer who sees a growth problem and immediately thinks, “I could build something for that,” this role is for you.

Eon Benefits

💸Equity Participation (RSUs!)

💰401K match

🍼Paid Parental Leave

🏥Generous benefits including medical, dental, and vision options available to you

🏢Vibrant office with meals, happy hours, employee events, and volunteer days

💻Home office setup and culture events for remote employees

We’re committed to creating a culture of inclusion and equality – across race, gender, sexuality, and disability – where innovation and growth thrive, every voice is heard, and everybody belongs.

title: Vice President - Collection & Processing
description:
Role Overview

This position will lead to oversee the development of recycling system expansion and optimization and will lead the strategy and development of collection and processing initiatives to achieve the recycling targets prescribed in regulations (e.g., increasing material access, supporting the use of new sorting and/or recycling equipment). Key materials targeted, include, but are not limited to flexible plastic packaging, small format plastics, PET thermoforms, and poly-coated containers.

The ideal candidate must combine strong operational background within the recycling industry, stakeholder management skills to ensure a successful relationship with recycling service providers and processing entities, and strong team leadership experience. This position will also oversee material data acquisition, especially through waste composition analysis (i.e. characterization), and would support downstream reporting requirements across multiple states in the U.S.

This role will report to the Chief of Staff at CAA.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Development

  • Develop and implement holistic collection and processing strategies (by material) that raise material access and capture for targeted materials in all states where CAA is involved, including multi-year roadmaps and investment plans.
  • Collaborate with other Program Planning and Operations teams on regulatory targets, exemptions, source reduction activities, and PCR targets.
  • In collaboration with the CAA Chief of Staff, Executive Directors, state operations staff, the role will work with MRFs, secondary processors, and

compost facilities to identify primary and secondary sortation best-practices to meet industry targets. Vet and champion new ideas to deliver transformation system changes in recycling to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

  • Identify and implement primary and secondary processing solutions to improve bale quality in support of end market strategies developed by the end markets team. Drive and catalyze third-party investments in additional collection and sortation as required to meet statute targets.
  • In partnership with states, support development of program plans for materials for new states outlining detailed strategies.
  • Lead the evaluation and development of the alternative collection models for CAA including dedicated curbside collection, drop-off collection, take-back programs, mixed waste collection, and other strategies to complement existing curbside and commercial recycling.

State Execution Plan Support

  • In support of state EPR programs, the VP will work with Executive Directors and state materials-leads to ensure annual state implementation plans for materials align with national strategies to solve materials challenges.
  • Support states in development of coordinated action and operating plans to accomplish state goals and to ensure budgets align with expected industry costs.
  • Support states in developing key strategies to work with MRFs to on-ramp materials and provide detailed guidance and analysis to enable investments to proceed at the state level.
  • Support third-party large-scale investments that impact multiple states (i.e. secondary sortation) and drive alignment with the states.

Interest-Holder Engagement

  • Responsible for engaging with recycling and materials trade associations, service providers, and other key interest holders to support materials collection and processing strategy development and implementation (in partnership with state teams).

Data and Waste Composition Analysis

  • Develop CAA materials intelligence (i.e., how materials flow within recycling systems) in partnership with Data & Analytics.
  • Design and oversee the development and implementation of CAA waste characterization protocols for inbound and outbound materials in different states.
  • Develop and manage the budget for materials strategy collection and processing initiatives, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and meet key performance indicators.

Support Source Reduction Initiatives

  • In collaboration with the VP of Circularity and Packaging Design, Executive Directors, and states materials leads; work with local interested holders to support collection and processing for reusable and refillable packaging in alignment with source reduction activities and strategies.

Team Leadership

  • Oversee, manage, delegate tasks, and motivate a team of industry professionals to accelerate system performance improvement and investments, primarily focused on plastics.
  • Set annual goals, lead team meetings, provide clear direction, ensure SOW’s are in place, and drive outcomes aligned with the schedules and needs of the business.
  • Complete necessary performance reviews and other HR related tasks.

· Other job related duties as assigned.

Skills & Competencies

  • Thorough knowledge of recycling collection, processing, and waste characterization principles and procedures.
  • Experience implementing sortation improvements and increasing collection via various channels.
  • Experience creating roadmaps, strategies, and operational plans to deliver long-term goals.
  • Strong understanding of Extended Producer Responsibility.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and identify actionable insights.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and compliance.
  • Ability to build, develop, lead and engage strong teams, with direct or indirect reporting lines including remote employees.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment for rapid pace and flexibility. Ideally understand and adapt to the startup nature of CAA.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering or equivalent.
  • At least 10+ years of operational experience in MRFs or recycling facilities.

· 3+ years managing teams.

  • Must possess or be able to obtain a valid Driver's License with a clean driving history.

Compensation & Other Information

  • Location: Fully Remote in the United States
  • Pay Rate: Based on a variety of factors in accordance with applicable law including the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, knowledge, and experience.

· Reports To: Chief of Staff

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: APAC RCSC Engineering Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Join our dynamic Customer Support Center Hub in Kuala Lumpur, where your technical and engineering expertise directly empowers healthcare providers across the Asia-Pacific region. As a Technical Support Specialist, you will act as a primary point of contact for complex customer inquiries, providing first-line technical problem-solving, driving digital tool adoption, and conducting laboratory simulations to ensure seamless diagnostic operations.

In this high-impact role, you will:

  • Deliver Technical Support: Handle customer inquiries via phone, written communications, and remote service channels to diagnose and resolve complex technical, instrument, and workflow issues.

  • Drive Quality Governance: Act as a Local Case Handler to identify product quality issues, perform root-cause troubleshooting, and escalate complex cases according to established standards.

  • Champion Digital Adoption: Onboard and guide laboratory customers in adopting digital support platforms, remote assistance, and self-fix tools to improve turnaround times and operational efficiency.

  • Simulate Customer Environments: Utilize our specialized onsite support laboratory to recreate customer scenarios, test instrument performance, and validate technical solutions.

  • Facilitate Knowledge Sharing: Utilize AI-driven knowledge management tools to create self-fix materials, support software/hardware updates, and deliver technical discussions for customers and internal teams.

  • Collaborate in Agile Networks: Participate in local and regional service projects within the hub, collaborating cross-functionally to improve service delivery and strengthen long-term customer trust.

Who You Are

You are a customer-centric, analytical problem solver who thrives in an intercultural environment. You communicate technical engineering concepts clearly, adapt quickly to new scientific information, and enjoy working collaboratively across diverse teams.

Your Qualifications:

  • Educational Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Medical Technology, or an equivalent technical qualification.

  • Professional Experience: You bring at least 3 years of professional experience in medical technology, electrical engineering systems maintenance, or laboratory operations.

  • Technical & Engineering Aptitude: You possess strong working knowledge of medical analysis systems, robotics, mechanics, fluidics, and basic IT network structures/interfaces.

  • Language Capabilities: You bring professional fluency in English alongside fluency in at least one regional language cluster (e.g., Mandarin dialects, Thai, or Korean) to support regional customers effectively.

  • Operational Flexibility: You are available to work within a 24/7 rotating shift pattern, including local public holidays, to accommodate regional country cluster business hours.

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together.

Backlog and Feature Management

Preferred Experience/Qualifications

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: Quantitative Developer [Python]
description:
A leading investment management firm is seeking a Quantitative Developer to help build and scale the technology platform that supports research, trading, risk, and data across the organization.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technologist who enjoys operating at the intersection of software engineering, quantitative finance, data infrastructure, and trading technology. You will work closely with investment professionals, researchers, and technology leadership to design, develop, and enhance systems that support the firm's investment process.

This is a highly visible position offering significant ownership and the opportunity to influence platform architecture and technology direction.

Responsibilities

Platform Development & Integration

  • Design, build, and enhance core investment technology platforms
  • Develop APIs, services, and internal tools supporting research, trading, and operational workflows
  • Integrate disparate systems and datasets into a scalable, unified platform
  • Contribute to technology architecture and platform design decisions
  • Support the full software development lifecycle from design through production deployment

Quantitative Research & Trading Support

  • Partner with quantitative researchers and investment teams to deploy models and analytics into production environments
  • Build tools and workflows that enable efficient research, testing, and deployment of investment strategies
  • Support systems across multiple asset classes including equities, futures, options, fixed income, and derivatives
  • Build and maintain market data, reference data, and internal data pipelines
  • Integrate third-party and proprietary data sources into the firm's technology ecosystem
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, monitoring, and observability across platforms
  • Support data architecture and storage initiatives

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
  • Support containerized applications and cloud-native environments
  • Improve monitoring, logging, automation, and platform reliability
  • Contribute to infrastructure modernization initiatives

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience within financial services, investment management, hedge funds, trading firms, or fintech environments
  • Strong programming skills in Python
  • Experience with at least one additional object-oriented language such as C#, C++, or Java
  • Experience building scalable APIs, distributed systems, and production-grade software
  • Strong SQL and data engineering capabilities
  • Familiarity with market data, trading systems, risk systems, or quantitative research platforms
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, including testing, version control, CI/CD, and code reviews
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from concept through delivery
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Experience

  • Buy-side, hedge fund, or asset management experience
  • Experience supporting quantitative research or systematic trading environments
  • Knowledge of options, futures, fixed income, derivatives, or risk systems
  • Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or other cloud technologies
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with modern data platforms and data pipeline design
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering workflows

What You'll Bring

  • A problem-solving mindset and willingness to challenge existing approaches
  • The ability to understand business problems and translate them into scalable technical solutions
  • Experience working in fast-paced, collaborative environments
  • A passion for building high-quality technology that directly impacts investment outcomes

The Site Robotics Lead will lead the robotics transformation of the Drug Substance manufacturing site in Schaftenau, Austria, driving the development, implementation, scaling, and lifecycle management of robotics solutions across manufacturing, laboratories, warehousing, and material handling. The role combines robotics expertise, strategic leadership, program management, and stakeholder engagement to enhance productivity, quality, safety, and operational excellence while ensuring GMP, validation, and cybersecurity compliance. As the site's robotics expert, the individual will collaborate with local and global stakeholders, engineering, operations, quality, IT/OT teams, and technology partners to build a sustainable robotics ecosystem.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the site robotics strategy and roadmap, identifying high-value automation opportunities and defining long-term robotics initiatives.
  • Lead robotics programs end-to-end, from opportunity assessment and business case development through implementation, deployment, and value realization.
  • Own the full lifecycle of robotics solutions, ensuring sustainable operations, maintenance, optimization, upgrades, and replacement planning.
  • Evaluate, select, and deploy robotics technologies, including AMRs, AGVs, material handling robots, service robots, AI-enabled robotics, and emerging Physical AI solutions.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration, partnering with manufacturing, laboratories, warehousing, engineering, quality, IT/OT, and global robotics experts.
  • Establish robotics governance, standards, and performance monitoring, ensuring scalability, reliability, safety, and operational excellence.
  • Ensure regulatory and operational compliance, including GMP requirements, validation, qualification activities, cybersecurity standards, and inspection readiness.
  • Build site robotics capabilities and external partnerships, acting as the site's robotics subject matter expert and fostering strong vendor and stakeholder relationships.

Essential Requirements:

description:
