Preferred Degree: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or related discipline.

Experience:

  • 14 years of relevant professional IT/software/systems engineering experience.
  • Prefer at least 10 years directly involving software engineering, systems engineering, architecture, integration, development/test, or enterprise application engineering.
  • Prefer at least 3-5 years functioning as a senior engineer, technical lead, systems architect, solution architect, or engineering lead.
  • Prefer 5+ years support DoD, Air Force, Federal, or comparable highly regulated mission-critical environments.
  • Prefer at least 3-5 years

Certifications:

IASAE Level 1 and/or the applicable DoD 8140 632-Intermediate qualifications required by the contract/government.

Clearance:

US Citizen/Active Secret/Whatever level is confirmed by the DD254

Work Location: REMOTE: Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota & Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Software Engineer IV does more than identify that a system has a problem.

This individual can determine why the problem exists, identify which systems and technical domains are affected, develop a technically sound corrective solution, determine how the change should be tested, understand its cybersecurity and configuration implications, coordinate implementation with the appropriate engineering teams, validate the result after deployment, and document the technical decision so that it remains supportable throughout the system lifecycle.

The strongest candidate will be able to operate comfortably between software, infrastructure, databases, cybersecurity, configuration management, testing, and program leadership while maintaining the disciplined engineering practices required in a mission-critical Department of the Air Force environment.

Position Overview

Seeking a Senior Software Engineer IV to provide senior-level systems and software engineering support for the Department of the Air Force Financial Management enterprise. This is not a traditional application-development position focused solely on writing software. The Senior Software Engineer IV will operate within an integrated engineering environment supporting mission-critical Air Force financial systems, cybersecurity requirements, infrastructure, databases, development and test environments, configuration baselines, system modifications, deployment validation, and lifecycle sustainment. The engineer will work across technical domains to analyze system requirements and modifications, identify dependencies and risks, develop technically sound solutions, support implementation, conduct engineering verification and validation, and ensure that changes can be safely introduced into highly available Government environments. The successful candidate must be capable of looking beyond an individual application or technical component. The position requires an understanding of how software, infrastructure, databases, cybersecurity controls, configuration baselines, test environments, deployment processes, and mission requirements interact throughout the system lifecycle.

The position requires integrated enterprise lifecycle engineering encompassing infrastructure engineering, database engineering, system administration, database administration, and cybersecurity engineering to sustain, optimize, secure, and technically validate the FMWorkFlow environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Highly competitive candidates will possess several of the following:

  • Prior Department of the Air Force experience.
  • Prior DoD enterprise systems engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical or highly available systems.
  • Experience with Air Force Financial Management or comparable Government financial systems.
  • Experience supporting AFFSO, SAF/FM, AFIMSC, or related organizations.
  • Experience working in environments governed by RMF and formal authorization requirements.
  • Experience implementing or validating IAVA, TCNO, vulnerability-remediation, or comparable cybersecurity directives.
  • Experience with development/test and production environments governed by formal configuration controls.
  • Experience providing Level III engineering or technical escalation support.
  • Experience coordinating software, infrastructure, database, middleware, and cybersecurity engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting system modernization, lifecycle sustainment, or major technical upgrades.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or serving as a senior technical lead.
  • Experience briefing technical recommendations to Government program managers or leadership.

Security and Access Requirements

The successful candidate must:

  • Obtain and maintain the security and suitability determinations required for assigned duties.
  • Meet requirements established in the applicable DD254.
  • Obtain and maintain required Government system and installation access.
  • Satisfy background-investigation requirements applicable to assigned system privileges.
  • Obtain and properly safeguard any required Common Access Card or Restricted Area Badge.
  • Complete required Air Force Information Assurance Awareness Training before accessing applicable Government computing resources.
  • Comply with Air Force Instructions, Air Force System Security Instructions, Air Force security memoranda, and local installation security procedures.
  • Immediately report known or suspected security incidents as required.
  • Protect Government information, systems, equipment, credentials, and resources.

Penn State's interdisciplinary Center for Theory of Emergent Quantum Matter (C-TEQ), part of the Institute for Computational and Data Sciences (ICDS) Quantum Hub, invites applications for several "C-TEQ Fellow” Postdoctoral Scholar positions. Start dates are flexible but can be immediate.

The successful candidates will have expertise in one or more areas related to quantum information science, quantum materials, quantum computation, artificial intelligence and computational approaches to emergent quantum matter, quantum geometry, Majorana modes, the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect, or closely related fields.

C-TEQ Fellows will benefit from a highly collaborative and intellectually stimulating research environment, working alongside fellow postdoctoral scholars and faculty affiliates from Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Information Sciences and Technology. description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

POSITION SPECIFICS

Director, Social Sciences Research Institute

As one of Penn State’s seven, university-wide interdisciplinary institutes in the Office of the Senior Vice President for Research (OSVPR), the Social Sciences Research Institute (SSRI) supports and promotes innovation and excellence in the social and behavioral sciences and contributes to a University-wide culture of interdisciplinary collaborative research. The new SSRI Director will build on a strong foundation to promote the social and behavioral sciences at Penn State, including by working with faculty from across the University as well as the other OSVPR Institute Directors, College Deans, Research Associate Deans and Department Heads to advance the Institute’s and University’s strategic priorities.


With an annual budget of approximately $11 million, the SSRI’s mission is to foster research that brings the social sciences to bear on critical challenges at the local, national, and international levels. The Institute does so by bringing together researchers from a range of disciplines and by providing consultation, financial support, shared accessible infrastructure, and services to social and behavioral scientists across Penn State’s colleges and campuses. The SSRI’s five strategic foci, Reducing Social Disparities, Smart and Connected Health, The Human System, Innovative Methods, and Dissemination and Implementation Science, are contained within a portfolio of activities within SSRI’s research units .


The SSRI Director reports to the Senior Vice President for Research who oversees Penn State research--currently exceeding $968 million annually. The Director’s responsibilities include: (1) advancing a vision for Penn State’s social and behavioral sciences, university-wide leadership, and catalyzing translational research excellence at the interfaces of the social and behavioral science and other science disciplines; (2) building interdisciplinary collaborations across the social and behavioral sciences and beyond including by developing policies and incentives for faculty engagement and creating an atmosphere of inclusion of diverse expertise and perspectives; (3) chairing SSRI’s Executive and Steering Committees, which advise on SSRI investments, policies, and programs; (4) chairing the SSRI Deans, Associate Research Deans, and Department Head Advisory Committees, which provide input and insights on both strategic and operational matters; (5) identifying new funding opportunities; (6) promoting interdisciplinary, collaborative, and translational research through seed funding and research infrastructure support; and (7) serving as a liaison between the University’s social and behavioral science research initiatives and state, national, and international organizations.


The successful candidate will be an internationally recognized leader in the social, behavioral, or population health sciences, with a strong record of interdisciplinary research and the vision and leadership needed to advance new initiatives, sustain existing research strengths, and translate research into evidence-based programs, policies, and practices. The candidate must have credentials appropriate for appointment as a tenured professor in an appropriate college and demonstrate a commitment to advancing Penn State’s land-grant mission. The candidate should also bring experience maintaining research excellence in the face of change, enthusiasm for fundraising and resource development, along with the ability to create new opportunities for sponsored research, philanthropic support, and industry partnerships, including the translation of research into science- and technology-based solutions, programs, government policies, and practices.


The successful candidate must also support maintaining and nurturing an exceptional work environment. Our employees are our greatest asset and our success as an organization in achieving our goals is based on having a team of inspired individuals with unique perspectives, an array of skills, and providing them with an engaging environment with opportunities for growth. The successful candidate will ensure Penn State Values are in the forefront of workforce expansion; they will provide professional development and opportunities for career advancement; and they will provide a work environment that positions individuals to do their best work, ranging from opportunities for individuals to excel, teams to be creative, and units to inspire.


The Pennsylvania State University is in central Pennsylvania. Coined Happy Valley for its highly ranked livability, the area is known for its access to nature spanning beautiful mountains, streams, and parks, as well as superb sports and recreational opportunities. The area has excellent schools and offers a multitude of cultural and sporting events.


Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. Applicants should submit a letter expressing their interest in this position with a detailed vision statement for advancing Penn State social sciences research, managing talented faculty and staff to achieve greater impact. Also include a curriculum vitae and contact information for four references. Interested individuals are invited to visit SSRI’s website for more information about SSRI.


Inquiries can be directed to Craig Newschaffer, Raymond E. and Erin Stuart Schultz Dean, College of Health and Human Development (cjn5389@psu.edu), chair of the search committee.

In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, employees enjoy robust retirement plans.   • Operate mixing equipment with variable agitation to achieve consistent batch quality
  • Monitor product quality throughout the mixing and filling process, identifying and reporting any out-of-spec materials or batches
  • Partner with Quality team members to resolve batch discrepancies and ensure compliance with standards
  • Perform thorough cleaning of all mix tanks and associated equipment to maintain a safe and sanitary work environment
  • Operate forklifts, palletizers, scales, pumps, and other material handling equipment to move raw materials and finished goods
  • Conduct routine preventative maintenance on production equipment and facility systems
  • Maintain accurate production records and equipment logs
  • Contribute to a culture of safety by following all Ecolab safety protocols and participating in safety initiatives
  • Collaborate with team members to identify and implement process improvements aligned with Ecolab’s continuous improvement goals
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support plant operations and team success

  • Gain hands-on experience with chemical processing systems and industry-leading safety practices
  • Grow in a supportive environment that values safety, collaboration, and shared success

  • Previous experience with industrial (large batch) mixing experience, mixing multiple tanks at once
  • Previous experience in chemical mixing

  • Experience working effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

title: Collateral Risk Analyst
description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE:

The Collateral Risk Analyst evaluates results of automated quality control reviews of commercial real estate appraisal reports to determine accuracy of review model results and to mitigate valuation and regulatory compliance risks. This is a remote role that requires experience as a certified general real estate appraiser or commercial real estate appraisal underwriter. The incumbent is primarily responsible for determination of valuation risk by providing expert knowledge in assessing, validating, and responding to results of proprietary appraisal review tool(s) and taking action to remediate any valuation risks identified by the tool or discovered independently by the Analyst. The purpose of this role is to provide expertise in employing results indicated by appraiser-developed appraisal review software intended to produce a robust, data-driven assessment of the reasonableness of valuations.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL GET TO:

  • Evaluate results of automated quality control reviews of commercial real estate appraisal reports to determine automated model accuracy and to mitigate valuation risks. for properties located throughout the United States
  • Employ appraiser-developed, automated review software to:
    • Evaluate reports for logical consistency and completeness
    • Assess whether report’s methodologies, approaches, and conclusions suggest compliance with federal and state regulations, and applicable bank policies.
    • Identify errors, omissions, inconsistencies, and deficiencies
    • Complete all tasks within established turnaround time standards while maintaining required quality benchmarks.
  • Communicate knowledgably and proficiently with appraisers and other valuation professionals to request corrections, clarifications, or revisions as needed to meet compliance standards.
  • Conduct all workflow activities — including report receipt/delivery and communications— exclusively through the company’s designated web portals and applications.
  • Evaluate vendor performance and provide feedback to support the maintenance of approved appraiser/vendor panel(s).
  • Participate in scheduled staff calls, ongoing professional development, and training activities.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all client, bank, and appraisal report information.
  • Maintain strict adherence to company policies and applicable laws, rules and regulations.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Appraisal Operations management team.

THIS OPPORTUNITY IS FOR YOU IF YOU HAVE/ARE:

  • Required
    • Certified General Real Property Appraiser license in good standing OR 10+ years experience as commercial real estate collateral risk/appraisal underwriter
    • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial real estate appraisal methodology, valuation theory, and applicable valuation approaches (Sales Comparison, Income Capitalization, Cost).
    • Working knowledge of Interagency Appraisal and Evaluation Guidelines, USPAP, FIRREA requirements, and applicable federal and state appraisal regulations.
    • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify errors, omissions, and logical inconsistencies in complex valuation reports.
    • Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a remote work environment.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).
    • Proficiency with and/or willingness to learn artificial intelligence tools (Augur, Copilot, Claude, Chat GPT) for daily use.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document findings clearly and concisely.
    • Ability to work independently and as a self-starter with minimal supervision.
  • Preferred
    • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, accounting, real estate, or a closely related field.
    • Experience evaluating appraisal compliance and/or risk in a bank, AMC, or regulatory environment.
    • Familiarity with commercial mortgage lending operations and bank credit policies.
    • Experience with appraisal management software or web-based review platforms.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

  • Complete all tasks within established deadlines, maintaining a strong on-time delivery rate.
  • Deliver work product that meets defined quality thresholds, as assessed through pre-delivery quality checks conducted by the Review Manager.
  • Maintain clear, professional, and timely written communication with appraisers, valuation professionals, clients, and internal team members.
  • Actively participate in team meetings and continuous improvement initiatives.

PERFORMANCE METRICS

  • Production Units — tracked via Appraisal Management System (AMS)
  • On-Time Delivery Rate — tracked via AMS
  • Quality Rating — assessed through pre-delivery review by Review Manager
  • Team Participation — engagement in weekly staff calls and professional development activities

WHAT WE OFFER:3 weeks of PTO, 13 company paid holidays, paid parental leave, and a flexible work environment. Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, and 401K plans begin the first of the month after 30 days of employment.

OUR PURPOSEis to provide opportunities that help people thrive using their God-given abilities.

OUR CORE VALUES:

  • Be a Self-Starter.Continuously seek ways to improve yourself and the business, take responsibility, and act with urgency to solve problems.
  • Be a Team Player.Prioritize team success over individual achievements, support your colleagues, and contribute to creating high-performing teams.
  • Be a Patriot. Focus on the greater good of the organization, be honest about what’s working, and passionately work towards making the company better.
  • Do it Right.Uphold high standards and integrity, even when no one is watching, and always aim to do the right thing.
  • Be Humble. Lead by serving others, value diverse perspectives, and remain open to new ideas and feedback.

WHAT WE DO:

As the largest commercial real estate services marketplace in the nation, MountainSeed MarketPlaceoffers a comprehensive range of appraisal management, review services, and more. title: Copy Writer & Editor (Contractor)
description:

The copy writer and editor role is essential for supporting and elevating communications while enhancing the effectiveness of ASCP BOC operations and assuring positive outcomes for all constituents, both internal and external.

  • ASCP BOC branding and visual identity standards

  • Support continuous quality improvement by recommending enhancements to communication processes, standards, templates, and governance practices that strengthen the quality and consistency of ASCP BOC communications.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
You work on the power beneath the digital world: streaming services, banking apps and AI services all run on it. No homes, no offices, critical technology where every second counts.

Right to work: You must already be allowed to work in the Netherlands. We do not sponsor visas or work permits.

UPS systems, battery banks and backup power: the installations that keep servers up, even when the grid drops out. You replace battery modules, measure voltage and conductance, pull and label cables and record what you did, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. One week you are in Amsterdam, the next in Frankfurt or Brussels, at sites almost no one enters. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself, alongside an experienced engineer. Physical, technical and precise, because a mistake is not an option here.

The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 40 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Wateringen.

In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.

What you bring

  • Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
  • MBO 3 Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of UPS and backup power systems, extensive experience with them is a welcome plus
  • NEN 3140 VP and VCA VOL, or the willingness to obtain them
  • Driver's license B
  • You can work independently
  • English at working level is a plus
  • Willing to work abroad (regularly Benelux, occasionally further)

What we offer

  • Manufacturer training on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
  • NEN 3140 and VCA certification if you don't have them yet
  • The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
  • LOTO and ESD training
  • International work in Europe's most secure data centers
  • Metal & Engineering CAO with travel allowance, overtime pay and ADV days
  • A team of 20, no meeting culture, things get done

“Last month I was in Frankfurt. The week before, two days in Belgium. You never know exactly where you'll be next week, but you do know it won't be a boring job.” · Data Center Engineer · 2 years at First Case

How to apply

Low-threshold and honest. No mailbox full of forms. Applying takes a few minutes and a CV is optional. We get back to you quickly.

The Lead, Ecommerce Program Management roles serves as a critical connection point between Global Ecommerce strategy, digital teams, and regional execution. This role is responsible for proactively translating global initiatives into actionable regional plans, coordinating cross-functional execution, and ensuring projects are delivered effectively while balancing regional priorities, capacity, and business needs.

Acting as a primary point of contact for Global Ecommerce initiatives requiring regional support, this individual will manage the intake, assessment, prioritization, communication, and execution of projects across the ecommerce organization. You will work closely with Global and regional stakeholders to clarify objectives, define requirements, identify dependencies, establish timelines, and drive initiatives through completion.

This is a highly cross-functional and hands-on role requiring strong business judgment, ecommerce knowledge, stakeholder management, and the ability to move seamlessly between strategic conversations and detailed execution. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating with ambiguity, creating structure where it does not exist, and influencing stakeholders across teams.

  • Serve as a primary regional partner and point of contact for Global Ecommerce initiatives requiring North American support or execution.
  • Translate Global Ecommerce strategies and initiatives into clear regional deliverables, timelines, and execution plans.
  • Establish and manage a centralized intake, assessment, and prioritization process for Global Ecommerce requests, creating visibility into incoming demand, business value, timing, and regional resource requirements.
  • Evaluate incoming initiatives based on strategic importance, business value, customer impact, level of effort, timing, dependencies, and available capacity.
  • Own and manage a portfolio of cross-functional ecommerce initiatives from initial planning and requirements through execution, launch, and post-launch measurement.
  • Partner with Global stakeholders to ensure regional business requirements, customer needs, operational considerations, and dependencies are represented during project planning and execution.
  • Develop clear project plans, milestones, ownership, success measures, and accountability across participating teams.
  • Directly own and execute project deliverables where appropriate, operating as a hands-on leader and also functional teams for execution.
  • Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Site Merchandising, Marketing, Analytics, Customer Experience, Operations, Finance, IT, and other relevant business functions.
  • Proactively identify project risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and blockers and drive the decisions necessary to maintain momentum.
  • Facilitate prioritization and tradeoff discussions when project demand exceeds available regional resources or conflicts with existing business priorities.
  • Maintain a consolidated view of Global initiatives impacting the regional ecommerce organization, including project status, milestones, capacity requirements, risks, and upcoming deliverables.
  • Provide clear and consistent project communication and reporting to working teams, Global partners, regional leadership, and senior stakeholders.
  • Develop business requirements, business cases, presentations, project documentation, status reporting, and executive updates as needed to support decision-making and execution.
  • Support testing, launch readiness, implementation, and operational handoff of new ecommerce capabilities and experiences.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, simplify, or standardize processes and ways of working between Global and regional Ecommerce organizations.
  • Build strong relationships across Global and regional teams, influencing stakeholders and driving alignment without direct reporting authority.
  • Advocate for regional customer and business needs while supporting broader Global Ecommerce strategies, creating clarity and facilitating decisions when Global and regional priorities or requirements differ.

YOUR TALENT


  • 8+ years of experience in ecommerce, digital product, program management, ecommerce operations, digital strategy, or a related field, preferably within retail or a consumer-facing business.

  • Strong program and project management capabilities, including managing multiple concurrent initiatives, dependencies, risks, resources, and competing priorities.

  • Strong business judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to create structure and clarity in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Highly action-oriented and comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on execution to drive initiatives through completion.

title: Maintenance Specialist at Edgewater Marina- $16/hr
description:
Compensation Amount:

16.00 USD Hourly

Job Summary:

The Boat Maintenance Mechanic is responsible for assisting with all marina services offered, quality control, maintains a clean and safe dock area, Maintains bathrooms and boat launching equipment, and secures guests’ boats.

Job Description:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Maintain Marina/Boat maintenance to include:
    • Motors:
      • Change engine oil and oil filters (every 100 hours, monthly)
      • Change external fuel filters (100hrs)
      • Change internal fuel filters (300hrs)
      • Change spark plugs (300hrs)
      • Change lower unit oil (200hrs)
      • Inspect propellers, lower units, and hubs (100hrs) and repair/replace as needed
      • Inspect powerhead for corrosion. Remove and coat with inhibitor
      • Buff and wax engine cowlings
      • Fill grease points
      • Knowledge of engine cooling systems and ability to replace impellers or water pump assemblies
      • Flush motors at the end of each day.
      • Ability to troubleshoot and repair/service tilt and trim systems
    • Steering:
      • Top off steering fluid
      • Inspect system for leaks, tighten loose fittings
      • Knowledge of cable, hydraulic, and Teleflex steering systems
    • Electrical:
      • Examine battery connections and clean corrosion
      • Test batteries and engine stators
      • Be able to troubleshoot and repair navigation, VHF, water pressure, sound, and light systems
      • Knowledge of marine water heater and air conditioning systems
    • Boats:
      • Inspect and repair gel coat chips and scratches
      • Pump out boats
      • Inspect and touch up deck paint
      • Repair rub rails
      • Remove surface rust from cleats, fasteners, etc. and protect.
      • Apply sun protectant to canvas tops and side curtains
      • Inspect and repair/replace Coast Guard Safety equipment (fire extinguishers, life jackets, VHF radio, anchors/tackle, EPIRB, flares, etc.)
      • Pump out waste tanks and fill water tanks with fresh water. Know how to properly sanitize each tank.
      • Knowledge of marine toilets and how to repair
      • Knowledge of marine propane gas systems
      • Knowledge of boat haul-outs and gear to inspect during this time
      • Knowledge of appropriate boat bottom paints and how to properly prepare and apply
    • Dock:
      • Be familiar with dock pump out systems and lift stations and be able to repair.
      • Be familiar with dockside fueling systems and tank monitors and know basic troubleshooting
      • Know how to properly secure boats to the dock and ensure that dock and boat hardware remains adequate for this.
      • Knowledge of proper boat fueling and fuel spill laws/procedures
  • Provide excellent customer service to guests, while directing customer issues to supervisor or unit manager.
  • Responsible for maintaining grounds keeping equipment and company vehicles.
  • Other Duties as assigned.

SKILL AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS INCLUDE

  • Partial High School education; High School Diploma/G.E.D. equivalent preferred.
  • Strong customer service abilities; actively looks for ways to assist customers and coworkers.
  • Ability to recognize when a problem has occurred and communicate it to management.
  • Ability to swim.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification.
  • Candidate should have their own tools necessary to carry out these tasks
  • Candidate should have adequate computer skills to create spreadsheets, access email, and use engine diagnostic software. Will be responsible for creating and maintaining a boat maintenance schedule and checklists for all boats. Good organization.
  • Candidate must be willing to travel to other units if need be.
  • Candidates must be personable and willing to work with the US Coast Guard during biannual haul-out inspection. Must comply with all Coast Guard regulations and inspector recommendations.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly frequent movements from place to place within the unit. Bend, lift, carry, reach/extend arms and hands above shoulder height frequently, or otherwise move in a constantly changing environment.
  • Lifting, carrying, and pushing up to 25 lbs. regularly, 30-35 lbs. frequently, and up to 50 lbs. occasionally.
  • Ability to stand for the entire work day.
  • Climbing steps regularly.
  • Working in wet and slippery conditions. Frequently working in an outdoor, hot, and damp environment.
  • Frequently immerses hands in water.
  • Withstanding temperature extremes in outdoor environments and inclement weather.
  • Reading and writing work-related documents in English.
  • Speech recognition and clarity, including the ability to understand the speech of customers and co-workers and the ability to speak clearly so that you can be understood by customers and co-workers in English.
  • Physical presence at the job site is essential to perform job duties.

EQUIPMENT USED

  • All dock equipment and materials (gas pump, boats, ropes, anchors, among others)

Founded in 1917, Guest Services has worked tirelessly to earn the reputation as the premier hospitality management company and National Park Service concessionaire in the United States. Guest Services takes great care and pride in providing best-in-class services across a wide variety of client sites including luxury communities, hotels, resorts, government and business dining facilities, full-service restaurants, state and national parks, outdoor recreation, boathouses, marinas, museums, conference centers, senior living communities, health care systems, school and university dining facilities, and specialty retail stores.

title: Verkoopmedewerker student - Diest (Zaterdag 7.5 uur)
description:
WAT JE GAAT DOEN
Als verkoopmedewerker bij H&M speel je een centrale rol in het creëren van een unieke klantervaring.
De wisselwerking van jouw acties en onze waarden draagt bij aan jouw eigen succes en dat van H&M.

Jij:

  • deelt jouw kennis over mode en producten om onze klanten te ondersteunen tijdens hun winkelervaring.
  • werkt samen met je team om eersteklas service te bieden.
  • zorgt ervoor dat de winkelvloer en het magazijn goed gevuld en georganiseerd zijn.
  • kunt helemaal jezelf zijn en vertegenwoordigt de H&M Group op een positieve manier.

Wil je meer weten over de functie van Sales Advisor? Luister naar onze Jobcast-aflevering en kom meer te weten over de functie uit eerste hand - rechtstreeks van ons team: Sales Advisor
Zodra je op de link klikt, verlaat je onze site en word je doorgestuurd naar Spotify. Het privacybeleid van Spotify AB vind je hier: Privacybeleid - Spotify.

MET WIE JE GAAT SAMENWERKEN

Onze winkels vormen het hart van H&M – daar waar klanten het merk van dichtbij beleven. Elk teamlid draagt bij aan een inspirerende en gastvrije sfeer. Je werkt nauw samen met je team om onze klanten te helpen zich zelfverzekerd te voelen en zichzelf te uiten met de nieuwste trends en tijdloze stijlen.

WIE JIJ BENT
We zoeken talenten met ...

  • een passie voor mode en de ambitie om onze klanten een uitzonderlijke winkelervaring te bieden.

En talenten die...

  • opbloeien in een dynamische, teamgerichte omgeving.
  • communicatief, creatief en nieuwsgierig zijn, graag werken met winkeltechnologie en bereid zijn om zich voortdurend te ontwikkelen.
  • flexibel en oplossingsgericht zijn.

WIE WIJ ZIJN
De H&M Group is een wereldwijd bedrijf met sterke modemerken en innovatieve businesslijnen. Wij geloven dat excellent design, betaalbare prijzen en duurzame oplossingen hand in hand kunnen gaan. Onze klanten staan centraal in alles wat we doen. Onze bedrijfscultuur wordt gevormd door duizenden gepassioneerde en getalenteerde teamleden. Samen gebruiken we onze schaal en kennis om de mode-industrie te leiden richting een inclusievere en duurzamere toekomst.

WAAROM JE HIER GRAAG WILT WERKEN
We zijn trots op ons levendige en open karakter. Onze teams profiteren van aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en diverse ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden wereldwijd.

  • We waarderen verschillende achtergronden, inclusief maar niet beperkt tot ras, etniciteit, geslacht, leeftijd, religie, seksuele geaardheid en handicap
  • We zijn er trots op dat we een waardengedreven organisatie zijn, geleid door onze 7 unieke waarden die al meer dan 75 jaar deel uitmaken van ons succesverhaal
  • Je hebt toegang tot onze Colleague Resource Groups (CRG's) voor het vinden van gemeenschaps- en netwerkmogelijkheden onder collega's
  • We zijn een inclusief bedrijf waar je wordt aangemoedigd om jezelf te zijn op het werk
  • Je hebt toegang tot een grote wereldwijde talentengemeenschap, waar carrièregroei en ambities geen grenzen kennen
  • Wij geloven in het ondersteunen van je algehele welzijn en bieden uitgebreide secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een ziektekostenverzekering, wellness- en gezinsondersteuningsprogramma's, een pensioenregeling die door het bedrijf wordt ondersteund, betaalde verlofprogramma's en betaald verlof, waaronder een gemeenschapsdag om je in te zetten voor de lokale gemeenschap
  • Je kunt je persoonlijke stijl uitdragen met onze personeelskorting bij H&M & al onze brands binnen H&M Group wereldwijd.

KOM ERBIJ
Onze kracht en uniciteit zitten in veel dingen – in onze inclusieve cultuur, onze sterke waarden en onze ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Maar bovenal zijn het onze teams die ons maken tot wat we zijn.

*Assessment voor functies in winkels: Voor sommige functies in onze winkels maken we gebruik van een online assessment als onderdeel van een competentiegericht selectieproces. Je vult dit assessment in als onderdeel van je sollicitatie. Je antwoorden worden getoetst aan vooraf vastgestelde criteria van de H&M Group.
** Meer informatie over de verwerking van je persoonlijke gegevens vindt je in onze mededeling over gegevensbescherming.

title: Sundhedsprofessionel leder til Borgernær Sundhed SUH
description:
Er du en leder, der trives i en hverdag, hvor rammerne ikke er færdigdefinerede? Så er det dig, vi søger

Vi søger en leder til vores nyetablerede afsnit for Borgernær Sundhed Sjællands Universitetshospital (SUH) Køge og Nykøbing F, dækkende for hele optageområdet i Sundhedsråd Østsjælland og Øerne.

Du vil organisatorisk indgå i en afsnitsledelse sammen med oversygeplejerske. Sammen skal I skabe et ledelsesteam med flere perspektiver på arbejdsopgaverne, og samarbejde tæt om udvikling, drift og personaleledelse på tværs af afsnittet. Derudover vil du organisatorisk indgå i et lederteam med to øvrige afsnitsledelser og have et tæt samarbejde med afdelingsledelsen.

Som sundhedsfaglig leder for fremtidens myndighedsområde får du en central rolle i at omsætte Sundhedsreformen til konkret praksis og udvikle myndighedsområdet på tværs af sektorer. Du bliver en nøgleperson i både etablering, drift og videreudvikling af Sundheds- og omsorgspladserne (SOP) – med afsæt i gældende kvalitetsstandard og med fokus på høj faglighed, Patientsikkerhed og borgernær værdi.

Med sundhedsreformen flytter ansvaret for myndighedsområdet og akutsygeplejen til den nyetablerede geriatriske afdeling SUH Køge og Nykøbing F.

Det stiller nye krav til ledelse, koordinering og samarbejde på tværs af sektorer. Derfor søger vi en sundhedsfaglig leder med ansvar for det samlede myndighedsområde i vores sundhedsrådsområde, som dækker over kommunerne: Roskilde, Solrød, Greve, Køge, Stevns, Faxe, Vordingborg, Guldborgsund og Lolland.

Med reference til afdelingsledelsen, får du en afgørende rolle i transformationen og skal sikre, at borgerne oplever en samlet, tilgængelig og højt kvalificeret indsats, der skal styrke det nære og sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

• lede og udvikle det borgernære sundhedstilbud, på tværs af hospital og kommuner

• sikre høj faglig kvalitet og ensartede standarder i hele optageområdet

• opbygge stærke samarbejdsrelationer mellem hospital, kommuner, almen praksis og øvrige aktører

• drive implementeringen af nye arbejdsgange og organisering som følge af strukturreformen, herunder kompetenceløft af medarbejdere, så kompetencerne matcher den fremtidige opgave

• bidrage til at gøre hospitalet mere udadvendt

• bidrage til strategisk udvikling af det borgernære område

• understøtte en kultur præget af omsorg, omhu, innovation, læring og høj medarbejdertrivsel

Er du en erfaren leder med lyst til at sætte retning, skabe struktur og videreudvikle fagligheden i en afdeling i forandring?

Vi søger en erfaren og visionær leder, der kan navigere i en kompleks organisation og skabe resultater gennem samarbejde. Du skal kunne se dig selv i SUH's værdier: Ordentlighed, følgeskab, fællesskab og nytænkning.

Som sundhedsfagligleder vil du få en fremtrædende rolle i omstruktureringen og organiseringen af de nye opgaver, der kommer i forbindelse med regionsfusion og sundhedsreform

Vi søger en kandidat med følgende profil:

• er sundhedsfagligt uddannet med solid ledelseserfaring – gerne på mellemlederniveau

• har relevant lederuddannelse, fx diplom eller master i ledelse eller tilsvarende

• har indgående kendskab til både hospitalsvæsenet og det kommunale sundhedsområde, herunder sundhedsaftaler og tværsektorielt samarbejde

• har indsigt i de juridiske aspekter af arbejdet i en myndighedsafdeling

• du kan gå ind i i dilemma- og konfliktfyldte situationer med en positiv tilgang og med henblik på at finde den mest optimale løsning for patienten/borgeren

• evner at skabe psykologisk tryghed, så dine medarbejdere tør tale om, når det er svært med samarbejdet med borgere, pårørende eller samarbejdspartnere

• har erfaring med forandringsledelse og implementering af nye organisatoriske løsninger og samarbejdsformer

• arbejder strategisk og nytænkende og formår at omsætte visioner til konkret praksis

• er tydelig, inddragende og handlekraftig i din ledelsesstil

• har stærke relationelle kompetencer og kan skabe tillid på tværs af sektorer

• har evnen til at samle flere matrikler om en fælles kultur

Vi tilbyder:

• en nyoprettet lederstilling med stort ledelsesrum

• en unik mulighed for at præge fremtidens indsatser i det nære

• en central lederrolle i en af sundhedsvæsenets mest markante strukturændringer

• et stærkt fagligt miljø med engagerede medarbejdere og ledelseskolleger

• Et rart arbejdsmiljø med høj trivsel og gennemsigtighed

• En travl hverdag, hvor den gode tone og den gode stemning sættes højt

• En afdeling der ikke går på kompromis med oplæring og uddannelse

• gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

• en hverdag præget af høj kompleksitet, tempo og stor indflydelse

Om afdelingen

Stillingen er forankret i Geriatrisk afdeling på SUH, som vil bestå af et afsnit dedikeret til Borgernær Sundhed og 2 geriatriske sengeafsnit med tilhørende ambulante funktioner. Afsnit for Borgernær Sundhed etableres for at understøtte Sundhedsreformens ambition om at skabe et mere nært, sammenhængende og lige sundhedsvæsen.

Ansvaret for akutsygeplejen, myndighedsområdet på SOP og implementeringen af speciallægedækning af sundheds- og omsorgspladser, vil ligge her.

I din ansøgning skal du beskrive, hvordan du vil bidrage til at udvikle myndighedsområdet på tværs af hospital og kommuner

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Chefsygeplejerske Malene Nielsen, på mail mnels@regionsjaelland.dk eller telefon: 4732 2402Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med ansættelse på Sjællands Universitets Hospital. Løn- og ansættelsesforhold følger gældende overenskomst for ”Sundhedskartellet ledere”.




Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Lead Full Stack Software Developer
description:
Lead Full Stack Software Developer


Scotland based | Hybrid


C£100k + Benefits


c5yrs hands on JavaScript & TypeScript full stack, this is non-negotiable


About the Company


Our client is a fast-growing, UK-based SaaS company whose products sit at the heart of many B2B sales and marketing teams. They're scaling quickly, shipping daily, and looking for two technical leads who wants real ownership over how their customer-facing products are built.


The Opportunity


This is a technical leadership role for someone who wants to shape a product from first design conversation through to code running in production while staying close to the build the whole way. You'll move fluidly between hands-on delivery and architectural decision-making, working across a modern stack and deploying multiple times a day. You will be challenged to experiment and champion AI, where currently almost 80% of code is agent generated.If you want influence over how things are built, not just what gets built, this is worth a conversation.


Please note: Candidates must have the right to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.


What You\u2019ll Be Doing



  • Partner with stakeholders on solution design, scoping and system architecture from the earliest conversations.

  • De-risk uncertain areas of a design through spikes and proof-of-concepts before committing the team to a direction.

  • Experimenting responsibly with AI, choosing your tooling and how it is utilised.

  • Work with initiative managers to break ambitious ideas into deliverable epics and stories.

  • Turn user stories into production code as a high-performing individual contributor and as lead developer and embedded architect within a small squad.

  • Champion the quality, maintainability and operability of everything you and the team (fellow engineers and agentic agents) ship.

  • Stay close to the product in production, supporting it and resolving issues as they arise.

  • Shape ongoing design, architecture and implementation decisions as the platform evolves.


What We\u2019re Looking For



  • 10+ years\' full stack software development experience, with genuine technical leadership under your belt.

  • 5+ years\' fluency in JavaScript and TypeScript full stack, this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong grasp of system design and domain modelling, with a commercial mindset behind every technical decision.

  • A track record of clean code, SOLID principles and thoughtful design patterns.

  • Broad full stack experience, ideally gained building large-scale SaaS platforms.

  • Comfortable operating in a mature CI/CD environment, deploying continuously under a DevSecOps approach.

  • A forward-thinking demonstrable approach to using AI to accelerate high-quality software delivery.

  • An aptitude for problem-solving, with the appetite to pick up new tools and techniques fast.

  • Excellent interpersonal & collaboration skills, with confidence working directly with customers.

  • Solid experience with automated testing and quality assurance practices.

  • An understanding of building systems that hold up and perform at scale.

  • A genuine enthusiasm for building secure systems and championing security best practice.

  • A technical or computer science degree, or equivalent hands\u2019on professional experience.


Useful:



  • Exposure to NodeJS microservices, Vue, Redis, SQL Server or Snowflake.

  • Experience deploying and operating services in AWS.

  • A track record of driving high standards and pushing a team towards ever-higher levels of efficiency.


Why This Role?



  • Real influence as you will be shaping products from the first design conversation, not just executing someone else’s spec.

  • A modern, fast-moving stack with daily production deployments and a DevSecOps culture that actually works.

  • A company culture built around a \"One Team\" and growth mindset, not just words on a wall.

  • Volunteer days, fundraisers and charity initiatives — a business that gives back.

  • Hybrid working, based in Scotland.


Package



  • Salary: £90-£100k, dependent on experience

  • Location: Scotland based, but hybrid working

title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs Strategy (Spain)
description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.


Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.


Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!


The Role


Reporting to the Country Medical Director of Spain/Portugal, the Associate Director, Medical Affairs Strategy will be a key scientific and strategic leader responsible for developing and delivering Medical Affairs strategies and tactical plans for assigned oncology assets.


The role will have a particular focus on launch readiness, evidence generation and lifecycle management. Strong strategic thinking skills will be essential to anticipate challenges and opportunities, establish clear medical priorities and shape long-term asset strategy. Working across European and global teams, the Associate Director will translate scientific data, stakeholder insights, patient needs and business priorities into clear medical strategies and impactful activities.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver Medical Affairs strategic and tactical plans, in collaboration with the Country Medical Director and cross-functional team
  • Apply strategic thinking to identify emerging opportunities, anticipate evidence gaps and prioritize activities across launch readiness and lifecycle management
  • Acts as subject matter expert in local/regional/global cross-functional teams, clinical development teams, advisory boards and congresses
  • Supports pre/peri/post-launch medical activities for assigned asset(s)
  • Partners with MSL team for the execution of local Medical Affairs strategies
  • Works with Clinical Development, Regulatory, Commercial, and Market Access to shape product strategy and launch/lifecycle plans
  • Oversee local data generation strategy
  • Review materials for alignment with global and local strategy
  • Engages Thought Leaders and patient advocacy groups for insight-gathering

Requirements


  • Advanced degree (PharmD, PhD, or MD); oncology experience preferred
  • 5+ years in medical affairs, clinical development, or related roles
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, anticipate future needs and translate insights into actionable Medical Affairs strategies
  • Strong grasp of data interpretation
  • Local healthcare system/payer landscape familiarity
  • Ability to travel internationally as required

Desirable


  • Nominated signatory status or experience acting as a final medical signatory
  • Registered physician, preferably with the GMC, or pharmacist registered with the General Pharmaceutical Council
  • Experience contributing to early access to medicines, either in-house or through the Early Access to Medicines Scheme
  • Extensive oncology experience, with solid tumour experience preferred
  • Good understanding of the ABPI Code of Practice

Location: Madrid, Spain — hybrid, 20–30% remote flexibility


The proposed gross annual base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

EUR88.536,00---132.804,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Pension
  • Health insurance and wellness benefits
  • Paid time off
  • Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.



About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.


Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

title: Analytics Engineer, Integrity
description:
WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week.

_________________

Position Summary

The NBA’s Basketball Strategy & Growth department is seeking an analytics engineer to own the ingestion and transformation of the data that powers the Integrity Team’s work on the league’s gaming policy. The role is responsible for turning disparate and inconsistent external feeds — data from betting partners and operators, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and third-party vendors — into well-modeled, tested, and documented datasets, and for integrating those feeds with internal league basketball data so that betting activity can be evaluated in the context of what happened on the court.

These models are the foundation for downstream data science and machine learning work: the anomaly detection, alerting, and AI-driven software the Integrity Team uses to surface conduct that may violate the gaming policy. The analytics engineer joins a team of data scientists, engineers and basketball experts and collaborates closely with the Legal department on any investigation relating to a potential violation of the gaming policy. The work is confidential, frequently time-sensitive, and expected to hold up to legal scrutiny — lineage, definitions, and data quality controls matter as much as speed.

Major Responsibilities

  • Own the ingestion of data from disparate betting partners, operators, and data vendors — each with its own schema, granularity, delivery cadence, and idiosyncrasies — and normalize them into a consistent, conformed model of markets, wagers, prices, and accounts.
  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for OSINT and other unstructured or semi-structured sources, including the entity resolution work required to link external identities to known accounts and subjects.
  • Integrate betting and OSINT data with internal league basketball data — schedule, play-by-play, box score, tracking, officiating, and player availability data — so that activity can be analyzed in game context.
  • Develop production-ready analytical data models in dbt on Snowflake, applying dimensional modeling and analytics engineering best practices, including layered staging and mart designs, incremental models, and consistent naming conventions.
  • Create curated, reusable pipelines and feature-ready datasets that support downstream data science and machine learning work, including model development, backtesting, and production inference.
  • Implement automated data quality testing, freshness and volume monitoring, and reconciliation checks on incoming feeds so that vendor changes, outages, or silent data loss are detected before they affect investigative output.
  • Build and manage orchestration and scheduling for pipelines, including dependency management, retries, alerting, and service levels appropriate to time-sensitive feeds.
  • Develop and maintain a semantic layer with standardized business definitions and metrics so that analysts, data scientists, and the Legal department work from a single version of the truth.
  • Document models, sources, lineage, and assumptions to support knowledge transfer, auditability, and the evidentiary needs of investigations.
  • Onboard new betting partners and data providers — evaluating feed quality, defining requirements and specifications with providers, and absorbing vendor schema changes without breaking downstream consumers.
  • Partner with data scientists to translate analytical and modeling requirements into scalable data models, and with the full stack engineer to expose those datasets to the platform’s backend jobs and UI.
  • Apply appropriate access controls, data classification, and retention practices to sensitive betting, personal, and investigative data.

Required Skills/Knowledge

  • Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience developing complex analytical data models.
  • Production experience with analytics engineering frameworks such as dbt, including testing, documentation, macros, and managing a large model DAG.
  • Production experience with Snowflake, including performance and cost management such as warehouse sizing, clustering, and query tuning.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and analytics engineering best practices.
  • Understanding of sports betting markets — odds, line movement, limits, player props, and market maker behavior — and of basketball data such as play-by-play, box score, and tracking data.
  • Proficiency in Python for ingestion, API integration, and data processing.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple external partners or vendors, including messy, high-volume, semi-structured, and unstructured sources.
  • Experience building and operating orchestrated data pipelines, including scheduling, dependency management, retries, and monitoring.
  • Experience developing semantic layers, standardized business definitions, and reusable analytical datasets.
  • Experience implementing automated data quality testing, monitoring, and documentation to support trusted analytical data assets.
  • Experience building pipelines that serve downstream data science and machine learning consumers.
  • Familiarity with Git-based development workflows (GitHub or Azure DevOps), code review, and CI practices.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business and investigative requirements into scalable analytical solutions for both technical and non-technical audiences, including attorneys and investigators.
  • Sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential and legally sensitive information.
  • Confident individual, able to work in a fast-paced environment and manage short-term deliverables along with long-term projects.
  • Excels when working as part of a team, collaborating effectively both within BSG Integrity and cross-functionally.

Preferred Skills/Knowledge

  • Experience with Databricks, including Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and/or ML lifecycle tooling such as MLflow.
  • Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or a comparable orchestration platform.
  • Experience with entity resolution, identity matching, or record linkage.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices such as feature pipelines, model registries, training/retraining workflows, and model monitoring.
  • Prior work on integrity, surveillance, fraud, AML, or trust and safety data is a plus.
  • Experience in sports, gaming, or another regulated or compliance-driven environment is a plus.

Experience/Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required in a technical or quantitative field; master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or developing analytical data models on cloud-based data platforms.

$130,000-$150,000

title: Project Lead Practitioner
description:
Project Lead Practitioner

What we believe

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.

Our role

We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.

Our approach

The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.

What we value

Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.

If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.

About the role

  • Lead client engagements that help private equity investors and technology businesses understand, improve and create value from technology.
  • Bring the judgement and communication skills of a trusted consultant: frame the question, lead senior client conversations, synthesise evidence and tell a clear, decision-useful story.
  • Apply genuine technology depth to assess strategy, product and engineering capability, architecture, delivery performance, data, cyber risk, scalability, technical debt and operating model.
  • Translate technical findings into commercial implications for growth, customer outcomes, margin, investment risk, timing, capital requirements and value creation.
  • Develop a recognised functional specialism and use it to bring differentiated insight to clients. Specialisms may include product and engineering, software architecture and cloud platforms, data and AI, cybersecurity, software delivery or technology operating model.
  • Work collaboratively with investment teams, management teams and Crosslake colleagues across technical, commercial, operational and financial workstreams.

Role responsibilities

  • Independently lead complex client engagements from scoping through to high-quality delivery, balancing client service, project management, team leadership and commercial awareness.
  • Build credibility quickly with senior investors, boards and management teams through sound judgement, clear communication and an ability to make complex issues accessible.
  • Deliver concise reports, executive presentations and workshops that connect technology findings to the decisions clients need to make.
  • Lead technical due diligence work that identifies material risks and opportunities, then help clients prioritise practical post-deal value-creation actions.
  • Contribute to broader commercial diligence, investment thesis and value-creation engagements where technology is central to the business case.
  • Develop and apply a functional specialism while maintaining enough breadth to lead integrated client discussions and direct multidisciplinary teams.
  • Support the growth of Crosslake through excellent client relationships, repeat work, thoughtful proposition development and mentoring of colleagues.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in technology consulting, technology due diligence, technology strategy, digital transformation or technology leadership.
  • A track record of leading client-facing workstreams or engagements, including managing senior stakeholders and producing high-quality, decision-ready outputs.
  • Strong technology fundamentals and demonstrable depth in at least one functional specialism, such as product and engineering, architecture and cloud, data and AI, cybersecurity, delivery or technology operating model.
  • An experience spike in a business domain – e.g. Insurance, capital markets, healthcare, logistics and supply chain,
  • The ability to move confidently between technical detail and business discussion, identifying the issues that genuinely matter to a client or investment case.
  • Experience with private equity, transaction advisory, corporate development or high-growth technology businesses is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent structured thinking, written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a compelling, clear narrative.
  • A collaborative and action-oriented style, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the curiosity to learn beyond an initial area of expertise.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and appetite to build client relationships, lead teams and grow into broader commercial and technology value-creation work.

title: Operational Scheduler

We are looking for a highly motivated Operational Scheduler to support manufacturing operations through effective production planning, scheduling, resource coordination, and operational execution.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that production activities are optimally scheduled, resources are efficiently utilized, and manufacturing commitments are delivered safely, compliantly, and on time. Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Coordinate production activities to ensure optimal utilization of personnel, equipment, and materials.
  • Monitor schedule adherence and proactively manage deviations and operational disruptions.
  • Support launch activities and production campaigns to ensure timely execution.

Operational Coordination

  • Act as the main point of coordination between Production, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Quality, and Engineering functions.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent til E-teamet – skab nærvær gennem skærmen
description:
Har du lyst til at bruge din SSA-faglighed på en ny måde – og være med til at udvikle fremtidens hjemmepleje?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores E-team i Mariagerfjord Kommune.

I E-teamet yder vi digital omsorg til borgere i eget hjem gennem skærmbesøg. Her bruger du din faglighed til at skabe tryghed, struktur og nærvær og understøtte borgerens selvstændighed og mulighed for at mestre sin egen hverdag.

Det får du hos os

Vi tilbyder en aftenvagtstilling på 37 timer ugentligt – eller efter aftale med tiltrædelse 1. december 2026 eller efter aftale. Arbejdstiden er kl. 15.00–23.00, og der arbejdes hver 2. weekend.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab med sparring og udvikling og får grundig introduktion og oplæring i arbejdet i E-teamet. Teamet er fysisk placeret på Tempovej i Hadsund.

Din rolle i E-teamet

Skærmbesøg er mere end et opkald. Du skal kunne skabe tillid og nærvær gennem skærmen og samtidig bruge din faglighed til at observere, spørge ind og vurdere borgerens behov og trivsel.

Du gennemfører skærmbesøg, støtter og vejleder borgeren, dokumenterer dine observationer og samarbejder med kolleger og øvrige fagpersoner, når der er behov for koordinering omkring borgeren.

E-teamet er fortsat i udvikling, og du får også mulighed for at bidrage til at afprøve og udvikle nye arbejdsformer og være nysgerrig på, hvilke borgere der kan have gavn af et tilbud fra E-teamet.

Samarbejde og fællesskab

I Ældre og Omsorg i Mariagerfjord Kommune er vi ansat til to ting: faglighed og samarbejde.

Det gælder også i E-teamet.

Selvom kontakten til borgeren foregår digitalt, står du ikke alene. Samarbejdet med kolleger, den øvrige hjemmepleje og andre fagpersoner er afgørende for, at borgeren oplever sammenhæng og får den rette hjælp på det rette tidspunkt.

Du skal derfor både trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og have lyst til at være en aktiv del af et fagligt fællesskab.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent, og som:

  • har en sikker faglighed og tager ansvar for dine faglige vurderinger
  • kan skabe tillid, tryghed og nærvær gennem digital kontakt
  • har gode kommunikative evner og blik for det enkelte menneske
  • er nysgerrig på teknologi og nye arbejdsformer
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig vægter samarbejde højt

Du behøver ikke være ekspert i teknologi. Det vigtigste er, at du har mod på at lære. Erfaring fra hjemmeplejen er en fordel.

Vil du være med?

Så send os din ansøgning og fortæl, hvem du er, og hvad der motiverer dig ved at arbejde med digital omsorg og skærmbesøg. Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

Praktisk info

Ansættelsen sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Kørekort er en forudsætning for stillingen.

Der indhentes straffe- og børneattest, og ansættelsen er betinget af, at disse kan godkendes.

For at være ansat i Mariagerfjord Kommune skal du have MitID.

Har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte hjemmeplejeleder Maja Maria Andersen på majma@mariagerfjord.dk eller telefon 20 34 57 19.

Ansøgningsfrist: 11.10.26

Om Mariagerfjord Kommune
Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen.

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge job hos os, uanset personlig baggrund.

title: Quantitative Developer - Financial Forecasting
description:
We're seeking someone to join our FP&A team as a Quantitative Developer.

Join Morgan Stanley’s Corporate FP&A team and help re-engineer how a global financial institution forecasts revenues and balance sheet. This is a high-impact opportunity for a quantitative developer, strategist, or engineering-minded modeller who wants to build scalable forecasting platforms, apply advanced analytics, and bring ML/AI-driven solutions into real business decision-making.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of Finance, Quantitative Modelling, Software Engineering, and Technology, contributing to a flagship transformation initiative that will modernize the Firm’s forecasting framework. If you enjoy solving complex problems, writing robust code, and building models that move from concept to production, this role is designed for you.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, and enhance quantitative forecasting models for revenues, balance sheet, and key financial drivers

  • Build scalable, production-ready solutions on modern platforms, contributing to architecture design and technical implementation

  • Translate complex business and financial requirements into robust modelling frameworks and technical specifications

  • Partner with Finance, Strats, and Technology teams to industrialize models and ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • Apply machine learning, AI, statistical modelling, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting accuracy and insight generation

  • Contribute to model lifecycle activities, including documentation, governance, validation, and engagement with Model Risk teams

  • Help shape the long-term evolution of forecasting infrastructure, automation, and data-driven decision-making across Corporate FP&A

What you’ll bring

  • Strong academic background in a quantitative or technical discipline such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or Quantitative Finance

  • Experience in a quant developer, strategist, modelling, analytics, or software engineering role

  • Strong programming skills, ideally in Scala, C++, Python, or similar languages

  • Engineering mindset with experience building clean, scalable, and production-quality solutions

  • Strong understanding of quantitative modelling, data structures, algorithms, or statistical methods

  • Interest in financial markets, forecasting, planning, or balance sheet modelling

  • Ability to break down complex problems and develop structured, practical solutions

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both quantitative and business stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience with forecasting models, financial planning, stress testing, or risk models

  • Exposure to ML/AI techniques, model deployment, or modern data platforms

title: 2027 Spring Intern - Pharmaceutical Technical Development - Bioassay
description:
The Position

2027 Spring Intern - Pharmaceutical Technical Development - Bioassay


Department Summary


Pharmaceutical Technical Development (PTD) develops, delivers, and supports robust, cost-effective production methods and technologies for innovative therapeutics to meet the needs of Genentech’s Research, Development, Commercial, and Product Operations groups. The group has long been recognized as a world leader in developing large-scale manufacturing processes, sophisticated analytical methods, and effective drug delivery systems.


The Bioassay department resides within PTD and is responsible for developing, characterizing, validating and implementing analytical methods for recombinant proteins and novel therapeutics, and ensuring robust assay performance and data integrity throughout the product lifecycle, from laboratory to manufacturing scale. A Bioassay team member may be responsible for assay development, commercial product support, continuous improvement activities, innovation projects, or other activities within the function.


This internship position is located in South San Francisco, on-site.


The Opportunity


As a Technical Development Intern, Laboratory focus, you will be assigned a project in the bioassay group within PTDA.


  • The candidate will work alongside scientists to design, execute, optimize and analyze biochemical/immunochemical and/or cell-based assays in support of our clinical through launch-phase biologics products.
  • The individual will be responsible for designing and executing experiments, summarizing/presenting data and participating in group meetings and/or project teams.
  • The individual will collaborate with multidisciplinary and cross functional teams to develop novel cell-based potency methods for products with complex mechanisms of action in support of process development, characterization, formulation screens, and GMP quality control of product release and stability.
  • This program provides a broad perspective and appreciation of the development of new processes, methods, and technologies at different production scales in the biotechnology industry.

Program Highlights


  • Intensive 6 months, full-time (40 hours per week) paid internship.
  • Program start dates are in January 2027 (Spring).
  • A stipend, based on location, will be provided to help alleviate costs associated with the internship.
  • Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects.
  • Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.



Who You Are (Required)


Required Education: You meet one of the following criteria:


  • Must be pursuing or have attained an Associate's Degree
  • Must be pursuing a Bachelor's degree
  • Must have attained a Bachelor's degree (recent graduates not currently enrolled in a grad program)
  • Must be pursuing a Master's degree
  • Must have attained a Master's degree
  • Must be pursuing a PhD

Required Majors: Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular and Cellular Biology, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemistry, Biophysics, or related disciplines are preferred.


Required Skills:


  • Detail-oriented, enthusiastic, and self-directed individual who is excited about tackling complex and creative scientific challenges in an industrial setting.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications


  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
  • Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.
  • Relevant work experience in research labs or the biotechnology industry is desirable but not required.
  • Prior cell culture experience is preferred but not required.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.


The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $26.00-$47.00 per hour. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position also qualifies for paid holiday time off benefits.
