ROLE AND PURPOSE

To work as part of a multi disciplinary team involved in discharging the City Council’s functions and commitments in relation to managing the Highway Network and improving local environmental quality. Investigating civil parking offences, offences relating to the highways and to tackle anti-social behaviour and to undertake enforcement action against perpetrators within parking, environmental, highways and anti-social behaviour legislation and/or other appropriate powers.


To show, at all times, a personal commitment to treating all customers and colleagues in a fair and respectful way, which gives positive regard to people’s differences and individuality (for example, their age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability or religion) and assists in ensuring equal access to services and employment opportunities for everyone.


To lead a team of Civil Enforcement Officers, assisting in note taking in meetings involving staff, undertake spot checks on staff that are deployed as directed. Take responsibility for the Civil Enforcement Officers that are deployed on street at the direction of the management team. Open or close the operation base and various Multi Story Car Parks as directed.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:
1. To undertake on a daily basis pro-active inspections/investigations in relation to offences concerning parking, environmental issues, highways and anti-social behaviour. Determine how best to deal with and proceed with investigations and appropriate enforcement action (e.g. advice, guidance, warning notices, fixed penalty notices).
2. To work effectively as an individual or as part of a team in accurately recording, collating, preparing and producing correspondence, records, files and data, including the use of a range of IT systems and applications.
3. To undertake routine patrols in order to issue parking Penalty Charge Notices , whilst accurately recording, collating, disseminating information and intelligence and the preparation of evidence to a high standard. Make decisions to determine appropriate enforcement action on the basis of evidence obtained in context with service area policies and procedures to ensure a constant high quality service and to comply with the Council’s enforcement policy.
4. The post holder will have access to information of a confidential nature which must be handled responsibly and particularly within the requirements of legislation covering Data Protection, Freedom of Information and other appropriate requirements dictated by rules governing the collection and storage of evidence for legal proceedings.
5. To maintain an up to date working knowledge of all appropriate legislation relating to civil and criminal law relating to a post of this nature, and to have a knowledge of internal policy relating to Civil Parking Enforcement, environmental crime and highway enforcement. To make decisions in relation to complaints on a daily basis on their own initiative, as to how best to deal with and proceed with investigations, and the lines of enquiry.
6. To provide advice, guidance and information, as and when required, to members of the public and business community.
7. To work, on a day to day basis, with people who can display aggressive, challenging or emotionally demanding behaviour and to deal with this calmly, rationally and assertively in line with Council policies/procedures and to establish practical solutions and negotiate where possible informal solutions to avoid the need for enforcement action
8. To undertake appropriate risk management assessments of situations to ensure that personal risk (and/or risk to others) is minimised and effectively managed.
9. To prioritise workloads and make enforcement decisions, in a climate of conflicting priorities (both professional and political) and demands, whilst meeting necessary timescales/deadlines as required by legislation. Decides on the recording, evaluation, interpretation and dissemination of information and intelligence received.
10. To liaise as required with other internal service areas, external agencies, private companies, consultants and private individuals on a regular basis to provide a constant high quality of service.
11. To be able to work anti-social hours, away from local authority premises.
12. The Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and associated legislation places responsibilities for health and safety on Hull City Council, as your employer and you as an employee of the council. In addition to the Councils overall duties, the post holder has personal responsibility for their own health & safety and that of other employees; additional and more specific responsibilities are identified in the Council’s Corporate H&S policy.
13. To open and close the Multi Story Car Parks as directed and ensure they are fit for purpose including site safety check.
14. Lead a team of Civil Enforcement Officers (CEOs), carry out regular spot checks on equipment and pocket books while deployed. Assist with note taking at various meeting involving members of their team.
15. Take responsibility for the operation as directed by management to include base radio, opening or closing the operation, emergency control and response. Appraise the management of any on street issues or problems
16. To provide the first point of response to service requests and emergency response for CEOs on street
17. A full driving license is needed to drive staff members to schools during term time for zig zag enforcements, weekends and evenings staff may be on zones that require a senior to drop them off at the location. Cone bookings throughout the city require a Senior CEO to deploy cones at the requested location from the van.
18. During emergencies or unforeseen circumstances seniors are required to attend incidents away from the city centre in the van as a first response measure. When working on the late shift, extreme weather or as requested seniors who are mobile would be required to drive the van with a small team of enforcement officers to cover a wider area of the city.

title: Global Launch Activation Lead, Director
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
Role Summary

The Global Launch Activation Lead is the global capability leader accountable for translating portfolio, brand, and launch priorities established by Marketing, Launch Excellence, and Medical partners into integrated training content, capability activation, and field-readiness plans. The role leads ICET's launch activation portfolio, aligning content development, applied learning, coaching resources, reinforcement, and performance support to prepare customer-facing colleagues to execute launch priorities with confidence and consistency.

Operating across global and regional markets, the Director establishes the integrated view of launch capability demand, identifies sequencing and capacity risks, recommends portfolio trade-offs, and governs ICET's launch content activation approach. The role applies established capability architecture and launch-readiness requirements rather than defining brand, medical, launch, or enterprise learning strategy.

The role does not own brand strategy, launch strategy, medical strategy, capability architecture, or training delivery. Those responsibilities remain with the appropriate Brand, Medical, Launch Excellence, Capability Architecture, GCET Delivery, and market teams. The Global Launch Activation Lead connects these inputs to ICET's content and capability remit, ensuring scalable, compliant, market-adaptable solutions are developed and transitioned effectively to delivery teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead ICET's global launch activation portfolio, translating business, brand, medical, and launch-readiness requirements into integrated training content and capability activation plans.
  • Establish the enterprise view of launch capability demand, identifying portfolio dependencies, capacity constraints, sequencing risks, and opportunities for reuse across therapeutic areas and markets.
  • Recommend launch activation priorities and trade-offs to ICET, GCET, and launch leadership, making decisions within the role's authority and escalating choices requiring broader enterprise alignment.
  • Serve as ICET's strategic launch activation partner to Commercial Excellence Partners, Brand Teams, Medical, Launch Excellence, Regional Teams, Capability Architecture, and GCET Delivery.
  • Govern the launch content activation approach, integrating disease-state, product, competitive, applied-skill, coaching, reinforcement, and performance-support content into a coherent field-readiness journey.
  • Apply established capability and learning architecture to launch activation, ensuring training experiences move customer-facing colleagues from awareness and knowledge to application, coaching, reinforcement, and confident execution.
  • Set requirements for modularity, reuse, localization, and AI-enabled content development, enabling launch assets to scale efficiently across markets while preserving quality, compliance, and brand fidelity.
  • Define ICET launch capability measures, including content completion and availability, training readiness, adoption, confidence, application, and reinforcement indicators.
  • Partner with Launch Excellence and business stakeholders to connect training and capability indicators with broader launch-readiness and business-outcome measures without assuming ownership of launch effectiveness.
  • Lead launch-related content governance and cross-functional issue resolution, surfacing risks, clarifying decision owners, and preventing duplication, misalignment, and downstream rework.
  • Oversee external partners supporting launch content and capability activation, establishing expectations for quality, speed, scalability, compliance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Ensure approved content and activation plans are transitioned effectively to GCET and market delivery teams, with clear requirements, timing, readiness checkpoints, and feedback loops.
  • Advise senior leaders on launch capability readiness, presenting portfolio-level insights, risks, resource implications, and recommended actions.
  • Shape and continuously improve ICET's launch activation operating model, codifying repeatable practices and lessons that strengthen execution across the global launch portfolio.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 8+ years of relevant and progressive work experience in pharmaceutical or biopharma commercial capability, learning and development, sales training, or launch excellence roles, including demonstrated cross-functional leadership across matrixed teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or leading training content, applied learning, or capability activation programs supporting a product launch, at a national or global scale.
  • Working fluency in capability and learning architecture — how content, applied learning, coaching, and reinforcement combine to build field proficiency — with experience applying an established architecture rather than designing one from scratch.
  • Proven ability to translate business, brand, and launch-readiness requirements into executable training content and activation plans, working fluently with senior stakeholders across Commercial, Medical, and Regional organizations.
  • Experience managing competing priorities across a portfolio of concurrent initiatives, with a track record of structured governance, prioritization, and decision-making under ambiguity.
  • Strong track record partnering with or overseeing external vendors and agencies delivering training content, learning, or activation solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MBA or related) preferred.
  • Direct experience within a global commercial capability, launch excellence, or content/learning center of excellence function, ideally within GCET or an equivalent enterprise capability organization.
  • Background in instructional design, learning experience design, or a related capability-building discipline.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled content generation, content-reuse platforms, or modern learning ecosystems, with experience embedding these into scaled operating models.
  • Experience designing or applying readiness and adoption measurement frameworks that link capability investment to launch performance and commercial outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of Medical, Legal, and Regulatory review requirements as they apply to commercial content and field-facing materials.
  • Experience operating across international markets and time zones, with cultural fluency in adapting global activation approach to regional execution realities.
  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work in a standard office or remote/hybrid environment, including extended periods of computer-based work, virtual meetings, and cross-time-zone collaboration.
  • Ability to synthesize complex, ambiguous, and sometimes conflicting inputs from multiple senior stakeholders into clear strategic direction under time pressure.
  • Ability to communicate and influence effectively at senior and executive levels, both in writing and in live or virtual presentation settings.

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Global role requiring flexibility to accommodate meetings and deliverables across multiple time zones, including periodic early morning or evening engagements with international markets.
  • Domestic and international travel required, estimated at approximately 15-25%, to support launch activation planning, market engagement, and cross-functional working sessions.
  • Periods of heightened intensity around major launch milestones may require adjusted availability to support time-sensitive activation decisions.

OTHER JOB DETAILS:

  • LAST DAY TO APPLY: October 2, 2026
  • WORK LOCATION ASSIGNMENT: Hybrid, 2-3 days onsite/week US Commercial Pfizer site (per Pfizer’s Log in for Your Day Policy)
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $189,200.00 to $315,400.00.* In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. title: Division Administrator - Onsite, Nashville TN
description:
Discover Vanderbilt Health: With eight hospitals and over 180 clinics, we are the region’s largest comprehensive academic health system. Vanderbilt Health has a long tradition of providing world-class care to the people of the Mid-South, living out our mission of moving medicine forward through preeminent programs in patient care, education and research. Here you’ll find a spirit of collaboration and a supportive community where your expertise is valued, your knowledge expanded and your uniqueness celebrated. We are committed to fostering an environment where talented, compassionate people are united in bringing the most advanced care to our neighbors throughout the region.

Organization:

Medicine Division Admin

Job Summary:

The Department of Medicine divisions of Diabetes, Endocrinology and Metabolism and Rheumatology and Immunology are seeking a Division Administrator to serve as a key member of the leadership team for both divisions.

This position will partner closely with the directors of both divisions and provide leadership for the fiscal, operational, and personnel functions that support their missions. The Division Administrator will be responsible for fostering an efficient and effective environment in which faculty, staff and trainees can successfully carry out their work. This role will directly oversee the administrative teams and collaborate with key stakeholders across the divisions, including faculty, staff, and Department of Medicine leadership.

About the Division of Diabetes, Endocrinology and Metabolism:
The Division of Diabetes, Endocrinology and Metabolism continues to advance Vanderbilt Health’s clinical, research, and educational missions through nationally recognized leadership, innovative patient care, and sustained growth. The division includes approximately 50 faculty members, 23 advanced practice providers, a dedicated administrative team, and a robust cohort of trainees who support its broad clinical and academic mission. The division provides highly specialized care across diabetes, obesity medicine, metabolic disorders, rare bone diseases, and endocrine conditions, while earning national and international recognition through the accomplishments of its faculty. During the 2025-2026 academic year, division leaders received prestigious awards and held prominent roles within leading professional societies, while educational initiatives expanded through new interdisciplinary training programs and strong partnerships with the VA system. Clinically, the division experienced significant growth, achieving a 7% increase in outpatient RVUs, a 10% increase in net revenue, and delivering nearly 55,000 outpatient visits across an expanding regional footprint. Supported by $11.2 million in NIH funding, the division remains a leader in endocrinology research and physician-scientist development.
About The Division of Rheumatology and Immunology:
The Division of Rheumatology and Immunology advances Vanderbilt Health’s clinical, educational, and research missions through a highly collaborative team of approximately 34 faculty members, five advanced practice providers, dedicated administrative staff, and trainees. The division provides comprehensive rheumatology care while expanding patient access to clinical trials and disease registries focused on complex autoimmune and inflammatory conditions, supporting both exceptional patient care and translational research. Education remains a core focus, with faculty actively teaching medical students, residents, graduate students, and fellows across clinical and laboratory settings. The division also maintains a robust research enterprise, with strong grant and publication productivity and the successful renewal of its NIH-funded T32 training program, which supports the development of future physician-scientists. As Vanderbilt Health continues to expand its clinical footprint, the division remains committed to increasing access to specialized rheumatology care, advancing innovative research, and training the next generation of leaders in rheumatology and immunology.

title: Production Planner
description:
Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 300 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust.


We are seeking a qualified and experienced Production Planner to join our Production & Raw Material planning team at our Bedford Park, IL Plant. As a Planner, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the timely production of orders and/or the procurement of raw materials to meet customer delivery schedules and maintain safety stock levels. Your focus will be on promoting teamwork, integrity, and upholding our core values of reliability, trust.

If you are passionate about planning and are dedicated to upholding our vision, mission, and core values, we encourage you to apply and join our team.


What’s in it For You:

  • Opportunity for a long-term career path that allows for exposure into all areas of Ecolab’s supply chain
  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology
  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world

What You Will Do:

  • Planning production orders and raw materials to support on-time delivery to customers and maintain safety stock levels
  • Participating in daily planning meetings and assigning priorities to production planning tasks
  • Reviewing open order reports and ensuring production plan supports on time delivery to customers
  • Updating production schedule based on vessels and production status and liaising with the Production team on the status of Process Orders
  • Working cross-functionally with production, logistics, quality and maintenance to ensure issues are addressed to support schedule adherence
  • Review and approve invoices for raw material orders
  • Drive continuous improvement ideas across functions
  • Complete ownership of inventory levels in assigned MRP


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Supply Chain Management, other relevant field, or equivalent work experience

title: Summer 2027 Data Engineering Internship
description:

title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Network Security (CISSP)
description:
Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
  • Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
  • Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
  • Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
  • Monitor and enhance the performance, availability and reliability of network security solutions, ensuring compliance with ISO, NIST, GDPR and internal standards
  • Design, configure and troubleshoot network security devices and services across on‑prem and cloud environments, providing advanced Level‑3 support when needed

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
You’ll join a friendly and collaborative Network Security Engineering team of seven, soon to be eight, working closely with colleagues across Business Tech. Your daily partners will include network SMEs, Cyber Security Advisors, Core Platforms and Global Infrastructure Services, as well as teams supporting stores, warehouses and new market entries. You’ll also connect with external partners and contribute to cross‑functional projects where network and cyber security come together. This is a highly collaborative environment where your expertise will help shape our security posture and uplift the team’s cyber maturity.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, with a focus on network environments
  • Strong, practical knowledge of: Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, SWG, SASE, VPN, CASB, ZTNA), Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, Security architecture methodologies and governance frameworks
  • Expertise in network security solutions and products provided by Cisco, HP Aruba, Zscaler and Citrix NetScaler (proven by certificates)
  • Strong knowledge of risk assessment and security control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST).
  • Familiarity with security maturity models including C2M2
  • Excellent ability to translate security requirements into implementable engineering solutions.
  • Strong understanding of IP networking and protocols, including IPsec, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, and QoS.
  • Understand regulatory and compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, Schrems, etc.).
  • Independent problem-solving, addressing complex security challenges with minimal supervision.

Preferred qualifications:

  • CCNP (Security) or higher-level certifications such as the CCIE.
  • CISSP or OSCP security certifications.
  • Azure Security Engineer, or GCP Security Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira/Confluence)

WHO WE ARE
H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

Benefits

  • All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
  • All our employees receive a staff discount card, which is usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET.
  • Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation and wellness allowance 4000 SEK/yearly
  • Access to Benify, for discounts on e.g. Gym memberships, travel, hotels and many other great deals.
  • Compensation boost during parental leave

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity
H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Data engineer (12 month FTC)
description:
Location: This role can be based at our London, Sheffield or Edinburgh office, with a blend of in-office (3 days) and homeworking (2 days) per week.

Use your data engineering skills to help Hachette UK migrate from legacy systems to modern cloud technology.

Hachette UK is a creative powerhouse and the UK's second largest book publishing group. Our mission is to make it easy for everyone to discover new worlds of ideas, learning, entertainment and opportunity. We're made up of 10 autonomous publishing divisions and over 60 imprints with a rich and diverse history and an incredible range of authors. We're also the market leader in e-books and publish a range of bestsellers in audio format, the fastest growing part of our business.

Our award-winning adult publishing divisions are Little, Brown, which won Publisher of the Year at the 2026 British Book Awards; Orion (2021 Publisher of the Year Award Winner); John Murray Press; Hodder & Stoughton; Headline; Octopus, and Bookouture. They publish fiction and non-fiction in digital, audio and print format, from the world's best and most diverse authors, including Brit Bennett, Candice Carty-Williams, Martina Cole, Michael Connelly, John Grisham, Stephen King, Stieg Larsson, Nelson Mandela, Stephenie Meyer, Maggie O'Farrell, Delia Owens, Ian Rankin, J.K. Rowling, Colson Whitehead, and Malala Yousafzai.

Hachette Children's Group publishes a wide and vibrant range of books for children across all age ranges, while Hachette Learning is a market leader in resources for both primary and secondary schools.

Hachette UK is part ofHachette Livre, the world's third largest trade and educational publisher. As well as our headquarters in Carmelite House, London, and our state-of-the-art book distribution centre in Didcot, Oxfordshire, we have recently opened five new offices in Manchester, Bristol, Sheffield, Newcastle, and Edinburgh. The UK region also includes offices in Australia, New Zealand, India, Singapore, the Caribbean, and Ireland.

It's an exciting time to join our business because the publishing market continues to grow and thrive. The UK remains the largest exporter of physical books in the world and book adaptations for film and TV are the foundation of the UK's creative industries.

What you’ll be doing

  • Cloud Development & Migration (Microsoft Fabric / Azure)
    • Build and maintain multi-tier data pipelines (Bronze/Silver/Gold architectures) in Microsoft Fabric using PySpark, Data Factory, Lakehouses, and Data Warehouses.
    • Execute the migration of legacy stored procedures, SSIS packages, and database tables into cloud-native, Medallion-architecture solutions.
    • Monitor cloud workloads for performance, reliability, and data quality across modern platform environments.
  • Legacy Optimization & Support
    • Help analyse, tune, and streamline existing on-premise relational databases (SQL Server) and ETL packages (SSIS).
    • Identify bottlenecks, optimize T-SQL queries/indexes, and refactor inefficient pipelines to minimize system load and maintenance overhead.
    • Support routine operations and troubleshooting to ensure the legacy platform remains stable and self-sustaining during the migration phase.
  • Problem Solving & Communication
    • Active Problem Solving: Methodically investigate pipeline issues, data discrepancies, and job failures to fix root causes rather than temporary patches.
    • Clear Communication: Document technical workflows clearly and communicate project updates, timelines, and technical requirements effectively across the data team and business partners.
    • Team Collaboration: Work closely with senior engineering leads, database admins, and BI developers to support cross-functional data delivery.

Who we are looking for

Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud & Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services and familiarity with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, PySpark, Data Factory).
  • SQL & Scripting: Strong proficiency in T-SQL (query writing, optimisation, stored procedures) and PySpark or Python for data processing.
  • Legacy ETL: Solid experience working with on-premise relational databases (SQL Server) and legacy ETL tools (SSIS or similar).
  • Data Fundamentals: Solid understanding of data modelling principles (dimensional modelling, star schemas) and ETL/ELT best practices.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong Problem Solver: Curious and proactive when digging into unfamiliar legacy code or debugging pipeline errors.
  • Solid Communicator: Able to explain technical details clearly in team discussions and keep technical documentation up to date.
  • Balanced Focus: Comfortable juggling modern cloud development tasks alongside legacy maintenance activities.

Nice-to-Have

  • Microsoft Certifications such as DP-600 (Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric) or DP-203.
  • Exposure to version control and CI/CD tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Git).

What we offer

Our staff are our greatest asset, and our benefits reflect this:

  • 28 annual leave days per year, increases to 29 days after 2 years' service and goes up to 30 days after 5 years' (+ bank holidays)
  • Generous pension schemes
  • Rent deposit loans
  • 2 community days per year
  • Summer hours (finishing at 1pm on Fridays during the summer months)
  • Retail discounts through Hachette rewards
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Eye care vouchers
  • Wide-ranging training library
  • Development programmes (including mentoring)
  • Up to 70% off book purchases
  • A charity bookshelf
  • An active range of staff-led employee networks that are voluntary, including AgeWise, Gender Balance, Thrive, Pride, All Together, Wellbeing, Women in Tech and religious networks
  • Season ticket loans
  • And much more!

Our commitment

Hachette employs people on the basis of their abilities. We aim to attract and develop talent from a base as broad as the world of readers we want to reach, with a wide and representative range of age, faith, disability, race, gender, sexuality and socio-economic, regional and cultural backgrounds.

We want everyone to have the opportunity to perform at their best during our recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, you can let us know at the ‘Reasonable Adjustments’ section of your application. We’ll make sure you’re supported throughout the process.

The Book Trade Charity offers financial support to people looking to enter the book trade but who may struggle to afford the costs of attending interviews and undertaking junior roles. For more information visit www.booktradeentrysupport.org

We welcome and encourage applications from candidates who are under-represented in the creative industries.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

Location: South West, Gloucestershire, Rosehill - Hybrid

Contract Type: Full Time

About us

About UCAS

UCAS is at the heart of connecting people to higher education.

UCAS is the world’s leading shared admissions service for higher education. We provide application services for UK universities and colleges as well as delivering a wide range of research, consultancy and advisory services to schools, colleges, careers services, professional bodies and employers.

We’re a successful and fast-growing organisation, which helps hundreds of thousands of people every year. We're committed to delivering a first-class service to all of our customers — they're at the heart of everything we do.

Business Unit description

The Digital Services business unit is at the heart of UCAS’ technical innovation, data and infrastructure. It focuses on leveraging data science, technology, and enterprise architecture to enhance UCAS' digital products and services.

The unit is dedicated to developing and improving customer-centric digital solutions, ensuring seamless and secure online experiences for all users. By providing insightful data and analysis, often made available to anyone with free-to-use intuitive dashboard, Digital Services empowers the Higher Education sector and those interested in the sector with valuable information to make informed decisions. By working in collaborative, expert led, multi-disciplinary teams, Digital Services drives UCAS’ mission to connect students with their next opportunities through advanced technological solutions.

About the role

The Senior Software Engineer is the key development and technical specialist resource for the team, responsible for developing and delivering software solutions in line with UCAS’ Corporate and IT strategy, while maintain a detailed knowledge of existing UCAS applications and systems. They will work alongside other Senior Software Engineers to ensure compliance with UCAS coding and design standards.

Contractual Hours

35.00

Key accountabilities

  • Provide technical leadership and innovation, utilising advanced technical skills.
  • Accountable for the development of quality solutions based on technical requirements, leading projects and/or project teams as required.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring support and feedback to team members in key technologies and developments, to improve general skill set of the team and increase knowledge of solutions.
  • Code/configure and document complex solutions from supplied specifications, using agreed standards and tools, and conduct reviews with others as appropriate.
  • Define and maintain coding and best practice standards and documentation guidelines.
  • Develop and maintain specialist knowledge of cloud technologies, design principles, architectures, and software.
  • Analyse data requirements to establish, modify, and maintain object/data models
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for related technologies and understand the interactions between the systems.

For more information about this role please see the attached role profile.

Skills, qualifications, and experience

  • Educated to degree level in relevant computing discipline or able to demonstrate an equivalent level of professional experience.
  • Substantial experience of developing enterprise level .Net applications.
  • Significant experience leading and designing solutions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to communicate effectively to both non-technical and technical audiences
  • Experience of working successfully in a dynamic, large-scale agile department with multiple technologies.
  • Significant experience developing solutions for the cloud.
  • Highly proficient in automated CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing.
  • Significant experience of coaching and mentoring junior members of staff, with a proven ability to develop individuals and input into performance evaluation.
  • Proven ability to lead architectural designs, considering business need, cost, and delivery timescales.

Package

Salary up to £60,000

  • Purpose-driven work in a charity-led organisation connecting people to education and opportunity

title: Senior UX Researcher, Commerce
description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Oura is looking for a senior-level UX Researcher to help improve the experience of discovering, evaluating, purchasing, and managing Oura products and Membership online. This role will initially focus on the global DTC eCommerce experience, with opportunities to support Membership and Commercial/B2B experiences as the work expands.

What You Will Do:

  • Spearhead holistic user research initiatives spanning digital commerce and enterprise portals, directing efforts from initial scope formulation to strategic actionable guidance.
  • Design and execute user interviews, usability evaluations, concept testing, card sorting, alongside diverse qualitative evaluation techniques.
  • Collaborate closely with Design, Product Management, Engineering, Insights, Marketing, and Commercial partners to surface critical research priorities.
  • Synthesize investigative work into impactful deliverables, such as journey maps, entry point analysis, Jobs to Be Done, page-level goals, and friction mapping.
  • Assess user experiences by integrating qualitative findings with analytics metrics, experimentation outcomes, and heuristic standards.
  • Articulate themes effectively to leadership, tying customer motivations directly to overarching business and product metrics.
  • Elevate internal research operations through scalable frameworks, standardized templates, and lightweight workflows that streamline design validation choices.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco, San Diego, or Boston.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of dedicated user research practice, showcasing a proven history of guiding end-to-end studies that directly shape product strategy.
  • Proven background evaluating digital commerce platforms alongside B2B, enterprise, SaaS, or complex web applications.
  • Exceptional qualitative research mastery—specifically in-depth interviews, usability studies, core synthesis, and distilling key insights responsibly from small user cohorts.
  • Modern AI-driven methodology: Skillfully leverages cutting-edge AI tools to streamline participant recruitment, session moderation, transcript analysis, research repositories, and knowledge sharing—while maintaining rigorous standards around data privacy, ethics, and study integrity.
  • Deep expertise deploying customer journey mapping, Jobs to Be Done, page-level objective definitions, heuristic reviews, and comprehensive experience audits.
  • Adept at unifying qualitative insights with quantitative metrics, telemetry, and experiment results to form cohesive narratives.
  • Outstanding workshop facilitation and communication abilities that build consensus across executive leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Practical exposure to centralized research repositories, behavioral analytics suites, experimentation tools, and scalable research operations.
  • Track record of establishing or scaling a high-impact research function within rapidly expanding organizations or agile startup environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience researching health, wellness, digital health, healthcare, or wearable technology products.
  • Experience working across international markets and diverse user groups.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Sr Lead Product Manager owns the full product lifecycle strategy and management for strategic Infrastructure Services product families, advanced services, and enterprise modernization initiatives. This role is responsible for defining long-term product direction, shaping future-state capabilities, aligning business objectives with execution, and leading cross-functional collaboration across business, engineering, architecture, design, operations, and delivery teams.

This role requires advanced product management depth and the ability to operate beyond a single-product focus. The Sr Lead Product Manager serves as a strategic product athlete who can flex across complex initiatives, connect work across domains, and drive progress on high-impact priorities involving Optical, Ethernet, network modernization, digital enablement, API-enabled experiences, and next-generation connectivity services.

The Sr Lead Product Manager translates highly ambiguous business challenges into actionable product strategies, capabilities, commercial considerations, and delivery plans while ensuring solutions meet reliability, efficiency, scalability, performance, and customer experience objectives. This role is expected to influence senior leaders, guide strategic tradeoff decisions, and move critical initiatives forward across a highly matrixed organization.

The Main Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Own full product lifecycle strategy and management for one or more strategic product families advanced services or modernization initiatives
  • Develop and execute long term product strategy through roadmaps product guides journey maps use cases business process models and investment priorities
  • Refine strategic concepts into product capabilities features requirements user acceptance criteria MVPs and measurable outcomes
  • Shape future state product direction across advanced connectivity domains such as Optical Ethernet offnet digital ordering API enabled services and next generation network capabilities
  • Partner with leadership to evaluate modernization opportunities business value delivery sequencing and strategic tradeoffs
  • Connect product strategy across initiatives to reduce silos and ensure capabilities are built for scale reuse and long term enterprise value

Customer Market and Business Understanding

  • Translate highly ambiguous business challenges into structured problem statements, strategic options and actionable delivery work
  • Analyze architecture impacts cross stack dependencies customer insights market trends operational gaps and product performance to guide strategic decisions
  • Partner with business stakeholders to deliver products and capabilities that achieve reliability efficiency scalability performance and customer experience objectives
  • Evaluate how advanced services and modernization initiatives support revenue growth operational transformation market competitiveness and future product differentiation
  • Bring a broad enterprise view to product decisions balancing customer needs technical feasibility, financial impact and organizational readiness

Product Delivery and Execution

  • Facilitate solutioning workshops across software API architecture engineering UX operations and business teams to drive consensus and remove barriers
  • Drive alignment across business design engineering architecture operational and delivery teams to ensure successful execution and adoption of product capabilities
  • Present product vision strategy progress risks dependencies tradeoffs and recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to drive API enabled designs and promote digital best practices that enable scalable secure and customer centric product experiences
  • Use JIRA or similar Agile product delivery tools to define capabilities manage backlog readiness track dependencies support cross functional planning and drive execution discipline
  • Lead through influence in a highly matrixed environment ensuring strategic initiatives continue to move forward despite competing priorities and organizational complexity
  • Operate as a senior product athlete who can flex across emerging business needs advanced service opportunities modernization programs and executive priorities

Performance and Risk Management

  • Measure product success through data driven insights KPI analysis customer outcomes operational improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Identify risks dependencies issues and decision points that may impact delivery adoption financial outcomes or strategic alignment
  • Develop mitigation plans and guide cross functional teams through tradeoff decisions
  • Use business cases performance data and strategic value assessments to inform prioritization and investment recommendations
  • Ensure product decisions support long term scalability modernization and enterprise-wide reuse where appropriate

What We Look For in a Candidate

Required

  • Eight or more years of experience in product management supporting Enterprise Infrastructure Network Services
  • Demonstrated leadership capability with experience influencing large matrixed organizations
  • Experience managing product portfolios product families’ strategic initiatives or advanced services across cross functional teams
  • Strong technical acumen data driven decision-making skills and ability to measure business outcomes and solution impact
  • Ability to connect product strategy architecture customer experience operational readiness and delivery execution
  • Ability to thrive in a remote work environment, lead distributed teams effectively and operate independently within established direction and priorities
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage senior leaders and influence outcomes
  • Strong relationship building and facilitation skills with experience leading cross functional discussions and executive level decision making
  • Demonstrated initiative ownership and the ability to navigate ambiguity in complex environments
  • Ability to operate as a strategic product athlete flexing across product domains advanced services modernization efforts and future state initiatives

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Engineering Computer Science Information Systems or a related discipline, MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • Experience in telecom cloud edge services SaaS platforms managed services digital transformation or advanced connectivity services
  • Familiarity with Optical Ethernet offnet network modernization API enabled services enterprise connectivity or digital service enablement
  • Product leadership experience modernizing legacy capabilities into digital first customer centric product experience
  • Product management certifications or equivalent professional training
  • Entrepreneurial innovation or transformation leadership experience
  • Demonstrated success driving KPI improvements ROI focused initiatives operational improvements and strategic business outcomes

Job Description:

Principal Scientist - Cell Line Development & Upstream Process Development

Location: Wrexham, UK (Hybrid Working)
Contract: Permanent
Travel: Occasional travel (European)

Shape the Future of Biologics at Ipsen

At Ipsen, we're passionate about advancing innovative medicines that make a meaningful difference to patients' lives. We are seeking an experienced Principal Scientist to join our Bioprocess Sciences team and provide scientific and technical leadership across Cell Line Development (CLD) and Upstream Process Development (USP) activities.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior biologics development professional to lead critical Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) development programmes, working with cutting-edge technologies and collaborating with global teams across our international network.

The Opportunity

As Principal Scientist, you will act as a recognised subject matter expert, leading the development and optimisation of cell line and upstream manufacturing processes for biologic products from candidate selection through to commercial manufacturing.

A key focus of the role will be driving upstream process development activities using mammalian and/or microbial cell lines, supporting multiple development programmes while providing technical leadership and mentorship to junior scientists. You will play an integral role within cross-functional CMC teams, partnering with internal stakeholders and external Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations (CDMOs) to ensure successful programme delivery.

This position offers exposure to a diverse biologics pipeline and the opportunity to influence development strategy across multiple projects while collaborating with colleagues throughout Ipsen's global organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Cell Line Development and Upstream Process Development strategies across biologics development programmes.
  • Provide scientific leadership for CMC development projects from early development through commercialisation.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for CLD and USP activities, supporting technical decision-making across programmes.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement to enhance process productivity, robustness and product quality.
  • Represent Upstream Process Development within multidisciplinary CMC teams.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external CMOs to support development, scale-up and technology transfer activities.
  • Contribute to regulatory submissions and technical documentation.
  • Conduct technical assessments for new product opportunities and in-licensing activities.
  • Mentor, coach and develop junior scientists, fostering a culture of scientific excellence.

About You

We're looking for a scientifically driven leader with strong biologics development experience and the ability to influence across complex, matrixed environments.

Essential Experience & Skills

  • Significant pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience within biologics development.
  • Deep expertise in Cell Line Development and/or Upstream Process Development.
  • Strong experience working with CHO cell lines and mammalian cell culture processes.
  • Experience leading CMC development activities across the product lifecycle.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners.
  • Experience engaging with and managing activities CDMOs
  • Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable

  • PhD in a relevant scientific discipline (or equivalent industry experience).
  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions and technology transfer activities.
  • Experience progressing biologic products from early to late-stage development and commercialisation.
  • Demonstrated mentoring, coaching or leadership experience within scientific teams.

Why Join Ipsen?

At Ipsen, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative organisation where science drives meaningful patient outcomes. We offer:

  • Flexible hybrid working.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international teams across the UK, Ireland and France.
  • Exposure to a diverse and exciting biologics pipeline.
  • A culture that values scientific excellence, innovation and continuous learning.
  • The opportunity to mentor others while continuing to develop your own career within a global biopharmaceutical company.

If you're an experienced biologics scientist looking to make a significant impact across Cell Line Development, Upstream Process Development and CMC programmes, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of biologics at Ipsen.

title: Afløser til Kære Pleje Odense
description:
Flere af vores dygtige afløsere skal snart videre på uddannelse , og derfor søger vi nye kolleger, der brænder for at gøre en forskel for borgerne i deres eget hjem.

Vi er en privat leverandør i Odense Kommune og leverer helhedspleje samt praktisk og personlig hjælp efter serviceloven. Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde i et fagligt engageret og fleksibelt team, hvor borgernes trivsel altid er i centrum.

Vi tilbyder fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tage vagter om aftenen og/eller i weekenderne – perfekt, hvis du ønsker et studiejob eller et fleksibelt bijob.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring fra pleje- og omsorgsområdet, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og gøre en positiv forskel. Vi sørger for en grundig oplæring, så du bliver godt klædt på til opgaverne.

Hos os arbejder vi ud fra værdierne omsorg, respekt, tryghed og fleksibilitet. Det er værdier, der præger vores hverdag og den måde, vi møder både borgere og kolleger på.

Kan du genkende dig selv i disse værdier, og er det sådan, du ønsker at arbejde, så er vi et godt match.

Det er et krav, at du som minimum kan tage 4-5 vagter om måneden.

Er du i gang med en uddannelse som social- og sundhedshjælper (SSH), social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA), pædagogisk assistent (PAU) eller sygeplejerske, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

#LI-Hybrid

Are you passionate about shaping the evidence that determines how innovative medicines reach patients worldwide?

As Director, International HEOR & HTA, Immunology, you will play a critical role in maximizing the value proposition of Novartis' Immunology portfolio by developing and executing impactful Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) strategies across the Research, Development, and Commercial continuum. Reporting to the HEOR TA Head, you will partner closely with Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial Launch Strategy, Development, Biomedical Research, Patient Engagement, and country teams to ensure payer and HTA evidence requirements are embedded into clinical development plans, integrated evidence plans, and product strategies. This highly visible international role offers the opportunity to influence reimbursement, pricing, access, and healthcare system decisions in priority markets, while driving evidence generation that supports stronger patient outcomes and sustainable access. If you are energized by translating complex evidence into compelling value stories and shaping the future of healthcare decision-making, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute Health Economics and Outcomes Research and Health Technology Assessment strategies across the Immunology portfolio.
  • Generate impactful value evidence that strengthens payer value propositions and supports patient access objectives.
  • Ensure payer and Health Technology Assessment evidence requirements are integrated into clinical development plans and evidence strategies.
  • Lead development of key value evidence deliverables, including global value dossiers, economic models, evidence syntheses, and real-world evidence studies.
  • Partner with Access, Medical Affairs, Development, Biomedical Research, and Commercial teams to maximize asset value.
  • Translate complex scientific and economic evidence into compelling value stories for healthcare decision-makers and payers.
  • Build strong relationships with external experts, Health Technology Assessment bodies, policy stakeholders, and scientific organizations.
  • Monitor emerging Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Health Technology Assessment, reimbursement, and healthcare policy trends to shape strategic decisions.

Essential Requirements:

  • Advanced Degree; preferably Doctor of Philosophy, Medical Doctor, Master of Business Administration, Registered Pharmacist, or equivalent.
  • 8+ years of experience in Market Access or Health Economics and Outcomes Research within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Deep understanding of payer and Health Technology Assessment evidence requirements and decision-making dynamics outside the United States.
  • Significant experience working in global or above-country multidisciplinary drug development environments.
  • Strong knowledge of research methodology and statistical methods in the field of data analysis.
  • Fluent English, both oral and written.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management experience.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience within the Immunology therapeutic area.

title: Research Assistant, Optical Physiology and Neurotechnology
description:
The role

This is an engineering-oriented science role, recording, controlling, analyzing, and visualizing neural activity at cellular and subcellular resolution. The job involves careful thinking about which parameters matter and why, meticulous execution, and sharp observation of results, figuring out which parameters to optimize to improve recording quality and throughput.

You report to the Head of Optical Physiology, and work with other members of the Optical Physiology team, using logic and evidence to advance your work so as to boost the performance of all.

The position is intended for someone who wants to redefine what is possible in cellular activity imaging, in addition to performing experiments using existing tools. Given the multidisciplinary nature of the job, it is ideal for a person who enjoys problem solving across intellectual boundaries, at the level of concepts as well as of hands-on debugging. It also requires systematic documentation, analysis, and iterative problem solving, to arrive at working protocols, apply them, and share them.

What you'll do

  • Execute and optimize cellular activity imaging experiments.
  • Produce high-quality voltage imaging and synaptic recording data from iPSC-derived neurons and human and mouse brain slices.
  • Characterize optogenetics and voltage sensor performance.
  • Evaluate gene expression systems.
  • Documentation and training: keep protocol records that others can execute, with the reasoning behind each parameter.

Required qualifications

  • B.S or B.A. in bioengineering, neuroscience, biophysics, chemistry, biochemistry, materials science, or a related field.
  • Direct hands-on experience with neural tissue handling, cell culture, histology, and fluorescent microscopy.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, modify, troubleshoot, and improve complex experimental systems.
  • Excellent experimental judgment and scientific rigor.



Preferred qualifications

  • Strong data analysis skills (Python, C++, MATLAB, ImageJ, or similar).
  • Direct experience with image analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with neuronal activity recordings, e.g. electrophysiology, calcium imaging, voltage imaging and optogenetics.
  • Experience with human iPSC differentiation and mouse brain slice recording.
  • Familiarity with viral and nonviral gene expression systems.

Culture we're building

The disorders of the brain affect over 1,000,000,000 people around the world: Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, stroke, and other conditions. We operate with a sense of urgency, even as we look to understand the brain at its most fundamental levels.

We are hypercollaborative, and focused on impact over short-term markers of productivity. Creativity and failure are the stepping stones to scale, and working together with “strong opinions, weakly held” is our style.

We solve real engineering problems the best way we can: inventing fast when we have to, and using good existing solutions where they exist. We believe hard problems only yield to many disciplines working together, so collaboration is not optional.

We expect people to explore the unknown, which means making mistakes daily, owning them, and learning from them to improve and excel.

We are recruiting a team of scientists and engineers who exemplify all these values.

What we're looking for

The ideal candidate is a scientist-engineer who naturally crosses disciplinary boundaries. You are intellectually curious, relentlessly practical, and happiest when solving problems that have never been solved before.

You have a strong detail orientation and exceptional organizational, planning, interpersonal, and communication skills. You are good at writing, can work within a team and also independently, and can prioritize and multitask as needed. Self-motivation, commitment to high quality standards, and a service-oriented mindset are all key. You have good judgment, balancing flexibility and focus, action and planning, speed and thoughtfulness, as appropriate. You are open to giving and receiving feedback, constructively and thoughtfully, to advance scientific missions and personal growth.

This is an in-person job. Flexible hours may be required at times.


What we offer

The chance to contribute to a core scientific pipelines of a new research institute alongside some of the most adventurous scientists in the field, with real autonomy and a direct line to the people setting the scientific agenda. The institute is organized around end-to-end runs that carry tissue from intake to a reconstruction worth simulating, and your pipeline sits in the middle of every one of them. You will get to contribute to addressing one of the most important unmet medical needs of our time, as part of the initial team. You will learn lots of things that probably cannot be learned any other way, as you solve problems, build, and work with others. As Mindspan grows, we expect this role to grow with it. We are excited to invest in someone who wants to take on increasing responsibility over time.

Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and family benefits, and a matching retirement contribution.

Competitive salary ($75,000 to $110,000) depending on experience.

title: Senior Scientific Product Leader
description:
The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.


Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Data and Digital Catalysts (DDC) department within the CS CoE is a diverse, curious and action-driven team at the intersection of computation, engineering and science with ambition to advance our technical excellence. The focus of the team is on partnering with the informatics and scientific communities to create a computational and data ecosystem that powers scientific discovery and accelerates decision making. We aim to modernize our ability to acquire, store, link, share, find and analyze data across the organization through scalable and integrated solutions that truly make every data point count. Reporting to the Domain Head for Lab Workflows & Data, this Senior Product Leader will play a key role in defining and executing the strategy for a family of products that are critical for drug discovery research.


The Lab Workflows & Data domain provides the end-to-end digital backbone for research design, experiment management, assay data & insights, and Lab Workflows & Data . It spans hypothesis and study design (protocol authoring, approvals, ELN linkage), experiment orchestration (intake, scheduling, LIMS/LES execution), and the full sample/material lifecycle with automation, provenance, and chain-of-custody. It delivers assay data & insights capabilities—standardized ingestion, processing/secondary–tertiary pipelines, QC, lineage, harmonization, and analytics-ready datasets—underpinned by governed research master data, shared ontologies, and interoperable APIs.


As a Senior Scientific Product Leader for Lab Workflows & Data, you will lead an integrated product strategy for lab workflows, research data, and AI/ML enablement. Working with senior scientific leadership across Research and Development, you will translate scientific priorities into an outcomes-driven roadmap spanning study design, entity selection and registration, protocol execution, data acquisition and processing, and insights.

You will make high-quality, governed, reproducible, and reusable data a core product outcome—not simply an output of workflow execution. Your roadmap will address the identifiers, metadata, provenance, harmonization, and data quality needed to support scientific analysis, training-set curation, and model reproducibility.


Partnering with scientists, lab managers and operations, automation specialists, technical capability leaders, and product, engineering, data/AI, and UX teams, you will translate research needs into prioritized workflow, data, and AI/ML capabilities. You will balance foundational investments with high-value deliveries, establish explicit success criteria, and guide capabilities from pilots to scaled adoption—reducing hand-offs and rework, accelerating learning cycles, and improving scientific decision making.


This is an exciting opportunity to significantly impact and accelerate discovering diverse therapeutics that fundamentally make patients’ lives better. You will have the opportunity to work closely with Genentech’s top tier scientists and drug discovery experts.


The Opportunity:


  • Own an integrated workflow, data, and AI product strategy. Define the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for lab workflows, research data, and AI/ML-enabling capabilities, aligned to scientific priorities and portfolio needs. Make foundational data investments and their contribution to research outcomes explicit in roadmap decisions.
  • Own research-data capabilities as product outcomes. Deliver integrated workflows connecting study design, protocol execution, the sample/material lifecycle, assay outputs, and insights. Define product requirements for standardized ingestion, processing, QC, metadata, lineage/provenance, and harmonization so that datasets are reproducible, reusable, and suitable for scientific analysis and AI/ML.
  • Lead AI product discovery and prioritization. Through continuous discovery with PIs, lab scientists, assay owners, and operations, identify and prioritize opportunities for AI/ML-enabled research capabilities. Partner with data/AI and engineering teams to translate these opportunities into product requirements, data-readiness requirements, prioritized epics, and explicit success criteria.
  • Drive governed platform and data interoperability. Use API-first, event-driven, ontology-aligned patterns to connect ELN/LIMS, lab automation, instrumentation, and data platforms. Ensure consistent use of GUPRIs, master data, and shared ontologies, with clear provenance, access controls, and auditability.
  • Lead change and adoption by establishing communication plans, training curricula, role-based onboarding, super-user networks, and feedback loops.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional delivery (product, engineering, data/AI, UX, QA/CSV, security, privacy, procurement/vendors); remove blockers, manage risks, and maintain a durable delivery cadence.

Who You Are:


In hiring new employees, we look for people who are inspired by our mission and can thrive with the collaborative, thorough, and entrepreneurial spirit of our company culture. Because we know that employees are essential to our success in bringing novel medicines to patients, we are dedicated to remaining an extraordinary place to work and to providing employees with programs, services, and benefits that allow them to bring the best to the organization and to their personal lives.


The ideal candidate will satisfy many of the following requirements:


  • 5+ years of product leadership in life-sciences R&D (biotech/pharma, CRO, or research tech), including end-to-end ownership of a complex product area serving scientists and lab operations.
  • Demonstrated AI product leadership in scientific research. Experience translating scientific needs into prioritized AI/ML product capabilities, defining success criteria, and partnering with data/AI and engineering teams to move from use-case discovery through pilots and scaled adoption. Able to connect AI product priorities to scientific outcomes and the data foundations required to achieve them.
  • Deep research-data expertise. Strong understanding of how assay outputs become high-quality, analysis-ready, and reusable datasets through ingestion, processing, QC, harmonization, and lineage/provenance. Able to translate requirements for training-set curation, harmonized identifiers, and model reproducibility into actionable product priorities.
  • Strong systems and data-governance acumen. Experience with API-first and event-driven integration, data modeling and ontologies, master data management, FAIR data practices, metadata quality, and data stewardship. Understand how project- and study-based access controls, auditability, and security/privacy-by-design support governed data sharing and reuse.
  • Track record of delivering measurable scientific and data outcomes, including cycle-time reduction, first-time-right execution, improved data and metadata quality, and increased reuse of entities and datasets. Experience instrumenting products with telemetry and using evidence to guide prioritization, iteration, and adoption.
  • Skilled at stakeholder leadership across PIs, lab managers, assay owners, data/AI teams, product/engineering, and executive sponsors; excellent written and verbal communication tailored to scientific and executive audiences.
  • Comfortable operating in a matrixed, global organization; adept at change management, roadmap sequencing, and risk management for multi-team deliveries.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Advanced degree in a life-science discipline (PhD, PharmD, MD, MS) or comparable hands-on lab experience that enables fluent conversations with researchers and scientific staff.
  • Experience with lab automation ecosystems and instrument/data integration across key assay families (e.g., sequencing/omics, high-content imaging, flow cytometry, bioanalytical/PK/PD).

Onsite presence, on our South San Francisco campus, is expected for at least 3 days a week.

Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
