title: Director, Portfolio Strategy and Management
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose
At Pfizer, our purpose is breakthroughs that change patients’ lives and our colleagues make this happen. All over the world, our colleagues work together to touch millions of lives.


What You Will Achieve

The Director, Portfolio Strategy & Management shapes the strategic direction of the Global Hospital & Biosimilars (GH&B) portfolio by developing enterprise recommendations on where the business should grow, defend, improve, simplify, or exit. The Director leads and advises high-priority portfolio assessments, identifies strategic opportunities and emerging business questions, and partners across functions to deliver rigorous, evidence-based recommendations. These recommendations integrate commercial, financial, operational, manufacturing, regulatory, and strategic considerations; clearly articulate trade-offs and enterprise implications; and enable timely decisions through the Global Portfolio Forum and other governance bodies.

Success in this role requires maintaining clear, current strategic direction for priority portfolios; advancing assessments in line with business priorities; proactively identifying, sizing, and prioritizing future opportunities; and resolving cross-functional trade-offs to support effective execution. The Director also helps evolve GH&B’s portfolio operating model, assessment methodology, and future opportunity agenda to strengthen enterprise alignment and value creation.

How You Will Achieve It

Portfolio Strategy and Recommendations

  • Lead Annual Portfolio Review and own portfolio recommendations across GH&B value chains, identifying where to grow, defend, improve, simplify, rationalize, or exit.
  • Translate strategic theses into decision-ready recommendations with explicit assumptions, risks, trade-offs, dependencies, and enterprise implications.
  • Ensure recommendations balance commercial opportunity, network realities, operational feasibility, financial returns, and long-term enterprise value.
  • Present and defend recommendations in the Global Portfolio Forum and other governance forums as required.
  • Maintain a current portfolio opportunity pipeline beyond committed programs and proactively elevate emerging opportunities and risks.

Portfolio Assessments and Deep Dives

  • Lead, co-lead, and/or provide strategic advise for high-priority portfolio assessments, determining the appropriate scope, analytical approach, level of evidence, and cross-functional engagement required to progress each opportunity toward a decision.
  • Assemble and direct cross-functional teams from Commercial, Manufacturing, Finance, Regulatory, Medical, Quality, Digital, and market organizations as appropriate.
  • Determine which opportunities require hands-on leadership, which should be led by project teams with strategic oversight, and which require further evidence before governance consideration.
  • Following approval, transition recommendations to execution owners with assumptions, risks, dependencies, and expected value clearly documented.
  • Guide recommendations from assessment through governance and transition to execution, ensuring decision requests, supporting rationale, assumptions, risks, dependencies, expected value, and ownership are clearly documented; reassess recommendations when material facts change.

Portfolio Assessment Frameworks

  • Own and continuously improve the GH&B value assessment methodology. Ensure recommendations are evaluated consistently across financial, commercial, operational, manufacturing, regulatory, and strategic dimensions.
  • Define the decision questions, metrics, analytical views, and visualization capabilities needed to generate actionable portfolio insights; apply artificial intelligence-enabled analytics responsibly to identify patterns, outliers, margin erosion, capacity constraints, growth signals, and optimization opportunities while ensuring validated data lineage, transparent assumptions, and appropriate human judgment.

Portfolio Performance Dashboards & Visualizations

  • Define the strategic decision questions, performance measures, and analytical views required to evaluate portfolio health, value creation, and emerging opportunities across GH&B.
  • Shape and advance AI-enabled analytics and visualization capabilities that identify material portfolio patterns, outliers, margin erosion, capacity constraints, growth signals, and optimization opportunities.
  • Establish scalable and reusable approaches that accelerate the path from business question to decision-ready insight, reducing reliance on bespoke manual analysis and enabling appropriate self-service access.
  • Translate portfolio performance signals into actionable optimization opportunities, applying enterprise judgment to size, prioritize, and sequence opportunities within the portfolio pipeline.
  • Set expectations for decision-grade portfolio insights by ensuring appropriate data validation, transparent assumptions, traceable data lineage, and human judgment before AI-generated outputs inform enterprise recommendations.

Enterprise Partnership and Influence

  • Build and leverage trusted enterprise partnerships across Commercial, Manufacturing, Finance, Regulatory, Quality, Digital, and market organizations to shape integrated portfolio recommendations and advance shared priorities.
  • Anticipate, surface, and facilitate resolution of cross-functional implications, dependencies, and trade-offs during recommendation development, strengthening alignment and reducing downstream execution risk.
  • Integrate external perspectives into portfolio strategy by evaluating relevant market trends, competitive developments, evolving customer needs, and industry practices for their potential enterprise impact.
  • Represent and advocate for the enterprise perspective when functional, geographic, or market priorities compete, using influence and sound judgment to guide stakeholders toward decisions that optimize long-term portfolio value.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

  • Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 8 years of
    experience; OR a master's degree with at least 7 years of experience; OR a PhD with 5+ years of experience
  • Broad pharmaceutical experience in Commercial, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Regulatory, or related functions to solve complex enterprise problems.
  • Candidates should demonstrate most of the following capabilities through a combination of professional experience, business impact, and leadership achievements:
  • Experience within sterile injectables, biosimilars, specialty medicines, hospital products.
  • Experience shaping and influencing significant portfolio, investment, operational, commercial, or strategic business decisions.
  • Strong financial acumen, including the ability to interpret business cases, product economics, P&L performance, margin drivers, stranded costs, and capacity trade-offs.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate competing priorities and make recommendations under uncertainty using incomplete information.
  • Experience using portfolio analytics, scenario modeling, visualization tools, or AI-enabled analytical capabilities.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to frame choices, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for leadership audiences.
  • Enterprise mindset with the ability to balance local, functional, and business-unit interests against broader organizational objectives.
  • Experience applying, building, improving, or governing portfolio, investment, prioritization, or value assessment frameworks.
  • undefined
  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

  • Strategy consulting, corporate strategy, corporate development, portfolio management, or business transformation experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing network strategy, footprint optimization, supply strategy, or portfolio rationalization.
  • Demonstrated leadership in enterprise-wide transformation, strategic planning, or portfolio optimization initiatives.



Non-Standard Work Schedule, Travel or Environment Requirements

Occasional business travel, 10-15%


Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $162,900.00 to $271,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. title: Tuotannon operaattori, kappalekäsittely
description:
Tuotannon operaattori, kappalekäsittely, Oulu


Haemme tuotannon operaattoria Oulun huippumodernille sahalle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!



Mitä työ pitää sisällään?


Tuotannon operaattorina pääset työskentelemään sahaustuotannon parissa uudella laitoksellamme Oulun Laanilassa. Haemme nyt vahvistusta kappalekäsittelypuolelle, missä vastataan sahattujen tuotteiden saumattomasta kulusta prosessin eri vaiheissa, aina tuorelajittelusta pakkaamoon saakka.



Työhön voi hypätä monenlaisella taustalla, et tarvitse välttämättä aiempaa tuotannon työkokemusta - tärkeintä on vahva halu ottaa modernin tuotantolaitoksen tehtävät haltuun pelottomasti sekä tulla rakentamaan kanssamme mukavaa työarkea.



Uudella laitoksella työpäivät ovat hyvin vaihtelevia, askeleita kertyy ja ongelmia ratkotaan myös hartiavoimin. Pidemmällä tähtäimellä operaattorin työ painottuu yhä enemmän prosessinvalvontaan sekä ongelmanratkaisuun huippuunsa automatisoidulla laitoksellamme. Työn mielekkyys ja vaihtelevuus on meille erityisen tärkeää, joten jokainen operaattori toimii vaihtelevissa työpisteissä läpi tuotantomme. Pienessä tiimissä saat käyttää ammattitaitoasi laajasti, ja pääset myös kehittämään uuden laitoksemme arjen toimivuutta.



Työ on vuorotyötä ja meillä työskennellään 2-vuoro ja 3-vuorotöissä 8 h työpäivin. Työhön edellytämme suomen kielen taitoa. Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian.



Millaista henkilöä etsimme?


Viihdyt varmasti meillä, kun olet asenteeltasi reipas ja positiivinen, innokas oppimaan uutta ja tykkäät tehdä hommia hyvässä porukassa. Meillä työkaverit ja pomotkin on niin mukavia, että oksat pois!



Sinulle on voinut kertyä jo osaamista tuotantopuolen töistä, mutta tässä on myös loistava mahdollisuus tehdä urahyppy täysin uudelle alalle. Jokainen uusi tiimiläisemme saa kattavan perehdytyksen uuteen työhön aina perusteista lähtien, ja rakennamme sinulle sopivan kehityspolun saha-alan ammattilaiseksi. Ei siis tosissaankaan tarvi pystymettästä lähteä hommiin, vaikka ekaa kertaa sahalle astelisit.



Tarjoamme sinulle sekä erinomaisen ympäristön kasvaa ja kehittyä sahateollisuuden parissa. Oulun sahalla työnteko ei maistu puulta, sillä meillä on tutkitusti hyvä yhteishenki, ja työkaverit tukevat toisiaan.



Kuinka voit hakea tehtävää?


Voit lähettää meille hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi pian ja viimeistään 16.10. mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antavat kappalekäsittelyn työnjohtajat Tiia Lippo p. 0503436321 tai Henri Kolvanki p. 0503496549. Tavoitat heidät keskiviikkona 7.10. klo 15-16 ja torstaina 8.10. klo 15-16.


Valitulle henkilölle teetetään terveystarkastus sekä huumausainetesti.


Tervetuloa työskentelemään uusiutuvien materiaalien yritykseen!

Oulun liiketoimintayksikkö on Stora Enson suurin megaintegraatti, johon on investoitu viime vuosien aikana 1,7 miljardia euroa. Liiketoimintayksikön toimintaa on neljällä paikkakunnalla: Oulussa, Kalajoella, Kemissä ja Oulaisissa. Mekaanisen puunjalostuksen, sellu- ja kartonkitehtaiden sekä satamatoimintojen parissa työskentelee yhteensä noin 900 henkilöä. Haluamme, että asiakkaamme eri puolilla maailmaa voivat valita korkealaatuisia pohjoismaisia tuotteita, oli kyseessä sitten sellu, pakkaus- tai kuluttajakartonki tai sahatavara.

Metsä on Stora Enson ytimessä, ja uskomme, että kaikki, mikä tänään valmistetaan fossiilisista materiaaleista, voidaan huomenna tehdä puusta. Olemme johtava uusiutuvien pakkaus-, biomateriaali- ja puurakentamisen tuotteiden valmistaja sekä yksi maailman suurimmista yksityisistä metsänomistajista.

Uskomme, että monimuotoisuus vahvistaa kilpailukykyämme ja edistää parempaa päätöksentekoa. Tiimit, jotka koostuvat erilaisista ihmisistä antavat meille mahdollisuuden tutkia erilaisia näkökulmia ja haastaa ajattelutapaamme. Työskentelemme aktiivisesti lisätäksemme monimuotoisuutta ja toivotamme tervetulleeksi hakijoita erilaisista taustoista. Stora Enso on tasa-arvoinen työnantaja ja noudattaa syrjimisen vastaisia käytäntöjä.

title: Insurance Program Administrator
description:
Job Description:

At National Church Residences, we believe every senior should lead a vibrant, healthy, and independent life. Since 1961, our mission has been to provide quality housing that meets the diverse and evolving needs of seniors.

With over 340 communities across 25 states, we are the nation’s largest not-for-profit provider of affordable senior housing and the leading employer of service coordinators. In addition to residential senior communities, we offer home and community-based services and permanent supportive housing for formerly homeless and disabled individuals.


PURPOSE

In this full-time, in-office role, you will provide strategic oversight and autonomous administration of the organization’s property and casualty insurance program. This exempt-level position requires independent judgment, discretion, and decision-making authority in managing claims processes, stakeholder communications, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role ensures compliance with organizational policies and all applicable local, state, federal, and accreditation regulations, while playing a critical role in risk identification, risk management, and financial reconciliation related to insurance claims.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Serves as the lead administrator for the organization’s Risk Management Information System (RMIS), maintaining system integrity, managing user access, and recommending workflow enhancements. Independently coordinates with vendors and oversees testing and implementation.
  • Exercises discretion and professional judgment in reviewing incident reports and determining appropriate claim submission to insurance carriers.
  • Manages property claims in collaboration with external third-party administrators (TPAs) and provides consultative support for casualty claims across departments.
  • Acts as the primary liaison for internal and external stakeholders, delivering strategic updates on claim status, timelines, and financial reconciliation.
  • Leads the collection and analysis of data for insurance applications and policy audits, coordinating with external brokers to ensure accurate and timely submissions.
  • Oversees processing of insurance invoices, claim proceeds, and reconciliation of self-insurance funds in partnership with internal accounting teams.
  • Facilitates cross-functional collaboration to advance organizational risk mitigation strategies and proactively identifies areas for operational improvement.
  • Develops and implements process improvements aligned with strategic risk management goals.



EXPECTATIONS

  • Demonstrates and maintains a positive, professional manner, manages time efficiently and effectively, provides leadership as a role model to promote a team approach, collaborates and participates in policy creation and appropriate problem-solving methods.
  • Must adhere to all policies, procedures, terms and conditions set forth in the National Church Residences’ Employee Information Guide (EIG), the Code of Conduct, as well as any facility handbook, including but not limited to, corporate compliance, drug free workplace, safe work practices, all federal, state, local regulations and laws.
  • With respect to Resident Rights, ensure all care is provided with respect and dignity for the residents/clients, their families and the staff. Reports all complaints made by residents/clients and/or families to the appropriate supervisors, reports all allegations of abuse, misappropriation of funds/resident property and/or any other corporate compliance, drug free workplace, safe work practices, all federal, state and local regulations and laws.
  • Completes all annual education requirements timely, including but not limited to Compliance, Privacy, Security and HIPAA training and exhibits behavior as set forth by the Code of Conduct in the performance of their duties.
  • Performs other exempt-level duties as assigned, which may include project leadership, policy development, and strategic initiatives.



Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, or related field preferred. ARM, CPCU, or similar designations are a plus.


Experience: Minimum 3 years of progressively responsible experience in claims administration, risk management, or insurance operations.


Mental: Must have excellent communication, comprehension, and interpersonal skills. Must have the ability to speak, read, write and understand English, as well as the ability to make self-understood.


Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with RMIS and Yardi preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills.


Travel: Up to 25% travel required.


Licensure: Valid driver’s license required.


In return, National Church Residences offers an excellent total reward package that includes:

  • Medical & Rx – 3 plan options to fit your budget; choose from coverage offered through a Nationwide network for you and your family
  • Complimented with a Healthcare Flexible Spending Account or Employer funded Health Savings Account
  • Includes Fertility & Family Building Support, Weight Management, and Chronic Condition Support
  • Parental Leave paid at 100% for four weeks
  • Coverage begins first of the month following your date of hire!
  • Dental & Vision coverage for you and your family with Nationwide providers.
  • Company provided Life & ADD insurance and Disability coverage.
  • Supplemental benefits such as Life and AD&D for you and your family, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Dependent Care and Transportation & Parking
  • Well-being Programs including an enhanced EAP with mental health and work-life support, tobacco cessation, and Well-Being Your Way which offers up to $1000/year in rewards & reimbursements!
  • Retirement Savings Plan offering immediate company funding at 3%, increasing up to 5% over time and an additional company match up to 5% when you contribute your own funds!
  • Reimbursement for Tuition expenses
  • Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 paid Holidays and Parental Paid Leave at 100%

(Programs vary depending on Full Time, Part Time or Contingent Status)

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

title: Director, Team Lead Bioanalytical Science
description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.


Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.


Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!



The Department


The Bioanalytical Science department is responsible for developing fit-for-purpose bioanalytical strategies and methods to quantify drug in circulation and assess unwanted immunogenicity. We are experts in the design, development, validation, execution and interpretation of bioanalytical methods, with a focus on pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics (PK/PD), anti-drug antibodies (ADA), neutralizing antibodies (NAb) and soluble markers. We perform bioanalysis activities for both regulated (GLP, GCP) and non-regulated (mouse studies, exploratory tox & Dose Range Finding) studies. As such, we deliver and translate indispensable high-quality bioanalytical data into conclusive insights that power decisions across all stages of Genmab drug development.

The Role

The Bioanalytical Science team develops bioanalytical strategies to support the pre-clinical and clinical development of Genmab’s formats and compounds. We design, execute, interpret, and validate bioanalytical methods (Pharmacokinetic, Pharmacodynamic and Immunogenicity assays) and perform bioanalysis activities for both regulated (GLP, GCP) and non-regulated studies. As such, we provide a strong foundation for informed decision-making at critical points throughout Genmab’s entire drug development program.

The Team Lead Bioanalytical Study Management is a member of the Bioanalytical Science leadership team and leads the Bioanalytical scientists responsible for study management, scientific oversight, data review, vendor/CRO interactions, and cross-functional Bioanalytical study delivery.


This role combines people leadership and strong Bioanalytical scientific expertise. The Team Lead will provide strategic and scientific leadership for the Study Management function by setting direction for study delivery standards, workload and resource planning, vendor governance, innovation implementation, operational continuity, and role coverage. The successful candidate will be an experienced Bioanalytical professional who can provide scientific credibility, coach and develop scientists, manage priorities across studies and programs, contribute to portfolio prioritization and capability development, and align people, resources, and scientific priorities with Genmab’s R&D portfolio.

Key Accountabilities


  • Lead, coach, and develop Bioanalytical Study Management scientists as one integrated team, including goal setting, performance enablement, development planning, engagement, role clarity, and accountability for delivery.
  • Set and drive the strategy for Bioanalytical Study Management, including scientific standards, operating model maturity, delivery expectations, capability development, and alignment with Bioanalytical Science and R&D portfolio priorities.
  • Contribute as a member of the Bioanalytical Science leadership team to functional strategy, portfolio prioritization, capability investment, resource planning, risk management, and future-state workforce needs.
  • Provide clear expectations for roles, responsibilities, deliverables, escalation routes, decision-making, and ways of working.
  • Drive workload, resource, and portfolio planning across studies, programs, vendors, submissions, and key portfolio milestones, including capacity assessment, prioritization, headcount input, sourcing options, budget assumptions, and risk-based trade-offs.
  • Make and/or recommend risk-based decisions across studies, programs, vendors, and portfolio milestones, balancing scientific quality, timelines, resources, regulatory expectations, and operational risk.
  • Provide experienced Bioanalytical scientific guidance across study design, assay strategy, data review, scientific interpretation, issue resolution, and key preclinical, clinical, and regulatory documents.
  • Ensure consistent scientific standards and compliance across Bioanalytical Study Management activities, including applicable GCP/GLP expectations, internal SOPs, documentation quality, data integrity principles, and inspection-readiness requirements.
  • Support Bioanalytical delivery for clinical and nonclinical studies, including internal activities and outsourced study oversight.
  • Ensure end-to-end Bioanalytical Study Management oversight from study strategy and planning through delivery, data interpretation, documentation, issue resolution, and close-out.
  • Act as Bioanalytical Innovation Project Lead; drive the design, execution, interpretation, validation, implementation, and organizational adoption of innovation approaches.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant scientific literature, regulatory expectations, and technical developments in Bioanalytical Science, and translate applicable advances into improved study management practices, scientific standards, and innovation opportunities.
  • Oversee vendor/CRO governance, including expectations for communication, timelines, scientific issue resolution, escalation, data quality, performance oversight, and continuous improvement.
  • Influence and partner effectively with Bioanalytical Science leadership, study scientists, lab colleagues, RAs, QA, regulatory, clinical teams, project teams, senior internal stakeholders, and external vendors to optimize study delivery, quality, and portfolio outcomes.
  • Identify and manage operational risks related to study coverage, workload pressure, capability gaps, succession depth, knowledge concentration, vendor oversight, and outsourced activities.
  • Strengthen continuity by ensuring backup coverage, knowledge transfer, and cross-training for critical study management responsibilities.
  • Lead change with clear communication, stakeholder alignment, role clarity, and active team engagement.
  • Translate portfolio priorities, regulatory timelines, clinical development needs, and outsourced activities into practical workforce and capability planning actions.

Essential Skills & Experience


  • PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, or related discipline with at least 10 years of relevant Bioanalytical experience.
  • At least 3 years of management experience in a research setting, preferably in a pharma or biotech business context.
  • Strong experience in Bioanalytical Science, including regulated Bioanalytical study support, assay strategy, data review, scientific interpretation, and issue resolution.
  • Experience leading and managing Bioanalytical study deliverables across clinical and/or nonclinical development, with accountability for scientific quality, timelines, cross-functional coordination, issue resolution, and continuity of study execution.
  • Experience supporting internal activities and/or outsourced study oversight.
  • Strong scientific credibility, with the ability to guide experienced scientists and act as a trusted discussion partner on complex Bioanalytical topics.
  • Proven people leadership experience, including leading, coaching, developing, and managing scientists and matrixed scientific contributors to ensure study delivery, scientific quality, prioritization across programs, and continuity within the Study Management group.
  • Experience leading team management processes, including goal setting, development planning, performance enablement, engagement, role clarity, and accountability.
  • Strong operational judgment, prioritization, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance scientific quality, timelines, capacity, workload, resources, and risk.
  • Experience with workload, capacity, resource, and portfolio planning in a scientific or regulated study management environment.
  • Experience contributing to workforce needs, budget assumptions, capability investment planning, and risk-based prioritization.
  • Experience with vendor/CRO oversight, including issue escalation, communication, data quality, delivery follow-up, and performance oversight.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory, GxP, documentation quality, data integrity, SOP, and inspection-readiness expectations, with the ability to apply these principles in Bioanalytical study management, vendor oversight, issue escalation, and delivery of high-quality study outputs.
  • Experience providing expert Bioanalytical input into preclinical, clinical, and/or regulatory documents within agreed timelines.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence Bioanalytical leadership, project teams, QA, regulatory, clinical teams, vendors, senior stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Ability to identify and manage capability gaps, succession risks, continuity risks, knowledge concentration, and operational dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through change with clear communication, structure, stakeholder alignment, and team engagement.
  • Experience setting direction for a scientific function, capability area, or study management group, including standards, priorities, operating model, and delivery expectations.
  • Scientific track record demonstrated through publications, presentations, regulatory contributions, innovation delivery, or recognized subject matter expertise in Bioanalytical Science.

Highly Valuable Skills & Experience


  • Experience with both LBA and LC-MS/MS environments.
  • Experience supporting clinical Bioanalytical studies.
  • Experience with outsourced vendor governance.
  • Experience preparing Bioanalytical input for submissions or inspections.
  • Familiarity with GxP expectations, documentation quality, and data integrity principles.
  • Experience building team structures, decision rights, escalation pathways, and continuity plans during organizational change.
  • Strong understanding of how Bioanalytical work connects to program milestones, regulatory timelines, clinical development needs, and portfolio priorities.

EUR97.920,00---146.880,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Pension
  • Health insurance and wellness benefits
  • Paid time off
  • Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.



About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.


Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

This role within the Applied AI, Low Molecular Weight (LMW) group of AI4R will contribute to the development, evaluation, and application of AI methods and workflows for LMW drug discovery. Purpose of the role

Senior Expert (Applied AI, LMW Drug Discovery):

  • Work within a global team of AI researchers and SME with core domain expertise in applying AI to low molecular weight drug discovery.
  • Contribute to the conceptualization of AI methods and their applications for hit generation, lead optimization, pre-clinical analysis, including safety and PK/PD
  • Develop, adapt and evaluate state-of-the-art AI/machine learning models, including foundation models, generative AI, multimodal AI, and agentic systems
  • Establish rigorous evaluation and benchmarking frameworks to assess the robustness and scientific validity of models deployed in drug discovery applications
  • Define translatable metrics that connect model performance to downstream scientific decisions, including assay-level or prioritization improvements, and experimental efficiency
  • Help integrate of AI approaches into design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycles to accelerate LMW drug discovery
  • Facilitate delivery of AI solutions through collaboration with Engineering and Product Development teams
  • Communicate progress and impact to stakeholders and multidisciplinary audiences

Collaboration & partnership

  • A respectful team-player attitude is an absolute must

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with ability to translate analytical concepts for diverse audience and stakeholders (English is our primary language)

What you’ll bring to the role:


  • A deep curiosity and passion for biomedical sciences driven therapeutic discovery.
  • 4+ years of significant experience in innovation, development, deployment and continuous support of Machine Learning data management and modeling
  • Strong hands-on coding proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks
  • Strong understanding and experience in using version control systems for developing software (e.g. GitHub, git, subversion, bitbucket, etc.)
  • Demonstrated expertise / experience in several of molecular AI/ML areas, such as generative chemistry; structure-based drug design across hit finding, hit to lead, lead optimization, and candidate selection; protein-ligand modelling, co-folding; docking, scoring, and pose assessment with rigorous model validation and tight coupling to experimental follow up; QSAR; multi-objective property optimization (uncertainty estimation, active learning concepts); free energy and affinity prediction
  • Demonstrated expertise / experience with AI driven molecular design applied to the areas above· Experience working in a large Research organization & deep understanding of drug development a plus

  • Ability to balance requirements, manage expectations, and drive effective results using a proactive attitude towards identifying and resolving issues
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with ability to execute and prioritize well in a complex matrixed environment.



Relevant areas of desired expertise:

Molecular representation learning for small molecules, graph neural networks, geometric deep learning, property prediction for ADME PK, physiochemical properties, safety, de novo design, chemical space exploration, foundation models for chemistry, uncertainty quantification, active learning, agentic AI, generative chemistry, counterfactuals and explainability, multi-objective optimization.

of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Apoteket är öppet 09.00-20.00 på vardagar, 10.00-18.00 på lördagar och 11.00-17.00 på söndagar så möjlighet till flexibla arbetstider finns. Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning på heltid/deltid och du välkomnas till apotekschef Mahbobeh Rajabis team. Önskad start enligt överenskommelse.

På apoteket hjälps vi alla åt med det dagliga arbetet och tillsammans skapar vi en trevlig, välmående och trygg arbetsmiljö där vi växer, har roligt och delar med oss av våra framgångar.

Din ansökan
Om detta låter som rätt utmaning för dig tveka inte att skicka din ansökan till oss. I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV eller din LinkedInprofil. Personligt brev? Det kan du skippa! Vi är intresserade av din kompetens, lära känna dig gör vi vid en eventuell intervju.

I slutet av rekryteringsprocessen tillämpar vi en bakgrundskontroll på samtliga personer vi vill anställa, oavsett roll eller funktion. Då vi enbart tillämpar detta på slutkandidat informerar vi mer om det längre fram.

Är du intresserad av att kombinera din tjänst med kundservice? Kolla in vår kundserviceannons här för mer information.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! 😊

title: Hlavný Pokladník/Hlavná Pokladníčka/Cash Office responsible, Bratislava
description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ
Ako Cash Office Responsible, budete zodpovedný za administratívu pokladne a predajnej plochy vo vašom obchode, pričom zabezpečíte efektívnosť a dodržiavanie firemných štandardov. Budete školiť a podporovať tím obchodu, aby poznal a bol sebavedomý vo všetkých postupoch súvisiacich s manipuláciou s hotovosťou, skladom, bankovníctvom a administratívou. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

  • Zvýšiť efektívnosť obchodu zabezpečením najlepších praktík pri manipulácii s hotovosťou, správe technického vybavenia a administratívnych postupoch, pričom podporíš tím manažmentu obchodu a kolegov pri poskytovaní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku, keď to bude potrebné.
  • Riadiť vyrovnanie účtov, rutiny manipulácie s peniazmi a otváranie a zatváranie pokladne, analyzovať nezrovnalosti a spolupracovať s manažmentom a prevenciou strát na následnom postupe.
  • Dozerať na bezpečnostné rutiny v súlade s firemnými pokynmi, vrátane vykonávania a podpory auditov.
  • Spolupracovať s tímom manažmentu obchodu na zabezpečení plynulého zážitku pre zákazníkov a kolegov na predajnej ploche a podporovať náš vernostný program.
  • Školiť a podporovať kolegov obchodu v postupoch pri pokladni, rutinných činnostiach s hotovosťou a procesoch obchodu týkajúcich sa tvojich zodpovedností, zabezpečujúc konzistentné dodržiavanie.
  • Reprezentovať seba a značku pozitívne pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

  • ​ Vášeň pre koučovanie tímov, vytváranie pozitívnej kultúry a vedenie podľa firemných hodnôt.

A ľudí ktorí sú…​

  • Organizovaní, efektívni a motivovaní na zlepšovanie procesov a rutín s cieľom zabezpečiť najlepšie praktiky v obchode.
  • Nápomocní a spoľahliví kolegovia s efektívnou komunikáciou, prispievajúci k tímovej spolupráci v rámci tímu vedenia obchodu.
  • Prosperujú v spolupráci a dynamických prostrediach.
  • Flexibilní, zvedaví, rozhodní a orientovaní na riešenia.
  • Motivovaní vytvárať skvelé zákaznícke zážitky, pričom propagujú a predávajú naše produkty.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

  • 25 % zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v obchodoch aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).
  • H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Viac o programe sa dozviete tu.
  • Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
  • Športová karta Multisport,
  • Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.
  • Rozsiahly program školení,
  • Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
  • Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
  • Občerstvenie na pracovisku,
  • Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,
  • Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,
  • Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,
  • 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Táto pozícia je na plný úväzok, so sídlom v Košiciach.

Platové ohodnotenie tvorí základná mzda od 1 420 € brutto/mesačne. Mzda pozostáva zo základnej mzdy 1250,- Butto/Mesiac a mesačného retenčného príspevku pre Bratislavu 170,- Brutto/Mesiac. Súčasťou odmeňovania je aj možnosť mesačnej obratovej prémie a nadštandardné príplatky za prácu počas víkendov. Konečná výška mzdy bude stanovená na základe skúseností kandidáta.

Prihláste sa zaslaním svojho životopisu čo najskôr, najneskôr do 11.10.2026. Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov prijímame žiadosti výlučne prostredníctvom kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.

*Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a cyber security company in Bahrain that receives a very large volume of security telemetry from many customers. The platform runs automated analysis and gives our operations teams the tools to reach and act on decisions. The platform serves many customers from a single deployment, so every pipeline stage has to hold up under strict tenant isolation, bursty traffic, third-party rate limits, and partial failure. The engineering problems are, first and foremost, distributed systems problems. The team is small and senior in outlook. Engineers ship to production, own what they ship, and work directly with the operations teams who use the product every day. We hire for engineering quality above everything else. You will own one or more of the subsystems that make the platform work under load. Ownership means the design, the delivery, the production operation, and the reliability numbers. We need someone who has already done this elsewhere: you designed a system that many people depended on, watched it break at scale, and rebuilt the parts that broke. You can hold a room of engineers to a high bar without slowing them down, and you will be expected to mentor associate engineers toward ownership of their own.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • Six or more years of professional software engineering, including at least two in a senior or lead capacity on a production system.
  • You designed and operated a system at scale. Be ready to give the numbers: throughput, data volume, tenants or users, latency percentiles, availability. Be ready to tell us what broke, what it cost, and what you changed.
  • Distributed systems depth: queues and streams, workflow engines, retries and idempotency, consistency trade-offs, partial failure, backpressure, observability.
  • Strong TypeScript on Node.js and strong Python, with the judgment to know which to use where, and comfort reading and fixing code in either.
  • Cloud and Kubernetes fluency. You have run services on Kubernetes in production.
  • Production ownership. You have defined service-level objectives, led incident response, run blameless post-incident reviews, and driven the follow-through.
  • A proven record of excellence, evidenced by several of: promotions ahead of the typical cadence; ownership of a system critical to your employer's business; public work such as talks, papers, patents, or open-source projects with real users; a reputation among former colleagues we can verify by reference; a measurable outcome you drove, such as an order-of-magnitude cost, latency, or reliability improvement.
  • A security mindset. You have shipped systems where the threat model mattered, treat tenant isolation as a security boundary rather than a configuration, and design for the case where the input is hostile.
  • Built and operated multi-tenant platforms where isolation of data and credentials was a hard requirement.
  • Deep experience with a durable-execution or workflow engine, or with a streaming platform, at scale.
  • Integrated with security tooling APIs and know their rate limits and quirks by heart.
  • Graph databases, and familiarity with open security data standards for events and threat intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience defending production systems, as an engineer or in an operations role.
  • Productionized machine-learning or language-model components with a proper evaluation discipline.
  • Useful, not required: this is a software engineering role. This is a hands-on senior engineering role, not a management position, with architectural ownership and mentoring responsibilities.

title: Salgskonsulent, Schulstad
description:
Lantmännen Schulstad er Danmarks største bageri

Vi har eksisteret siden 1880. Vi var højst sandsynligt på frokostmenuen dengang PS Krøyer malede sine Skagensmalerier, og vi solgte allerede brød i egen butik på Store Kongensgade, da bilen blev opfundet. Og vi her endnu - i bedste velgående, faktisk. Vi bager hvert år mere end 100 mio. brød til kerneglade danskere. Det gør vi 24/7 fra vores to topmoderne bagerier i Avedøre og Pandrup. Vores brød kører vi ud i vores el-lastbiler fra vores distributionscenter i Vejle.

Vi er en del af den globale bagerikoncern Lantmännen Unibake, som er en del af Nordeuropas førende koncern indenfor landbrug, bioenergi, maskiner og fødevarer. Sammen med Lantmännen følger vi kornet fra jord til bord og tager ansvar for en bæredygtig produktionskæde, så vi kan garantere det mest smagfulde og naturlige brød.

I Lantmännen Schulstad møder du 700 brødnørder, der på trods af vores faglige forskelligheder indenfor bageri, distribution, salg, udvikling og administration, hver dag arbejder for vores fælles mål at forny og forbedre den danske brødkultur.

Salgskonsulent til Schulstad

Vil du være med til at sælge nogle af de stærkeste brands i dansk dagligvarehandel? Og har du en vindende personlighed, som kan skabe værdi i samhandlen med dine kunder? Så er du måske vores nye salgskonsulent til vores distrikt i Storkøbenhavn

Med reference til salgschefen i øst, får du ansvaret for at planlægge og drive salgsudviklingen hos en række af de største butikskæder i handlen. Du arbejder ud fra din bopæl, som liger i Storkøbenhavn. Du arbejder selvstændigt i hverdagen, men indgår i et meget velfungerende team med 17 kolleger.

Rådgivning med fokus på værdi

Som konsulent består din hverdag i høj grad i at rådgive dine kunder omkring værdiskabende aktiviteter, som produktlanceringer, marketing tiltag, space og distribution. Med udgangspunkt i salgsudviklingen på markedet og i butikken, er det dig, som har løsningerne med til kunden.

Du er chefen for din kundeportefølje, og du får en høj grad af frihed til at planlægge indsatserne i din hverdag. Resultater skaber du i tæt samarbejde med en organisation, som indeholder stor viden om brødkategorien, dens kunder og forbrugere. En viden som sammen med en adfærd baseret på værdierne: Åbenhed, Helhedssyn og Handlekraft positionerer os som klar markedsleder i brødkategorien. Du er den helt rigtige ansøger til jobbet hvis du:

·Har kendskab til detailhandlen, evt. fra butik eller fra en lignende konsulentstilling

·Er engageret, har en positiv smittende energi og brænder for at gøre en forskel i hverdagen

·Er en vinder og en teamplayer

·Kan bygge relationer, er dialogsøgende, tænker langsigtet og er skarp på detaljer

·Er god til at prioritere dine indsatser

·Er god til talanalyse og kan formidle budskabet

·Har tjek på Microsoft Office pakken

Har du appetit på mere?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte regional salgschef Peter Balle på mobil 24 28 00 30. Ellers skynd dig at sende os din ansøgning – vi holder løbende samtaler.

Od zahájení konverzace po asistenci u pokladny, v kabinkách a na prodejní ploše budete hrát klíčovou roli při zlepšování nákupního zážitku. Vaše odpovědnosti zahrnují také zpracování dodávek, doplňování zboží a prezentaci nejnovějších oděvů na prodejní ploše.

Vaše role je zásadní pro vytváření přívětivého prostředí, které ukazuje to nejlepší z naší značky. S vřelostí a nadšením budete provázet zákazníky jejich cestou, nabízet upřímnou pomoc a proaktivní servis, který inspiruje a baví. Společně se svým týmem budete vytvářet okamžiky, na kterých záleží.

Předchozí zkušenosti v zákaznickém servisu a znalost materiálů jsou vítány, ale nejsou podmínkou.

  • Orientace na zákazníka: Baví vás komunikace s lidmi a poskytování skvělého servisu.
  • Flexibilita: Umíte reagovat na měnící se priority a požadavky zákazníků.
  • Proaktivní přístup: Jste iniciativní a zaměřeni na kvalitní výsledky.
  • Silné komunikační dovednosti: Máte opravdový zájem o lidi, komunikujete jasně a nasloucháte.
  • Chuť se učit: Otevřenost zpětné vazbě a hledání příležitostí k rozvoji.
  • Nadšení pro značku: Milujete naši značku a kolekci a rádi sdílíte toto nadšení se zákazníky.
  • Flexibilní pracovní doba: Ochota pracovat ve večerních hodinách a o víkendech.
  • Dobrá unalost českého a anglického jazyka

Vítané, ale není nutné:

  • Znalost provozu prodejny a zákaznického servisu z předchozí praxe
  • Sebejistota při poskytování rad ohledně módních trendů, materiálů, velikostí apod.
  • Jedná se o částečný úvazek s pracovní smlouvou na 20 hodin týdně.
  • Svou přihlášku zašlete nejpozději do 10.10.2026

Benefity:

Jsme odhodláni podporovat naše zaměstnance atraktivními benefity a cennými možnostmi rozvoje. Jako člen našeho týmu získáte 25% slevu na všechny značky H&M Group – dostupnou v prodejnách i online. Navíc jsou všichni zaměstnanci zapojeni do H&M Incentive Programu (HIP), který odměňuje váš přínos a podporuje váš růst ve společnosti.

Pro kolegy v Česku dále nabízíme:

  • Příspěvek na stravování
  • Program Multisport
  • Dovolená nad rámec zákona
  • Bonus za doporučení zaměstnance
  • Neomezené možnosti kariérního růstu a individuálního rozvoje

Inkluze & Diverzita

Ve skupině H&M jsme odhodláni vytvářet inkluzivní, rozmanitá a spravedlivá pracoviště napříč celou organizací. Věříme, že týmy obohacuje, když spojují širokou škálu zkušeností, perspektiv a znalostí. Tato rozmanitost zlepšuje naši schopnost kreativně řešit problémy, rozšiřovat myšlení a budovat smysluplné vztahy s kolegy i zákazníky po celém světě. Proto zohledňujeme všechny dimenze rozmanitosti v našem náborovém procesu – aby naše pracovní síla odrážela bohatství komunit, které obsluhujeme.

title: Osakonnajuhataja H&M Jõhvi (40h/n)
description:
MIDA SA TEED
Osakonnajuhatajana oled juht, kes toetab ja julgustab kogu oma meeskonda. Edendades kaasavat kultuuri, mis edendab koostööd ja ettevõtlikkust, lood keskkonna, kus kõik saavad areneda. Tegutsedes kooskõlas meie väärtustega, aitad kaasa nii enda kui ka ettevõtte edule.

Sinu ülesanded:

  • Juhid oma meeskonda silmapaistva kliendikogemuse pakkumiseks, tagades suurepärased tegevus- ja visuaalsed standardid, reklaamides ja müües samal ajal aktiivselt meie tooteid.
  • Võtad vastutuse oma poe ja osakonna tugevate külgede eest, analüüsid müügitulemusi, tuvastad kaubandusvõimalusi, sead eesmärke ja koostad plaane tulemuste, kasumi ja laoseisu optimeerimiseks.
  • Haldad meeskonna planeerimist, ajakava koostamist ning tagad sujuvad avamis- ja sulgemisrutiinid.
  • Värbad, kaasake ja arendad oma meeskonda, edendades samal ajal kaasavat ja koostööl põhinevat kultuuri, mis edendab kasvu ja innovatsiooni.
  • Konkurentsieelise säilitamiseks oled kursis moesuundade, klientide eelistuste ja konkurentidega.
  • Esindad ennast ja brändi positiivselt kogu kliendisuhtluse ajal.

KELLEGA SA KOOSTÖÖD TEED

Meie kauplused on meie ettevõtte süda, kus kliendid kogevad meie kaubamärki omal nahal. Dünaamilise kaupluse meeskonna osana aitavad kõik rollid – alates müüginõustajatest, osakonnajuhatajatest, poe juhatajatest ja dekoraatoritest kuni kassahalduriteni – inspireeriva ja külalislahke keskkonna loomisele. Samuti saad luua ühenduse laiema piirkonna meeskonnaga, tehes kauplustes koostööd, et jagada teadmisi ja saavutada koos edu. Koos oma meeskonnaga mängid olulist rolli, et aidata klientidel end enesekindlalt tunda ja väljendada oma individuaalsust uusimate trendide ja ajatute stiilidega. Luues oma kauplustes klientidega sisukaid sidemeid, muudame moe kõigile kättesaadavaks ja jätkusuutlikuks.

KES SA OLED​

Otsime inimesi, kellel on…​

  • Jaemüügi juhtimise ja tegevuse kogemus.
  • Teadmised müügi planeerimisest, analüüsist ja järeltegevusest, kasutades kliendikeskseid tööriistu ja aruandlust.

Ja inimesi, kes on…​

  • Tugevad ja enesekindlad juhid, kes inspireerivad, juhendavad ja arendavad oma meeskondi, näidates samal ajal ettevõtte väärtusi ja kultuuri.
  • Edukad koostööl põhinevas dünaamilises keskkonnas ja lahendustele keskendunud mõtteviisiga.
  • Motiveeritud looma suurepäraseid kliendikogemusi, reklaamides ja müües samal ajal oma tooteid.
  • Tugeva huviga moesuundade, kommertslikkuse ja konkurentide teadmiste vastu, et suurendada müüki.
  • Tõhusad suhtlejad, loomingulised ja uudishimulikud.
  • Paindlikud, analüütilised ja saavutustele orienteeritud, võimelised haldama statistikat ja töötama numbritega.

KES ME OLEME

H&M Group on ülemaailmne ettevõte, mis koosneb tugevatest moebrändidest ja ettevõtmistest. Meie eesmärk on tõestada, et erakordse disaini, taskukohaste hindade ja jätkusuutlike lahenduste vahel pole kompromisse. Tahame vabastada moe paljude jaoks ja meie kliendid on iga meie otsuse keskmes.​

Meid ühendavad tuhanded kirglikud ja andekad kolleegid, keda omakorda ühendab meie ühine kultuur ja väärtused. Üheskoos tahame kasutada oma jõudu, ulatust ja teadmisi, et viia moetööstust kaasavama ja jätkusuutlikuma tuleviku poole. ​

MIKS SULLE MEELDIB SIIN TÖÖTADA ​
H&M Groupis oleme uhked, et oleme elujõuline ja külalislahke ettevõte. Pakume oma töötajatele atraktiivseid hüvesid koos ulatuslike arenguvõimalustega kogu maailmas. ​

  • 25% töötajate soodustus kõigilt meie H&M Groupi kaubamärkidelt nii kauplustes kui ka veebis (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories ja ARKET).​
  • Mitmed lisasooduskupongid terve aasta vältel
  • Paindlik töögraafik
  • Tasustatud soovitusprogramm

LIITU MEIEGA

Meie ainulaadsus tuleneb paljude asjade kombinatsioonist – meie kaasavast ja koostöökultuurist, tugevatest väärtustest ja kasvuvõimalustest. Kuid ennekõike on meie inimesed need, kes teevad meist need, kes me oleme.​
Kandideeri, saates oma CV esimesel võimalusel, kuid mitte hiljem kui 22.10.2026. Andmepoliitika tõttu võtame taotlusi vastu ainult karjäärilehe kaudu.

Brutotöötasu 1560Eur / kuus

Astu koos meiega oma karjääris järgmine samm. Teekond algab siit.​

*Oleme pühendunud värbamisprotsessile, mis on aus, õiglane ja põhineb kompetentsusel. Seetõttu palume taotlusele kaaskirja mitte lisada.

title: Software Test Automation Co-Op
description:
The Software Test Automation Co-op will participate in the design, development, integration and testing of software systems for security products. Students will work with product and development teams to identify test cases to meet project requirements. The Intern will work in a cross-functional team environment comprised of software engineers, software test engineering, and product managers and will be responsible for assigned software tasks from design through development, integration, and testing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Participate in the development of either test automation, or supporting infrastructure, for a new product, a cloud-native security panel ecosystem.
  • Verification of automated test of software and embedded firmware platforms.
  • Evaluate results of repeatability and reliability studies.
  • Troubleshoot product and test equipment, propose and implement fixes.
  • Engage a data driven approach to product performance, trending reports, and analysis of test results.

Learning Objectives:

The Software Test Automation Co-op will partner closely with a staff mentor to build skills in software engineering, test automation, and test infrastructure. You will gain experience with software testing for new product development and working with seasoned software engineers in a professional environment.

Job Requirements:

  • Must be pursuing BS Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or another technology-related field.
  • GPA of 3.0 or higher preferred.
  • Software development experience in Python required.
  • Experience with CI/CD concepts including unit and integration test and automation of test procedures preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, including analysis of existing software code and utilization of software tools preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both a technical and non-technical audience preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to take ownership and work independently in an organized and structured fashion required.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methods preferred.
  • Software experience with real-time embedded systems written in C / C++ using OOP principles preferred.
  • Experience in software development including Linux, Android OS, Azure preferred.
  • High level of self-motivation, a drive for self-development and possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

The U.S. hourly range for this full-time position is $25.00-26.00 per hour. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc.

In addition to base salary, full-time employees are eligible to participate in Keenfinity Group's (US) Health and Welfare Benefit Plans—including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance—as well as the company’s 401(k) plan, subject to the terms and conditions of the respective plan documents. Full-time employees are eligible to participate in Keenfinity Group’s paid time off and sick leave programs in accordance with applicable policies.

  • Reasonable accommodations may be made, to the extent they do not pose an undue hardship, to enable qualified individuals with covered disabilities to perform essential functions.
  • Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization is not available.
  • All of your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology. We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.

Keenfinity Group is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer in MarTech
description:
Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea's transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.

We are looking for a senior DevOps engineer to help shape the next generation of web and mobile bank's analytics and marketing capabilities for Nordea's private and corporate customers. This is an opportunity for you to join a team of highly motivated people that strive to deliver a modern digital banking solution to millions of our customers across the Nordics. This is a permanent and full-time position, at Nordea Campus in Helsinki (Finland).

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank; we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people's daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About our team

Meet the Orchestration and Optimization train & its teams. We are part of the SD MarTech & Sales Technology in Group Technology, working at the intersection of business, data, and technology to support Nordea's digital sales ambition.

What we do

Our role is to enable effective orchestration marketing, experience management and analytics across all customer channels. We focus on creating and optimizing simple, relevant, and personalized marketing, voice of the customer and analytics experiences that help customers discover and engage with Nordea's products and services.

How we work

We build solutions that bring together customer data, insights, and content to deliver meaningful interactions across channels such as mobile, online banking, and other digital touchpoints. By combining data with technology, we help ensure that the right message reaches the right customer at the right time - while continuously learning and improving based on feedback and performance.

Main responsibilities in this role

  • You will own the infrastructure automation, pipeline orchestration, and deployment strategies required to operate and upgrade high-scale analytical workloads on GCP and Snowflake ecosystems
  • Scale CI/CD Pipelines: Design and build robust CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Bitbucket Pipelines and SonarQube to support continuous integration and deployment of data jobs, microservices, and models.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Design and maintain Ansible templates to ensure consistent infrastructure across cloud (GCP/Snowflake) and on-premises environments.
  • Scripting & Linux Expertise: Create and maintain deployment scripts leveraging advanced Linux systems expertise and scripting skills (Bash, Python, Groovy) to automate complex changes
  • System Monitoring & Optimization: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance, scaling, and cost efficiency across our cloud and big data infrastructure - using Sysdig and Splunk.
  • Security & vulnerabilities management: Partner with security teams to enforce secure IAM, PAM, SSLcertificates management and platform security controls, keeping our platform' data foundation compliant.
  • DevOps Mentorship & Best Practices: Drive best practices in DevOps methodologies and help engineering teams adopt high-quality standards.

This role is based in Helsinki and we follow hybrid model of working (60 % onsite).

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you:

  • Take ownership of platform quality, drive continuous improvement, and work well across engineering and business teams
  • Platform Collaborator: Experience aligning software development, data engineering, and infrastructure in Agile environments
  • Automation Advocate: Passionate about eliminating manual processes through reliable platform tooling
  • Systems Thinker: Strong analytical skills for troubleshooting complex network, IAM, or compute issues across hybrid environments
  • Clear Communicator: Able to translate infrastructure complexity for business partners and domain leads
  • Are curious about how AI can change the way software is built

Your background and skills include:

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): 4+ years of hands-on experience writing Ansible for onprem and cloud infrastructure management
  • Cloud Platforms (GCP): Strong operational experience with core GCP services, including IAM, GKE, RDS and networking/VPC routing. GCP certification is highly regarded
  • Container Orchestration: Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • CI/CD & Version Control: Expert-level mastery of Git, Groovy and Bitbucket, with deep experience designing branching strategies and Jenkins pipelines and shared libraries
  • Big Data & Cloud Transition: Solid understanding of both legacy big data ecosystems (Hadoop, HDFS, Hive) and modern cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)
  • Security Knowledge: Understanding of OWASP Top 10 security vulnerabilities and secure development practices, and knowledge of Sysdig secure, SBOM, vulnerabilities elimination cycle
  • Observability Stack: Hands-on experience configuring monitoring, alerting, and logging (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk)
  • (good to have) Operating Systems & Scripting: 5+ years of advanced Linux/Unix systems administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python)

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions - and that we imagine you share with us.

People

are driven by many different factors. For some, it's to take their career to the next level. For others, it's to break new ground within their area of expertise - in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture

that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model -

we believe in the value of bringing people together and at same time we embrace freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion

are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics, and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.

A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position.

title: Prodejní poradce/poradkyně, hlavní pracovní poměr 38,75h týdně, Praha Myslbek
description:
CO BUDETE DĚLAT

Jako Prodejní poradce/poradkyně v H&M budete klíčovou součástí týmu a pomůžete zákazníkům najít to, co hledají. Přivítáte je v prodejně, poradíte jim s výběrem a zajistíte, aby měli skvělý zákaznický zážitek. Svou energií a přístupem přispějete nejen k vlastnímu úspěchu, ale i k úspěchu celého týmu.

  • Pomáhat zákazníkům s výběrem a sdílet své znalosti o módě
  • Spolupracovat s kolegy a zajistit, aby byl obchod vždy přehledný a dobře zásobený
  • Podílet se na otevírání a zavírání prodejny
  • Reprezentovat značku H&M s pozitivním přístupem

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Naše prodejny jsou srdcem společnosti – místem, kde zákazníci zažívají naši značku na vlastní kůži. Jako součást dynamického týmu, který tvoří Prodejní poradci, Store Manageři, Visual Merchandiseři a další kolegové, budete přispívat k příjemné atmosféře a skvělému zákaznickému servisu. Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

KOHO HLEDÁME

Hledáme nadšené lidi, kteří:

  • Mají zkušenosti se zákaznickým servisem v oblasti módy, retailu nebo podobném oboru (není podmínkou, ale výhodou).
  • Baví je móda a chtějí zákazníkům zajistit skvělý zákaznický zážitek.
  • Rádi pracují v dynamickém a týmovém prostředí.
  • Jsou komunikativní, kreativní a otevření novým technologiím.
  • Jsou flexibilní, proaktivní a ochotní učit se nové věci.
  • Mají češtinu na úrovni minimálně B2
  • Otevření odpoledním směnám (cca do 22:00) a víkendové práci

PROČ SE K NÁM PŘIDAT
V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • 25% sleva na všechny značky skupiny H&M – nakupujte výhodně v prodejnách i online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Motivační program H&M HIP – Více informací najdete zde.​
  • Stravenkový paušál 90 CZK za každou odpracovanou směnu – při plném měsíčním úvazku až 1890 CZK navíc.
  • Multisport karta – udržujte se fit s přístupem do stovek sportovišť po celé ČR.
  • Odměna za doporučení nového kolegy až 7000 CZK – pomozte nám najít nové talenty a buďte za to odměněni.
  • 21 dní dovolené + až 4 Relaxing Days navíc – čas na odpočinek je u nás prioritou.
  • Jubilejní dny volna až 3 dny – oslavte pracovní výročí s volnem navíc.
  • Rozsáhlý školící program – investujeme do vašeho rozvoje od prvního dne.
  • Skvělé příležitosti pro kariérní růst – podpoříme vás na každém kroku vaší profesní cesty.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na plný úvazek (38,75 hodin týdně), se sídlem v Praze. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 05.09.2026.

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

*Hodnocení rolí v obchodě:
Abysme, zvládli vysoký objem žádostí na pozici Prodejního poradce, používáme v našich obchodech online hodnotící metodu pro nábor založený na dovednostech. Hodnocení je součást procesu žádosti a výběru. Vaše odpovědi budou hodnoceny nástrojem, který používá předem stanovená kritéria stanovená skupinou H&M.

Po dokončení hodnocení budete mít možnost sdílet zpětnou vazbu a klást otázky. Pokud narazíte na nějaké potíže nebo preferujete alternativní metodu hodnocení, kontaktujte prosím recruitment­_support@hm.com. Výběr alternativy nebude mít vliv na vaši žádost.

Pro více informací o tom, jak zpracováváme vaše osobní údaje, prosím, podívejte se na naše Oznámení o ochraně soukromí.

** Zavazujeme se k náborovému procesu, který je spravedlivý, rovný a založený na kompetencích. Proto vás laskavě žádáme, abyste k vaší žádosti nepřikládali motivační dopis.

title: Service Assistant under 18 år 4 timer

Du byder kunderne velkommen, guider dem gennem butikken og hjælper dem med at finde det, de leder efter, samtidig med at du præsenterer vores varer. Ved at handle i overensstemmelse med vores værdier bidrager du til både din egen og virksomhedens succes.
