title: Associate Director - Real Estate Portfolio Management APAC
description:
Job Purpose

GSK is a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Getting ahead means preventing disease as well as treating it, and we aim to impact the health of 2.5 billion people around the world in the next 10 years. In Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF) our unique contribution will accelerate GSK’s success by transforming the employee experience, inspiring everyone to be their best wherever they work.

WREF is the global team that is responsible for the full lifecycle of planning, execution and operations of the GSK real estate portfolio consisting of R&D facilities, office buildings, manufacturing plants and distribution centers. The sites may be owned, leased or be occupied through a serviced space arrangement. WREF works in close collaboration with our Global Function partners (Finance, Tech, HR, EHS, Legal, Procurement etc) and relies extensively on our network of vendor partners to deliver a safe, productive and highly desirable work environment for all users of our sites.

The Real Estate Portfolio Manager, APAC supports the Director of Real Estate and Asset Management, APAC, and works alongside highly skilled external consultants to optimise the performance of the Region’s property portfolio (currently comprising over 6.7m Sqft, comprising more than 98 properties in 15 countries, and with an annual operating cost of c.£160m).


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the GSK End-to-End Process for Real Estate Portfolio, including but not limited to stakeholder alignment, real estate strategy, site selection, negotiation, STP paper, lease execution and capital project delivery.
  • Working with real estate experts and advisors across the region to develop highly creative and innovative real estate solutions that fully leverage GSK’s property assets, driving higher returns, creating added value, lowering GSK’s cost base, and creating vibrant new workplaces that drive higher employee productivity and user experience.
  • Development and delivery of the regional real estate strategy
  • Leading multiple small or large, complex transactions from concept to completion, including the preparation of submissions for Executive approval of real estate transactions • Management of sub-leases whereas GSK may be a landlord, responsible from advertisement / RFP to tenant selection, documentation and subsequent relationship management
  • Supporting the development and delivery of significant projects to optimise business performance and ensure the optimum utilisation of facilities ensuring cost efficiency, effectiveness and sustainability
  • Supporting the development of GSK’s culture through the ongoing development of physical workspace environments such that it ensures GSK maintains its position as an Employer of choice.
  • Working with peers in Procurement team to raise and manage Purchase Order (PO) to vendors, brokers, landlords, local authorities, etc.
  • Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand current and future business priorities, enabling the delivery of proactive asset management initiatives that drive long-term value and business outcomes.
  • Working with peers in Finance team to support the preparation of regular financial reviews of the Regional property portfolios
  • Working with peers in Legal team to support the preparation of lease agreement reviews
  • Working with the WREF regional team to ensure seamless ‘OneWREF’ project delivery and connection to stakeholders
  • Working with WREF global & regional team on real estate and workplace initiatives

Why You?

  • Subject matter expertise in a Real Estate Asset Class with 16+ overall experience and bachelor’s or master’s degree
  • A proven track record of managing Real Estate assets across multiple geographies
  • Financial analysis including cashflow, NPV, P&L, etc.
  • Proven knowledge of real estate, property development and the built environment
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management experience partnering with senior levels of management and external third parties
  • Experience developing strategic real estate plans
  • Proven leadership capability – including line, matrix, project and third-party management
  • Experience of leading organizational change
  • Experience in using artificial intelligence agents

Preferred Qualifications and experience:

  • Familiar with End-to-End real estate process from collection of user requirement, portfolio planning and strategy to project execution.
  • Experience in R&D or manufacturing environment, experience in a large corporate real estate team also advantageous
  • Ability to think strategically, anticipating the impact of external environmental changes on Real Estate and to translate the impact into operational plans that proactively respond to and manage the changes to the benefit of the organization
  • Good judgement based on proven analytical and complex problem solving skills
  • Highly organized and able to plan, priorities and manage multiple activities effectively
  • Ability to identify, evaluate, resolve and manage outcomes of project risks (through project specialists and/or stakeholders)
  • Recognition of other cultures, points of view and stakeholders’ needs
  • Good communication, presentation and leadership skills.
  • Ability not only to identify challenges but to create solutions and options
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity and complexity and skilled at simplifying complex and specialist information
  • Ability to project manage real estate & workplace delivery and program manage new initiatives


Skills

Commercial Real Estate, Digital Fluency, Financial Acumen, Influencing Without Authority, Project Delivery, Project Management, Real Estate Transactions, Service Delivery Management, Stakeholder Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Inclusion at GSK:

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. title: Tax Processing Specialist
description:
Job Description:

Tax Processing Specialist


  • Prepare 700+ sales and use tax returns monthly for level 2-3 clients, applying in-depth compliance knowledge and independent professional judgment to resolve complex tax reporting issues accurately and on time.
  • Independently implement new clients, entities, and data files; ensure seamless onboarding and transition; review client tax data for accuracy, investigate discrepancies, and take corrective action.
  • Foster strong client relationships through regular communication, proactive support, and timely response to inquiries; provide support for online filings, payments, and tax authority notice responses.
  • Format and import monthly tax data into Vertex Indirect Tax Returns (VITR) software; prepare and maintain monthly client tax compliance reports and documentation.
  • Utilize automation and data processing technologies, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Alteryx, to enhance process efficiency and operational accuracy.
  • Serve as trainer and mentor to 1-3 junior staff members; actively participate in 1-3 MSO special teams, contributing to process improvements and business initiatives.
  • Accommodate additional work hours during peak monthly processing periods, typically the 5th through the 20th of each month.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of related experience in tax processing, accounting, or a related business discipline.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills; customer-focused with experience building productive internal and external working relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and transition work to junior staff members effectively.
  • Ability to exercise sound, independent professional judgment in identifying and resolving complex tax reporting problems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Vertex Indirect Tax Returns (VITR) software.
  • Exposure to Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools and/or Alteryx for data processing and workflow automation.

title: Group Copy Supervisor
description:
As a Group Copy Supervisor, you’ll lead the copy function across key client accounts, shaping brand voice, creative direction, and the quality of work from concept through execution. Working in close partnership with your art counterpart, you’ll help solve strategic and creative challenges, strengthen client confidence, and ensure teams are delivering work that is original, relevant, and grounded in a deep understanding of the brand, category, and market.

You’ll also play a significant people-leadership role. You’ll manage, mentor, and develop a team of creatives while balancing a fast-moving workload across multiple assignments. Success in this role means bringing together strong creative judgment, healthcare knowledge, operational discipline, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and cross-functional partners.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead copy and creative direction across assigned accounts, bringing together client objectives, audience needs, market dynamics, competitive activity, and clinical developments to shape strategically grounded work.
  • Partner with art leadership and cross-functional teams to develop original, integrated creative ideas and solve strategic or executional challenges from concept through delivery.
  • Review and guide creative output to ensure work meets high standards for writing, brand consistency, strategic alignment, scientific accuracy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Build trusted client relationships through regular collaboration, creative presentations, market research, and strategic discussions, clearly articulating the thinking behind the work.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop direct reports through clear expectations, ongoing feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Set priorities and manage team workloads, project schedules, budgets, and resources to keep multiple assignments moving efficiently and effectively.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment and build strong relationships across Creative, Client Services, Strategy, Medical, Science & Regulatory, Production, and other disciplines.
  • Stay current on healthcare, creative, cultural, and technology trends, including responsible applications of AI, and share relevant learning that strengthens the work and the team.

Required

  • 7+ years of professional experience in copywriting, advertising, marketing communications, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking and integrated campaign work.
  • Demonstrated experience leading copy and creative direction across complex brands or client accounts, from strategic concept through final execution.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare or pharmaceutical marketing, including product and treatment-category dynamics, clinical developments, healthcare audiences, and regulated review environments.
  • Ability to translate complex strategic, scientific, and clinical information into clear, compelling creative communications.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and client relationship skills, with experience confidently presenting and defending creative and strategic recommendations.
  • People-management experience, including mentoring, coaching, performance management, and developing creative talent.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while collaborating effectively across Creative, Client Services, Strategy, Medical, Science & Regulatory, and production teams.

Desired

  • Experience leading and developing copy teams and contributing to the hiring and retention of strong creative talent.
  • Experience presenting campaign concepts, brand platforms, and strategic creative direction to senior client stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with healthcare creative production and review workflows, including annotation tools, reference management systems, routing, and regulatory review platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Marketing, Communications, Writing, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.

title: 2027 Spring Intern - Cell Line Development Automation
description:
The Position

2027 Spring Intern - Cell Line Development Automation


Department Summary


As part of our Pharma Technical Development (PTD) organization, we are committed to realizing our Pharma ambitions by bringing game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core mission is to develop safe, innovative, and effective drugs using cutting-edge technologies for manufacturing processes (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development.


This role is an integral part of our Cell Culture and Bioprocess Operations (CCBO) team, which is dedicated to driving biotechnological advancements for therapeutic development. By driving automation development, digital transformation, and computational modeling in cell line development and cell culture process development workflows, you will accelerate the development of innovative therapies in Genentech's pipeline.


This internship position is located in South San Francisco, on-site.


The Opportunity


You will be part of a cross-functional team developing automated cell line development (CLD) workflows, with the goal of shortening program timelines. In this role, you will:


  • Test proof-of-concept workflows to find where automation gives the most benefit.
  • Develop automated methods for the workflows you select.
  • Run those methods and evaluate them against the current manual approach.
  • Document the methods so others on the team can run them.
  • Implement the validated workflow into routine use and present your results to the team.

Program Highlights


  • Intensive 6 months, full-time (40 hours per week) paid internship.
  • Program start date is in January 2027 (Spring).
  • A stipend, based on location, will be provided to help alleviate costs associated with the internship.
  • Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects.
  • Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.



Who You Are (Required)


Required Education: You meet one of the following criteria:


  • Must be pursuing a Bachelor's degree
  • Must have attained a Bachelor's degree (recent graduates not currently enrolled in a grad program)
  • Must be pursuing a Master's degree
  • Must have attained a Master's Degree
  • Must be pursuing a PhD

Required Majors: Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, Biology, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related life sciences or engineering discipline.


Required Skills:


  • You have coursework or hands-on experience in a laboratory or life sciences discipline.
  • You can troubleshoot an experiment that did not work, and you speak up when a procedure looks inefficient.
  • You can read and write Python, and you are comfortable working with AI-assisted coding tools.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications


  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
  • Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.
  • You are familiar with automated liquid handlers or other automated laboratory platforms.
  • You have done molecular cloning at the bench: plasmid design and assembly, restriction or Gibson cloning, transformation, and plasmid prep.
  • You have cultured mammalian cells using aseptic technique.

title: GENERAL PRODUCTION - Boone
description:
Job Description

General Purpose: Performing one or more steps in preparation of processing poultry products. Production employees use a knife or scissors to cut up or debone chicken as it moves down the production line. This work involves standing for long periods of time, doing rapid and repetitive work in a cold and damp environment. It may also include lifting heavy objects.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Employees use a knife or scissors to cut up or debone chicken as it moves down the production line.
  • Checks for bones and excess fat attached.
  • Removes bones with a knife and pulls off the extra fat with the hand or trims it with the knife.
  • Participate as an active team member of production in assigned area.
  • Perform repetitive tasks as assigned.
  • Ensure compliance with established food safety programs, including HACCP programs, SSOPs and GMPs.
  • Effectively communicate with all levels of employees.
  • Follow all company safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment.
  • Attend monthly or annual meetings and trainings as required.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor or lead

Essential Skills and Abilities:

  • Commitment to company values
  • Ability to comprehend and follow instructions
  • Ability to work in cool or warm temperatures
  • Ability to multitask and work quickly
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to frequent changes to the needs of production
  • Must be a team player and be willing to work close to other employees stations (less than 2 feet)
  • Must be able to lift 40 lbs
  • Must be able to stand and/or walk for entire 8-hour shift
  • Must wear correct job specific PPE as designated by company policy
  • Be able to work overtime when needed

Physical Demands and work environment: The physical and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical demands: Regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and talk or hear. Occasionally required to sit. Frequently must squat, stoop, or kneel, reach above the head, and reach forward. Daily uses hand strength to grasp tools, supplies and equipment.

Work environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to weather conditions prevalent to the time. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. Often work in dusty, humid, and heated environments; as well as cold, moist environments.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Agent & Experience Team
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The AI Agent & Experience team is Toast's internal platform team for AI. We build the infrastructure, governance, and developer tooling that makes AI a reliable, scalable force multiplier across the entire product development lifecycle. Our products include the LLM Proxy, AI Key Management, Observability pipelines, the Claude Plugin Marketplace, and autonomous agents that participate directly in the software development lifecycle.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll be hands-on building the systems that other Toast engineers depend on every day: the LLM proxy, agentic workflows, and the plugin marketplace that brings AI-native development practices to teams across the company.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, and ship features across AI platform infrastructure, including the LLM proxy, AI key management, and observability pipelines
  • Develop and extend autonomous agents that participate in the SDLC, such as the AI Review GitHub App and Developer Platform MCP integrations
  • Build on and contribute to the internal plugin marketplace, developing plugins that encode Toast's architectural standards and quality practices into AI assistant behavior
  • Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) services and service templates that make it faster and easier for teams across Toast to build AI-powered workflows
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate in design and code reviews
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and platform teams to understand developer needs and translate them into reliable platform solutions
  • Contribute to the team's adoption of agentic development practices and tooling
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Bachelor's Degree with relevant experience of 5+ years in designing and implementing scalable backend services
  • Demonstrated experience building, deploying, or operating LLM-powered agents or AI-assisted developer tooling
  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and an interest in extending them through custom plugins, skills, or hooks
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool use patterns, or similar agentic integration frameworks
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering and how LLM behavior responds to context and instructions
  • Strong foundation in Java, Kotlin, or another object-oriented language
  • Experience with distributed systems, REST APIs, and cloud-native infrastructure
  • Strong customer empathy and a drive to make developers‘ lives better through reliable, well-designed platform solutions

What will help you stand out

  • Familiarity with A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocols and multi-agent orchestration patterns
  • Experience with machine learning concepts, model evaluation, or ML infrastructure
  • Experience building developer experience platforms, internal tooling, or API gateways
  • Familiarity with observability tooling for AI/LLM systems (e.g., Langfuse, DataDog)

*** This is a hybrid role requiring in-office presence two days per week ***

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

title: Night Shift Plant Technician
description:
ABOUT POET

At POET, it is our mission to be good stewards of the Earth by converting renewable resources to energy and other valuable goods as effectively as humanly possible. For over thirty-five years, our drive and passion to change the world has enabled us to become the largest producer and marketer of bioethanol and a leader in sustainable products in the world.


CULTURE IS KING AT POET

We’re all on the same team. We always communicate. And we park our egos at the door. These aren’t just slogans on our walls. It’s the way we do things at POET. We provide an environment for team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance. It’s the best way to optimize health, wellness, and productivity in a sustainable way. We work hard. We play hard. We have frequent team events, volunteer efforts, and we know how to celebrate wins!

JOB SUMMARY & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Plant Technician is responsible for the operation of all plant processing equipment and performing routine basic maintenance in a highly automated chemical facility. In the area of maintenance, Plant Technicians are responsible for the safe and efficient maintenance, basic repair, and cleaning of all equipment associated with bioprocessing processes. At times, Plant Technicians may be asked to assist Maintenance Technicians in more technical and complex maintenance procedures. Team members in this position are required to maintain knowledge of the process flow, computerized equipment, and be aware of hazards associated with the process as well as understand and execute standard operating procedures (SOPs). Continuous plant operation requires 12-hour shift work. Plant Technicians must be able to adapt to 12-hour workdays and be able to meet call-in requirements as needed.


This is an on-site role located in Caro, MI. Responsibilities include:

  • Use your knowledge to maintain and operate all processes associated with the plant where required.
  • Perform maintenance and basic repairs of plant equipment and document these activities.
  • Operate the DCS (Distributed Control System) for the plant.
  • Safely perform basic electrical troubleshooting.
  • Follow procedures for plant start-up, shut-down, cleaning, and batching.
  • Maintain accurate and timely logs.
  • Collect and test quality control samples, interpret QA/QC results and make adjustments to optimize plant operations, timely and accurately document results and enter results into our data collection system, PI.
  • Assist in removal, installation, rebuild, and performance of preventive and predictive maintenance on all equipment associated with plant processes.
  • Help to keep your plant clean by following the sanitation schedule and completing all tasks as assigned.
  • Notify the management team of safety, environmental, quality and production concerns, problems and opportunities.
  • Keep your plant safe by fostering a culture of safe behavior and environmental compliance.
  • Maintain a team environment at all times and champion POET in the community.
  • Foster a culture of safe behavior and environmental compliance at all times.
  • Maintain and advance the food safety and quality of POET’s products and processes to deliver a best-in-class culture of quality.
  • Since we’re all about teamwork and getting the job done, your skills may be put to a lot of other uses!

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Experience requirements:
    • Plant Technician I: experience in a production environment preferred.
    • Plant Technician II: Documented successful performance as a Plant Technician I or equivalent work experience required.
    • Plant Technician III: Documented proficiency in the skills listed in the Plant Technician III Skills Checklist.
  • Working knowledge in math, reading comprehension and mechanical reasoning required.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Experience with software systems, such as Maximo, preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills as well as the ability to embrace change.
  • You know the basics of Microsoft Office Suite. You’re capable of learning new programs.

A SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE

  • High level of personal integrity
  • Interpersonal skills – ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels within/outside the organization
  • Ability to embrace and promote change
  • Innovative mindset
  • Ability to think objectively
  • Self-awareness in the face of uncertainty
  • Ability to work in a team environment

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role has some physical requirements that our team members will need to be able to perform, such as:

  • Wearing Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as hard hats, gloves, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, hazardous material suit, hearing protection, and harness.
  • Working at extreme heights (approximately 150 ft), in confined spaces, and in extreme temperatures from -20 to +100 degrees Fahrenheit, both indoors and outdoors. Due to the nature of the work, the areas can be dusty at times.
  • Must be able to use the following equipment/tools, with training provided (not all encompassing): forklift, power washer, pallet jack, hoist systems, scissor lifts, JLG lifts, telehandlers, Front End Loaders, various hand tools, and computers.

Frequently:

  • Sitting in a chair in the Control Room while operating the plant
  • Walk indoors and outdoors sometimes over rough, uneven, or wet/slick surfaces
  • Carry to up to 15lbs
  • Climb stairs and/or ladders
  • Stand indoors to clean and maintain areas
  • Reach at arm’s length to gather samples
  • Be in awkward back, shoulder, wrists, and hand positions
  • Use coordination and grip, with a force of up to 50lbs
  • Bend while standing
  • Use repetitive arm motions to wipe down and maintain work area
  • Climb in and out of Powered Industrial Vehicles

Occasionally:

  • Lift up to 50lbs, with or without assistance
  • Carry up to 40 lbs, with our without assistance
  • Push with a force of 10lbs, with or without assistance
  • Pull with a force of up to 85lbs, with or without assistance
  • Bend, twist, turn, kneel, and crouch, while holding light and medium weighted objects
  • Since we are all about teamwork, you may be asked to help other roles that have their own unique set of physical requirements.
  • Due to the physical and safety-sensitive nature of this job, you will be subject to a physical and expected to pass a drug screen during the pre-screen process. During employment, you’ll be subject to random drug and alcohol testing.

GROWTH & DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES

At POET, we encourage internal development and growth by allowing team members to carve their own path to success. Leaders support team members with the necessary resources to develop their skills, achieve goals, and create the most value. We believe in developing our team members to their highest potential and recognizing contributions that add value to the organization. Each new team member’s position and compensation are carefully determined by considering their unique qualifications and skillset.


BENEFITS

For eligible team members

  • Comprehensive benefits package: Individual and family plans for health, dental, & vision insurance, including a generous employer Health Savings Account contribution

  • Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses and Bi-Annual Incentive Bonuses

  • Competitive pay, including shift premium pay for qualifying positions

  • 401K with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays – 40 hours available on day ONE!

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Attractive Relocation Assistance and Bonus Programs for qualifying positions and/or locations


OTHER PERKS

For eligible team members

  • A multifaceted wellness program encompassing the whole person – mentally, physically, and spiritually

  • Onsite fitness centers or fitness reimbursements

  • Safety and cold weather gear reimbursements

  • Discounted home and auto insurance

POET is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, abilities, merit, and other legitimate business factors, without regard to any legally protected characteristic. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, working conditions, promotion, and termination.

title: Energy Project Coordinator
description:
Do you have an eye for detail? Do you pride yourself on your ability to prioritize and coordinate several moving pieces? Do you thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment?

You’re in the right place! We are hiring an Energy Project Coordinator to join our team serving Energy Trust of Oregon's Industry & Ag customers.

Key Details:

  • Location: Onboarding is 100% onsite in Portland; flexibility for a hybrid work arrangement may be available once fully onboarded. Relocation assistance is provided.
  • Pay: Full base pay range is $75,000 - $88,000 commensurate with skills and experience. Our target hiring range is at or below mid-point to allow for growth and internal equity. All positions are eligible for an annual bonus and profit share on top of base pay.
  • Benefits: Health, dental, vision, disability, FSA or HSA option, 401K with 4% match and profit sharing, annual cash performance bonus, paid vacation, paid sick time, paid floating holidays, parental leave, wellness reimbursement, home office stipend, and first-time homebuyers assistance.
  • Schedule: Full time; 40 hours per week; Monday-Friday

About Energy 350: The future is bright at Energy 350! We are an energy efficiency consulting firm located in Portland, OR. Energy 350 is a leader in energy efficiency programs, policy, research, evaluation, and engineering. At Energy 350, we care about our employees and prioritize a balanced work lifestyle. We look for fast learners who are highly motivated and mission driven to join us in our casual yet hard working environment where we value people for who they are and for their differences.

Position Overview: As an Energy Project Coordinator, you will serve as the quality control point between industrial customers, vendors, engineers, account managers, and our client. The Energy Project Coordinator reviews energy efficiency project applications and project deliverables to ensure forms and Excel-based tools are filled out completely and correctly, reports are grammatically sound, error-free, and formatting meets client’s expectations. The Energy Project Coordinator is responsible for troubleshooting any missing or inaccurate data on project forms and materials; this requires proactive phone and email communications with industrial customers, vendors, account managers, and engineers. The Energy Project Coordinator submits all project deliverables to our client through various channels and software programs, and inputs project data into project tracking and CRM systems at various project milestones. Additionally, the Energy Project Coordinator is responsible for monitoring phone lines, message lines, and email accounts and distributing customer inquiries in a timely matter. The Energy Project Coordinator position requires someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and skilled at prioritizing varied tasks.

A typical day may include:

  • Communicating with our client, customers, vendors, account managers, and engineers via phone, email, Microsoft Teams, and in-person.
  • Communicating with customers and vendors regarding project specifications or missing information.
  • Inputting data into our internal project tracking system as well as our client’s project tracking and customer relationship management (CRM) systems at each project stage, including: adding new project information, linking sites/accounts/contacts, creating and updating forecasts, generating project tracking codes, uploading documents, and queuing payments.
  • Regularly navigating Excel-based tools to track project and application details.
  • Reviewing project documents and deliverables to ensure they are complete, accurate, grammatically sound, and correctly formatted, and communicating needed clarifications to move the project forward.
  • Managing project dates and reaching out to customers, contractors, and account managers to communicate approaching deadlines and project statuses.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Software Engineer IV does more than identify that a system has a problem.

This individual can determine why the problem exists, identify which systems and technical domains are affected, develop a technically sound corrective solution, determine how the change should be tested, understand its cybersecurity and configuration implications, coordinate implementation with the appropriate engineering teams, validate the result after deployment, and document the technical decision so that it remains supportable throughout the system lifecycle.

The strongest candidate will be able to operate comfortably between software, infrastructure, databases, cybersecurity, configuration management, testing, and program leadership while maintaining the disciplined engineering practices required in a mission-critical Department of the Air Force environment.

Position Overview

Seeking a Senior Software Engineer IV to provide senior-level systems and software engineering support for the Department of the Air Force Financial Management enterprise. This is not a traditional application-development position focused solely on writing software. The Senior Software Engineer IV will operate within an integrated engineering environment supporting mission-critical Air Force financial systems, cybersecurity requirements, infrastructure, databases, development and test environments, configuration baselines, system modifications, deployment validation, and lifecycle sustainment. The engineer will work across technical domains to analyze system requirements and modifications, identify dependencies and risks, develop technically sound solutions, support implementation, conduct engineering verification and validation, and ensure that changes can be safely introduced into highly available Government environments. The successful candidate must be capable of looking beyond an individual application or technical component. The position requires an understanding of how software, infrastructure, databases, cybersecurity controls, configuration baselines, test environments, deployment processes, and mission requirements interact throughout the system lifecycle.

The position requires integrated enterprise lifecycle engineering encompassing infrastructure engineering, database engineering, system administration, database administration, and cybersecurity engineering to sustain, optimize, secure, and technically validate the FMWorkFlow environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Highly competitive candidates will possess several of the following:

  • Prior Department of the Air Force experience.
  • Prior DoD enterprise systems engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical or highly available systems.
  • Experience with Air Force Financial Management or comparable Government financial systems.
  • Experience supporting AFFSO, SAF/FM, AFIMSC, or related organizations.
  • Experience working in environments governed by RMF and formal authorization requirements.
  • Experience implementing or validating IAVA, TCNO, vulnerability-remediation, or comparable cybersecurity directives.
  • Experience with development/test and production environments governed by formal configuration controls.
  • Experience providing Level III engineering or technical escalation support.
  • Experience coordinating software, infrastructure, database, middleware, and cybersecurity engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting system modernization, lifecycle sustainment, or major technical upgrades.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or serving as a senior technical lead.
  • Experience briefing technical recommendations to Government program managers or leadership.

Security and Access Requirements

The successful candidate must:

  • Obtain and maintain the security and suitability determinations required for assigned duties.
  • Meet requirements established in the applicable DD254.
  • Obtain and maintain required Government system and installation access.
  • Satisfy background-investigation requirements applicable to assigned system privileges.
  • Obtain and properly safeguard any required Common Access Card or Restricted Area Badge.
  • Complete required Air Force Information Assurance Awareness Training before accessing applicable Government computing resources.
  • Comply with Air Force Instructions, Air Force System Security Instructions, Air Force security memoranda, and local installation security procedures.

  • Protect Government information, systems, equipment, credentials, and resources.

title: Electric Mobility Research Assistant
description:
Consultant as Electric Mobility Research Assistant - Cities and Transport Program


This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.



Program Overview

WRI Indonesia’s e-mobility portfolio focuses on reducing cities’ greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions through sustainable transportation and vehicle electrification, while working in parallel with energy and climate programs to green the electricity grid and maximize emission reductions. Our mission is to help cities and provinces implement low-carbon development, particularly in the transportation and energy sectors, to achieve economic, social, and environmental goals.

Zero-Emission Heavy-Duty Vehicle (HDV) Acceleration

Heavy-duty vehicles (HDVs) contribute 31.7% of GHG emissions from national land transport and are also a major contributor to air pollution. From an energy security perspective, national diesel consumption continues to increase, reaching 38.57 million kiloliters (KL) in 2024. Indonesia’s high reliance on diesel also exposes the transport sector to volatility in global oil prices, creating broader implications for national energy security. To address these environmental and energy challenges, the Government of Indonesia (GoI), through the National Energy Master Plan, has set ambitious targets for zero-emission vehicle (ZEV) adoption, including the electrification of heavy-duty vehicles such as public transport buses and trucks.

To address these fundamental barriers, WRI Indonesia is proposing a supply- and demand-side approach to accelerate ZEV adoption in the HDV sector in Indonesia. The goal of this project is to develop a policy framework and proof of concept for the National Green Logistics Corridor Initiative to accelerate freight decarbonization, which can simultaneously address supply- and demand-side barriers to HDV electrification. Through this strategic program, which will be co-implemented with key national ministries and private-sector stakeholders, WRI Indonesia seeks to engage an Electric Mobility Research Assistant to support technical analysis, research, and the development and monitoring of the National Green Logistics Corridor Initiative in Indonesia.

Job Highlight

The Electric Mobility Research Assistant will work closely with the Urban Mobility Team to conduct technical research and analysis on electric mobility. The role will focus on developing zero-emission transport solutions to support transport decarbonization and energy sovereignty through rigorous data collection, analysis, and model development. The Research Assistant will work with specialists and other analysts on the team to support knowledge development on electric mobility, particularly through the National Green Logistics Corridor Initiative to accelerate zero-emission HDV adoption and advance supply- and demand-side regulations.

The Electric Mobility Research Assistant will work under the direction and supervision of Electric Mobility Program Lead, with support from other specialists on the team. The position is based in Jakarta based in Jakarta with an office-flex working arrangement and travel as required. In support of WRI's DEI commitment, you are responsible for actively participating in these collaborative efforts by integrating equity into your work, our workplace, and the organizational culture.

What You Will Do

Technical Research and Analysis (80%)

  • Conduct technical research and analyses on electric mobility topics, including but not limited to electric mobility policies, zero-emission trucks, green logistics corridors, and supply-side regulations, using rigorous research methodologies (e.g., methodology design, data collection, modeling, and analysis).
  • Support the development of research on electric mobility policies through literature reviews, policy analysis, and the preparation of technical reports and presentations.
  • Support in preparing materials in the form of concept notes, presentations and/or talking points relevant to electric mobility analysis.
  • Support the development of knowledge product by providing research inputs and supporting materials to support WRI Indonesia’s role as a thought leader in the urban mobility portfolio.

Project Management (20%)

  • Support project implementation through administrative and coordination task, including procurement, TOR development, and travel planning, and maintenance of project documentation.
  • Support the organization and coordination of internal and external meetings, FGDs, workshops, conferences, and dissemination activities under the cities and transport portfolio.
  • Maintain regular coordination with the team regarding project updates, progress, and challenges, and support follow-up on agreed actions and deliverables

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in transportation, urban planning, civil engineering, economics, geography or any other related field.
  • Minimum 1 year of full-time work experience in transportation, with knowledge of and direct experience in electric mobility studies preferred.
  • Ability to support discrete elements of research projects with limited manager guidance, e.g. systematically reviewing, analyzing and synthesizing existing literature; collecting, cleaning, organizing, and visualizing data.
  • Ability to clearly document and communicate data collection, cleaning, and analysis processes to ensure transparency, reproducibility, and accessibility for team members and reviewers.
  • Highly organized and systematic with strong time management skills and ability to juggle competing priorities and deadlines required.
  • Business proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English on both verbal and written communications
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and across cross-sectoral issues.
  • Highly motivated, strong can-do attitude, proactive work style and excellent organizational skills and work ethic.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed
  • Legally able to work in Indonesia

Duration

15 October 2026 – 31 Maret 2027


Deliverables

1. A monthly consolidated report documenting progress against agreed deliverables, key achievement, challenges, and lesson learned.

2. All assigned research and analytical output including research reports, studies, presentations, analytical summaries, and supporting materials, are delivered in accordance with the agreed timeline

3. All assigned inputs, drafts, and final knowledge products outputs are completed and submitted in accordance with the agreed timeline.

4. Required project documentation and administrative outputs completed and submitted in accordance with applicable requirements

Terms of Payment

Daily rate-based consultant with a maximum of 108 (one hundred eight) working days for the whole contract period or 18 (eighteen) working days per month on average.



How to Apply:

  • Please submit a resume with a cover letter by 9 October 2026. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates.
  • Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position.
  • Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed.
  • This is a locally engaged position, Indonesian nationals are encouraged to apply.

What we offer:

  • Consultant rate that is commensurate with experience and skill.
  • Travel insurance for both domestic and international for any travel duty as assigned by WRI Indonesia
  • Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields.
  • A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work
  • The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI
  • Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours


About Us:

World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.


Our mission and values:

WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations.

Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership, and Care.


Our culture:

WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Our Human Resources Team carefully reviews all applications.

Trumling är en vanlig process inom metallindustrin där metallkomponenter bearbetas i roterande trummor tillsammans med exempelvis slip- eller polermedia. Processen används bland annat för att avgrada, rengöra, jämna till och ytbehandla detaljer innan de går vidare i produktionen.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Är driven, arbetsvillig och ansvarstagande
  • Har god fysik och trivs med ett fysiskt arbete
  • Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten
  • Har lätt för att samarbeta och fungerar bra i team
  • Har en positiv inställning och vilja att lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter
  • B-körkort är ett krav
  • Truckkort är meriterande

Arbetstid

Tjänsten är förlagd till 2-skift.

Vi erbjuder

Ett varierande och praktiskt arbete i en industriell miljö där du får möjlighet att utvecklas och bli en viktig del av ett engagerat team.

Låter detta som något för dig?

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Vi intervjuar kandidater löpande.

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Line Worker - Andrades-Carrillo
description:

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Removes bones with a knife and pulls off the extra fat with the hand or trims it with the knife.

  • Effectively communicate with all levels of employees.
  • Follow all company safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment.
  • Attend monthly or annual meetings and trainings as required.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor or lead

Essential Skills and Abilities:

  • Commitment to company values
  • Ability to comprehend and follow instructions
  • Ability to work in cool or warm temperatures
  • Ability to multitask and work quickly

  • Must be a team player and be willing to work close to other employees stations (less than 2 feet)

Work environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to weather conditions prevalent to the time. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. Often work in dusty, humid, and heated environments; as well as cold, moist environments.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer Hybrid
description:
Job Description

Who are we?

Humanforce’s vision is to make work easier and life better for frontline and flexible workforces.

Humanforce provides the market leading, best-in-one human capital management (HCM) suite for frontline and flexible workforces - without compromise. Our employee centred, intelligent and compliant HCM suite is highly integrated and composable, and consists of Workforce Management (WFM), HR, Talent, Payroll, and Wellbeing.

Humanforce has built strong foundations since its founding in 2002. We help over 2300 customers and almost 1 million employees under management in 30+ countries, across a wide range of industries, including aged, child and health care; education; hospitality; retail; local government and more. Today, we have offices across Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom, North America and the Philippines.

Customers choose Humanforce because we enable them to deliver an exceptional employee experience, build a compelling employee value proposition, and connect the flow of the world’s talent with the growth, productivity and efficiency objectives of frontline and flexible workforces.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our growing product and engineering team. This is an opportunity to work across the full software development lifecycle, contributing to modern, scalable products used by organisations around the world. You will play an important role in designing, building and improving customer-focused solutions across both backend and frontend technologies.

You will work with a collaborative team of engineers, product managers, designers and other specialists. You will bring strong technical capability, sound engineering judgement and a genuine interest in solving complex problems in a practical, customer-focused way.

What you will do
  • Design, build, test and maintain high-quality full stack software solutions.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using .NET and related technologies.
  • Build responsive, intuitive user experiences using the frontend technologies and practices used by the team.
  • Contribute to technical design, architecture and engineering standards.
  • Work closely with Product, Design and other engineering teams to deliver valuable customer outcomes, while constructively challenging assumptions and negotiating practical scope where needed.
  • Translate business and customer needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Take ownership of work from discovery and estimation through to delivery and ongoing improvement, proactively looking beyond assigned tickets to identify and investigate opportunities to improve the product.
  • Adopt a testing-first mindset by writing, running and updating appropriate automated tests alongside code changes, validating behaviour before changes are released, and keeping test coverage and regression protection current as the system evolves.
  • Identify and address performance, scalability, reliability and security considerations.
  • Participate in code reviews and support a culture of clean, maintainable code.
  • Mentor and support the development of other engineers, helping to build an engaged, accountable and collaborative team.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues when required.
  • Be inquisitive about how the product and team work, challenge “this is how it’s always been” when appropriate, and have the courage to propose and help deliver meaningful changes to practices, tooling and ways of working.
  • Explore and responsibly apply AI tools to improve development efficiency, quality and problem-solving.
What we are looking for
  • Significant experience in full stack software engineering within a commercial product or SaaS environment.
  • Strong experience developing applications using .NET and C#.
  • Strong experience building user interfaces using the frontend technologies relevant to the team’s product, together with a solid understanding of modern frontend practices.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with relational databases.
  • Understanding of cloud platforms, automated testing, CI/CD and modern software delivery practices.
  • A testing-first mindset and practical experience writing, maintaining and improving automated tests appropriate to the change, such as unit, integration, API or end-to-end tests.
  • A strong sense of ownership for the quality, testability and maintainability of your changes.
  • Experience working with agile product and engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, engineering patterns and development lifecycle practices.
  • A track record of delivering reliable, maintainable and scalable software.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the ability to negotiate requirements and manage expectations constructively with Product.
  • Experience mentoring or leading other engineers, with the ability to support team engagement, accountability and development.
  • A genuinely inquisitive, ambitious and proactive mindset: someone who wants to understand the product, customers and underlying problems, actively looks for improvements, and has the courage to challenge established ways of working and make changes.
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development and AI-enabled product experiences.
Our values
  • We are bold
  • We are all in
  • We are customer obsessed
  • We do what we say
  • We are good humans
Our approach to flexibility

We are passionate about people making their own decisions about where and when they work. Our hybrid model of minimum two days a week of in office moments supports flexibility tailored to individual and team needs, empowering people to achieve their career and personal goals.

Benefits
  • A truly flexible workplace through our Flex@HF approach
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing global tech company
  • A focus on learning and development through Humanforce HR
  • A generous talent referral program – know great people, be rewarded
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers, 4 weeks’ for secondary
  • 4 extra days leave to focus on your wellbeing
  • Contemporary and practical Employee Assistance Program
  • A cool reward and recognition program – shout to your colleagues and earn points to spend
  • Access to our own financial wellbeing platform Thrive – including earned wage access, tools to budget and save, perks and cashback across 100s of Australian retailers
  • Fun, collaborative culture with passionate people
  • A workplace where you can genuinely improve the world of work!

We are a diverse and dispersed organisation and are actively looking to grow our team with individuals from all diverse backgrounds. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, ages, genders, neurodiversity, religions, sexual orientations, and experiences to apply.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Functieomschrijving

Kandidaten dienen de tijd te nemen om alle onderdelen van deze vacature zorgvuldig te lezen. Gelieve snel te solliciteren.
Als Platform Engineer heb je ervaring met operations, automatisering en software development. Met die kennis help jij teams om hun werk zo goed mogelijk te laten landen op het cloud native platform.

Jouw functie als Platform Engineer:

Als Platform Engineer werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten van meerdere klanten. Je werkt vanuit kantoor, vanuit huis of een paar dagen in de week bij de klant op visite. Wat doet een Platform Engineer hoor je wel eens, maar de vraag is eerder wat doet hij/zij niet? De Platform Engineer vult de grote leegte tussen een blanco cloud, container of CI/CD omgeving en de functionaliteit die DevOps team nodig heeft voor het voortbrengen van software. Je helpt de organisatie graag met alle tooling omtrent CI en CD met in het achterhoofd standaardisatie voor een voorspelbaar cloud landschap. Je hebt dan ook een brede ervaring met automation en scripting in moderne container en public cloud omgevingen. Metrieken zijn jouw vriend en helpen je om pro-actief te acteren. Jouw interesse stopt niet bij een platform, maar je ademt DevOps en wilt het verschil maken bij succesvolle implementaties. Precies daarom hebben we jou graag in ons team. En aangezien je zelf een vakidioot bent, werk jij ook graag samen met andere vakidioten.

Wat bieden wij jou:

  • Een salaris van tussen de €3.600,- en €6.000,- o.b.v. 40 uur aangevuld met bonussysteem, afhankelijk van jouw achtergrond en ervaring

  • Een omgeving waarin het hybride werken compleet omarmd wordt

  • Duik in moderne projecten en opdrachten die jouw expertise en creativiteit uitdagen

  • Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën en initiatieven worden gewaardeerd en gestimuleerd

  • Technische trainingen op maat met certificaten die jouw expertise onderstrepen

  • Persoonlijk loopbaantraject, met alle ruimte om je eigen carrière pad te bewandelen

  • Samenwerking met ervaren collega’s in data, cloud en security

Wat vragen wij van jou:

  • Een afgeronde hbo of wo opleiding, of autodidact met de juiste werkervaring

  • Goede zelfkennis, weten wat je kunt en vooral ook wat je niet kunt

  • Sterke affiniteit met techniek

  • Analytisch denkvermogen

  • Kritisch op kwaliteit, maar waar nodig pragmatisch

  • Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden, we praten graag

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal

Verder heb je:

  • Container technieken (bijv. Docker, OCI, Kubernetes, Openshift)

  • Infra-as-code (bijv. Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation)

  • Scripting (bijv. shell, Python)

  • CI/CD is voor jou gesneden koek (bijv. delivery pipelines, Argo, Helm, Kustomize)

  • GitOps concepten zoals CI, CD, Helm, Kustomize, YAML etc

  • Observability (bijvoorbeeld Elastic, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos)

  • Data persistency met de gebruikelijke relationele en NoSQL databases

  • Je kunt uiteraard de weg vinden binnen Linux

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal

Bovenstaande criteria zijn een indicatie van het profiel dat we zoeken. We beseffen dat elk individu een unieke set aan vaardigheden, expertise, skills en denkwijzen met zich meebrengt. Tegelijkertijd blijkt uit onderzoek dat sommigen pas solliciteren als er een 100% match is. Hierbij nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren als je je herkent in het profiel, óók als je niet aan alle eisen voldoet! Aanvullende trainingen om jouw kennis te vergroten investeren wij graag in.

Het team

Naast dat jij de juiste skills en interesses hebt, vinden we het belangrijk dat je past in het team. Wij zoeken iemand die het fijn vindt om in een hechte en fijne sfeer bezig te zijn met zijn of haar passie. Deze passie heeft bij iedereen een andere uiting. De een is wild van Cloud, de ander is gek van Development of Integratie. Een andere groep zit met smart te wachten op datasets waar ingedoken kan worden. Ons uitgangspunt is dat jij je goed moet voelen in wat je doet en met wie je werkt. Alleen dan kunnen wij als kennisclub namelijk de kwaliteit leveren die we beloven.

Ons kennisarsenaal is onderverdeeld in drie elkaar overlappende disciplines: Integratie & API, Applicatie Modernisatie en Data Driven. Binnen deze specialismen wordt er voortdurend verkennend gekeken naar de nieuwste en natuurlijk coolste technologieën. xrurlwr Directe en nauwe samenwerking onderling is ook hierin ‘a way of life’.

title: Patient Experience Business Designer
description:
The Position

Public Affairs & Access (PAA) is a multi-disciplinary organization that includes Corporate Communications; Policy, Evidence & Access Strategy; Channel & Contract Management; External Affairs; Patient Experience; and Strategy and Business Operations. Our purpose is to deliver impact through a fully integrated public affairs function that leverages our capabilities and world-class Genentech brand to deliver on our mission for patients and our employees.


Patient Strategy aims to create a holistic, cross-functional approach to deliver a best-in-class patient experience that aligns with the portfolio, technology tools, and consumer-driven patient expectations in a rapidly evolving business landscape.


The Opportunity

As a Patient Experience (PX) Business Designer, you will evaluate the commercial viability and financial scalability of patient experience concepts designed across our portfolio. In doing so, you will bridge the gap between creative design and business execution to maximize patient impact by transforming complex healthcare navigation into frictionless, patient-first solutions that ensure every innovation translates into tangible value for those we serve.

  • Apply strategic frameworks to assess opportunity spaces and potential patient experience concepts, providing a clear business lens to support patient opportunity prioritization.
  • Define patient outcome metrics (e.g., time to therapy, persistence, patient-reported experience) alongside commercial KPIs to prioritize concepts with the greatest patient benefit.
  • Translate patient experience concepts into rigorous commercial and financial models to evaluate cost structures, revenue potential, KPIs, and long-term viability.
  • Identify and articulate both financial and non-financial value drivers (e.g., adherence, brand differentiation, ecosystem positioning) to guide design trade-off decisions.
  • Quantify risks and sensitivity scenarios using discovery-driven planning to build phased investment models for future-state patient solutions.
  • Inform the business architecture underpinning patient programs, including vendor strategy, funding models, and value realization tracking.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Data, Digital, & Analytics, RDT, Activation & Capabilities Enablement, Experience Design teams to provide budget inputs and recommendations on scale, pivot, or sunset calls.

Who You Are

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, public health, or a related discipline.
  • Bring 4-7 years of professional experience, preferably in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or healthcare setting.
  • Demonstrate strong financial modeling, value case development, and scenario/risk analysis capabilities.
  • Possess strong presentation and executive communication skills with an ability to translate technical data into strategic insights.
  • Show proven ability to connect patient outcomes and experience metrics directly to enterprise value and KPI frameworks.

Preferred Experience

  • Advanced degree in business or quantitative field (i.e. MBA, MPH)
  • Experience applying human-centered design principles or working alongside experienced design/innovation teams.
  • Familiarity with healthcare access pathways, reimbursement models, and digital health technology trends.

Location

  • This role is based in South San Francisco and offers a hybrid schedule working 3 days per week on campus
  • No relocation benefits are available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $130,800 - $243,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. title: Senior Director, Field Program Integrity
description:
Job Title: Senior Program Director

Location:U.S. Remote

Reports to:VP, Field Programs

WHO WE ARE

Fueled by passion and urgency, the National Kidney Foundation is a lifeline for all people affected by kidney disease. As pioneers of scientific research and innovation, NKF focuses on the whole patient through the lens of kidney health. Relentless in our work, we enhance lives through action, education, and accelerating change.

WHAT WE BELIEVE IN

NKF’s Mission is what we do, our Values are how we do it.

  • Accountability- Earn and Keep Trust
  • Collaboration-Work as a team
  • Communication- Empower with information
  • Community-Build stronger community
  • Compassion- Lead with care and respect
  • Impact-Focus on the mission

Your Voice Matters:

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Reporting to the Vice President of Field Programs, the Senior Program Director will oversee the strategy, standardization, technical assistance, and evaluation of local programming to maximize impact within the communities served. This position will lead discussions on program adaptations, inform recommendations of program improvements, and develop innovative concepts to drive our success measures.

The Senior Program Director will serve as the subject matter expert for program implementation. Assigned programs will require data informed adaptations, quality measure review, alignment with Program Strategic Framework, and impact dissemination.

The Senior Program Director will work closely with field program staff to provide support and technical assistance to achieve programmatic and revenue goals. Serving as a two-way conduit between the field and National, this role bridges local implementation with national expertise. Success depends on the ability to lead as a national resource and to influence outcomes without direct authority, operating with the strength, clarity, and credibility to move field partners toward shared goals.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert in the implementation of assigned programs. Subject Matter Experts are responsible for providing technical assistance, identifying emerging issues and solutions, and utilization of public health best practices. Guide field teams on where programs may be adapted to local context versus where model fidelity and standardization must be preserved, exercising clear decision rights over program adaptations
  • Create and maintain strategic partnerships with community-based organizations to build enduring relationships at the local level
  • Develop and analyze local needs assessment that identifies gaps and opportunities in the market with a focus on health equity, including social determinants of health, and kidney disease-related care quality, using both quantitative and qualitative data points to inform future program design and/or strategic market goals
  • Responsible for the creation and maintenance of assigned program’s implementation guide, budget guidelines, and calendar
  • Responsible for the management of an internal workgroup for each identified program
  • Produce outcomes and impact reports and provide feedback to relevant leadership
  • Collaborate across multiple departments at the HQ and local level to ensure programmatic success
  • Develop and disseminate program communications, field-facing toolkits, and technical guidance; maintain a regular communication cadence that keeps field teams current on program updates, best practices, and available resources
  • Serve as the program’s data steward in Salesforce, ensuring accurate and consistent data entry, alignment, and integrity across field offices, and translating program data into impact reporting that is disseminated to field and national stakeholders
  • Lead and mobilize cross-functional program workgroups to drive execution and alignment across field and national partners, demonstrating influence without direct authority
  • Identify non-industry revenue opportunities for program funding
  • Support development teams in meeting participation and concept creation for programs assigned
  • Perform additional duties, as required

WHAT YOU’LL POSSESS

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university. Masters in health-related or social services field, preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in health-related program delivery, public health initiatives, or community engagement
  • Experience building and maintaining partnership relationships, ideally in healthcare and/or public health
  • Project management experience, including managing and developing project budgets, event logistics, establishing priorities, meeting deadlines, and functioning independently and as part of a team
  • Volunteer management skills, ideally with healthcare or other professionals
  • Superior interpersonal, communication, time management and organizational skills
  • Flexible and adept at troubleshooting when things don’t go as planned
  • Experience with data/basic statistical analysis required
  • Comfortable learning and using multiple software platforms daily including but not limited to Microsoft Office, Zoom meeting/webinar, Salesforce, Smartsheet, Branding UI. Demonstrated proficiency with Salesforce (or a comparable CRM/data platform) for program tracking, data management, and impact reporting is required
  • Experience in grant proposal writing and securing funding opportunities through new grants, preferred

Competencies:

  • Accountability: Takes ownership of program outcomes and holds field and national partners mutually accountable to shared commitments, standards, and timelines.
  • Change Leadership: Champions program adaptations and process improvements, guiding field teams through change and building buy-in for new or evolving program models
  • Collaboration: Leads collaborative efforts across the organization, bi-directionally, ensuring that departments work together to achieve strategic objectives. Actively builds partnerships with external stakeholders to advance mission
  • Cultural Humility: Promotes cultural humility across departments, ensuring that programs, policies, and services reflect a deep understanding of and respect for cultural diversity
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Results Orientation: Leverages accurate program data—primarily through Salesforce to assess impact, inform program adaptations, and set clear performance targets, ensuring assigned programs deliver on their intended outcomes
  • Diversity, Equity and Inclusion For All (DEI 4A): Drives organizational DEI initiatives, ensuring that policies, programs, and services are designed with an equity lens for all. Champions efforts to promote diversity and inclusion in decision-making and ensures that underserved communities have access to NKF’s programs

  • Operational Excellence: Drives consistent, high-quality program implementation across field offices, standardizing tools and processes to elevate performance
